en: The International Labour Organization says the number of people without jobs is increasing. (13 words)
cn: 国际劳工组织表示，失业人数正在增加。

en: In its latest update on global employment trends, the agency says projections of the number of unemployed people this year range from 210 million to nearly 240 million people. (25 words)
cn: 该机构在其对全球就业趋势的最新更新中表示，今年失业人数的预测范围在2.1亿到近2.4亿之间。

en: The report warns that 200 million poor workers are at risk of joining the ranks of people living on less than two dollars per day in the past three years. (27 words)
cn: 报告警告说，过去三年中，有2亿贫困工人面临加入每天生活费不足两美元行列的风险。

en: The Director-General of the International Labour Organization Juan Somavia notes that some countries have taken measures to address the effects of the global crisis. (23 words)
cn: 国际劳工组织总干事胡安·索马维亚指出，一些国家已采取措施应对全球危机的影响。

en: However, he points out that many countries have not done so. (11 words)
cn: 然而，他指出许多国家尚未这样做。

en: And based on past experiences, it takes four to five years after economic recovery for unemployment to return to pre-crisis levels. (22 words)
cn: 根据以往经验，经济复苏后需要四到五年时间失业率才能恢复到危机前水平。

en: Mr. Somavia says the International Labour Organization is proposing a global job's agreement to deal with unemployment. (17 words)
cn: 索马维亚先生说，国际劳工组织正在提议一项全球就业协议来解决失业问题。

en: It's key objective is to place at the center of recovery efforts, measures that would generate higher levels of employment and provide basic social protection for the most vulnerable. (27 words)
cn: 其关键目标是将能够产生更高就业水平并为最脆弱群体提供基本社会保护的措施置于复苏努力的中心。

en: Big fast food chains in New York City have started to obey a first-of-its-kind rule requiring them to post calorie counts right on the menu. (25 words)
cn: 纽约市的大型快餐连锁店已开始遵守一项前所未有的规定，要求它们在菜单上直接标注卡路里含量。

en: Cathy Nonas is with the New York City Department of Health. (11 words)
cn: 凯西·诺纳斯就职于纽约市卫生局。

en: We wanted to give people an opportunity to actually see the calories before they purchase the food and make a decision, an informed decision that if they want to make the healthier choice, if they want to eat fewer calories, they can. (40 words)
cn: 我们希望给人们一个机会，在购买食物之前实际看到卡路里含量，从而做出明智的决定——如果他们想选择更健康的食品，想摄入更少的卡路里，他们可以做到。

en: And we expect this will have a huge impact on obesity. (12 words)
cn: 我们预计这将对肥胖问题产生巨大影响。

en: And of course, if it has an impact on obesity, it will have an impact on diabetes and heart disease and high blood pressure. (24 words)
cn: 当然，如果它对肥胖有影响，那么它也会对糖尿病、心脏病和高血压产生影响。

en: The new rules were introduced as part of an anti-obesity campaign that also includes a recent citywide ban on artificial trans-fats in restaurant food. (25 words)
cn: 这些新规定是作为反肥胖运动的一部分推出的，该运动还包括最近在全市范围内禁止餐馆食品中使用人工反式脂肪。

en: The menu rule only applies to restaurants that serve standardised portion sizes and have fifteen or more locations nationwide. (19 words)
cn: 菜单规定仅适用于提供标准化份量且在全国拥有15家或以上分店的餐馆。

en: Starting last Saturday, chains big enough to fall under the rule will face penalties of up to 2 000 dollars for not showing calorie information in a prominent spot on their menus, preferably next to the price. (35 words)
cn: 从上周六开始，规模足够大的连锁店若不按规定在菜单显著位置（最好是价格旁边）标注卡路里信息，将面临最高2000美元的罚款。

en: Almost all companies recognize the importance of innovation today, but not many are able to integrate innovation into their business. (18 words)
cn: 如今几乎所有公司都认识到创新的重要性，但很少有公司能够将创新融入其业务中。

en: A commentary in the Shanghai Daily points out that innovation doesn't mean piles of documents. (15 words)
cn: 《上海日报》的一则评论指出，创新并不意味着成堆的文件。

en: It is something more practical. (5 words)
cn: 它更注重实践。

en: The article says many people tend to assume that innovation just means creating something new, but actually it's more than that. (20 words)
cn: 文章说，许多人倾向于认为创新就是创造新事物，但实际上远不止如此。

en: It's an attitude of doing things. (6 words)
cn: 它是一种做事的态度。

en: A company should find ways to innovate not just in products but also in functions, business models and processes. (19 words)
cn: 公司应该找到创新的方法，不仅在产品上，还要在功能、商业模式和流程上创新。

en: The article cites the global giant Procter & Gamble as an example, saying a real innovative company should develop an innovation culture and use it as a primary tool for success. (28 words)
cn: 文章援引全球巨头宝洁公司为例，称一家真正创新的公司应该发展创新文化，并将其作为成功的主要工具。

en: Procter & Gamble has a 'Corporate Innovation Fund' which offers big rewards for high-risk ideas that succeed. (18 words)
cn: 宝洁公司设有‘企业创新基金’，为成功的高风险创意提供丰厚奖励。

en: It also has a special innovation facility for its employees. (11 words)
cn: 它还为员工设有专门的创新设施。

en: Sometimes its employees are released from their daily jobs for weeks and spend their time interacting in the innovation facility instead. (20 words)
cn: 有时员工会从日常工作中脱身数周，转而在创新设施中互动交流。

en: In conclusion, the article says innovative ideas alone do not ensure success. (12 words)
cn: 总之，文章称仅靠创新想法并不能确保成功。

en: It's pointless unless there is a repeatable process in place to turn inspiration into financial performance. (17 words)
cn: 除非有可重复的流程将灵感转化为财务业绩，否则毫无意义。

en: So, Lyndsay, do you like to text message on your cell phone? (12 words)
cn: 那么，林赛，你喜欢用手机发短信吗？

en: Yeah, I text message a lot. (6 words)
cn: 是的，我经常发短信。

en: I don't do it so much. (6 words)
cn: 我不太常发短信。

en: I prefer to make a call if I'm in a hurry. (12 words)
cn: 如果赶时间，我更倾向于打电话。

en: Yeah, I go both ways. (6 words)
cn: 是的，我两种方式都用。

en: Sometimes I don't really want to talk to the person. (11 words)
cn: 有时我并不真的想和对方说话。

en: I just want to ask them one question, so it's much easier for me just to text message. (18 words)
cn: 我只想问他们一个问题，所以发短信对我来说容易得多。

en: If I call them, I'll have to have a long conversation. (13 words)
cn: 如果我打电话，就得进行长时间的谈话。

en: Yeah, I can see what you mean. (8 words)
cn: 是的，我明白你的意思。

en: But I get off the phone pretty quickly when I call. (12 words)
cn: 但我打电话时很快就会挂断。

en: I'm not a big talker. (6 words)
cn: 我不是个话多的人。

en: Yeah, that's true. (4 words)
cn: 是的，确实如此。

en: You don't talk a lot. (5 words)
cn: 你话不多。

en: So are you fast at writing the messages with your thumb? (12 words)
cn: 那么你用拇指写信息快吗？

en: Well, when I first got a cell phone, I was so slow. (13 words)
cn: 嗯，我刚有手机时，动作很慢。

en: I thought I would never text message. (7 words)
cn: 我以为我永远不会发短信。

en: But then people kept text messaging me, so I felt obliged to learn how to text message. (18 words)
cn: 但后来人们一直给我发短信，所以我感到有必要学习如何发短信。

en: So now I'm pretty fast. (5 words)
cn: 所以现在我的速度相当快。

en: What about you? (3 words)
cn: 你呢？

en: Actually I have the opposite problem. (6 words)
cn: 实际上我有相反的问题。

en: When I first got my cell phone, I thought it was so cool to text message all my friends who have one, and I was pretty fast with my thumb then. (28 words)
cn: 我刚有手机时，觉得给所有有手机的朋友发短信很酷，那时我的拇指动作也很快。

en: But it seems like now I don't use it so much. (11 words)
cn: 但似乎现在我不太用了。

en: I've gotten slower actually. (4 words)
cn: 实际上我变慢了。

en: What? (1 word)
cn: 什么？

en: He said he'd never text message. (7 words)
cn: 他说他从不发短信。

en: He thinks it's very childish and unprofessional to text message. (10 words)
cn: 他认为发短信非常幼稚且不专业。

en: Yeah, I can see what he means. (8 words)
cn: 是的，我明白他的意思。

en: It's considered pretty informal to text message someone. (8 words)
cn: 给某人发短信被认为是很不正式的。

en: Good morning, Mr. Johnson. (4 words)
cn: 早上好，约翰逊先生。

en: How can I help you? (5 words)
cn: 我能为您做些什么？

en: Well, I'd like to talk to you about Tim Bond, the department manager. (15 words)
cn: 嗯，我想和您谈谈部门经理蒂姆·邦德。

en: What seems to be the problem? (6 words)
cn: 有什么问题吗？

en: Well, ever since Sandra left the department, I feel like I've been targeted to do all her work as well as mine. (22 words)
cn: 嗯，自从桑德拉离开部门后，我觉得自己成了目标，要做她所有的工作以及我自己的。

en: I'm expected to attend too many meetings and I seem to be spending a lot of my time doing unnecessary paperwork. (20 words)
cn: 我被要求参加太多会议，而且似乎花了很多时间做不必要的文书工作。

en: I'm sorry to hear that. (6 words)
cn: 听到这个消息我很难过。

en: And, on top of that, I'd specifically asked if I could leave early last Friday as I'd done a lot of overtime during the week. (27 words)
cn: 而且，最重要的是，我上周五特别问过是否可以早退，因为我那周加了很多班。

en: But that afternoon, even though I'd finished my assigned work. (11 words)
cn: 但那天下午，即使我已经完成了分配的工作。

en: I was told to help other colleagues finish their work, too. (12 words)
cn: 我还被告知要帮助其他同事完成他们的工作。

en: But surely that's a positive sign showing that Mr. Bond has a lot of trust in you. (18 words)
cn: 但这肯定是一个积极的信号，表明邦德先生非常信任你。

en: Yes, but other colleagues get to leave early, and they don't have such a lot of work to do. (20 words)
cn: 是的，但其他同事可以早走，而且他们没有那么多工作要做。

en: So you feel he's been making unrealistic demands on you? (12 words)
cn: 所以你感觉他对你提出了不切实际的要求？

en: Yes, absolutely. (3 words)
cn: 是的，完全正确。

en: Have you approached Mr. Bond about this particular problem? (11 words)
cn: 你就这个具体问题找过邦德先生吗？

en: I've tried, but it seems like he just has no time for me. (14 words)
cn: 我试过，但似乎他根本没有时间理我。

en: Well, at this stage, it would be better if you approached him directly. (16 words)
cn: 嗯，在这个阶段，如果你直接去找他，会更好。

en: If nothing else, showing that you've tried to solve the problem yourself, before you take it further, makes it clear that you're not just a complainer. (28 words)
cn: 至少，在进一步行动之前，表明你已经尝试自己解决问题，这能清楚说明你不仅仅是一个抱怨者。

en: Why don't you send an email requesting a meeting with him in private? (16 words)
cn: 为什么不发一封邮件，要求与他私下会面呢？

en: Hmm, I'd be a bit worried about his reaction. (10 words)
cn: 嗯，我有点担心他的反应。

en: But anyway I'll send him an email to request a meeting, and I'll see what happens from there. (20 words)
cn: 但不管怎样，我会给他发邮件要求会面，然后看看情况如何。

en: Thanks for your advice. (4 words)
cn: 谢谢您的建议。

en: Good luck. (2 words)
cn: 祝你好运。

en: And let us know the outcome. (6 words)
cn: 并让我们知道结果。

en: The massive decline in sleep happened so slowly and quietly that few seemed to notice the trend. (18 words)
cn: 睡眠的大幅下降发生得如此缓慢和安静，以至于似乎很少有人注意到这一趋势。

en: Was it because of the growing attraction of the Internet, video games and endless TV channels? (17 words)
cn: 是因为互联网、电子游戏和无穷无尽的电视频道日益增长的吸引力吗？

en: Never disconnecting from work? (4 words)
cn: 从不脱离工作？

en: No matter how it happened, millions of Americans are putting their health, quality of life and even length of life in danger. (22 words)
cn: 无论它是如何发生的，数百万美国人正在将他们的健康、生活质量甚至寿命置于危险之中。

en: New evidence shows why getting enough sleep is a top priority. (13 words)
cn: 新的证据表明为什么获得充足睡眠是头等大事。

en: Some 40% of Americans get less than seven hours of shut-eye on weeknights. (14 words)
cn: 约40%的美国人在工作日晚上睡眠不足七小时。

en: The link between sleep and health, and bad sleep and disease is becoming clearer and clearer, says Lawrence Epstein, a sleep expert at Harvard University. (26 words)
cn: 哈佛大学睡眠专家劳伦斯·爱泼斯坦说，睡眠与健康、不良睡眠与疾病之间的联系正变得越来越清晰。

en: For example, sleep duration has declined from some eight hours in the 1950s to seven in recent years. (19 words)
cn: 例如，睡眠时间已从20世纪50年代的约8小时下降到近几年的7小时。

en: At the same time, high blood pressure has become an increasing problem. (14 words)
cn: 与此同时，高血压已成为一个日益严重的问题。

en: Blood pressure and heart rate are typically at their lowest levels during sleep. (14 words)
cn: 血压和心率通常在睡眠期间处于最低水平。

en: People who sleep less tend to have higher blood pressure, heart attack, diabetes, weight gain and other problems. (21 words)
cn: 睡眠较少的人往往有更高的血压、心脏病、糖尿病、体重增加和其他问题。

en: Sleeping better may help fight off illness. (6 words)
cn: 睡得更好可能有助于抵御疾病。

en: When people are sleep-deprived, there are higher levels of stress hormones in their bodies, which can decrease immune function, says Doctor Felice of Northwestern University in Chicago. (27 words)
cn: 芝加哥西北大学的费利斯医生说，当人们睡眠不足时，体内压力激素水平会升高，这会降低免疫功能。

en: A university of Chicago study shows people who sleep well live longer. (14 words)
cn: 芝加哥大学的一项研究表明，睡得好的人寿命更长。

en: So say good night sooner and it may help you stay active and vital to a ripe old age. (19 words)
cn: 所以早点说晚安，它可能帮助您保持活力，活到高龄。

en: Parents and teachers will tell you not to worry when applying for a place at university, but in the same breath we'll remind you that it is the most important decision of your life. (31 words)
cn: 父母和老师会告诉你申请大学名额时不要担心，但同时也会提醒你，这是你一生中最重要的决定。

en: The first decision is your choice of course. (8 words)
cn: 首要决定是选择课程。

en: It will depend on what you want to get out of university, what you are good at and what you enjoy. (22 words)
cn: 这将取决于你想从大学得到什么，你擅长什么以及你喜欢什么。

en: The next decision is where to apply. (8 words)
cn: 下一个决定是申请哪里。

en: Aim high but within reason. (6 words)
cn: 目标要高但要合理。

en: Do you have the right combination of subjects and are your expected grades likely to meet entry requirements? (21 words)
cn: 你的科目组合是否正确，你的预期成绩是否可能达到入学要求？

en: The deadline is January 15th. (6 words)
cn: 截止日期是1月15日。

en: But it is best to submit your application early because universities begin work as soon as forms start rolling in. (21 words)
cn: 但最好尽早提交申请，因为大学一收到申请表就开始处理。

en: The most important part of the application is the much feared personal statement. (15 words)
cn: 申请最重要的部分是令人畏惧的个人陈述。

en: This is your chance to convey boundless enthusiasm for the subject. (13 words)
cn: 这是你表达对学科无限热情的机会。

en: So economy of expression is foremost. (7 words)
cn: 所以表达简洁最为重要。

en: Omit dull and ineffective generalities and make sure you give concrete examples. (16 words)
cn: 省略枯燥无效的泛泛之谈，确保给出具体例子。

en: Admissions officers read every personal statement that arrives. (9 words)
cn: 招生官员会阅读每一份收到的个人陈述。

en: It is not convincing if you say you have chosen the subject because you enjoy it. (19 words)
cn: 如果你说你选择这门学科是因为你喜欢，那没有说服力。

en: You have to get across what it is about a particular area that has inspired you. (20 words)
cn: 你必须传达出该学科的某个特定方面是如何启发你的。

en: They will look for evidence that you have reflected and thought about the subject. (18 words)
cn: 他们会寻找你对该学科进行过反思和思考的证据。

en: Applicants should be honest. (4 words)
cn: 申请者应该诚实。

en: There is no point saying you run marathons if you are going to be out of breath arriving at the interview on the second floor. (27 words)
cn: 如果你爬到二楼面试就气喘吁吁，那说你跑马拉松就没有意义了。

en: It is usually agreed that a German, Carl Benz, built the first motor car in 1885. (17 words)
cn: 人们普遍认为，德国人卡尔·本茨于1885年制造了第一辆汽车。

en: It was actually a tricycle with a petrol motor at the rear. (13 words)
cn: 它实际上是一辆后置汽油发动机的三轮车。

en: Soon, members of the Royal family and other wealthy people took up motoring as a sport. (17 words)
cn: 很快，王室成员和其他富人开始将驾车视为一种运动。

en: Many of the early cars had two seats. (9 words)
cn: 许多早期汽车只有两个座位。

en: There were no petrol pumps and few garages, so every driver had to be his own engineer for the frequent breakdowns. (23 words)
cn: 当时没有加油站，修理厂也很少，所以每个司机都必须是自己的工程师，以应对频繁的故障。

en: By 1905, cars began to look like cars of today, with headlamps, windscreen, rubber tyres and number plates. (20 words)
cn: 到1905年，汽车开始看起来像今天的汽车，配有前灯、挡风玻璃、橡胶轮胎和车牌。

en: Henry Ford's Model T introduced in America in 1909 was cheaper because it was made on the assembly line. (21 words)
cn: 亨利·福特的T型车于1909年在美国推出，由于采用流水线生产，价格更便宜。

en: It brought cars closer towards the reach of ordinary people. (11 words)
cn: 它使汽车更接近普通人的购买力。

en: With the popularity of the car, registration became a must in 1903 with the Motor Car Act. (19 words)
cn: 随着汽车的普及，1903年的《汽车法案》规定必须进行车辆登记。

en: Competency tests were introduced in 1935. (8 words)
cn: 1935年引入了驾驶能力测试。

en: Today, the legal driving age for a car in the UK is 17. (15 words)
cn: 如今，英国合法驾驶汽车的年龄是17岁。

en: You are not allowed to drive a car unsupervised until you have passed a driving test. (19 words)
cn: 在通过驾驶考试之前，不允许无人监督驾驶汽车。

en: In 1958, Britain celebrated the opening of its first motorway—the Preston Bypass. (16 words)
cn: 1958年，英国庆祝了第一条高速公路——普雷斯顿绕道的开通。

en: Until then, no one really understood what a motorway was, not even the laborers who were building it. (21 words)
cn: 在那之前，没有人真正了解高速公路是什么，就连建造它的工人们也不清楚。

en: The bypass hailed a new era in motor travel and was greeted with excitement and optimism. (20 words)
cn: 这条绕道开启了汽车旅行的新时代，人们以兴奋和乐观的态度迎接它。

en: Service stations came with the motorway and the legend of the transport cafe was born. (18 words)
cn: 服务站随着高速公路而来，公路咖啡馆的传奇也随之诞生。

en: Of course, the service station has diversified greatly. (9 words)
cn: 当然，服务站已经大大多样化。

en: But whether it's an English-cooked breakfast or a coffee and a sandwich, one thing has remained the same: the prices. (23 words)
cn: 但无论是英式早餐还是咖啡和三明治，有一件事始终不变：价格。

en: You probably think college students are experts at sleeping. (9 words)
cn: 你可能认为大学生是睡眠专家。

en: but parties, preparations for tests, personal problems and general stress can wreck a student's sleep habits, which can be bad for the body and the mind. (26 words)
cn: 但是聚会、备考、个人问题和一般压力会破坏学生的睡眠习惯，这对身心都不利。

en: Texas Tech University is even offering a class called Improving Your Sleep Habits. (13 words)
cn: 德克萨斯理工大学甚至开设了一门名为“改善你的睡眠习惯”的课程。

en: People suffering from sleep loss are at an increased risk from obesity, psychological problems and car crashes. (17 words)
cn: 遭受睡眠不足的人面临更高的肥胖、心理问题和车祸风险。

en: Students who don't get enough sleep have poor attendance and lower grades. (12 words)
cn: 睡眠不足的学生出勤率低，成绩也较差。

en: On top of all that, a new study published in the journal Learning and Memory finds you are probably better off sleeping than making last-minute preparations for a test. (29 words)
cn: 除此之外，《学习与记忆》杂志上发表的一项新研究发现，睡觉可能比考前临时抱佛脚更有效。

en: Two hundred college kids were taught to play some unfamiliar video games. (12 words)
cn: 两百名大学生被教导玩一些不熟悉的视频游戏。

en: Subjects who learned the games in the morning lost some skills when they played again 12 hours later, but they did much better after getting a good night's sleep. (29 words)
cn: 早上学习游戏的人在12小时后再次玩时失去了一些技巧，但睡个好觉后他们表现得好得多。

en: So if you really want to do your job well, don't forget to get some sleep. (16 words)
cn: 所以如果你真的想把工作做好，别忘了睡个觉。

en: Long queues, delayed flights and overcrowding at airports have become almost as much a topic for conversation in Britain as the traditional complaining about the weather. (26 words)
cn: 在英国，排长队、航班延误和机场过度拥挤几乎已经成为和传统抱怨天气一样的话题。

en: Meanwhile there are complaints that poor service at London's major airports is discouraging foreigners from doing business in Britain. (19 words)
cn: 同时，有人抱怨伦敦主要机场的服务差，阻碍了外国人在英国做生意。

en: Much of the criticism is directed at the British Airports Authority, which runs seven major airports, including the three main ones serving London. (23 words)
cn: 大部分批评指向英国机场管理局，该局运营着七个主要机场，包括服务伦敦的三个主要机场。

en: The Competition Commission is now to investigate whether the British Airports Authority needs to sell off some of its assets. (20 words)
cn: 竞争委员会现在将调查英国机场管理局是否需要出售部分资产。

en: The idea is that competition between rival operators would lead to better service at airports. (15 words)
cn: 其理念是，竞争运营商之间的竞争会带来更好的机场服务。

en: The British Airports Authority, recently bought by a Spanish company, says the root cause of the problem is not the ownership structure but a lack of runway and terminal capacity, which it is addressing through a program of heavy investment. (40 words)
cn: 最近被一家西班牙公司收购的英国机场管理局表示，问题的根源不是所有权结构，而是跑道和航站楼容量不足，他们正通过一项重大投资计划来解决。

en: Under the law in Massachusetts, tobacco companies have to measure the nicotine content of every type of cigarette and report the results. (22 words)
cn: 根据马萨诸塞州的法律，烟草公司必须测量每种卷烟的尼古丁含量并报告结果。

en: The Department of Public Health in Boston gathers and carefully examines the figures and then draws its conclusions. (18 words)
cn: 波士顿公共卫生部门收集并仔细审查这些数据，然后得出结论。

en: A hundred and sixteen brands were looked at for this study. (11 words)
cn: 这项研究调查了116个品牌。

en: Ninety-two were found to have higher nicotine yields than they did six years previously. (14 words)
cn: 发现其中92种卷烟的尼古丁含量比六年前更高。

en: The biggest increases tended to be in brands that were popular with young smokers. (14 words)
cn: 增幅最大的往往是年轻吸烟者喜欢的品牌。

en: That worries the department because of the addictive nature of nicotine. (11 words)
cn: 这令该部门担忧，因为尼古丁具有成瘾性。

en: Stand Glance, a professor of medicine in San Francisco explains why. (11 words)
cn: 旧金山的医学教授斯坦德·格兰斯解释了原因。

en: The amount of nicotine that's delivered in every cigarette is 10% higher than it was six years ago, which means that it is easier to get hooked and harder to quit. (31 words)
cn: 每支卷烟释放的尼古丁含量比六年前高出10%，这意味着更容易上瘾，更难戒掉。

en: The big tobacco companies have always insisted that they are frank with their customers about the dangers of smoking and provide them with enough detail to make an informed decision. (30 words)
cn: 大烟草公司一直坚称他们对顾客坦诚吸烟的危害，并提供足够细节以做出明智决定。

en: However, none of them were prepared to comment on this study or discuss the detailed nicotine content of their products. (20 words)
cn: 然而，他们中没有人准备对这项研究发表评论或讨论其产品的详细尼古丁含量。

en: And you know, one thing that I want to ask you. (11 words)
cn: 你知道，我想问你一件事。

en: It's great that you have had this experience of teaching in Indonesia and following up on what you just mentioned. (20 words)
cn: 你有在印度尼西亚教学的经历并跟进你刚才提到的内容，这很好。

en: What would you recommend for students who do not live in an English-speaking country? (14 words)
cn: 对于不生活在英语国家的学生，你会推荐什么？

en: And, you know, they want to learn. (7 words)
cn: 而且，你知道，他们想学习。

en: I don't know about perfecting but they want at least to be able to communicate decently. (16 words)
cn: 我不知道是否要精通，但他们至少希望能够得体地交流。

en: How can they go about this? (6 words)
cn: 他们该怎么做呢？

en: Yeah, it's really hard. (4 words)
cn: 是的，真的很难。

en: That's the real struggle because, right now, I do live in Holland, but I really don't socialize much with Dutch people and my boyfriend's English is so good that we just basically speak English all the time. (37 words)
cn: 这才是真正的困难，因为现在我确实住在荷兰，但我真的不怎么和荷兰人社交，而且我男朋友的英语很好，所以我们基本上一直说英语。

en: So I have to make a real effort to practice. (10 words)
cn: 所以我必须付出真正的努力去练习。

en: There is as much listening exposure as I want—all I have to do is turn on the TV. (19 words)
cn: 我想听多少听力材料都有——我只需要打开电视。

en: And reading also, right? (4 words)
cn: 还有阅读，对吧？

en: Yeah, reading. (2 words)
cn: 是的，阅读。

en: There is plenty I can get to read and listen to. (11 words)
cn: 有很多东西我可以读和听。

en: But for speaking, there really is no substitute for trying to speak and use the language in a relaxed atmosphere. (20 words)
cn: 但对于口语，真的没有替代品，只能在轻松的氛围中尝试说和使用语言。

en: So I think that's really the challenge for people who live in a country where their target language isn't spoken. (20 words)
cn: 所以我认为这对生活在不说目标语言国家的人来说才是真正的挑战。

en: And for that, gosh, what would I do? (8 words)
cn: 为此，天哪，我该怎么办呢？

en: If I didn't have people here, probably try to find a club? (12 words)
cn: 如果我这里没有人，也许会试着找个俱乐部？

en: In Sweden, they have a really cool system called Study Circles; well, it's not...it's like a course. (18 words)
cn: 在瑞典，他们有一个很棒的体系叫学习圈；嗯，它不是……它像一门课程。

en: But really, you just have a course leader who is there, sort of, as a coach and guide and to help out, and you don't get grades, and you go just because you want to learn. (36 words)
cn: 但实际上，你只需要有一个课程负责人，他有点像教练和向导，提供帮助，而且没有评分，你去只是因为你想学习。

en: Okay, Nathan. (2 words)
cn: 好的，内森。

en: So we are talking about driving and are there any rules or regulations that you'd like to change? (18 words)
cn: 所以我们在谈论驾驶，有没有什么规则或规定你想改变的？

en: I'm not sure I want to change rules, but I'd like the police to be stricter on the rules. (19 words)
cn: 我不确定我想改变规则，但我希望警察对规则更严格。

en: Like if people jump the traffic lights, I don't know why there isn't a camera at the traffic lights to stop people doing that. (24 words)
cn: 比如如果人们闯红灯，我不知道为什么交通灯上没有摄像头来阻止人们那样做。

en: Or like speeding. (3 words)
cn: 或者超速。

en: It's very easy to put speed cameras in certain places. (10 words)
cn: 在某些地方安装测速摄像头很容易。

en: Maybe car manufacturers should have some responsibility in limiting the power of their engines. (14 words)
cn: 也许汽车制造商应该承担一些责任，限制发动机的功率。

en: What's the point in producing an engine that is big and powerful enough to go like 200km/h when the speed limit is only 100? (24 words)
cn: 当限速只有100时，生产一个能跑到200公里/小时的大功率引擎有什么意义？

en: Right, but do you know there are no speed limits in Germany. (12 words)
cn: 对，但你知道德国没有限速吗？

en: People there do drive responsibly, though. (6 words)
cn: 不过那里的人确实开车负责。

en: Often people break laws simply because the laws are there. (10 words)
cn: 人们常常违反法律，仅仅因为法律存在。

en: If the law isn't there, people will drive within their ability range. (12 words)
cn: 如果法律不存在，人们会在自己的能力范围内驾驶。

en: When you've got speed limits, this creates situations that actually present dangers on the road. (15 words)
cn: 当有限速时，这反而会造成道路上实际存在的危险情况。

en: Do you think Germans have better education about personal responsibility when driving? (12 words)
cn: 你认为德国人在驾驶方面的个人责任感教育更好吗？

en: Possibly. (1 word)
cn: 可能吧。

en: They also have very good cars. (6 words)
cn: 他们也有很好的车。

en: Right. (1 word)
cn: 对。

en: If you've got a good car that can go at a high speed then it's really nice to do that. (20 words)
cn: 如果你有一辆能开快车的好车，那感觉确实不错。

en: But still with care. (4 words)
cn: 但仍要小心。

en: So I think it's the restrictions that create the dangers sometimes. (11 words)
cn: 所以我认为有时候正是限制制造了危险。

en: Okay. (1 word)
cn: 好的。

en: Obviously, when driving through a residential area or where there is a school, you've got to have speed policemen. (19 words)
cn: 显然，当开车经过居民区或学校时，必须要有交警。

en: Speed bumps. (2 words)
cn: 减速带。

en: Yes, speed bumps, those speed bumps that force you to slow down. (12 words)
cn: 是的，减速带，那些迫使你减速的减速带。

en: I think they are a good idea. (7 words)
cn: 我认为它们是个好主意。

en: So you don't think firing people is useful. (8 words)
cn: 所以你认为罚款没用。

en: Not really, because the police don't have time to police every single driver. (13 words)
cn: 并不是，因为警察没有时间监管每一个司机。

en: Behind the cash register at a store in downtown San Francisco, Sam Azar swiped his credit card to pay for a pack of cigarettes. (24 words)
cn: 在旧金山市中心一家商店的收银台后面，萨姆·阿扎尔刷信用卡买了一包香烟。

en: The store's card reader failed to scan the card's magnetic stripe. (11 words)
cn: 商店的读卡器无法扫描卡上的磁条。

en: Azar tried again and again. (5 words)
cn: 阿扎尔试了又试。

en: No luck. (2 words)
cn: 没成功。

en: As customers began to queue, Mr. Azar reached beneath the counter for a black plastic bag. (16 words)
cn: 当顾客开始排队时，阿扎尔先生从柜台下面拿出一个黑色塑料袋。

en: He wrapped one layer of the plastic around the card and tried again. (13 words)
cn: 他在卡上包了一层塑料，又试了一次。

en: Success! (1 word)
cn: 成功了！

en: The sale was completed. (4 words)
cn: 交易完成。

en: I don't know how it works. (6 words)
cn: 我不知道这是怎么回事。

en: It just does, said Mr. Azar who learned the trick from another clerk. (13 words)
cn: 它就是管用，阿扎尔先生说，他从另一位店员那里学到了这个窍门。

en: Verifone, the company that makes the store's card reader, would not confirm or deny that the plastic bag trick worked. (20 words)
cn: 生产该店读卡器的公司Verifone既不确认也不否认塑料袋技巧有效。

en: But it's one of many low-tech fixes for high-tech failures that people without engineering degrees have discovered—often out of desperation—and shared. (23 words)
cn: 但这是许多没有工程学位的人——往往是出于绝望——发现并分享的用低技术解决高技术故障的方法之一。

en: Today's shaky economy is likely to produce many more such tricks. (11 words)
cn: 当今不稳定的经济可能会产生更多这样的技巧。

en: In post-war Japan, the economy wasn't doing so great, so you couldn't get everyday-use items like household cleaners, says Lisa Katayama, author of Urawaza, a book named after the Japanese term for clever lifestyle tips and tricks. (37 words)
cn: 战后日本经济不太好，所以买不到日常用品如家用清洁剂，丽莎·片山说，她是《Urawaza》一书的作者，书名取自日语中表示巧妙生活小窍门的词汇。

en: So people look for ways to do with what they had. (11 words)
cn: 所以人们寻找利用现有资源的方法。

en: Today, Americans are finding their own tips and tricks for fixing malfunctioning devices with supplies as simple as paper and glue. (21 words)
cn: 如今，美国人正在寻找用纸和胶水等简单材料修理故障设备的小窍门。

en: Some, like Mr. Azar's plastic bag, are open to argument as to how they work or whether they really work at all. (22 words)
cn: 有些方法，比如阿扎尔先生的塑料袋，其原理或是否真的有效仍有争议。

en: But many tech home remedies can be explained by a little science. (12 words)
cn: 但许多技术类家庭疗法可以用一点科学来解释。

en: If you are a graduate student, you may depend on your adviser for many things, including help with improving grades, acquiring financial support, forming an examining committee and getting letters of recommendation. (32 words)
cn: 如果你是一名研究生，你可能在很多事情上依赖导师，包括提高成绩、获得资助、组建考试委员会和获取推荐信。

en: If you're a graduate teaching assistant, your adviser also may be your boss. (13 words)
cn: 如果你是一名研究生助教，你的导师也可能是你的老板。

en: Academic departments vary in their procedures for assigning academic advisers to graduate students. (13 words)
cn: 各院系为研究生分配学术导师的程序各不相同。

en: In some departments, either the chairman or the director of graduate studies serves for at least the first semester as a new student adviser. (24 words)
cn: 在一些院系，系主任或研究生部主任至少在第一学期担任新生导师。

en: Then students select an adviser based on shared academic interests. (10 words)
cn: 然后学生根据共同的学术兴趣选择导师。

en: In other departments, a new student is assigned a faculty adviser based on some system of distribution of the department's advising load. (22 words)
cn: 在其他院系，新生根据院系指导工作分配制度被指派一位教师导师。

en: Later, students may have the opportunity of selecting the adviser that they prefer. (13 words)
cn: 之后，学生可能有机会选择他们更喜欢的导师。

en: In any case, new graduate students can learn who their advisers or temporary advisers are by visiting or emailing the departmental office and asking for the information. (27 words)
cn: 无论如何，研究生新生可以通过访问或邮件联系院系办公室询问来了解他们的导师或临时导师是谁。

en: Graduation requirements specify the number of credits you must earn, the minimum grade point average you must achieve and the distribution of credits you must have from among differing departments or fields of study. (34 words)
cn: 毕业要求规定了你必须获得的学分数、必须达到的最低平均绩点以及必须从不同院系或研究领域获得的学分分配。

en: In addition, it is necessary to apply for graduation when you are near the time that you will be completing your graduation requirements. (23 words)
cn: 此外，当临近完成毕业要求时，有必要申请毕业。

en: Since graduation requirements vary among divisions of the university, you should consult the Bulletin of Information. (16 words)
cn: 由于各学院的毕业要求不同，你应该查阅信息公告。

en: You should also direct your questions to your departmental office or academic adviser. (13 words)
cn: 你也应该将问题直接咨询院系办公室或学术导师。

en: Jody Hubbard is a diet and nutrition expert who travels around the state to speak in middle and high schools. (20 words)
cn: 乔迪·哈伯德是一位饮食和营养专家，她周游全州，在中学和高中演讲。

en: She primarily speaks to students in health classes, but sometimes the school will arrange for her to speak to several different groups of girls. (24 words)
cn: 她主要对健康课的学生演讲，但有时学校会安排她向几组不同的女生演讲。

en: Her biggest concern is the emphasis American culture places on thinness and the negative ways this affects girls today. (19 words)
cn: 她最大的担忧是美国文化对瘦的强调以及这对当今女孩产生的负面影响。

en: Jody has a Ph.D. in nutrition, but more importantly, she has personal experience. (13 words)
cn: 乔迪拥有营养学博士学位，但更重要的是，她有亲身经历。

en: Her mother taught her to diet when she was only eight years old. (13 words)
cn: 她母亲在她只有八岁时就教她节食。

en: Jody has created several different presentations, which she gives to different types of audiences, and she tries to establish an emotional connection with the students so that they will feel comfortable asking questions or talking to her privately. (38 words)
cn: 乔迪制作了几种不同的演示文稿，针对不同类型的听众，并试图与学生建立情感联系，让他们能自在地提问或私下交谈。

en: She shows them pictures and images from popular culture of beautiful women and explains how computers are used to make the women look even more thin and "beautiful" than they are in real life. (34 words)
cn: 她向他们展示流行文化中美女的图片，并解释电脑如何被用来让女性看起来比现实中更瘦更“美”。

en: She describes how the definition of beauty has changed over the years and even from culture to culture. (18 words)
cn: 她描述了美的定义多年来如何变化，甚至因文化而异。

en: She then talks about health issues and the physical damage that can occur as a result of dieting. (18 words)
cn: 然后她谈论健康问题和节食可能造成的身体损害。

en: Finally, she addresses self-respect and the notion that a person's sense of beauty must include more than how much a person weighs. (22 words)
cn: 最后，她谈到自尊，并指出一个人的美感必须超越体重数字。

en: Sometimes, Jody feels that she succeeds in persuading some students to stop dieting. (13 words)
cn: 有时，乔迪觉得她成功说服了一些学生停止节食。

en: Other times, she feels that she fails. (7 words)
cn: 其他时候，她觉得自己失败了。

en: A 16th century castle in Scotland is close to collapsing after lumps of soil were washed away by floods, threatening its foundations. (20 words)
cn: 在苏格兰，洪水冲走了成块成块的土地，导致一座16世纪的城堡地基受到威胁，濒临倒塌。

en: On Sunday, the castle's owner John Gordon, 76, was forced to move out of his property after the River Dee swept away about 60 feet of land, leaving the castle dangerously close to the river, according to the Scottish Daily Record. (38 words)
cn: 据苏格兰《每日纪事报》报道，迪河冲毁了约60英尺的土壤，使得该城堡靠近河边，面临危险；周日，76岁的城堡主人约翰·戈登不得不搬出城堡。

en: Abergeldie Castle, located in Aberdeenshire, Scotland, was built by Sir Alexander Gordon of Midmar, who later became the Earl of Huntly. (20 words)
cn: 阿伯杰尔迪城堡位于苏格兰阿伯丁郡，由米德马城堡的亚历山大·戈登爵士修建而成，他后来成为亨特利的伯爵。

en: The castle, which is located on 11,700 acres, was leased to members of the royal family between 1848 and 1970, including King Edward VII and George V. (26 words)
cn: 该城堡面积达11700公顷，在1848年至1970年间被租给王室成员，包括国王爱德华七世和乔治五世。

en: The Scottish Environment Protection Agency has issued more than 35 flood warnings covering several regions, as Scotland continues to clean up after Storm Frank hit the country last Wednesday. (27 words)
cn: 苏格兰环保署已经发布了超过35条洪水警示消息，范围覆盖几个区域。同时，自上周三风暴“弗兰克”袭击英国之后，苏格兰就一直在进行清理工作。

en: This means that rivers will rise more slowly, but then stay high for much longer, the environmental agency said. (17 words)
cn: 环保署称：“这意味着河水水面上升的速度会变慢，但在更长的一段时间内，水位会居高不下。”

en: Rescue efforts were underway Thursday morning for 17 miners who were stuck in an elevator below ground at Cargill Rock Salt Mine near Lansing, New York, according to Marcia Lynch, public information officer with Tompkins County's emergency response department. (37 words)
cn: 据汤普金斯县紧急部署部门的公共信息官员玛丽亚·林奇所说，17名矿工被困在纽约州兰辛的嘉吉岩盐矿地下的升降梯中，周四早上救援工作正在进行。

en: Emergency workers made contact with the miners via a radio. (9 words)
cn: 紧急救援人员通过无线电与被困矿工取得了联系。

en: And they all appear to be uninjured, said Jessica Verfuss, the emergency department's assistant director. (14 words)
cn: 紧急部署部门的主任助理杰西卡·沃弗斯称，他们似乎都没有受伤。

en: Crews have managed to provide heat packs and blankets to the miners so that they can keep warm during the rescue operation, Verfuss said. (24 words)
cn: 沃弗斯说，救援人员设法给矿工提供了暖水袋和毯子，供他们在救援期间保暖。

en: Details about what led to the workers' being trapped in the elevator weren't immediately available. (15 words)
cn: 至于工人为何被困在升降梯里，相关细节还不能即刻知晓。

en: The mine, along New York's Cayuga Lake, processes salt used for road treatment. (13 words)
cn: 该矿井沿着纽约州的卡尤加湖而开拓，加工用于路面处理的盐。

en: It produces about two million tons of salt that is shipped to more than 1,500 places in the northeastern United States. (20 words)
cn: 它生产约200万吨盐，运送到美国东北部的1500多个地区。

en: The rock salt mine is one of three operated by Cargill, with the other two in Louisiana and Ohio. (20 words)
cn: 该岩盐矿是嘉吉公司所属的三个矿之一，另外两个分别位于路易斯安那州和俄亥俄州。

en: The U.S. Postal Service announced today that it is considering closing about 3,700 post offices over the next year because of falling revenues. (22 words)
cn: 美国邮政服务公司今日宣布，由于收入下降，它正在考虑明年关闭约3700家邮局。

en: Facing an 8.3 billion dollar budget deficit this year, closing post offices is one of several proposals the Postal Service has put forth recently to cut costs. (26 words)
cn: 面对今年83亿美元的预算赤字，邮政服务公司最近抛出了几项削减成本的提议，关闭邮局便是其一。

en: Last week, for example, Postmaster General Pat Donahoe announced plans to stop mail delivery on Saturdays, a move he says could save 3 billion dollars annually. (27 words)
cn: 例如，邮政部长帕特·多纳霍上周宣布了停止周六邮递业务的计划，他说此举每年可节省30亿美元。

en: We are losing revenue as we speak, Donahoe said. (8 words)
cn: 正如我们所说，我们的收益在减少，多纳霍说。

en: We do not want taxpayers' money. (5 words)
cn: 我们不想要纳税人的钱。

en: We want to be self-sufficient. (5 words)
cn: 我们要自给自足。

en: So like any other business you have to make choices. (10 words)
cn: 因此，像任何其他企业一样，你必须做出选择。

en: Dean Granholm, the vice president for delivery and post office operations, said the first wave of closings would begin this fall. (19 words)
cn: 投递和邮局业务的副总裁迪安·格兰霍姆说，第一批邮局的关闭工作将从今年秋天开始。

en: He estimated that about 3,000 postmasters, 500 station managers and between 500 and 1,000 postal clerks could lose their jobs. (22 words)
cn: 他估计，大约3000名邮政局长、500名揽投站站长和500至1000名邮政职员可能会失去他们的工作。

en: Mrs. Hampton, we've got trouble in the press room this morning. (10 words)
cn: 汉普顿女士，今天我们在印刷车间遇到了麻烦。

en: Oh, dear. (2 words)
cn: 哦，天哪！

en: What about? (2 words)
cn: 发生什么了？

en: One of the press operators arrived an hour and a half late. (11 words)
cn: 一名印刷工人迟到了一个半小时。

en: But that's a straightforward affair. (5 words)
cn: 但这只是一件简单的事情。

en: He'll simply lose part of his pay. (7 words)
cn: 他只不过会失去一部分工资。

en: That's why we have a clock-in system. (7 words)
cn: 这就是我们设立打卡制度的原因。

en: But the point is the man was clocked-in at 8 o'clock. (13 words)
cn: 但问题是这个人的打卡记录是八点钟。

en: We have John standing by the time clock, and he swears he saw nothing irregular. (15 words)
cn: 负责监督打卡机的工作人员约翰断定他没有看到什么异常情况。

en: Is John reliable? (3 words)
cn: 约翰可靠吗？

en: Yes, he is. (3 words)
cn: 是的，他可信赖。

en: That's why we chose him for the job. (8 words)
cn: 这就是我们选他做那项工作的原因。

en: Have you spoken to the man who was late? (9 words)
cn: 你找那位迟到的员工谈话了吗？

en: Not yet. (2 words)
cn: 还没有。

en: I thought I'd have a word with you first. (9 words)
cn: 我想我应该先把情况跟您说一下。

en: He's a difficult man, and I think there's been some trouble on the shop floor. (16 words)
cn: 他是个难以相处的人，而且我认为最近车间里有一些麻烦。

en: I've got a feeling that trade union representative is behind this. (12 words)
cn: 我能感觉到工会代表是背后的主使者。

en: The manager told me that Jack Green's been very active around the shop the last few days. (18 words)
cn: 经理告诉我，在过去的几天里，杰克·格林在车间里非常活跃。

en: Well, what do you want me to do? (8 words)
cn: 哦，那你希望我做点什么呢？

en: I was wondering if you'd see Smith, the man who was late, because you are so much better at handling things like this. (24 words)
cn: 我在想您是否能和迟到的史密斯谈谈，因为您更擅长处理这种情况。

en: Oh, alright. (2 words)
cn: 哦，好吧。

en: I'll see him. (3 words)
cn: 我会见见他。

en: I must say I agree with you about there being bad feelings in the works. (15 words)
cn: 我得说我和你一样，对车间有不好的感觉。

en: I've had the idea for some time that Jack Green's been busy stirring things up in connection with the latest wage claim. (22 words)
cn: 一段时间以来我感觉杰克·格林一直在忙着鼓动众人，与最近的涨薪诉求有关。

en: He's always trying to make trouble. (6 words)
cn: 他总是试图制造麻烦。

en: Well, I'll get the manager to send Smith up here. (11 words)
cn: 嗯，我会让经理把史密斯带来谈谈。

en: Our topic today is about something that foreigners nearly always say when they visit Britain. (16 words)
cn: 我们今天的话题是一个来英国的外国游客基本上总会谈到的问题。

en: It's "Why are the British so cold?" and they're talking about the British personality—the famous British "reserve". (18 words)
cn: 那就是“英国人为什么如此冷漠？”他们说的是英国人的性格——著名的英式“矜持”。

en: It means that we aren't very friendly, we aren't very open. (12 words)
cn: 意思是我们不是非常友好，不是非常开放。

en: So do you think it's true? (6 words)
cn: 那么，你认为这种说法正确吗？

en: It's a difficult one. (4 words)
cn: 这很难说。

en: So many people who visit Britain say it's difficult to make friends with British people. (16 words)
cn: 那么多来英国旅行的人都说很难和英国人交朋友。

en: They say we're cold, reserved, unfriendly... (6 words)
cn: 他们说我们冷漠、矜持、不友好……

en: I think it's true. (4 words)
cn: 我认为这种说法是对的。

en: Look at Americans or Australians. (5 words)
cn: 看看美国人或澳大利亚人吧。

en: They speak the same language, but they're much more open. (10 words)
cn: 他们同样说英语，但是他们要开放得多。

en: And you see it when you travel, people—I mean strangers—speak to you on the street or on the train. (20 words)
cn: 当你去这些国家旅行的时候就会发现，人们——我说的是陌生人——会在街上或者火车上和你聊天。

en: British people seldom speak on the train, or the bus. (9 words)
cn: 英国人则很少在火车或者公交车上讲话。

en: Not in London, anyway. (4 words)
cn: 至少在伦敦是这样。

en: Not in London. That's it. (5 words)
cn: 至少在伦敦是这样。是的。

en: Capital cities are full of tourists and are never friendly. (9 words)
cn: 首都到处都是游客，从来都不友善。

en: People are different in other parts of the country. (9 words)
cn: 英国其他地方的人会有所不同。

en: Not completely. (2 words)
cn: 并不完全是这样。

en: I met a woman once, an Italian. (7 words)
cn: 我曾遇见过一位意大利女士。

en: She's been working in Manchester for two years, and no one—not one of her colleagues—had ever invited her to their home. (22 words)
cn: 她在曼彻斯特工作了两年，从没有一位同事邀请她到自己家做客。

en: They were friendly to her at work, but nothing else. (10 words)
cn: 同事们只有在工作时对她很友好。

en: She couldn't believe it. (4 words)
cn: 她难以相信这一点。

en: She said that would never happen in Italy. (9 words)
cn: 她说这种情况在意大利永远不会发生。

en: You know what they say—An Englishman's home is his castle. (9 words)
cn: 你知道他们这样说——英国人的家就是他们的城堡。

en: It's really difficult to get inside. (6 words)
cn: 确实很难进入。

en: Yeah. It's about being private. (5 words)
cn: 是的。这关乎私密性。

en: You go home to your house and your garden and you close the door. (14 words)
cn: 你回家时，进入房屋和花园，关上门。

en: It's your place. (3 words)
cn: 那就是你自己的空间。

en: That's why the British don't like flats. (7 words)
cn: 这就是英国人不喜欢公寓的原因。

en: They prefer to live in houses. (6 words)
cn: 他们喜欢住在独立的房屋里。

en: That's true. (2 words)
cn: 是的。

en: In college, time is scarce, and consequently, very precious. (9 words)
cn: 大学里的时间很稀有，因此十分宝贵。

en: At the same time, expenses in college pile up surprisingly quickly. (9 words)
cn: 与此同时，大学里的花费急剧攀升，令人乍舌。

en: A part-time job is a good way to balance costs while ensuring there is enough time left over for both academic subjects and after-class activities. (25 words)
cn: 在确保有足够的时间留给学习和课外活动的前提下，一份兼职工作是平衡开支的好方式。

en: If you are a college student looking for a part-time job, the best place to start your job search is right on campus. (22 words)
cn: 如果你是一名正在寻找兼职工作的大学生，那么开始职位搜寻的最好地方就是在校园里。

en: There are tons of on-campus job opportunities, and as a student, you'll automatically be given hiring priority. (18 words)
cn: 那里有非常多的校内工作机会，并且作为一名学生，你自然享有被录用的优先权。

en: Plus, on-campus jobs eliminate commuting time, and could be a great way to connect with academic and professional resources at your university. (20 words)
cn: 而且，校内工作省去了通勤时间，还是一种接触到学校里学术和专业资源的很好的方式。

en: Check with your school's career service or employment office for help to find a campus job. (16 words)
cn: 与你所在学校的就业服务中心或职业介绍办公室联系，请他们帮你找一份校内工作。

en: Of course, there are opportunities for part-time work off campus, too. (11 words)
cn: 当然，也有校外兼职工作的机会。

en: If you spend a little time digging for the right part-time jobs, you'll save yourself time when you find a job that leaves you with enough time to get your school work done, too. (34 words)
cn: 如果你花费少量的时间就找到了一份合适的兼职工作，并且这份工作能为你留出足够的时间来完成学校作业，那么你就为自己节省了时间。

en: If you are a college student looking for work but worry you won't have enough time to devote to academic subjects, consider working as a study hall or a library monitor. (28 words)
cn: 如果你是一名正在寻找兼职工作但又担心没有足够时间来钻研学业的大学生，可以考虑做自习室或者图书馆的监督员。

en: Responsibilities generally include supervising study spaces to ensure that a quiet atmosphere is maintained. (13 words)
cn: 工作职责大概就是监管学习区域，确保那里安静的学习氛围。

en: It's a pretty easy job, but one with lots of downtime, which means you will have plenty of time to catch up on reading, do homework or study for an exam. (29 words)
cn: 这是一份相当轻松的工作，但是有很多工作休息时间，这意味着你有充足时间用来阅读、完成作业或者准备考试。

en: Agricultural workers in green tea fields near Mt. Kenya are gathering the tea leaves. (13 words)
cn: 在肯尼亚山附近的绿茶农场中，茶农们正在采摘茶叶。

en: It is beautiful to see. (5 words)
cn: 这是一幅美丽的场景。

en: The rows of tea bushes are straight. (7 words)
cn: 一排排笔直的茶树丛。

en: All appears to be well. (5 words)
cn: 一切看上去都很美好。

en: But the farmers who planted the bushes are worried. (9 words)
cn: 然而种植茶树的茶农们却忧心忡忡。

en: Nelson Kibara is one of them. (6 words)
cn: 纳尔逊·基巴拉就是其中之一。

en: He has been growing tea in the Kerugoya area for 40 years. (13 words)
cn: 他在Kerugoya这片地区种植茶树已经有40年了。

en: He says the prices this year have been so low that he has made almost no profit. (17 words)
cn: 他说今年茶叶价格很低，他几乎没有任何盈利。

en: He says he must grow different kinds of tea if he is to survive. (15 words)
cn: 他说如果想要生存的话就必须要种植不同品种的茶树。

en: Mr. Kibara and hundreds of other farmers have been removing some of their tea bushes and planting a new kind of tea developed by the Tea Research Foundation of Kenya. (28 words)
cn: 基巴拉先生和其他数百名茶农移除了一部分他们所种植的茶树，种植了一种由肯尼亚茶叶研究基金会研发的新型茶树。

en: Its leaves are purple and brown. (6 words)
cn: 这种茶树的叶子是紫色和棕色的。

en: When the tea is boiled, the drink has a purple color. (11 words)
cn: 当茶叶被煮沸时，茶水就会呈现紫色。

en: Medical researchers have studied the health benefits of the new tea. (11 words)
cn: 医学研究人员研究了这一新型茶叶的健康功效。

en: They say it is healthier than green tea and could be sold for a price that is three to four times higher than the price of green tea. (28 words)
cn: 他们声称这种茶叶比绿茶更加健康，并且其售价可能要比绿茶的价格高出三到四倍。

en: But Mr. Kibara says he has not received a higher price for his purple tea crop. (17 words)
cn: 但是基巴拉先生称他这种紫茶作物并没有以更高的售价卖出。

en: He says the market for the tea is unstable, and he has been forced to sell his purple tea at the same price as green tea, frequently. (25 words)
cn: 他说这种茶叶的市场并不稳定，他不得不经常以与绿茶同样的价格来出售他的紫茶。

en: He says there are not enough buyers willing to pay more for the purple tea. (15 words)
cn: 他说没有足够多的买家愿意出更多钱来买这种紫茶。

en: Today's consumers want beautiful handcrafted objects to wear and to have for their home environment. (14 words)
cn: 如今的消费者喜欢漂亮的手工制品，用来佩戴和装饰家庭居所。

en: They prefer something unique and they demand quality. (8 words)
cn: 他们喜欢独特的东西，对品质有要求。

en: Craftsmen today are meeting this demand. (6 words)
cn: 如今的手工艺人正迎合着这种需求。

en: People and homes are showing great change as more and more unique handcrafted items become available. (16 words)
cn: 随着越来越多独特手工制品的出现，人们自身和家中展现出了巨大的变化。

en: Handcrafts are big business. (3 words)
cn: 手工艺品是大生意。

en: No longer does a good craftsman have to work in a job he dislikes all day and then try to create at night. (21 words)
cn: 技艺精湛的手工艺人再也不用整天做着他不喜欢的工作，而努力在晚上创作了。

en: He has earned his professional status. (6 words)
cn: 他已经获得了自己的职业地位。

en: He is now a respected member of society. (8 words)
cn: 他现在是社会上受尊敬的一员。

en: Parts of the fun of being a craftsman is meeting other craftsmen. (11 words)
cn: 作为一名手工艺人，部分乐趣在于认识其他艺人。

en: They love to share their ideas and materials and help others find markets for their work. (17 words)
cn: 他们愿意分享各自的想法以及创作材料，帮助别人为作品寻找市场。

en: Craftsmen have helped educate consumers to make wise choices. (8 words)
cn: 手工艺人帮助教导消费者做出明智的选择。

en: They help them become aware of design and technique. (9 words)
cn: 他们帮助他们了解（物品的）设计和工艺技巧。

en: They help them relate their choice to its intended use. (10 words)
cn: 他们帮助他们将自己的选择与预期的用途联系起来。

en: They often involve consumers in trying the craft themselves. (9 words)
cn: 他们经常引导消费者自己尝试这些工艺。

en: When a group of craftsmen expand to include more members, a small craft organization is formed. (16 words)
cn: 当一个手工艺小组扩张容纳更多的成员时，一个小型的手工艺组织就形成了。

en: Such an organization does a lot in training workshops in special media, crafts marketing techniques, crafts fairs and sales, festivals, TV appearances and demonstrations. (24 words)
cn: 这样的一个组织在特殊媒体、工艺营销技巧、工艺展销会、节庆、电视展示和示范表演方面做了大量的培训工作。

en: State art councils help sponsor local arts and crafts festivals which draw crowds of tourist consumers. (16 words)
cn: 州艺术委员会帮助主办可吸引大批旅游消费者的地方性工艺美术节。

en: This boosts the local economy considerably because tourists not only buy crafts, but they also use the restaurants and hotels and other services of the area. (26 words)
cn: 由于游客不仅会购买手工艺品，还会去当地的餐馆就餐，酒店住宿，同时会使用此区域的其他服务，所以此举会在很大程度上振兴当地经济。

en: New York State plans to shut off the thundering waters of Niagara Falls, again, at least, the American side of the falls. (20 words)
cn: 纽约州计划再次让雷鸣般的尼亚加拉大瀑布断流，至少让其在美国领土上的部分断流。

en: This once in a lifetime event actually may take place twice in some folks' lives. (15 words)
cn: 这一“一生一次”的事件实际上可能会在一些人的生命中发生两次。

en: The New York State parks system wants to turn off the falls on the American side sometime in the next two to three years to replace two 115-year-old stone bridges that allow pedestrians, park vehicles and utilities access to Goat Island. (37 words)
cn: 纽约州立公园系统想在未来两到三年内让美国领土上的这部分瀑布断流，以更换两座供行人、公园车辆和公用设施进入山羊岛的115年之久的石桥。

en: The American side of the falls was shut off in 1969 to study the build-up of rock at the base of the falls. (22 words)
cn: 尼亚加拉瀑布在美国的部分曾于1969年被断流过，以研究瀑布底部岩石的堆积过程。

en: When that happened, people came from all over the world to see the falls turned off. (16 words)
cn: 当这种情况发生时，来自世界各地的人们到此观看瀑布被断流这一场景。

en: People are curious by nature. (5 words)
cn: 人们的天性是好奇的。

en: They want to see what's underneath. (6 words)
cn: 他们想看看瀑布下面是什么。

en: In fact, those who first came to have a look did see something. (13 words)
cn: 事实上，那些最先过来观看的人确实看到了一些东西。

en: They found millions of coins on the bottom. (8 words)
cn: 他们发现底部有数百万枚硬币。

en: The Tunisian government said Monday that 45 people have been killed after gunmen attacked a town near the border with Libya. (20 words)
cn: 突尼斯政府周一表示，持枪歹徒袭击了靠近突尼斯与利比亚边境的一个小镇，45人被杀害。

en: The Interior and Defense ministries said that the Tunisian government has closed its two border crossings with Libya because of the attack. (21 words)
cn: 内政部和国防部称，由于袭击，突尼斯政府已经关闭了本国与利比亚之间的两个边境通道。

en: The Tunisian Military has sent reinforcements and helicopters to the area. (11 words)
cn: 突尼斯军方已经向该地区派遣了增援部队和直升机。

en: And authorities have been hunting several attackers who were still at large. (12 words)
cn: 当局一直在追捕几名依旧在逃的袭击者。

en: The violence came amid increasing international concern about Islamic State extremists in Libya. (14 words)
cn: 利比亚境内的“伊斯兰国”极端分子引起了国际社会越来越多的忧虑，而此次暴力事件正是在这一背景之下发生的。

en: Officials of the Tunisian government are especially worried after dozens of tourists were killed in an attack in Tunisia last year. (20 words)
cn: 去年，在突尼斯发生的一起袭击事件中有数十名游客丧生，自此之后，突尼斯政府官员尤其担心。

en: Defense Minister Farhat Horchani said last week that German and American security experts were expected to come to help Tunisia devise a new electronic video-supervision system on its border with Libya. (29 words)
cn: 国防部长Farhat Horchani上周表示，德国和美国的安全专家有望来帮助突尼斯在其与利比亚的边境设置一个新的电子视频监控系统。

en: Tunisia was targeted last year by three attacks that left 70 people dead and were claimed by Islamic State. (19 words)
cn: 去年，突尼斯遭遇三起袭击事件，造成70人丧生，“伊斯兰国”承认制造了三起袭击事件。

en: Three university students in Santiago, Chile, have developed a plant-powered device to charge their mobile phones. (16 words)
cn: 智利圣地亚哥的三名大学生已经开发出一种由植物供电的设备，可以为他们的手机充电。

en: The three engineering students got the idea for the device while sitting in their school's courtyard. (16 words)
cn: 这三名理工科学生是坐在学校的院子里的时候有了这个装置的创意的。

en: Their invention is a small biological circuit they call E-Kaia. (10 words)
cn: 他们的发明是一个微型生物电路，他们称之为E-Kaia。

en: It captures the energy which plants produce during photosynthesis, a process of converting sunlight into energy. (18 words)
cn: 它摄取植物在光合作用（将阳光转化为能量）过程中产生的能量。

en: A plant uses only a small part of the energy produced by that process. (14 words)
cn: 光合作用过程中所产生的能量，植物仅使用了一小部分。

en: The rest goes into the soil. (6 words)
cn: 其余的能量都进入了土壤。

en: E-Kaia collects that energy. (4 words)
cn: E-Kaia收集这些能量。

en: The device plugs into the ground and then into a mobile phone. (13 words)
cn: 将该装置插入土壤中，然后和手机相连接。

en: The E-Kaia solves two problems for the engineering students: they needed an idea for a class project; they also needed an outlet to plug in their phones. (25 words)
cn: E-Kaia可以解决这三名工科生的两个问题：他们需要为一个课堂项目寻找创意；而且，他们需要一个电源插座来为手机充电。

en: One of the student inventors, Camila Rupcich, says the device changes the energy released from the plant into low-level power to charge phones. (23 words)
cn: 其中一名学生发明家Camila Rupcich说，该设备将植物中释放出的能量转化为低功率的电流，从而为手机充电。

en: The E-Kaia is able to fully recharge a mobile phone in less than two hours. (15 words)
cn: E-Kaia能够在不到两个小时的时间之内为手机充满电。

en: Good morning. (2 words)
cn: 早上好。

en: What can I do for you? (6 words)
cn: 有什么需要帮助的吗？

en: Good morning. (2 words)
cn: 早上好。

en: Could I talk to Jeffery Harding, please? (7 words)
cn: 请找杰弗里·哈丁接电话好吗？

en: Speaking. (1 word)
cn: 请讲。

en: Hello, Jeff. (2 words)
cn: 你好，杰夫。

en: It's Helen. (2 words)
cn: 我是海伦。

en: I got your message on the answering machine. (8 words)
cn: 我在电话留言机上听到了你的留言。

en: What's the problem? (3 words)
cn: 有什么事情吗？

en: Oh, Helen. (2 words)
cn: 哦，海伦。

en: Well, it's the Grimsby plant again, I'm afraid. (8 words)
cn: 是这样的，恐怕又是格里姆斯比工厂的事。

en: The robots on Line Three have gone wrong, and the line is at a standstill. (14 words)
cn: 三号生产线上的操控机器人出了故障，生产线处于停滞状态。

en: Can't you replace them with the stand-ins? (7 words)
cn: 不能用备用机器人替换它们吗？

en: I'm afraid not. (3 words)
cn: 恐怕不行。

en: The stand-ins are already in use on Line Six. (9 words)
cn: 备用机器人已经在用六号生产线上了。

en: And the ones from Line Six are being serviced. (9 words)
cn: 而以前用于六号生产线上的机器人目前处于维修状态。

en: When did this happen, Jeff? (5 words)
cn: 这是什么时候发生的呢，杰夫？

en: Well, they've been making a low continuous sound for a day or two, but they finally went dead at 2:30 this afternoon. (22 words)
cn: 嗯，它们接连一两天都发出了连续低声的噪音，最后于今天下午2:30完全坏掉了。

en: I see. (2 words)
cn: 我了解了。

en: What did you do? (4 words)
cn: 你做了什么处理吗？

en: Have you tried the whole plant? (6 words)
cn: 是否已经对整个工厂的机器人进行了检测？

en: Not yet, Helen. (3 words)
cn: 还没有，海伦。

en: I thought I'd better get your OK first. (8 words)
cn: 我认为最好先得到你的许可。

en: OK. (1 word)
cn: 好的。

en: Get on the phone to Tom, and try to get their stand-ins over tonight. (14 words)
cn: 给汤姆打个电话，今晚尽量借用他们的备用机器人。

en: We have to be back at full capacity tomorrow morning. (9 words)
cn: 我们必须在明早恢复全能生产。

en: Is it a major job to repair our robots? (9 words)
cn: 修理我们的机器人是项大工程吗？

en: About a week. (3 words)
cn: 会花一周左右的时间。

en: That's what the maintenance engineer says. (6 words)
cn: 维修工程师这么说的。

en: Right. (1 word)
cn: 好的。

en: Well, if you can get the ones from a whole, please ask Tom to inform Sheffield that he may need their stand-ins in case of emergency during the next week. (29 words)
cn: 嗯，如果你能借用到我们所需要的全部备用机器人的话，就请汤姆通知谢菲尔德，为了防止出现紧急情况，下周汤姆可能需要他们的备用机器人。

en: OK. (1 word)
cn: 好的。

en: Thank you very much, Helen. (5 words)
cn: 非常感谢，海伦。

en: You're most welcome. (3 words)
cn: 你太客气了。

en: Sorry to spoil your day-off. (5 words)
cn: 在您休假时打扰了，抱歉。

en: It doesn't matter. (3 words)
cn: 没关系。

en: This is Kerry Burke, from New York Daily News. (9 words)
cn: 我是《纽约每日新闻》的克里·布尔克。

en: I'm speaking to Delroy Simmonds, an unemployed Brooklyn man who missed a job interview Tuesday for the best reasons. (19 words)
cn: 我正在采访的这位男士叫德罗依·西蒙斯，他是一位来自布鲁克林的失业者，他因为一个最正当的理由错过了周二的求职面试。

en: He was saving the life of a 9-month-old boy who was blown into the path of an oncoming subway train by a high wind. (23 words)
cn: 那天地铁即将到站时，他救下了一名被疾风刮下轨道的九个月大的男孩。

en: Everybody is making me out to be some sort of superhero. (10 words)
cn: 所有人都把我当成了某种意义上的超级英雄。

en: I'm just an ordinary person, and the father of two. (10 words)
cn: 可我只是一个普通人，是两个孩子的父亲。

en: Anybody in that situation would've done what I did. (10 words)
cn: 任何人处在当时的情况下都会像我那么做的。

en: You were going to an interview when the incident occurred, right? (12 words)
cn: 事故发生的时候，你正赶着去面试，对吗？

en: Yes, I was on my way to apply for a maintenance position. (12 words)
cn: 是的。我正要去面试维修工的职位。

en: I've been looking for a job for a year and more. (11 words)
cn: 我找工作已经有一年多的时间了。

en: I'm looking for something to support my family. (8 words)
cn: 希望可以找到养家糊口的工作。

en: Tell us what happened at the station? (7 words)
cn: 能跟我们谈谈当时地铁站内发生了什么吗？

en: There was a strong wind. (5 words)
cn: 那时风很大。

en: It had to be 30 to 40 miles an hour? (9 words)
cn: 大概时速可达30至40英里吧。

en: There was a woman with 4 kids. (7 words)
cn: 车站有位女士带着四个孩子。

en: One was in a pushchair. (5 words)
cn: 其中有个孩子还在婴儿车里。

en: The wind blew the baby onto the tracks. (8 words)
cn: 大风把车里的婴儿刮下轨道。

en: Witnesses said people were looking on in horror, as the child's mother identified by sources as Maria Zamara stood frozen in shock. (22 words)
cn: 目击者称周围的人们都惊恐地围观。婴儿的母亲，据信息来源确认为玛利亚·扎玛拉，震惊地呆站在原地。

en: In the distance, people could see the train rounding a bend headed into the station. (16 words)
cn: 人们可以看到不远处列车已经转弯，并朝车站驶来。

en: I guess you were not aware of any of this, right? (11 words)
cn: 我猜想你一定没注意到这一切，是吗？

en: No, I just jumped down and grabbed the baby. (10 words)
cn: 没注意，我只是跳下轨道，抓住了孩子。

en: The train was coming around the corner as I lifted the baby from the tracks. (16 words)
cn: 当我把孩子从轨道那抱上来的时候，列车马上就来了。

en: I really wasn't thinking. (4 words)
cn: 我当时真没多想。

en: What an amazing story! (4 words)
cn: 多么令人震惊的故事啊！

en: Thank you very much. (4 words)
cn: 非常感谢你（的分享）。

en: There's one sound that gets a big reaction from kids on a hot day—the sound of an ice-cream truck. (18 words)
cn: 热天里，有个声音总会让孩子们反应强烈，那就是冰激凌车到来的声音。

en: Maria McCartney has been in the mobile ice-cream business since 2005. (12 words)
cn: 自从2005年以来，玛丽亚·麦卡特尼就在流动贩卖冰激凌了。

en: When I was a little girl, I saw an ice-cream truck and knew I wanted to have one someday, McCartney said. (21 words)
cn: “在我还是个小女孩的时候，我看到了一辆冰激凌车，然后我就知道将来某一天我要拥有一辆。”玛丽亚·麦卡特尼这样说道。

en: During the hot days of summer, Maria and her daughter drive an ice-cream truck through neighborhoods and parks in Billings. (19 words)
cn: 在炎热的夏日里，玛丽亚和她的女儿开着冰激凌车走遍了比林斯的大街小巷和各处公园。

en: It's not about making money for this former elementary school teacher. (10 words)
cn: 对于这位曾经的小学教师来说，售卖冰激凌并非为了赚钱。

en: Rather, she wants to preserve the tradition of the neighborhood ice-cream truck. (11 words)
cn: 相反，她想要保留开着冰激凌车走街串巷卖冰激凌的传统。

en: Truly my favorite part is to see the kids jumping up and down, and they just get so excited. (19 words)
cn: 的确，我最喜欢看到的是孩子们蹦蹦跳跳的样子，（看到冰激凌车）他们就会变得非常兴奋。

en: It's great to build a memory for them too. (8 words)
cn: 还能为他们留下美好的回忆，这一点也很好。

en: There are not a lot of these ice-cream trucks around anymore. (11 words)
cn: 现在，周围没有多少这样的冰激凌车了。

en: The parents come out bare-foot and screaming, ready to buy ice-cream. (11 words)
cn: 家长们光着脚走出家门，呼喊着要买冰激凌。

en: They remember when they were kids they saw a truck, She said. (12 words)
cn: 他们记得，当他们还是小孩子的时候，他们会看到（冰激凌）车。”她说道。

en: While the treats may be ice cold, Maria has a warm heart for little faces. (14 words)
cn: 尽管冰激凌或许是冰凉的，玛丽亚对这一张张小脸却是热情的。

en: Her truck features a donation bucket for kids who don't have money for ice-cream. (15 words)
cn: 她的车有一个独特之处，带有一个捐赠桶，是专门为没钱买冰激凌的孩子设置的。

en: When there are three kids and only two of them have money, I always make sure the third one gets something, because I can't drive away and have that third one not have something, she said. (36 words)
cn: “如果有三个孩子，而其中只有两个孩子身上有钱，那么我总是会确保另外一个孩子也能得到些吃的，因为我不能就这么把冰激凌车开走了，而让第三个孩子一无所获。”她说道。

en: We know we have to pay for what we get. (9 words)
cn: 我们知道，我们必须为自己所购买的物品付钱。

en: If we buy food, we have to pay for it. (9 words)
cn: 如果要购买食品，我们必须花钱。

en: If a doctor treats us, we know there will be a bill to pay. (14 words)
cn: 如果医生为我们治病，我们知道要支付医疗账单。

en: These are private bills. (4 words)
cn: 这些都是私人账单。

en: But there are also public bills to be paid. (8 words)
cn: 但是还有些公共账单需要有人支付。

en: They are paid by the government. (6 words)
cn: 是由政府来承担的。

en: In turn we get the needed services. (7 words)
cn: 我们因此会得到所需要的各项服务。

en: We pay for these services through taxes. (8 words)
cn: 通过交税的形式，我们来为这些服务付费。

en: What would happen if everyone stopped paying taxes? (8 words)
cn: 如果人人都不再交税，会发生什么状况？

en: The water supply would stop; the streets might not be cleaned; schools would be closed. (15 words)
cn: 供水会停；街道可能会无人清扫；学校将被关闭。

en: We would not want to live in such a city. (9 words)
cn: 我们不会愿意居住在这样一座城市里。

en: The chief duty of every government is to protect persons and property. (12 words)
cn: 每个政府的首要职责就是保护居民人身及财产安全。

en: More than three fourths of government expenses are used for this purpose. (11 words)
cn: 有超过四分之三的政府开支都用于这一目的。

en: The next largest amount of public money goes to teach and train our citizens. (14 words)
cn: 剩下的一笔最大额的公共开支用于教育和培训市民。

en: Billions of dollars each year are spent on schools and libraries. (9 words)
cn: 每年，有数十亿美元的资金用在学校和图书馆方面。

en: Also a large amount of public funds is spent on roads. (11 words)
cn: 另外，有一大笔公共资金用于公路建设。

en: Most of the needed funds is raised by taxes. (9 words)
cn: 大部分所需资金是通过税收筹集的。

en: The law orders us to pay taxes. (7 words)
cn: 法律规定我们交税。

en: We have no choice in the matter. (7 words)
cn: 我们对此别无选择。

en: Years ago, the government made money by selling public lands, but most of the best public lands have now been sold. (20 words)
cn: 许多年以前，政府通过出售公共土地赚钱，但是目前大部分最好的公共土地都已经被卖掉了。

en: There are still some public lands that contain oil, coal and other natural resources. (14 words)
cn: 仍然剩下一些公共土地，它们含有石油、煤炭及其他自然资源。

en: They could be sold, but we want to save them for future years. (13 words)
cn: 这些土地本来可以被卖掉，但是我们想把它们留给未来岁月。

en: So we all must pay our share for the services that make our lives comfortable. (15 words)
cn: 因此，我们所有人都必须为各种服务买单，这些服务让我们的生活变得舒适。

en: Did you know that, besides larger places like France and Germany, Europe is home to several extremely tiny countries? (17 words)
cn: 你知道吗？除了诸如法国和德国等较大的领地之外，欧洲也有一些极其袖珍的国家。

en: One of these countries contains less than a square mile of land. (12 words)
cn: 在这些国家当中，有一个的领土面积不足一平方英里。

en: Another is surrounded on all sides by Italy. (8 words)
cn: 还有一个则被意大利四面包围着。

en: Yet each is an independent land, with its own government, trade and customs. (13 words)
cn: 即便如此，它们也都是独立国家，拥有自己的政府、贸易以及海关。

en: One of the best known of these small countries is Monaco. (11 words)
cn: 在这些袖珍国家中，有几个最负盛名，摩纳哥是其中一个。

en: It is situated on the Mediterranean Sea and surrounded by France on three sides. (14 words)
cn: 它坐落于地中海，被法国三面包围。

en: Monaco became familiar to Americans when its ruler, Prince Rainier, married the American actress Grace Kelly. (15 words)
cn: 美国人熟知摩纳哥是从它的统治者雷尼尔王子与美国女演员格瑞斯·凯莉结婚开始的。

en: Rainier's family has ruled Monaco almost continuously since 1297. (9 words)
cn: 从1297年开始，雷尼尔家族就几乎一直统治着摩纳哥。

en: The land has been independent for over three hundred years. (9 words)
cn: 这片国土赢得独立已有300余年。

en: Andorra, with an area of some 200 square miles, is considerably larger than Monaco. (14 words)
cn: 安道尔的国土面积大约200平方英里，要比摩纳哥大得多。

en: This country is located in the Pyrenees Mountains, with France on one side and Spain on the other. (17 words)
cn: 这个国家位于比利牛斯山，一面与法国接壤，另一面毗邻西班牙。

en: Potatoes and tobacco are grown in Andorra's steep mountain valleys. (9 words)
cn: 安道尔境内陡峭的高山谷地中种植着马铃薯和烟草。

en: One of the products it exports is clothing. (8 words)
cn: 服装属于该国出口的物品之一。

en: Andorra is also known for its excellent skiing locations. (8 words)
cn: 它也以极好的滑雪场所而声名远扬。

en: Within the Alps in Central Europe is Liechtenstein, a tiny country of about 30,000 people who speak mostly German. (19 words)
cn: 列支敦士登位于欧洲中部的阿尔卑斯山脉，是一个大概有3万人口并且大部分人都讲德语的袖珍国家。

en: Liechtenstein uses the same money as its neighbor Switzerland, but it has been an independent country since the 1860s. (18 words)
cn: 其境内流通的货币与邻国瑞士相同，但是自从19世纪60年代开始，它就成为了一个独立的国家。

en: Taxes are low, so many businesses have their headquarters here. (10 words)
cn: 由于征税比例很低，所以许多公司都将总部设在此国。

en: The country makes and exports a lot of machinery. (8 words)
cn: 这个国家制造并出口许多机器设备。

en: Other small independent states in Europe are San Marino and Luxembourg. (10 words)
cn: 欧洲境内其他两个独立的袖珍国家是圣马力诺和卢森堡。

en: Each of these has unique qualities as well. (8 words)
cn: 它们也都有自己的独特之处。

en: One of Google's self-driving cars crashed into a bus in California last month. (13 words)
cn: 上个月，谷歌的一辆自动驾驶汽车在加利福尼亚州与一辆公交车相撞。

en: There were no injuries. (4 words)
cn: 无人受伤。

en: It is not the first time one of Google's famed self-driving cars has been involved in a crash, but it may be the first time it has caused one. (29 words)
cn: 这不是谷歌著名的自动驾驶汽车第一次卷入交通事故，但可能是第一次由其引发事故。

en: On February 14th the self-driving car, travelling at 2mph, pulled out in front of a public bus going 15mph. (19 words)
cn: 2月14日，以每小时2英里的速度行驶的自动驾驶汽车，横冲到一辆车速为每小时15英里的公交车前面。

en: The man in the Google vehicle reported that he assumed the bus would slow down to let the car out, and so he did not switch to the manual mode. (30 words)
cn: 谷歌自动驾驶汽车中的人员报告称，他以为公交车会放慢速度让自动驾驶汽车通过，所以他没有切换到手动控制模式。

en: In a statement, Google said: "We clearly bear some responsibility, because if our car hadn't moved, there wouldn't have been a crash. (22 words)
cn: 谷歌公司在声明中表示："很明显，我们在此次事故中负有责任，因为如果我们的汽车不变道，就不会发生相撞事故。

en: That said, our test driver believed the bus was going to slow or stop to allow us to merge into the traffic, and that there would be sufficient space to do that." (32 words)
cn: 尽管如此，我们（谷歌）的测试驾驶员以为公交车会放慢速度或停下来让汽车并入车道，而且当时道路上有足够的空间可以那么做。

en: The company's self-driving cars have done well over a million miles across various states in the US, and until now have only reported minor accidents. (25 words)
cn: 谷歌公司的自动驾驶汽车已经穿越美国各州，行驶里程达100多万英里，表现一直都很好，截止到目前，据报道仅出现过几次小型事故。

en: Thousands of bees left a town after landing on the back of a car when their queen got stuck in its boot. (22 words)
cn: 数千只蜜蜂落到了一辆汽车的后部，随车离开了一座城镇，当时它们的蜂王被困在这辆汽车的后备箱里。

en: Tom Moses, who works at a nearby national park, noticed a "brown patch"on the back of the car after the owner parked it to do some shopping. (27 words)
cn: 当车主把车停下来去购物之后，在附近的国家公园工作的汤姆·摩西注意到了这辆汽车后部有"一块褐色的东西"。

en: When he looked closer he realized it was a huge group of bees. (13 words)
cn: 他靠近观察才意识到那是一大群蜜蜂。

en: Moses said, "I've never seen that many bees in one spot. (11 words)
cn: 摩西说："我从来没见过那么多蜜蜂聚集在一个地方。

en: It was very unusual. (4 words)
cn: 这很不寻常。

en: They were very close together and there was a lot of noise and movement. (14 words)
cn: 它们挨得很近，并且制造了很多噪音和动静。

en: It was interesting to see such a strange sight. (9 words)
cn: 看到如此怪异的景象很有意思。

en: But there were a lot of people around and I was a bit worried about the bees and the people stopping to look. (23 words)
cn: 不过，附近人流量大，我有点担心蜜蜂和停下来观看的人。

en: I thought that someone might do something stupid." (8 words)
cn: 我觉得有些人可能会做出愚蠢的举动。

en: Moses called two local bee specialists who helped remove the bees by attracting them into a box. (17 words)
cn: 摩西请来了两名当地的蜜蜂专家，他们通过把蜜蜂引入箱子的方式将其转移走了。

en: Moses spent three hours looking after the bees and was stung five times. (13 words)
cn: 摩西花了三个小时照看蜜蜂，被蛰了五次。

en: He said, "My stings are a bit painful but I'm pleased that all worked out and I could help. (19 words)
cn: 他说："被蜜蜂蛰是有点疼，但是我很开心一切进展顺利，而且我能帮上忙。

en: People need to realize that bees are valuable and they should be looked after." (14 words)
cn: 人们需要知道，蜜蜂是很宝贵的，应该得到妥善的照顾。

en: A new species of snake has been discovered on a remote island in the Bahamas. (15 words)
cn: 在巴哈马群岛的一个偏远岛屿上发现了一个蛇类新品种。

en: Scientists identified 20 of the one-meter-long snakes during two trips to the Caribbean islands. (14 words)
cn: 科学家两次去加勒比群岛时鉴别出了20条这种一米长的蛇。

en: The second trip was made in October last year. (9 words)
cn: 科学家第二次去加勒比是在去年10月。

en: One of the creatures made a dramatic appearance by moving on to the head of the team leader as he slept. (21 words)
cn: 其中一条蛇的出现富有戏剧性，当那个考察队的领队睡觉时，它爬到了他的头上。

en: The snake has been named Silver Boa because it is metal-colored and the first specimen found was climbing a silver palm tree. (22 words)
cn: 这种蛇被命名为"银蟒"，因为它是金属色的，而且第一个样本被发现时，它正在一棵银色的棕榈树上爬行。

en: The team was led by Dr. Graham Reynolds from Harvard University. (11 words)
cn: 那支队伍由哈佛大学的格雷厄姆·雷诺兹带队。

en: The scientist confirmed the snake was a previously unknown species after conducting a genetic analysis of tissue samples. (18 words)
cn: 这位科学家对蛇的组织样本进行基因分析之后，证实这种蛇是人类尚未发现的新品种。

en: Commenting on the find, snake expert Robert Henderson from the Milwaukee Museum of Natural History said, "Worldwide new species of frogs are being discovered and described quite regularly. (28 words)
cn: 来自密尔沃基自然历史博物馆的蛇类专家罗伯特·亨德森对该发现评论道："在全世界范围内，青蛙新品种被发现和描述很常见。

en: New species of snakes, however, are much rarer." (8 words)
cn: 然而，蛇类新品种却十分罕见。

en: Did you enjoy your stay with us, Mr. Brown? (9 words)
cn: 布朗先生，您享受在这里与我们一起度过的时光吗？

en: Yes, very much. (3 words)
cn: 是的，非常享受。

en: I had a wonderful time here. (6 words)
cn: 我在这里度过了一段非常开心的时光。

en: Now I'm going to the airport. (6 words)
cn: 现在我即将赶往机场。

en: My flight leaves in less than 2 hours. (8 words)
cn: 我的航班还有不到两个小时就要起飞了。

en: So, could you tell me what's the quickest way to get there? (12 words)
cn: 所以，能否告诉我去机场最快捷的方式？

en: Well, we can call a taxi for you. (8 words)
cn: 好的，我们可以帮您叫一辆出租车。

en: We also have a free airport shuttle service. (8 words)
cn: 我们也提供免费的机场班车接送服务。

en: That sounds great, but will the shuttle get me to the airport in time? (14 words)
cn: 那听起来不错，但是接送班车能把我及时送到机场吗？

en: Yes, it should. (3 words)
cn: 是的，可以。

en: The next shuttle leaves in 15 minutes. (7 words)
cn: 下一班接送班车15分钟后出发。

en: And it takes some 25 minutes to get to the airport. (11 words)
cn: 从这里到机场需要25分钟左右的时间。

en: Fantastic! (1 words)
cn: 那太好了！

en: I'll just wait in the lobby. (6 words)
cn: 我就在大厅里等一下吧。

en: Will you please let me know when it's leaving? (9 words)
cn: 要发车时，你能通知我一下吗？

en: Of course, sir. (3 words)
cn: 当然可以，先生。

en: Now I would like to settle my mini-bar bill. (9 words)
cn: 现在我需要结清迷你酒吧的消费账单。

en: How much is that? (4 words)
cn: 一共多少钱呢？

en: Let's see. (2 words)
cn: 我看一下。

en: It comes to thirty seven dollars and fifty cents. (9 words)
cn: 一共是37美元50美分。

en: How would you like to pay for it? (8 words)
cn: 您想用什么方式结账呢？

en: I'll pay with my credit card. (6 words)
cn: 我用信用卡。

en: Thanks. (1 words)
cn: 谢谢。

en: But I'll need a receipt, so I can charge it to my company. (13 words)
cn: 但是我需要一张收据，以便我可以跟公司报账。

en: Absolutely! (1 words)
cn: 当然可以！

en: Here you are, sir. (4 words)
cn: 给您（收据），先生。

en: If you like, you can leave your bags with the porter. (11 words)
cn: 如果您愿意，可以把您的行李给行李搬运工。

en: And he can load them onto the shuttle for you when it arrives. (13 words)
cn: 等接送班车来了，他会帮您把行李搬上去。

en: That would be great. (4 words)
cn: 那样的话就太好了。

en: Thank you. (2 words)
cn: 谢谢。

en: Would you like to leave a comment on our webpage when you have time? (14 words)
cn: 方便的时候，能否请您在我们的网页上留下评论呢？

en: Sure. (1 words)
cn: 当然可以。

en: I had a really good stay here, and I'd like to recommend your hotel to my friends and colleagues. (19 words)
cn: 我在这里住得非常舒适，所以我愿意把你们这家宾馆推荐给我的朋友和同事们。

en: That's very kind of you. (5 words)
cn: 您太好了。

en: Thank you again for staying at Sheraton Hotel. (8 words)
cn: 再一次感谢您入住喜来登酒店。

en: You know,Ben's given up making those terrible faces he used to make. (12 words)
cn: 你知道的，本已经不再像以前那样做可怕的鬼脸了。

en: The other day, he came home from school almost in tears. (11 words)
cn: 几天前，他放学回家，眼里含着泪水。

en: His teacher said if he went on like that, his face would get stuck when the winds changed. (18 words)
cn: 他的老师说如果他继续做可怕的鬼脸，当风向改变的时候，他的脸将动不了了。

en: And he believed her? (4 words)
cn: 他相信了他的老师？

en: Yeah, he's only a little boy. (6 words)
cn: 是啊，他只是个小孩子。

en: Don't you remember all those things we used to believe when we were little? (14 words)
cn: 你不记得我们小的时候曾经相信的那些事了吗？

en: I remember my aunt Mary used to say if you swallow a cherry stone, a tree will grow out of your mouth. (22 words)
cn: 我记得我姑姑玛丽过去常说，如果吞掉一颗樱桃核，就会有一棵树从嘴巴里长出来。

en: And I'm still terrified today, sort of subconsciously. (8 words)
cn: 到如今我潜意识里仍然害怕这件事。

en: You know, if I swallow one by mistake... (8 words)
cn: 你知道，如果我误吞了一颗樱桃核……

en: Yeah, I suppose you're right. (5 words)
cn: 是啊，我认为你是对的。

en: The one that used to get me was that swans could break your leg with a blow of the wing. (20 words)
cn: 最让我害怕的是天鹅拍一下翅膀就能打断人的腿。

en: They can, can't they? (4 words)
cn: 它们确实可以，难道不是吗？

en: I always thought they could. (5 words)
cn: 我一直认为它们可以。

en: No, they are not that strong. (6 words)
cn: 不，它们没有那么强壮。

en: But there's another one even more terrifying. (7 words)
cn: 但是还有一个更为恐怖的说法。

en: That is, if you put a postage stamp on upside down, you'll go to prison. (15 words)
cn: 那就是，如果将邮票贴倒了，你将会坐牢。

en: No, never heard of that. (5 words)
cn: 不，我从没听过这种说法。

en: But my grandmother was a terror for that kind of thing. (11 words)
cn: 但是我的祖母总是会把那样的事情说得非常恐怖。

en: For example, she would say, you will get a spot on your tongue if you tell a lie. (18 words)
cn: 比如说，她会说，如果说谎，舌头上就会长斑点。

en: If you eat stale bread, your hair will curl. (9 words)
cn: 如果吃不新鲜的面包，头发就会变卷。

en: And here's one more. (4 words)
cn: 还有一个例子。

en: We went on a camping trip once in Italy, and my wife spent the whole time worrying about bats getting into her hair. (23 words)
cn: 有一次，我们参加意大利的露营旅行，我妻子全程都在担心蝙蝠飞进她的头发。

en: She said her grandmother reckoned you had to shave your head to get it out. (15 words)
cn: 她说她的祖母认为只有把头发剃光才能把蝙蝠赶出去。

en: My wife was really terrified. (5 words)
cn: 我妻子真的非常害怕。

en: Silly, isn't it? (3 words)
cn: 很愚蠢，不是吗？

en: But that's how some parents try to keep their kids from doing the wrong thing or getting into trouble. (19 words)
cn: 但是一些父母就是通过这种方式试图让他们的孩子不做错事或不招惹麻烦。

en: If I could go back in history and live when I liked, I wouldn't go back very far. (18 words)
cn: 如果我能回到过去，生活在我喜欢的年代，我不会回去太远。

en: In fact, I'd like to relive a period I've already lived, the 1960s. (13 words)
cn: 事实上，我想要重温自己曾经历过的一段时间——20世纪60年代。

en: I was in my twenties, and everything was being renewed. (10 words)
cn: 那时的我二十多岁，一切正重新振兴。

en: People were coming out of a formal and almost Victorian attitude, and you really felt anything was possible. (18 words)
cn: 当时人们正在摆脱一种拘谨的几乎是维多利亚式的态度，你能真真切切地感受到一切皆有可能。

en: Meeting people was the thing, and you went to coffee bars where you met friends and spent the evening. (19 words)
cn: 社交是最流行的，人们去咖啡馆会友，并在那里度过夜晚的时光。

en: The cinema, the theater, all that was very exciting with new things coming out. (14 words)
cn: 电影院、剧院，所有这些新兴事物都令人异常兴奋。

en: In fact, we seemed to be out all the time. (10 words)
cn: 事实上，那时的我们似乎一直都待在外面。

en: I don't really remember working. (5 words)
cn: 我其实不记得自己工作过。

en: Of course, I was a student, or sitting around at home very much. (13 words)
cn: 当然了，那时我还是一名学生，大多数时间都待在家里无所事事。

en: That just wasn't where the scene was, even eating. (9 words)
cn: 但家里可看不到什么景象，就连吃饭也是。

en: It was the first time ordinary people started going out to eat. (12 words)
cn: 那时也是大众第一次开始在外就餐。

en: We were beginning to be adventurous about food, but we were more interested in meeting people than in eating or drinking. (21 words)
cn: 我们开始探索食物，但相较于吃喝，我们对社交更感兴趣。

en: And dress, yes, that was the revolution. (7 words)
cn: 而且，服饰，没错，那可是一场变革。

en: I mean, girls went around in really short skirts, and wore flowers in their hair. (15 words)
cn: 我是说，女孩们穿着相当短的裙子闲逛，头上还戴着花饰。

en: And men were in jeans, and could wear their hair long too. (12 words)
cn: 男士们穿着牛仔，也能留长发。

en: It was a wonderful period. (5 words)
cn: 那是个美好的时期。

en: It was like living in an age you could never have imagined, and that never has come back. (18 words)
cn: 仿佛生活在一个你想都没想过的时代，而那个时代一去不复返了。

en: We didn't have much money, but it didn't matter. (9 words)
cn: 那时我们不富有，但这不重要。

en: And there was plenty of opportunity to do whatever you felt like doing. (13 words)
cn: 在那个时期，你有无限的可能做任何你想做的事情。

en: Dogs, men's best friends, have a clear strategy for dealing with angry owners—they look away. (15 words)
cn: 狗，人类最好的朋友，有一个清晰的策略来应对生气的主人——它们会转移目光。

en: New research shows that dogs limit their eye contact with angry humans. (12 words)
cn: 新的研究表明，狗会减少与生气的人类进行眼神交流。

en: The scientists suggest this may be an attempt to calm humans down. (12 words)
cn: 科学家认为，这是使人类冷静下来的一种尝试。

en: This behavior may have evolved as dogs gradually learned they could benefit from avoiding conflicts with humans. (17 words)
cn: 随着狗逐渐意识到它们会从避免和人类起冲突中获得好处，这种行为可能已经得到了进化。

en: To conduct the tests, the University of Helsinki researchers trained 31 dogs to rest in front of a video screen. (20 words)
cn: 为了进行测试，赫尔辛基大学的研究者训练了31只狗，让它们待在一个录像机屏幕前。

en: Facial photos of dogs and humans were displayed on the screen for 1.5 seconds. (14 words)
cn: 每隔1.5秒，屏幕上就会出现狗和人类的面部照片。

en: They showed threatening, pleasant and neutral expressions. (7 words)
cn: 这些照片展现出了危险的、愉快的和中立的表情。

en: Nearby cameras tracked the dogs' eye movements. (7 words)
cn: 附近的录像机捕捉到了狗的视线移动。

en: Dogs in the study looked most at the eyes of humans and other dogs to sense their emotions. (18 words)
cn: 测试中大多数的狗看了人类和其他狗的眼睛，以感知其情绪。

en: When dogs looked at the expressions of angry dogs, their eyes rested more on the mouth, perhaps to interpret the threatening expressions. (22 words)
cn: 当狗看到生气的狗的表情时，它们的视线会更多停留在嘴上，可能想要诠释这种威胁性的表情。

en: And when looking at angry humans, they tended to turn away their gaze. (13 words)
cn: 当看到生气的人类时，它们却倾向于转移目光。

en: Dogs may have learned to detect threat signs from humans and respond by trying to make peace. (17 words)
cn: 狗或许已经学会了感知危险信号并尝试着用和平的方式作出回应。

en: According to researcher Sanni Somppi, avoiding conflicts may have helped dogs develop better bonds with humans. (16 words)
cn: 萨尼·松皮认为，避免冲突或许有助于狗与人类发展更好的关系。

en: The researchers also note that dogs scan faces as a whole to sense how people are feeling, instead of focusing on a given feature. (24 words)
cn: 研究者还指出，狗通过观察人类的整张脸来感知人类的情绪，而不是只关注某一个特定的特征。

en: They suggest this indicates that dogs aren't sensing emotions from a single feature, but piecing together information from all facial features just as humans do. (25 words)
cn: 他们认为，这表明狗不是通过某一个单一的特征来感知情绪，而是像人类一样，从所有的面部特征中综合分析信息。

en: Winter in many places is very cold. (7 words)
cn: 许多地方的冬天都很冷。

en: There is lots of snow around, and the ground freezes, which can make life difficult for animals. (17 words)
cn: 周围到处是积雪，地面也结冰，这会使动物的生存变得艰难。

en: People in cold places live in warm houses and have learned to adapt. (13 words)
cn: 寒冷地区的人们居住在温暖的房子里，而且已经学会适应寒冷天气。

en: What do animals do? (4 words)
cn: 动物们怎么办呢？

en: There are three main ways that animals survive the cold in winter: sleep, adapt or migrate. (16 words)
cn: 动物度过严冬有三种主要方式：冬眠、适应以及迁徙。

en: Some animals, such as bears, frogs and snakes, sleep all winter. (11 words)
cn: 有些动物，诸如熊、青蛙和蛇，它们会睡一整个冬季。

en: They sleep very deeply and need little or no food. (10 words)
cn: 它们的睡眠很深，需要很少或者几乎不需要食物。

en: While sleeping, their body temperature drops, and their heart beat slows down. (12 words)
cn: 当冬眠的时候，它们的体温会下降，心跳也会减速。

en: To prepare for this before winter, these animals eat extra food to become fat, which gives them the energy they need while they sleep. (24 words)
cn: 为了在寒冬来临之前做好冬眠的准备，这些动物吃些额外的食物增加脂肪，可以提供冬眠期间所需能量。

en: Other animals adapt, for example, by staying active in winter. (10 words)
cn: 另外一些动物则适应环境，比如说，在冬天保持活跃。

en: It is often hard for them to find food. (9 words)
cn: 找食物对它们来说往往很困难。

en: So some animals, such as mice, collect extra food before winter, and hide it. (14 words)
cn: 所以一些动物，比如鼠类，会在冬天到来之前收集更多的食物并把它们藏起来。

en: When winter comes, they return to the hiding places to eat the food. (13 words)
cn: 冬天一来，它们就返回贮藏处吃食物。

en: Some animals grow thicker fur, or live in tree holes or underground to stay warm. (15 words)
cn: 一些动物蓄起更厚的皮毛，也有些住进树洞或地下来保暖。

en: Some birds migrate by flying to a warmer place for the winter, where they can find more food. (18 words)
cn: 一些飞鸟迁徙到更温暖的地方过冬，在那里，它们能觅到更多的食物。

en: Some fly very long distances, including one kind of bird that flies from the remote north of the world, all the way to the distant south. (26 words)
cn: 有些鸟类飞行的距离很远，这其中包括一种鸟，它们从地球偏远的北方一路飞向遥远的南方。

en: Some birds fly in groups for safety, while others fly alone. (11 words)
cn: 有些鸟类为了安全，成群飞行，还有一些则选择单独飞行。

en: Automakers and tech companies are working hard to offer the first true self-driving car. (14 words)
cn: 汽车制造商和科技公司正在努力推出第一辆真正意义上的自动驾驶汽车。

en: But 75% of drivers say they wouldn't feel safe in such a vehicle. (13 words)
cn: 但75%的驾驶员表示，乘坐这样的汽车他们会感到不安全。

en: Still, 60% of drivers would like to get some kind of self-driving feature, such as automatic braking or self-parking, the next time they buy a new car. (27 words)
cn: 不过，60%的驾驶员表示，下次购买新车时，希望能获得某种自动驾驶功能，例如自动刹车或自动泊车。

en: The attitudes are published in a new AAA survey of 1,800 drivers. (12 words)
cn: 上述调查结果发表在一项针对1800名驾驶员的AAA新调查中。

en: Advocates of self-driving cars argue they would be safer than in cars driven by humans because they wouldn't get distracted or drive when tired. (24 words)
cn: 自动驾驶汽车的支持者认为，它们比人类驾驶的汽车更安全，因为它们不会分心，也不会疲劳驾驶。

en: But those surveyed by AAA say they trust their own driving skills. (12 words)
cn: 但参与AAA调查的人表示，他们信任自己的驾驶技术。

en: Many feel the technology is too new and unproven. (9 words)
cn: 许多人认为这项技术太新，尚未经过验证。

en: John Nielsen, AAA's managing director of automotive engineering and repair, said tests suggest drivers may be overestimating their own abilities. (20 words)
cn: AAA汽车工程与维修业务总监约翰·尼尔森表示，测试表明驾驶员可能高估了自己的驾驶能力。

en: He also believes they will be more likely to trust self-driving cars as they become more familiar with features such as automatic braking or parking. (25 words)
cn: 他还认为，随着驾驶员对自动刹车或自动泊车等功能越来越熟悉，他们会更愿意信任自动驾驶汽车。

en: He estimated that the "comfort level" will increase considerably in five to ten years. (14 words)
cn: 他估计，五到十年内，'舒适感'将大幅提升。

en: One dog has been killed and multiple dogs have been injured by a snowmobile driver in what appears to be an intentional attack on competitors in the Iditarod Race in Alaska. (31 words)
cn: 在阿拉斯加艾迪塔罗德雪橇比赛中，一名摩托雪橇驾驶员对参赛选手发动了疑似蓄意袭击，造成一只狗死亡、多只狗受伤。

en: Aliy Zirkle was the first to report an attack. (9 words)
cn: 埃莉·泽克尔是第一个报告袭击事件的人。
