en: A snowmobile driver had repeatedly attempted to harm her and her team, and one of Zirkle's dogs had received a non-life-threatening injury. (22 words)
cn: 一名摩托雪橇驾驶员曾多次试图伤害她和她的队伍，泽克尔的一只狗受了不危及生命的伤。

en: Zirkle reported the attack when she arrived in Nulato, Alaska, in the early hours of the morning. (17 words)
cn: 泽克尔在清晨抵达阿拉斯加努拉托时报告了这次袭击。

en: Then Jeff King, a four-time champion, reported a similar attack. (10 words)
cn: 随后，四届冠军杰夫·金也报告了类似的袭击事件。

en: His team was hit by a snowmobile driver, injuring several dogs and killing a 3-year-old male dog. (17 words)
cn: 他的队伍被一名摩托雪橇驾驶员冲撞，数只狗受伤，一只3岁的雄性狗死亡。

en: Reporter Zachariah Hughes says that neither King nor Zirkle was injured. (11 words)
cn: 记者撒迦利亚·休斯表示，金和泽克尔均未受伤。

en: Although this incident very much alters the race of the two participants competing for a win, both are going to continue on their way toward the finishing line. (28 words)
cn: 尽管这一事件严重影响了这两位争夺冠军的选手的比赛，但他们都将继续向终点线进发。

en: Alaska State Troopers released a statement saying they've arrested Arnold Demoski, 26. (12 words)
cn: 阿拉斯加州警察发表声明，称已逮捕26岁的阿诺德·德莫斯基。

en: He faces trial on several charges. (6 words)
cn: 他面临多项指控。

en: A tour boat turned over off the coast of Nicaragua, killing at least 13 people and leaving more passengers missing, officials said. (22 words)
cn: 官员称，一艘游船在尼加拉瓜沿海翻沉，造成至少13人死亡，更多乘客下落不明。

en: The boat was carrying 32 people—25 Costa Ricans, four Americans and three Nicaraguans. (13 words)
cn: 船上共载有32人，其中25名哥斯达黎加人、4名美国人和3名尼加拉瓜人。

en: The 13 dead were all Costa Rican, the Foreign Ministry said. (11 words)
cn: 外交部称，13名遇难者均为哥斯达黎加人。

en: The boat, traveling between Nicaragua's Big Corn Island and Little Corn Island, turned over Saturday near the larger island. (19 words)
cn: 这艘船在尼加拉瓜大科恩岛和小科恩岛之间航行，周六在靠近较大岛屿附近翻沉。

en: Some passengers remain missing, the Costa Rican Foreign Ministry said, but did not specify how many. (16 words)
cn: 哥斯达黎加外交部称，仍有部分乘客失踪，但未说明具体人数。

en: A local radio said an unspecified number of people were rescued, including the tour boat's owner, Hilario Blandon. (18 words)
cn: 当地一家广播电台报道，有不明数量的人员获救，其中包括游船船主伊拉里奥·布兰登。

en: Nicaraguan naval authorities had banned sea travel in the area because of bad weather and strong winds, but the tour boat proceeded anyway. (23 words)
cn: 尼加拉瓜海军当局已因恶劣天气和强风禁止该海域的海上旅行，但这艘游船仍然出发了。

en: Blandon, the boat's owner, has been arrested by Nicaraguan authorities, the state-run news agency said. (15 words)
cn: 据官方通讯社报道，船主布兰登已被尼加拉瓜当局逮捕。

en: Both he and a crew member are being investigated for unintentional murder and exposing people to danger, according to police. (20 words)
cn: 据警方称，他和一名船员正因过失杀人和使他人处于危险境地而接受调查。

en: Hi, Susan, you're looking very smart today. (7 words)
cn: 嘿，苏珊，你今天看起来非常精神。

en: I always look smart, James. (5 words)
cn: 我一直都很精神，詹姆斯。

en: Actually, I'm on my way to a job interview. (9 words)
cn: 其实，我正要去参加一个工作面试。

en: What job? (2 words)
cn: 什么工作？

en: Oh, you mean, for the summer holidays? (7 words)
cn: 哦，你是说暑假期间的工作吗？

en: Yeah. (1 words)
cn: 是的。

en: There's only two weeks to go. (6 words)
cn: 只剩两周了。

en: I've got a second interview with that big foreign accountancy firm in the city center. (15 words)
cn: 我在市中心那家大型外资会计公司获得了第二次面试的机会。

en: You know the one. (4 words)
cn: 你知道那家公司的。

en: That's fantastic. (2 words)
cn: 太棒了。

en: The work is just helping out with data input, you know, but the pay isn't too bad. (17 words)
cn: 这份工作只是帮忙录入数据，不过薪资还不错。

en: It might suit you too. (5 words)
cn: 也许也适合你。

en: I know they have at least two temporary positions available. (10 words)
cn: 我知道他们至少有两个临时职位空缺。

en: And I don't think they have anyone else. (8 words)
cn: 而且我觉得他们还没有其他合适的人选。

en: Hmm... If they take you on, tell them you know a friend who'd be really good too. (17 words)
cn: 嗯……如果他们录用你，告诉他们你有个朋友也很优秀。

en: I really need the money and the experience would look good on my resume. (14 words)
cn: 我非常需要这笔钱，而且这段工作经历会让我的简历更出色。

en: Maybe we'll be working together. (5 words)
cn: 也许我们会一起共事。

en: The dream team. (3 words)
cn: 梦之队。

en: OK. (1 words)
cn: 好的。

en: We'll do. (2 words)
cn: 没问题。

en: If the boss likes me, I'll mention it. (8 words)
cn: 如果老板喜欢我，我会提到你的。

en: It'll be good to have someone around who I know. (10 words)
cn: 身边有个认识的人会很不错。

en: I'll phone you afterwards. (4 words)
cn: 之后我会给你打电话。

en: But perhaps you should put in an application anyway. (9 words)
cn: 不过你也许还是应该主动投一份申请。

en: Thanks, Susan. (2 words)
cn: 谢谢，苏珊。

en: That's great. (2 words)
cn: 太好了。

en: Listen, do you want a lift to the city? (9 words)
cn: 你要去市中心吗？搭我顺风车吧。

en: I have my dad's car today, and nothing else to do this morning. (13 words)
cn: 我今天开着我爸的车，早上也没什么事。

en: Sure. (1 words)
cn: 当然。

en: Thanks, James. (2 words)
cn: 谢谢，詹姆斯。

en: Let's go then. (3 words)
cn: 那我们走吧。

en: The car's over there. (4 words)
cn: 车就在那边。

en: By the way, how's your knowledge of accountancy? (8 words)
cn: 对了，你对会计知识了解多少？

en: The interviewer may ask you about it. (7 words)
cn: 面试官可能会问你这方面的问题。

en: No problem. (2 words)
cn: 没问题。

en: I think I can survive. (5 words)
cn: 我觉得我可以应对。

en: I might just have to review a few accountancy terms. (10 words)
cn: 我可能只需要复习一些会计术语。

en: Maybe you can give me a practice interview first. (9 words)
cn: 也许你可以先帮我模拟一次面试。

en: Of course. (2 words)
cn: 当然可以。

en: Let's go then. (3 words)
cn: 那我们走吧。

en: Don't want to be late. (5 words)
cn: 不能迟到。

en: There's new data out today that confirms that many Americans are not good at math, and when it comes to everyday technology skills, we are dead last when compared to other developed countries. (33 words)
cn: 今天有新数据出炉，证实许多美国人不擅长数学，而且在日常技术技能方面，与其他发达国家相比，我们绝对垫底。

en: Here's Gabrielle Emanuel of National Public Radio. (7 words)
cn: 以下是国家公共电台记者加布里埃尔·伊曼纽尔的报道。

en: Let's start with the bad news that Americans are terrible at technology skills, using email, naming a file on a computer, using a link on a webpage, or just texting someone. (31 words)
cn: 先来说说坏消息——美国人在技术技能方面表现很差，无论是使用电子邮件、给电脑文件夹命名、使用网页链接，还是给别人发短信。

en: No country scored below the U.S.? (6 words)
cn: 没有哪个国家的得分比美国还低吗？

en: Only one country. (3 words)
cn: 只有一个国家。

en: Poland performed as poorly as we did. (7 words)
cn: 波兰的表现和我们一样糟糕。

en: Who came out the first? (5 words)
cn: 谁排名第一呢？

en: Japan did the best and then Finland. (7 words)
cn: 日本表现最好，其次是芬兰。

en: If you look at data about reading and math, you'll notice something interesting. (13 words)
cn: 如果你看一下阅读和数学方面的数据，你会发现一件有趣的事。

en: Younger adults who went to college or graduate school were doing pretty well. (13 words)
cn: 上过大学或研究生院的年轻人表现还不错。

en: In literacy, they were actually doing better than their peers in other countries. (13 words)
cn: 在读写能力方面，他们实际上比其他国家的同龄人表现更好。

en: So that's a bit of good news. (7 words)
cn: 这算是个好消息。

en: But when you look at Americans who have a high school diploma, they look a lot like other countries' high school dropouts. (22 words)
cn: 但如果你看看持有高中文凭的美国人，他们的表现就像其他国家的高中辍学生一样。

en: We have a lot of work to do. (8 words)
cn: 我们还有很多工作要做。

en: That is especially true when it comes to math. (9 words)
cn: 在数学方面尤其如此。

en: You go to the store and there's a sale. (9 words)
cn: 你去商店，看到有促销活动。

en: Buy one, get the second one half off. (8 words)
cn: 买一件，第二件半价。

en: You decide to buy two. (5 words)
cn: 你决定买两件。

en: How much do you pay? (5 words)
cn: 你要付多少钱？

en: You mean high school graduates can't do this task in general? (11 words)
cn: 你是说高中毕业生通常连这个问题都算不出来吗？

en: You're right. (2 words)
cn: 你说得对。

en: What does that tell us about our education system? (9 words)
cn: 这说明我们的教育体系存在什么问题呢？

en: Well, it tells us that we need to think about the preparedness of our students as they are leaving high school. (21 words)
cn: 嗯，这说明我们需要思考学生在离开高中时的学习准备情况。

en: Right. (1 words)
cn: 是的。

en: And schools, employers, in fact we all need to do something about it. (13 words)
cn: 学校、雇主，事实上我们所有人都需要采取行动。

en: Thank you, Gabrielle. (3 words)
cn: 谢谢你，加布里埃尔。

en: Wild carrots probably evolved with the other flowering plants about 360 million years ago. (14 words)
cn: 野生胡萝卜大约在3.6亿年前与其他开花植物一同进化。

en: Like apples, carrots are native to Central Asia. (8 words)
cn: 和苹果一样，胡萝卜原产于中亚地区。

en: That's why horses, which also come from Central Asia, like both apples and carrots so much. (16 words)
cn: 这就是为什么同样来自中亚的马既喜欢苹果又喜欢胡萝卜的原因。

en: With wild carrots, the roots are white, small and skinny, so you'd have to pick a lot of wild carrots to get enough to eat. (25 words)
cn: 野生胡萝卜的根是白色的，又小又细，所以必须采摘大量野生胡萝卜才能吃饱。

en: Doctors used carrot seeds and roots as medicine, on the theory that foods that taste bad must be good for you. (21 words)
cn: 医生将胡萝卜种子和根用作药物，他们认为味道不好的食物对身体有益。

en: Around 800 AD, people in Central Asia managed to develop a new kind of carrot—a purple carrot—that attracted more interest from international traders. (23 words)
cn: 大约在公元800年，中亚地区的人们培育出了一种新型胡萝卜——紫色胡萝卜，吸引了国际贸易商更多的兴趣。

en: Then, in the late 1500s, food scientists in the Netherlands cultivated large, straight, sweet, red carrots like the ones we eat today. (22 words)
cn: 随后，在16世纪后期，荷兰的食物科学家培育出了又大又直、甜美的红色胡萝卜，与我们今天吃的胡萝卜相似。

en: But people still mostly fed carrots to horses, donkeys and pigs, and didn't eat them themselves. (16 words)
cn: 但当时人们大多将胡萝卜喂给马、驴和猪，自己并不食用。

en: In the 1600s, people in China used carrots as medicine, but they also ate carrots boiled in soup. (18 words)
cn: 17世纪，中国人将胡萝卜用作药物，但也会把胡萝卜煮在汤里食用。

en: The red color was popular for Chinese New Year celebrations. (10 words)
cn: 红色胡萝卜在中国新年庆典中很受欢迎。

en: But carrots got their biggest boost during the two world wars, when food shortages forced people to eat them, and governments told everyone how healthy carrots were. (27 words)
cn: 但胡萝卜在两次世界大战期间得到了最大的推广，当时食物匮乏迫使人们食用胡萝卜，政府也向大家宣传胡萝卜的健康益处。

en: Today, cooler countries grow most of the world's carrots. (9 words)
cn: 如今，气候较凉爽的国家种植了世界上大部分的胡萝卜。

en: Machines do most of the planting and picking, and carrots are easy to store and ship, so they are cheap almost everywhere. (22 words)
cn: 机器完成了大部分的种植和采摘工作，胡萝卜也易于储存和运输，因此几乎在任何地方都价格低廉。

en: Katherine loved Facebook. (3 words)
cn: 凯瑟琳很喜欢Facebook。

en: With Facebook, she could stay connected with her family no matter how far away they were. (16 words)
cn: 有了Facebook，无论家人相距多远，她都能与他们保持联系。

en: She could see their photos and read their status updates. (10 words)
cn: 她可以看到他们的照片，阅读他们的状态更新。

en: With Facebook, she could keep her relatives up-to-date on what she was doing. (13 words)
cn: 有了Facebook，她可以让亲戚们随时了解她的动态。

en: Another thing Katherine loved about Facebook was that she didn't have to think about time zones when updating family. (19 words)
cn: 凯瑟琳喜欢Facebook的另一点是，向家人发布动态时不需要考虑时差问题。

en: Whenever she called her parents or other relatives, she always had to think about the time difference so that she wouldn't wake someone up or call when she knew they were at church. (33 words)
cn: 每次给父母或其他亲戚打电话时，她都必须考虑时差，以免打扰他们睡觉或在他们去教堂时来电。

en: Facebook was so convenient. (4 words)
cn: Facebook真的太方便了。

en: When Katherine joined Facebook, some of her classmates at high school started to add her as a friend. (18 words)
cn: 凯瑟琳加入Facebook后，她高中时的一些同学开始添加她为好友。

en: At first, this didn't bother her. (6 words)
cn: 起初，这并不困扰她。

en: She loved learning about the success of people she knew when she was just a teenager. (16 words)
cn: 她喜欢了解她青少年时期认识的人所取得的成就。

en: She loved finding out people were getting married, having babies, and traveling. (12 words)
cn: 她喜欢得知他们结婚、生孩子和旅行的消息。

en: Soon, however, Katherine found herself comparing herself with the people she was reading about on Facebook. (16 words)
cn: 然而，不久后，凯瑟琳发现自己开始将自己与在Facebook上看到的人进行比较。

en: It began to make her feel bad that some people seemed to be doing so much better than she was. (20 words)
cn: 看到一些人似乎过得比自己好得多，她开始感到难受。

en: She was also spending a lot of time on Facebook. (10 words)
cn: 她在Facebook上花费的时间也越来越多。

en: It took a lot of time and energy to keep up with everyone's status updates. (15 words)
cn: 跟上每个人的状态更新需要耗费大量时间和精力。

en: Katherine started to think. (4 words)
cn: 凯瑟琳开始反思。

en: She looked at the list of over 500 friends she had on Facebook and realized some of them were not really friends at all. (24 words)
cn: 她看了看自己Facebook上500多位好友的名单，意识到其中一些人根本算不上真正的朋友。

en: Do you know where a mule comes from? (8 words)
cn: 你知道骡子是怎么来的吗？

en: It is the child of a donkey and a horse. (10 words)
cn: 它是驴和马的后代。

en: Mules have strong muscles like horses, but they eat less, can work longer, and are gentler, like donkeys. (18 words)
cn: 骡子像马一样拥有强健的肌肉，但它们比马吃得少、工作时间更长，而且像驴一样温顺。

en: George Washington was the first person in the United States to own mules. (13 words)
cn: 乔治·华盛顿是美国第一个拥有骡子的人。

en: He had heard that mules made good farm animals and he contacted the U.S. ambassador in Spain to ask about them. (21 words)
cn: 他听说骡子是很好的农业动物，便联系了美国驻西班牙大使，询问有关骡子的事宜。

en: In 1785, King Charles III of Spain sent Washington a male donkey as a gift. (15 words)
cn: 1785年，西班牙国王查理三世送给华盛顿一头公驴作为礼物。

en: That male donkey became the father of the mule industry in the U.S. (13 words)
cn: 那头公驴成了美国骡业的奠基之父。

en: Every April, Maury County holds a Mule Day celebration. (9 words)
cn: 每年四月，莫里县都会举办骡子节庆典。

en: Held in Columbia, Tennessee, Mule Day had its beginnings as "Breeder's Day" in the 1840s. (15 words)
cn: 骡子节在田纳西州哥伦比亚市举办，起源于19世纪40年代的'育种者日'。

en: Farmers and farm animal breeders would bring their animals to market every April to show, buy, and trade. (18 words)
cn: 每年四月，农民和农畜饲养员都会将他们的动物带到市场上展示、买卖和交易。

en: This was an important business before the days of tractors, when many families made a living from farming and mules were used as work animals. (25 words)
cn: 这在拖拉机出现之前是一项重要的买卖，那时许多家庭靠务农为生，骡子则作为劳动动物使用。

en: Eventually, tractors began to replace mules, making them less in demand. (11 words)
cn: 后来，拖拉机开始取代骡子，骡子的需求量也随之减少。

en: A parade was added to Mule Day in 1934 to attract more people. (13 words)
cn: 1934年，骡子节增加了一场游行活动，以吸引更多人参与。

en: Over the years other activities have been added, and today more than 200,000 people show up each year to watch and participate. (22 words)
cn: 多年来，各种活动不断增加，如今每年有超过20万人前来观看和参与。

en: If you visit during Mule Day celebrations, you might see mule-driving contests, square dances, horse shows or even tree-cutting competitions. (20 words)
cn: 如果你在骡子节期间来访，可能会看到驾骡比赛、广场舞、马术表演，甚至伐树比赛。

en: A New Jersey black bear that walks upright on its two back legs and has become a social media darling has re-emerged and has been captured on video months after its last sighting. (33 words)
cn: 新泽西州一头用两条后腿直立行走的黑熊成了社交媒体上的明星，在最后一次被目击数月后，它又重新出现，并被拍下了视频。

en: The bear named Pedals was spotted in the town of Oak Ridge. (12 words)
cn: 这头名叫"佩德尔斯"的黑熊曾在橡树岭镇被人看到。

en: In a video posted to Facebook featuring the bear, it appeared to be in relatively good health and was moving quickly. (21 words)
cn: 在发布到脸书上的一段关于这头熊的视频中，它看起来健康状况相对良好，行动也很迅速。

en: Pedals apparently has an injured leg or paw that doesn’t allow it to walk comfortably on all fours, according to experts. (21 words)
cn: 据专家称，"佩德尔斯"显然有一条腿或一只爪子受伤了，因此无法舒适地用四肢行走。

en: Lawrence Hajna, spokesman for the State Department of Environmental Protection, said officials expect the bear to make it through next winter. (21 words)
cn: 州环境保护部的发言人劳伦斯·哈伊纳说，官员们希望这头熊能平安度过下一个冬天。

en: The bear first gained fame after it was spotted wandering around neighborhoods and was caught on videos that were posted on social media and shown on national television. (28 words)
cn: 这头熊最初出名是因为有人发现它在居民区附近游荡，并拍下了视频发布在社交媒体上，还在国家电视台播出。

en: Last year, supporters pushed for Pedals to be moved to a shelter, but New Jersey officials have said they won’t allow the bear to be captured and transferred to the facility. (31 words)
cn: 去年，支持者曾强烈要求将"佩德尔斯"转移到收容所，但新泽西州官员表示不会允许这头熊被捕获并转移到该设施。

en: The bear would do better in its natural habitat and the agency would step in if its condition deteriorated, they said. (21 words)
cn: 他们说，这头熊在自然栖息地会过得更好，如果它的状况恶化，该机构会介入。

en: It’s not your imagination. (4 words)
cn: 这不是你的错觉。

en: Traffic in the US is actually getting worse. (8 words)
cn: 美国的交通状况实际上正在恶化。

en: Americans drove more miles last year than any other year on record. (12 words)
cn: 去年美国人的驾驶里程超过了有记录以来的任何一年。

en: The U.S. Department of Transportation says Americans drove nearly 3150 billion miles last year. (14 words)
cn: 美国交通部称，去年美国人的驾驶里程接近3.15万亿英里。

en: That’s about the same distance as 337 round trips from Earth to Pluto. (13 words)
cn: 这大约相当于从地球到冥王星往返337次的距离。

en: The previous record was 3003 billion miles in 2007 before the economic recession in high gas prices. (17 words)
cn: 此前的纪录是2007年的3.003万亿英里，当时正值经济衰退和油价高企之前。

en: The traffic increase comes at the same time as gas prices drop significantly. (13 words)
cn: 交通流量的增加恰逢汽油价格大幅下跌。

en: The current average gas price in the US is $1.71 per gallon. (12 words)
cn: 美国目前的平均汽油价格为每加仑1.71美元。

en: A year ago, it was $2.31 per gallon. (8 words)
cn: 一年前是每加仑2.31美元。

en: It was often much higher in recent years. (8 words)
cn: 近几年的价格往往要高得多。

en: A transportation expert told the reporter that job growth likely plays a part as well, along with some people driving longer distances to and from work. (26 words)
cn: 一位交通专家告诉记者，就业增长可能也起了作用，此外还有一些人上下班的通勤距离更长了。

en: And so all this means more traffic jams on the road. (11 words)
cn: 所以这一切都意味着路上的交通堵塞会更多。

en: The Texas A&M Travel Institute found that rush-hour travelers spent extra 42 hours on the road last year because of travel delays. (22 words)
cn: 得克萨斯农工大学交通研究所发现，去年高峰时段的出行者因交通延误在路上多花了42个小时。

en: Now, that is depressing. (4 words)
cn: 这真是令人沮丧。

en: A 16-year-old asked a stranger at a grocery store to buy him and his mother some food in exchange for carrying the man’s groceries to his car. (27 words)
cn: 一个16岁的男孩在杂货店请求一位陌生人给他和他的母亲买些食物，作为交换，他帮那个人把东西搬到车上。

en: What happened next will pull at your heartstrings. (8 words)
cn: 接下来发生的事会触动你的心弦。

en: A wonderful bond formed between the two, and within a couple of weeks, the stranger named White helped raise $190,000 on the website to support the Memphis teenager and his disabled mother. (32 words)
cn: 两人之间建立了美好的情谊，几周之内，这位名叫怀特的陌生人在网站上帮助筹集了19万美元，以支持这位孟菲斯少年和他残疾的母亲。

en: "When Chauncy approached me, it just pulled at my heart,"White said. "Here comes Chauncy, just trying to get food for him and his Mom off of the grace of other people. (31 words)
cn: "昌西走近我时，就触动了我的心，"怀特说。"昌西走过来，只是想靠别人的善意为他和他妈妈讨口吃的。

en: When I looked at him and saw what he was doing and what he was asking for, I said he was my hero." (23 words)
cn: 当我看着他，看到他正在做的事和他提出的请求时，我说他是我心目中的英雄。"

en: "Chauncy is a top student who is doing his best to make it in a world with no money and very few resources,"White explained on the crowdfunding site. "He wants to work and help his mother financially." (37 words)
cn: "昌西是一名优等生，他在一个没有钱、资源匮乏的世界里竭尽全力地生存，"怀特在众筹网站上解释道。"他想工作，在经济上帮助他的母亲。"

en: "It’s so rare that we get an opportunity to affect so much change on one life,"White wrote. "I cannot thank you enough for caring about Chauncy. (26 words)
cn: "我们难得有机会对一个人的生活产生如此大的影响，"怀特写道。"我非常感谢你们关心昌西。

en: This is his big chance, and you’re making it possible." (10 words)
cn: 这是他的大好机会，而你们让它成为了可能。"

en: That was my last economics lecture of the week, and here’s the weekend again. (14 words)
cn: 那是本周最后一堂经济学课，周末又到了。

en: What are you up to tonight? (6 words)
cn: 你今晚有什么安排？

en: I was just wondering if we could try out the new restaurant on Charles Street, then go on to Queen Victoria for a drink. (24 words)
cn: 我在想我们能不能去查尔斯街上那家新餐厅试试，然后再去维多利亚女王酒吧喝一杯。

en: Sorry,I’m heading home this weekend, for my brother’s 18th birthday. (10 words)
cn: 抱歉，我这周末要回家，给我弟弟过18岁生日。

en: Oh, that’s great. (3 words)
cn: 哦，那太好了。

en: All of my relatives are gonna be there, as well as my brother’s horrible friends, of course. (17 words)
cn: 我所有的亲戚都会去，当然还有我弟弟那群闹腾的朋友们。

en: Listen, why won’t you come along? (6 words)
cn: 听着，你为什么不一起来呢？

en: Mom would be absolutely delighted to see you again. She’s always asking after you. (14 words)
cn: 妈妈再见到你一定会非常高兴，她总是问起你。

en: Yes, I’d love to see her too. (7 words)
cn: 是的，我也很想见她。

en: So, please, do come. It would be great. (8 words)
cn: 所以，来吧，一定会很有趣的。

en: And besides, with Jonathan’s wild game to contend with, I’d really welcome an ally. (14 words)
cn: 而且，要应对乔纳森那些疯狂的电子游戏，我真的很需要一个盟友。

en: That sounds tempting, but I won’t be ready till 5, as I’ve got my statistic seminar now. (17 words)
cn: 听起来很诱人，但我5点前没空，因为我现在要去上统计学研讨课。

en: What time are you heading off? (6 words)
cn: 你什么时候出发？

en: Well, I was going to leave right away. (8 words)
cn: 嗯，我本来打算马上走的。

en: However, I can hang around for you if you like. (10 words)
cn: 不过，如果你愿意的话，我可以等你。

en: It just means that I’ll need to change my ticket. (10 words)
cn: 只是意味着我需要改签车票。

en: But wouldn’t that be too much trouble for you? (9 words)
cn: 但这不会给你添太多麻烦吗？

en: No, not at all. (4 words)
cn: 不会，一点也不。

en: I’ll go to the station first, and see if I can get tickets for us on the 6:30 train. (19 words)
cn: 我先去车站，看看能不能买到6点半那趟车票。

en: Then, you can join me there. (6 words)
cn: 然后你可以来车站找我。

en: I’ll text you when it’s done. (6 words)
cn: 弄好了我发短信告诉你。

en: Brilliant. (1 words)
cn: 太好了。

en: Are you absolutely positive if it’s OK? (7 words)
cn: 你确定这样没问题吗？

en: I wouldn’t want to impose. (5 words)
cn: 我不想给你添麻烦。

en: Don’t worry, you are most welcome to join our party, and as I always say "the more, the merrier." (19 words)
cn: 别担心，非常欢迎你参加我们的聚会，就像我常说的，"人越多越热闹"。

en: Look, I’d better go or I’ll be late. (8 words)
cn: 哎呀，我得走了，不然要迟到了。

en: So, I’ll meet you down at the station around 6? (10 words)
cn: 那我6点左右到车站找你？

en: Fine, see you later. (4 words)
cn: 好的，待会儿见。

en: Hi, Jane. (2 words)
cn: 嗨，简。

en: How’s everything going? (3 words)
cn: 最近怎么样？

en: So far so good. (4 words)
cn: 还不错。

en: I’ve just finished my last exam. (6 words)
cn: 我刚考完最后一门考试。

en: Good. (1 words)
cn: 很好。

en: The term is coming to an end. (7 words)
cn: 这学期快结束了。

en: Do you think we should take a holiday overseas to relax and have fun? (14 words)
cn: 你觉得我们该去国外度假，放松一下吗？

en: I’ve saved my tips from my waiter job these past few months, and I should have enough by July. (19 words)
cn: 过去几个月我做服务员攒了小费，到7月应该够用了。

en: Yes, that’s a wonderful idea. (5 words)
cn: 好啊，这个主意很棒。

en: I’ve got a little put aside for a rainy day,but I might need to earn a little more before we go. (21 words)
cn: 我存了一点钱以备不时之需，但出发前可能还需要再挣一些。

en: By the way, what is it like working in the restaurant? (11 words)
cn: 顺便问一下，在餐厅工作感觉怎么样？

en: Well, it’s really tough, as working a 10-hour shift is like hell. (12 words)
cn: 嗯，真的很辛苦，10小时轮班简直像地狱一样。

en: I’m not sure if it’ll suit you. (7 words)
cn: 我不确定是否适合你。

en: But it’s pretty cool if your boss is all right. (10 words)
cn: 但如果老板好的话，还是相当不错的。

en: Do you think we should invite some others to come along? (11 words)
cn: 你觉得我们应该再邀请几个人一起去吗？

en: Yes, we could ask Tom and Tracy if they are interested. (11 words)
cn: 好啊，我们可以问问汤姆和特雷西感不感兴趣。

en: I haven’t been abroad for a long while. (8 words)
cn: 我很长时间没出过国了。

en: And it would be great to go somewhere by the sea. (11 words)
cn: 而且去海边会很棒。

en: I can’t wait,and if Tom goes, we could go sailing. (10 words)
cn: 我都等不及了，如果汤姆去的话，我们还可以去航海。

en: He has a lot of experience with boats, and it’ll work out a lot cheaper to hire one if there’s more of us to share the cost. (27 words)
cn: 他很有航海经验，而且如果更多人分摊费用，租船也会便宜很多。

en: So, that’s the plan. (4 words)
cn: 那就这么定了。

en: We’ll save as much as we can, and go sailing next July. (12 words)
cn: 我们尽可能多存钱，明年7月去航海。

en: Let’s say, Spain, or anywhere cheap would be fine. (9 words)
cn: 比如西班牙，或者任何便宜的地方都行。

en: OK. (1 words)
cn: 好的。

en: But first we’d better contact Tom and Tracy, and see if they are up for it. (16 words)
cn: 但我们最好先联系汤姆和特雷西，看看他们是否愿意去。

en: If not, it’ll be back to the drawing board. (9 words)
cn: 如果他们不去，就只能重新计划了。

en: Most people know Marie Curie was the first woman to win the Nobel Prize, and the first person to win it twice. (22 words)
cn: 大多数人都知道玛丽·居里是第一位获得诺贝尔奖的女性，也是第一位两次获此殊荣的人。

en: However, few people know that she was also the mother of a Nobel Prize winner. (15 words)
cn: 然而，很少有人知道她也是一位诺贝尔奖得主的母亲。

en: Irene Curie was born on September 12, 1897. (8 words)
cn: 伊雷娜·居里出生于1897年9月12日。

en: At the age of ten, Irene’s talents and interest in mathematics were apparent. (13 words)
cn: 十岁时，伊雷娜的数学天赋和兴趣已经很明显了。

en: Irene entered Sorbonne University in October 1914, to prepare for a degree in mathematics and physics. (16 words)
cn: 1914年10月，伊雷娜进入索邦大学攻读数学和物理学学位。

en: When World War I began, she left Sorbonne University to help her mother, who was using X-ray facilities to help save the lives of wounded soldiers. (26 words)
cn: 第一次世界大战爆发时，她离开索邦大学去帮助她的母亲——当时居里夫人正在用X射线设备救治受伤的士兵。

en: Irene continued this work by developing X-ray facilities for military hospitals in France and Belgium. (15 words)
cn: 伊雷娜继续这项工作，为法国和比利时的军医院研发X射线设备。

en: After the war, she received a military medal for her work. (11 words)
cn: 战后，她因这项工作获得了一枚军功勋章。

en: In 1918, Irene became her mother’s assistant at the Curie Institute. (11 words)
cn: 1918年，伊雷娜成为居里研究所里她母亲的助手。

en: In December 1924, Frederic Joliot visited the Institute, and met Marie Curie. (12 words)
cn: 1924年12月，弗雷德里克·约里奥参观了研究所，见到了玛丽·居里。

en: Frederic became one of her assistants, and Irene taught him the techniques required to work with radioactivity. (17 words)
cn: 弗雷德里克成为居里夫人的助手之一，伊雷娜教他研究放射性所需的技术。

en: Irene and Frederic soon fell in love and got married on October 29, 1926. (14 words)
cn: 伊雷娜和弗雷德里克很快坠入爱河，并于1926年10月29日结婚。

en: Their daughter was born in 1927 and their son in 1932． (11 words)
cn: 他们的女儿出生于1927年，儿子出生于1932年。

en: Like her mother, Irene combined family with career. (8 words)
cn: 和她的母亲一样，伊雷娜兼顾了家庭和事业。

en: Like her mother, Irene was awarded a Nobel Prize, along with her husband Frederic in 1935, for producing new radioactive elements. (21 words)
cn: 也像她母亲一样，伊雷娜于1935年与丈夫弗雷德里克共同因合成新的放射性元素而获得诺贝尔奖。

en: Unfortunately, also like her mother, she developed blood cancer because of exposure to radiation. (14 words)
cn: 不幸的是，她也像母亲一样因暴露于辐射而患上了血癌。

en: Irene Joliot-Curie died on March 17th, 1956. (7 words)
cn: 伊雷娜·约里奥-居里于1956年3月17日逝世。

en: Have you ever heard of the Vikings? (7 words)
cn: 你听说过维京人吗？

en: They were sea travelers from Norway. (6 words)
cn: 他们是来自挪威的海上探险者。

en: More than 1,000 years ago, they made three important geographical discoveries. (11 words)
cn: 一千多年前，他们有过三个重要的地理发现。

en: The Vikings’ first major discovery occurred in the 9th century. (10 words)
cn: 维京人的第一个重大发现发生在9世纪。

en: A man called Naddodd was on his way from Norway to the Faroe Islands, north of England, when his ship was caught in a storm. (25 words)
cn: 一个名叫纳德多德的人正在从挪威前往英格兰北部的法罗群岛途中，他的船遭遇了风暴。

en: The storm blew the ship west for several days. (9 words)
cn: 风暴将船向西吹了好几天。

en: When the weather cleared, Naddodd found himself on the coast of a new land. (14 words)
cn: 天气转晴后，纳德多德发现自己来到了一片新陆地海岸。

en: Later, Viking travelers named it Iceland. (6 words)
cn: 后来，维京旅行者将其命名为冰岛。

en: In 982, a Viking called Eric the Red, sailed west in search of new land. (15 words)
cn: 公元982年，一位名叫"红发埃里克"的维京人向西航行寻找新陆地。

en: 500 miles west of Iceland, he and his men reached an icy rocky massive land. (15 words)
cn: 在冰岛以西500英里处，他和他的手下到达了一片冰雪覆盖、岩石嶙峋的广阔陆地。

en: They sailed around it until they reached the western side. (10 words)
cn: 他们绕着这片陆地航行，直到抵达了西侧。

en: Here, they found some green areas, so they named the island Greenland. (12 words)
cn: 在这里，他们发现了一些绿色区域，于是他们将这个岛屿命名为格陵兰。

en: Then, in 1001, the Vikings made their most important discovery. (10 words)
cn: 然后，在1001年，维京人做出了他们最重要的发现。

en: The son of Eric the Red named Leif Erikson had heard rumors about land west of Greenland. (17 words)
cn: 红发埃里克之子列夫·埃里克松听说了关于格陵兰以西有陆地的传闻。

en: He sailed west and soon found it. (7 words)
cn: 他向西航行，很快就找到了那片陆地。

en: He and his men landed in three places. (8 words)
cn: 他和他的手下在三个地方登陆。

en: They called the first one Helluland, which means land of flat stones. (12 words)
cn: 他们将第一个地方称为"赫卢兰"，意为"平坦石头之地"。

en: The Vikings then sailed south and made their second landing. (10 words)
cn: 维京人随后向南航行，进行了第二次登陆。

en: They named this place Markland. (5 words)
cn: 他们将这个地方命名为"马克兰"。

en: Their third landing was at a place they called Vinland. (10 words)
cn: 他们的第三次登陆地是一个他们称为"文兰"的地方。

en: Leif Erikson and his men were the first Europeans to walk on the shores of North America, almost 500 years earlier than Columbus. (23 words)
cn: 列夫·埃里克松和他的手下是第一批踏上北美海岸的欧洲人，比哥伦布早了近500年。

en: Where do you think you’ll be in ten years? (9 words)
cn: 你觉得十年后你会是什么样子？

en: It’s difficult to know exactly where you’ll be, and what you’ll be doing. (13 words)
cn: 很难确切知道未来会身在何处、在做什么。

en: But everyone dreams about the future. (6 words)
cn: 但每个人都会梦想未来。

en: You might imagine the job you’ll get when you finish school. (11 words)
cn: 你可能会想象毕业后会得到什么样的工作。

en: You made day dream about meeting your life partner, or living in a big house by the sea. (18 words)
cn: 你可能会幻想遇见人生的伴侣，或者住在海边的大房子里。

en: In my dreams I would have twins, a boy and a girl. (12 words)
cn: 在我的梦想里，我有一对龙凤胎。

en: We will live in a large, two-storey house with floors and the staircase made of wood. (16 words)
cn: 我们住在一栋两层的大房子里，地板和楼梯都是木质的。

en: Now, at the age of 46, I look back on these dreams and smile. (14 words)
cn: 如今，我46岁了，回想这些梦想，不禁莞尔。

en: Things haven’t turned out exactly as I imagined,but I wouldn’t change what I have now for that imaginary world. (19 words)
cn: 事情并没有完全按照我想象的发展，但我不会用现在拥有的一切去换取那个想象中的世界。

en: In college, I studied international business and planned to enter a law school. (13 words)
cn: 大学时我学的是国际商务，并计划进入法学院。

en: In my third year of university, I realized that I didn’t want to become a lawyer. (16 words)
cn: 大三那年，我意识到自己并不想当律师。

en: Instead, I chose to become a language teacher. (8 words)
cn: 于是我选择成为一名语言教师。

en: I did get married, but had more than two children. We have five. (13 words)
cn: 我确实结婚了，但不止两个孩子——我们有五个。

en: Do I live in the dream house with wooden floors? (10 words)
cn: 我现在住在那个有木地板的梦想之家里吗？

en: No, I don’t, but I love my home, and I wouldn’t want to live in any other place. (18 words)
cn: 不，没有，但我爱我的家，不想住在其他地方。

en: I believed it, as a young person, it’s important to dream and make plans. (14 words)
cn: 我认为，年轻时拥有梦想和制定计划是很重要的。

en: However, it’s also important to realize that not all of your plans will turn out exactly as you wish. (19 words)
cn: 然而，同样重要的是要认识到，并非所有计划都会完全如你所愿。

en: One of the biggest lessons I’ve learned in life is this: "Be happy with what you have". (17 words)
cn: 我一生中最重要的教训之一就是："为你所拥有的感到满足。"

en: A 9-year-old girl in New Mexico has raised more than $500 for her little brother who needs heart surgery in Houston, Texas this July. (24 words)
cn: 今年7月，新墨西哥州一位9岁的女孩为她需要在得克萨斯州休斯敦接受心脏手术的弟弟筹集了500多美元。

en: Addison Witulski's grandmother Kim Allred said Addison probably overheard a conversation between family members talking about the funds needed to get her little brother to treatment. (26 words)
cn: 艾迪生·维图尔斯基的奶奶金·奥尔雷德说，艾迪生可能无意中听到了家人之间关于她弟弟看病所需资金的谈话。

en: "I guess she overheard her grandfather and me talking about how we’re worried about how we’re going to get to Houston, for my grandson’s heart surgery,"said Allred. (27 words)
cn: "当时她爷爷和我正在犯愁要怎么去休斯敦为我孙子做心脏手术，我想她听到了我们的对话。"奥尔雷德说。

en: She decided to go outside and have a lemonade stand and make some drawings and pictures and sell them. (19 words)
cn: 她决定到外面摆个柠檬水摊，画一些画，然后卖掉。

en: That’s when Addison and her friends Erika and Emily Borden decided to sell lemonade for 50 cents a cup and sell pictures for 25 cents each. (26 words)
cn: 从那时候起，艾迪生与她的朋友埃里卡和艾米丽·博登决定卖柠檬水和画像，每杯柠檬水卖50美分，每张画像卖25美分。

en: Before Allred knew it, New Mexico State police officers were among the many stopping by, helping them reach a total of $568. (22 words)
cn: 很多人顺便过来帮助她们，包括新墨西哥州的警察们，最后总共帮她们筹到了568美元，奥尔雷德后来才知道这件事。

en: The family turned to social media expressing their gratitude saying, "From the bottom of our hearts, we would like to deeply thank each and every person that stopped by!" (29 words)
cn: 奥尔雷德全家在社交媒体上表达了他们的感激之情，他们说："我们发自内心地深深感谢每一个路过帮忙的人！"

en: Last week, France announced that the country will pave 621 miles of road with solar panels over the next five years, with the goal of providing cheap, renewable energy to five million people. (33 words)
cn: 上周，法国宣布将在未来五年内用太阳能板铺设621英里长的公路，目标是为500万人提供廉价的可再生能源。

en: Called "the Wattway,"the roads will be built through joint efforts with the French road-building company Colas and the National Institute of Solar Energy. (23 words)
cn: 这些公路被称为"瓦特路"，将由法国道路建设公司科拉斯和法国国家太阳能研究所合作建设。

en: The company spent the last five years developing solar panels that are only about a quarter of an inch thick and are strong enough to stand up to heavy highway traffic without breaking or making the roads more slippery. (39 words)
cn: 科拉斯公司花了过去五年的时间开发太阳能板，这些太阳能板厚度仅约0.25英寸，但足够坚固，能够承受公路繁忙的交通，既不会损坏也不会让路面变得更滑。

en: The panels are also designed so that they can be installed directly on top of existing roadways, making them relatively cheap and easy to install. (25 words)
cn: 这些太阳能板的设计还使其可以直接铺设在现有路面上，因此成本相对较低，安装也较为简便。

en: France isn’t the first country to kick around the idea of paving its roads with solar panels. (17 words)
cn: 用太阳能板铺路并非法国最先提出的想法。

en: In November 2015, the Netherlands completed a 229-foot-long bike path paved with solar panels as a test for future projects. (20 words)
cn: 2015年11月，荷兰建成了一条229英尺长的太阳能自行车道，作为未来项目的一项试验。

en: However,this is the first time a panel has been designed to be laid directly on top of existing roads and the first project to install the panels on public highways. (30 words)
cn: 然而，这是第一次有太阳能板被设计成直接铺设在现有路面上，也是第一个在公共公路上安装太阳能板的项目。

en: Lions have disappeared from much of Africa, but for the past few years scientists have wondered if the big cats were hanging on in remote parts of Sudan and Ethiopia. (30 words)
cn: 狮子在非洲大部分地区已经消失，但过去几年科学家们一直在想，苏丹和埃塞俄比亚的偏远地区是否仍有这种大型猫科动物存活。

en: Continuous fighting in the region has made surveys difficult. (9 words)
cn: 该地区持续的战乱使得调查难以开展。

en: But scientists released a report Monday documenting, with hard evidence, the discovery of "lost lions". (15 words)
cn: 不过，科学家们周一发布了一份报告，用确凿证据证实了那些"消失的狮子"的发现。

en: A team with Oxford University’s Wildlife Conservation Research Unit, supported by a charity organization, spent two nights in November camping in the National Park in northwest Ethiopia, on the Ethiopia-Sudan border. (31 words)
cn: 牛津大学野生动物保护研究团队在一个慈善组织的支持下，于11月在埃塞俄比亚西北部、埃塞俄比亚-苏丹边境的国家公园露营了两个晚上。

en: The researchers set out six camera traps capturing images of lions, and they identified lion tracks. (16 words)
cn: 研究人员布设了六个自动触发相机来捕捉狮子的影像，并发现了狮子的足迹。

en: The scientists concluded that lions are also likely to live in the neighbouring National Park across the border in Sudan. (20 words)
cn: 科学家们推断，狮子也可能生活在边境对面苏丹境内的国家公园里。

en: The International Union for Conservation of Nature had previously considered the area a "possible range"for the species, and local people had reported seeing lions in the area, but no one presented convincing evidence. (33 words)
cn: 世界自然保护联盟此前曾认为该地区是狮子的"可能分布区"，当地人也报告说在该地区见过狮子，但没有人提供令人信服的证据。

en: I bet you’re looking forward to the end of this month. Aren’t you? (13 words)
cn: 我敢说你一定很期待这个月底的到来，对吧？

en: Yes, I am. (3 words)
cn: 是的。

en: How did you know? (4 words)
cn: 你怎么知道的？

en: David told me you had a special birthday coming up. (10 words)
cn: 戴维告诉我你有一个特别的生日快到了。

en: Oh…yeah. That’s right. (3 words)
cn: 哦……对，没错。

en: This year will be my golden birthday. (7 words)
cn: 今年是我的黄金诞辰。

en: What does that mean? (4 words)
cn: 那是什么意思？

en: I’ve never heard of a golden birthday. (7 words)
cn: 我从没听说过黄金诞辰。

en: I’ve actually just learnt this concept myself. (7 words)
cn: 其实我也是刚刚才知道这个概念。

en: Fortunately, just in time to celebrate. (6 words)
cn: 幸运的是，正好赶得上庆祝。

en: A golden or lucky birthday is when one turns the age of their birth date. (15 words)
cn: 黄金诞辰或幸运诞辰就是一个人到了与出生日期相同的年龄。

en: So, for example, my sister’s birthday is December 9th and her golden birthday would have been the year she turned nine years old. (23 words)
cn: 比如说，我妹妹的生日是12月9日，她的黄金诞辰就是她满九岁那一年。

en: Come to think of it,my parents did throw her a surprise party that year. (14 words)
cn: 现在想想，那年我父母确实为她办了一个惊喜派对。

en: Interesting. (1 words)
cn: 有意思。

en: Too bad I missed mine. (5 words)
cn: 可惜我错过了我的。

en: My golden birthday would’ve been four years ago. (8 words)
cn: 我的黄金诞辰应该是四年前。

en: I assume you’ve got big plans then. (7 words)
cn: 那我猜你有大计划了。

en: Actually, yes. (2 words)
cn: 确实有。

en: My husband is planning a surprise holiday for the two of us next week. (14 words)
cn: 我丈夫正在为我们俩计划下周的一个惊喜假期。

en: I’ve no idea what he’s got in mind,but I’m excited to find out. (13 words)
cn: 我不知道他有什么打算，但我很想知道。

en: Has he mentioned anything to you? (6 words)
cn: 他跟你提过什么吗？

en: He might’ve. (2 words)
cn: 他可能提过。

en: Anything you’d like to share? (5 words)
cn: 有什么可以透露的吗？

en: I’m dying to know what kind of trip he has planned out where we’re going. (15 words)
cn: 我特别想知道他到底计划了什么样的旅行，我们要去哪里。

en: You know nothing at all? (5 words)
cn: 你完全不知道？

en: Not a clue. (3 words)
cn: 一点线索都没有。

en: Hard to imagine, isn’t it? (5 words)
cn: 很难想象，对吧？

en: Though I must say I think he’s been having even more fun keeping the secret from me the past few weeks. (21 words)
cn: 不过我得说，我觉得过去几周他对保密这件事乐在其中。

en: I’m sure both of you’ll have a fantastic time. (9 words)
cn: 我相信你们俩一定会玩得很开心。

en: Happy golden birthday! (3 words)
cn: 黄金诞辰快乐！

en: I can’t wait to hear all about it when you get back. (12 words)
cn: 我等不及你回来跟我讲讲这次旅行了。

en: Mr. Green, what do you think makes a successful negotiator? (10 words)
cn: 格林先生，您认为成功的谈判者需要具备什么特质？

en: Well, that’s hard to define. (5 words)
cn: 嗯，这很难定义。

en: But I think successful negotiators have several things in common. (10 words)
cn: 但我认为成功的谈判者有几个共同点。

en: They are always polite and rational people. (7 words)
cn: 他们通常都彬彬有礼且理性。

en: They are firm but flexible. (5 words)
cn: 他们立场坚定但又不失灵活。

en: They can recognize power and know how to use it. (10 words)
cn: 他们能识别权力，也知道如何运用。

en: They are sensitive to the dynamics of the negotiation, the way of rises and falls and how it may change direction. (21 words)
cn: 他们对谈判的动向很敏感——知道起伏的规律以及方向可能如何变化。

en: They project the image of confidence,and perhaps most importantly, they know when to stop. (14 words)
cn: 他们展现出自信的形象，而最重要的是，他们知道什么时候该停下来。

en: And, what about an unsuccessful negotiator? (6 words)
cn: 那么，不成功的谈判者是什么样的呢？

en: Well, this is probably all of us when we start out. (11 words)
cn: 嗯，这大概就是我们刚入门时的样子。

en: We are probably immature and over-trusting, too emotional or aggressive. (10 words)
cn: 我们可能不够成熟、过于轻信，要么太情绪化，要么太好斗。

en: We are unsure of ourselves and we want to be liked by everyone. (13 words)
cn: 我们对自己缺乏信心，又想让每个人都喜欢自己。

en: Good negotiators learn fast. (4 words)
cn: 好的谈判者学得快。

en: Poor negotiators remain like that and go on losing negotiations. (10 words)
cn: 糟糕的谈判者停滞不前，不断在谈判中失败。

en: In your opinion, can the skills of negotiation be taught? (10 words)
cn: 在您看来，谈判技巧是可以教的吗？

en: Well, you can teach someone how to prepare for a negotiation. There are perhaps six stages in every negotiation. (19 words)
cn: 嗯，你可以教人如何为谈判做准备。每场谈判大概有六个阶段。

en: Get to know the other side. State your goals. (9 words)
cn: 了解对方；明确自己的目标。

en: Start the process. Clarify areas of disagreement or conflict. (9 words)
cn: 启动谈判进程；澄清分歧或冲突的领域。

en: Reassess your position. Making acceptable compromises. (6 words)
cn: 重新评估自己的立场；做出可接受的妥协。

en: And finally, reach some agreement in principle. These stages can be studied. (12 words)
cn: 最后，在原则上达成一致。这些阶段是可以学习的。

en: And strategies to be used in each can be planned beforehand. But I think, the really successful negotiator is probably born with the sixth sense about responding appropriately to the situation at hand. (33 words)
cn: 每个阶段所运用的策略可以提前计划好。但我认为，真正成功的谈判者或许天生就有一种第六感，知道如何恰当应对当前的情况。

en: The artistic sense you’ve just described? (6 words)
cn: 就是您刚才所说的那种技巧感吗？

en: Yes. That’s right. (3 words)
cn: 是的，没错。

en: Some people wonder why countries spend millions of dollars on space projects. (12 words)
cn: 有些人想知道为什么各国在太空项目上花费数百万美元。

en: They want to know how space research helps people on Earth. (11 words)
cn: 他们想知道太空研究如何帮助地球上的人们。

en: Actually, space technology helps people on Earth every day. (9 words)
cn: 事实上，太空技术每天都在帮助地球上的人们。

en: This is called "spin-off technology." (5 words)
cn: 这就是所谓的"衍生技术"。

en: Spin-off technology is space technology that is now used on Earth. (11 words)
cn: 衍生技术就是现在在地球上使用的太空技术。

en: In early space programs, such as the Apollo missions of the 1960s and 1970s, and in the Space Shuttle missions today,scientists developed objects for the astronauts to use on the moon and in space. (34 words)
cn: 在早期的太空计划中——比如20世纪60年代和70年代的阿波罗任务，以及如今的航天飞机任务——科学家们为宇航员研发了在月球和太空中使用的物品。

en: We now use some of these objects every day. (9 words)
cn: 我们现在每天都在使用其中的一些物品。

en: For example,we have quartz crystal clocks and watches accurate to within one minute a year. (15 words)
cn: 例如，我们使用的石英钟和石英表精确度达到每年误差在一分钟以内。

en: We purify the water we drink with a water filter designed for the astronauts’ use in space. (17 words)
cn: 我们用原本为宇航员在太空中使用而设计的滤水器来净化饮用水。

en: The cordless, hand-held tools we use in our homes, such as vacuum cleaners, flashlights, drills and saws came from the technology of these early space programs. (26 words)
cn: 我们在家中使用的无线手持工具——比如吸尘器、手电筒、电钻和电锯——都源自这些早期太空计划的技术。

en: On cold winter days, we can stay warm with battery-operated gloves and socks, and specially made coats and jackets. (19 words)
cn: 在寒冷的冬日，我们可以用电池供电的手套和袜子以及特制的外套和夹克来保暖。

en: All these clothes are similar to the spacesuit designs that kept astronauts comfortable in the temperatures of the moon, and are spin-offs from space technology. (25 words)
cn: 所有这些衣物都与让宇航员在月球温度下保持舒适的太空服设计相似，都是太空技术的衍生产品。

en: These products are only a few examples of the many ways space technology helps us in our everyday lives. (19 words)
cn: 这些产品只是太空技术在日常生活中帮助我们的众多方式中的几个例子。

en: No one knows how new spin-off technology from the International Space Station will help us in the future. (18 words)
cn: 没有人知道国际空间站新的衍生技术将来会如何帮助我们。

en: Well, if I could go back in history and live, I’d like to go back to the 18th century and perhaps in colonial America in Yankee, New England, where one of my ancestors lived, because it was the beginning of something. (41 words)
cn: 好吧，如果我能回到历史中去生活，我想回到18世纪，也许是殖民时期美国新英格兰地区的扬基，那里曾住着我的一个祖先，因为那是一个新事物的开端。

en: By the 18th century, there was a feeling of community that had grown. (13 words)
cn: 到了18世纪，一种社区感已经形成。

en: My ancestor was a preacher, traveling around the countryside. (9 words)
cn: 我的祖先是一位传教士，在乡间游历。

en: People lived in small communities. (5 words)
cn: 人们生活在小社区里。

en: There were fishermen and farmers who provided fresh food that tasted and looked like food, unlike that in today’s supermarkets. (20 words)
cn: 那里有渔民和农民，他们提供的新鲜食物味道和外观都像食物本身，与如今超市里的食物不同。

en: And there were small towns, and New York wasn’t that far away. (12 words)
cn: 那里有小城镇，纽约也不是那么遥远。

en: I’m deeply attached to the Puritan tradition, not in a religious sense, but they believed in working for something, working for goals, and I like that. (26 words)
cn: 我深深依恋清教传统，但不是在宗教意义上——而是他们相信为某件事而工作，为目标而工作，我喜欢这一点。

en: They worked hard at whatever they did, but they had a sense of achievement. (14 words)
cn: 无论做什么，他们都很努力，而且有成就感。

en: They believed in goodness in community and helping one another. (10 words)
cn: 他们相信社区中的善良和互助。

en: I love the colonial fabrics, all the silver work, the furnishings, the combination of elegance and simplicity. (17 words)
cn: 我喜欢殖民时期的织物、所有的银器、家具陈设，以及优雅与简约的结合。

en: I love it. (3 words)
cn: 我就是喜欢这些。

en: The printing, the books, I’m very attached to all that kind of thing that may not all be very entertaining in the modern sense of the world. (27 words)
cn: 印刷品、书籍——我非常喜欢这些东西，尽管它们在现代意义上可能并不都那么有趣。

en: But I would have enjoyed spending my evenings in that environment, discussing new ideas, building a new world. (18 words)
cn: 但我很愿意在那种环境中度过夜晚，讨论新想法，建设新世界。

en: And I can see myself sitting on a small chair by the fire doing needlework. (15 words)
cn: 我还能想象自己坐在火炉旁的小椅子上做针线活。

en: If you are lost in the woods, a little knowledge can turn what some people call a hardship into an enjoyable stay away from the troubles of modern society. (29 words)
cn: 如果你在森林里迷路了，一点点知识就能把一些人所谓的困境变成远离现代社会困扰的愉快时光。

en: When you think you are lost, sit down on a log, or a rock, or lean against a tree, and recite something that you have memorized, to bring your mind to a point where it’s under control. (37 words)
cn: 当你觉得自己迷路了，找一根圆木或一块岩石坐下，或者靠在一棵树上，背诵一些你记得的东西，让自己的思绪恢复到可控状态。

en: Don’t run blindly. (3 words)
cn: 不要盲目奔跑。

en: If you must move, don’t follow a stream unless you know it, and in that case, you are not lost. (20 words)
cn: 如果必须移动，不要顺着溪流走，除非你认识它——如果认识的话，你就不算迷路了。

en: Streams, normally flow through wetland before they reach a lake or a river. (13 words)
cn: 溪流通常在汇入湖泊或河流之前会流经湿地。

en: Though there are more eatable plants, there may also be wild animals, poisonous snakes, and other hazards. (17 words)
cn: 虽然那里有更多可食用的植物，但也可能有野生动物、毒蛇和其他危险。

en: Many experts feel that it’s wisest to walk uphill. (9 words)
cn: 许多专家认为往山上走是最明智的。

en: At the top of most hills and mountains are trails leading back to civilization. (14 words)
cn: 大多数丘陵和山顶上都有通往文明世界的小路。

en: If there are no trails, you are much easier to be seen on top of a hill, and you may even spot a highway, or a railroad from this point. (30 words)
cn: 即使没有小路，在山顶上也更容易被发现，而且从那里你甚至可能看到公路或铁路。

en: Nowadays, the first way someone will search for you is by air. (12 words)
cn: 如今，搜寻你的首要方式是通过空中。

en: In a wetland, or in dense growth, you are very hard to spot. (13 words)
cn: 在湿地或茂密的植被中，你很难被发现。

en: Anytime you go into the woods, somebody should know where you are going, and when you expect to return. (19 words)
cn: 任何时候进入森林，都应该有人知道你要去哪里以及预计什么时候回来。

en: Also, when someone comes looking, you should be able to signal to them. (13 words)
cn: 此外，当有人来找你时，你应该能向他们发出信号。

en: Kelly Swisher, an Arkansas woman, escaped injury and managed to safely stop her car after a four-foot-long rat snake came out from under her car seat and slithered across her feet as she was driving down the highway.
cn: 阿肯色州一位名叫凯利·史伟莎的女性开车行驶在高速公路上时，一条四英尺长的食鼠蛇从车座下方钻出来，蜿蜒爬到她的脚上，后来她设法安全地把车停下来，并且没有让自己受伤。

en: Rat snakes aren't poisonous or a threat to people generally.
cn: 食鼠蛇通常是无毒的，也不会威胁到人类。

en: But the woman says the snake she encountered Thursday terrified her out of her wits.
cn: 但是，史伟莎说她周四遇到的那条蛇把她吓得魂飞魄散。

en: "It was rough with big scales," said Swisher, who was on her way to pick up her friend at the airport when it happened.
cn: "它的鳞片很大，全身粗糙不平。"史伟莎说道，她是在去机场接朋友的路上遇到的这件事。

en: "I don't know whether I had my hands on the steering wheel or not.
cn: "我不知道当时我的手是否放在了方向盘上。

en: I am not the most flexible person in the world, but I can guarantee my knees were up next to my ears."
cn: 我绝不是身体特别灵活的人，但当时（我害怕得）膝盖抬高得都快跟耳朵贴在一起了。"

en: She said the snake first slipped back under the seat and she hoped it would stay there until she was able to get out of the highway and stop.
cn: 她说那条蛇一开始从座位下爬向了后方，她希望它可以一直在那里待着，让她可以从高速上下来并停车。

en: "That didn't work out," she said.
cn: "然而事情并非如我所愿，"她说道。

en: "Here he comes, and he wound up in my back seat before I could finally get off the road, stop and get out of the car."
cn: "‘它’还是来了，我还没有下高速停车并从车上下来，它就爬到我的车后座上。"

en: She called for help and Washington County animal control officers came and captured the snake.
cn: 她打电话求助，华盛顿郡动物控制中心的人员到了，抓住了那条蛇。

en: Fast food, it turns out, isn't quite as fast as it used to be.
cn: 事实表明，快餐行业的速度并不像过去那么快了。

en: A new study finds that McDonald's posted its slowest drive-through times since this survey was first conducted 15 years ago.
cn: 一项新的研究发现，自从15年前首次进行这项调查以来，麦当劳发布了其最慢的"免下车取餐"服务时间。

en: At McDonald's, customers will spend on average 3 minutes and 9 seconds from the time they place their orders until they receive their food.
cn: 在麦当劳，从下单到取餐，顾客需要等待的平均时间为3分9秒。

en: That's about 10 seconds more than the industry average—and a lot slower than a decade ago, according to the study, which was commissioned by QSR, an industry trade publication.
cn: 一家行业贸易刊物QSR所做的调查显示，麦当劳的上餐时间比行业的平均服务水平多了大约10秒——比10年前慢多了。

en: And McDonald's wasn't alone in slowing down: Other chains also saw their drive-through performance slow down.
cn: 服务速度变慢的并不只有麦当劳：其他（快餐）连锁店的"免下车取餐"服务速度也变慢了。

en: Among the reasons for the slower service: Today there are more choices on the menu, and the products themselves are more complex and take longer to prepare.
cn: 服务速度变慢的原因如下：如今菜单上有更多食品可供选择；食品本身变得更加复杂，需要更长的时间去准备。

en: Speed, of course, is essential to the drive-through experience, and drive-throughs are hugely important to chains such as McDonald's, Burger King and Taco Bell.
cn: 当然，速度对于"免下车取餐"体验非常重要，而"免下车取餐"服务对于诸如麦当劳、汉堡王和塔可钟等快餐连锁店至关重要。

en: "Usually the drive-through accounts for 60 to 70 percent of all business that goes through a fast-food restaurant," notes Sam Oches, editor of QSR.
cn: "一般来说，‘免下车取餐’占整个快餐店所有营业额的60%-70%。"QSR的编辑萨姆·奥其斯写道。

en: Of course, consumers also want their orders prepared correctly and on that score, Oches says, "accuracy is still really high."
cn: 奥其斯称，消费者当然还想让快餐店别弄错自己的订单，在这个问题上，快餐店的"准确率依然是非常高的"。

en: The first private mission outside of Earth's orbit is closer than many of us think.
cn: 首次私人探索地球外太空之旅越来越近，超出了我们当中很多人的想象。

en: U.S. government officials are set to approve a mission by privately-held space company Moon Express to travel outside of Earth's orbit in late 2017.
cn: 美国政府官员准备批准私营航天企业Moon Express申请的一项任务——2017年末实现外太空之旅。

en: Moon Express's mission involves plans to land a suitcase-sized package of scientific equipment on the moon for ongoing exploration and commercial development.
cn: Moon Express的任务是计划让一个手提箱大小的科学设备着陆月球，以进行持续探索和商业开发。

en: The decision involved months of lobbying and coordinated conversations between a number of federal agencies.
cn: 这个决定涉及为期数月的游说以及在许多联邦机构之间不断进行协调沟通。

en: Under international treaties, the U.S. is responsible for the cargo of both public and private spacecraft.
cn: 根据国际条约，美国负责公共宇宙飞船和私人宇宙飞船的载货量。

en: This makes commercial space travel a complex legal issue not just domestically, but abroad.
cn: 这使得商业太空旅游成为国内外复杂的法律问题。

en: A Moon Express representative declined to comment on the story, but noted that the company is very optimistic about its proposal.
cn: 针对此事，Moon Express的一名代表拒绝发表评论，但这名代表指出公司对这项提议保持非常乐观的态度。

en: Moon Express is not the only company seeking for the right to travel to outer space.
cn: Moon Express并不是唯一一家申请外太空旅游权利的公司。

en: Elon Musk's SpaceX aims to send an unmanned aircraft to Mars by 2018.
cn: 埃隆·马斯克的SpaceX的目标是到2018年之前向火星发射无人驾驶飞机。

en: Hey, Sophia, how are you doing?
cn: 你好，索菲娅，最近怎么样？

en: Hi, Bob. I'm good, thanks.
cn: 你好，鲍勃，我一切都好，谢谢问候。

en: Actually, I'm on holiday with my family in Thailand at the moment, although I wish it were with my friends instead.
cn: 我现在实际上跟我的家人在泰国度假，尽管我更希望是跟我的朋友一起来的。

en: Really?
cn: 真的吗？

en: You never said you are going to Thailand.
cn: 从没听你说过你要去泰国。

en: How I envy you!
cn: 真羡慕你！

en: I've only been here a week, but you know, Thailand's an amazing place.
cn: 我才在这里待一周，但是你知道的，泰国是个神奇的地方。

en: I'm having a great time here.
cn: 我在这里度过了愉快的时光。

en: In fact, I'm now lying on the beach in Phuket.
cn: 事实上，我现在正躺在普吉岛的海滩上呢。

en: I've been in the sun for around 15 minutes only, and I'm already getting sun burnt.
cn: 我只是在太阳下待了15分钟左右，就已经被晒伤了。

en: Have you been here before?
cn: 你以前来过这里吗？

en: No, I wish I had.
cn: 没有，我希望我去过。

en: What else have you been doing in Thailand besides enjoying the sun?
cn: 你在泰国除了享受阳光还做了什么呢？

en: Well, I met a guy from Germany yesterday.
cn: 嗯，昨天我遇见了一个德国人。

en: He showed me around the orphanage he works at.
cn: 他带我参观了他工作的孤儿院。

en: There, I met many volunteer teachers who are mainly young people from Europe.
cn: 在那里，我见到了许多志愿者教师，他们大部分都是来自欧洲的年轻人。

en: Ah, that's interesting.
cn: 哇，那很有意思。

en: Yes. I also made a new little friend, Sarah.
cn: 是的。我还交了一个年纪小的新朋友，她叫萨拉。

en: She was so cute.
cn: 她非常可爱。

en: I was so sad when I had to leave at the end of the day.
cn: 当那天结束我不得不离开的时候，我感到非常难过。

en: If I ever come back to Thailand, I'd definitely visit this place again, as a volunteer.
cn: 如果我还有机会到泰国，我一定要重回这个地方做志愿者。

en: Well, you can tell me all about it when you get back.
cn: 嗯，你回来的时候可以把一切经历告诉我。

en: My phone battery is almost dead now.
cn: 现在我的手机电池马上就没电了。

en: Remember to get me something from the souvenir shops.
cn: 记得从纪念品商店帮我带点东西回来。

en: I like to collect bits and pieces from different parts of the world.
cn: 我喜欢收集不同国家的零碎小物件。

en: Bye now, enjoy yourself, Sophia.
cn: 再见，好好玩，索菲娅。

en: Bye.
cn: 再见。

en: Hi David, there is a new gym opening in town today.
cn: 你好，大卫，今天镇上新开了一家健身房。

en: Would you like to go with me this afternoon?
cn: 你今天下午想跟我一起去看看吗？

en: Yes, more than glad to. I haven't been to a gym for ages.
cn: 好啊，非常乐意。我好久没去健身房了。

en: I need to do some exercise to tone up.
cn: 我需要一些锻炼来增强体魄。

en: Then this is a good chance.
cn: 那这是个好机会。

en: They sent me an invitation with a note saying I could take a friend for free on the first day.
cn: 他们给我发了一份邀请函，上面写着开业第一天我可以免费带一位朋友去。

en: Also, if we both sign up before Friday, we can get a discount on a six-month membership.
cn: 而且，如果我们都在周五之前报名，就能享受六个月会员折扣。

en: Great, count me in.
cn: 太好了，算我一个。

en: I really want to lose some of this belly fat and turn it into muscle, but I'm not sure which of the gym equipment would best help.
cn: 我真想把腹部赘肉练成肌肉，但是我不知道哪种健身器材最有效。

en: Well, I'm no expert on that, but I think you can try lifting weights and do at least 200 sit-ups twice a day.
cn: 呃，我在这方面也不专业，但是我认为你可以尝试举重，每天做两次仰卧起坐，每次至少做200个。

en: I've never tried weight-lifting before.
cn: 我以前从未尝试过举重。

en: Is it dangerous?
cn: 危险吗？

en: No, not at all—if you know some of the basics.
cn: 不，根本不危险——只要你知道一些基础知识的话。

en: Don't worry. I'll show you the ropes.
cn: 不用担心，我会告诉你其中的窍门。

en: I used to practice this at another gym before my membership ended.
cn: 会员卡到期之前我曾在其他健身房练习过这项运动。

en: I'll be your personal trainer.
cn: 我会当你的私人教练。

en: Thank you.
cn: 谢谢你。

en: What other equipment do they have?
cn: 他们还提供其他的什么健身器材？

en: Well, like all gyms, they have all sorts of things to help build up muscles in different parts of the body, like upright bicycles, chest stretching machines, and running machines.
cn: 呃，和所有健身房一样，他们有各种各样的器材，可以帮你练就身体不同部位的肌肉，比如直立式健身车、胸部伸展机以及跑步机。

en: You could use any of these to suit your purpose.
cn: 你可以选用任意一种去满足你的健身需求。

en: Now the gym opens at noon, so can we meet up in town at 1:30 p.m.?
cn: 目前这家健身房中午开门，所以我们下午一点半在镇上集合好吗？

en: Perfect, see you there, coach.
cn: 太好了，在那儿见，教练。

en: In today's job market, it's not uncommon for job seekers to submit applications for many positions.
cn: 在如今的就业市场上，求职者申请多个职位的情况并不少见。

en: That involves lots of time and lots of work to organize.
cn: 这需要花费大量的时间，做大量的规划工作。

en: Certainly, you don't want to waste your precious hours on following the developments in a disorderly fashion, and miss important deadlines, confuse interview times or forget to follow up as a result.
cn: 当然，你一定不希望浪费宝贵的时间而以混乱的方式关注事态的发展、错过重要的截止日期、搞混面试时间或最后忘记跟进。

en: Accordingly, managing your job search properly is just as important as identifying job opportunities and submitting your applications.
cn: 于是，在求职期间，合理规划就与发现工作机会和提交申请同等重要。

en: If you are familiar with Microsoft Excel or a similar program, creating a table is a simple and effective way to keep track of your job applications.
cn: 如果你熟悉微软的Excel软件，或类似程序，创建表格是记录工作申请的一个简单、有效的方法。

en: If Excel isn't quite your cup of tea, don't worry.
cn: 如果你不喜欢用Excel也不用担心。

en: You can create a table in Microsoft Word or a similar word processor.
cn: 你可以用微软的Word软件或其他类似的文字处理软件创建表格。

en: Google is another tool to help you get organized effectively.
cn: 谷歌是另一个可以帮你有效保持条理性的工具。

en: If you have a Gmail account, you can create, save and send tables in addition to written documents like your cover letter and resume.
cn: 如果你有谷歌邮箱的账户，除了求职信和简历等书面文件，你也可以创建、保存和发送表格。

en: You can also link up with Google Calendar to make sure you stay on top of important dates.
cn: 你还可以连接到谷歌日历，确保重要的日期置顶。

en: Clearly, there are plenty of ways to keep track of your job search and making the effort to simplify your job search will pay off.
cn: 很显然，有很多方法可以记录求职过程，而且，尽量简化你的求职过程，也会是值得的。

en: Nevertheless, you should always focus on quality, not quantity.
cn: 然而，你应该始终关注质量而不是数量。

en: Only apply for positions you're qualified for, and make each application count, personalizing each cover letter and updating and editing your resume.
cn: 只申请你能胜任的职位，每个申请都要算数，每封求职信都要个性化，更新并编辑你的简历。

en: Some people say if kids didn't have to go to school they'd all be out in the streets.
cn: 有些人说，如果孩子们不用去上学的话他们就都会出来在街上玩。

en: My reply is "No, they wouldn't." First, even if schools stayed just the way they are, children would spend at least some time there because that's where they'd be likely to find friends.
cn: 我的答复是：不，他们不会的。首先，即使学校还是老样子，孩子们也会在学校至少待一段时间，因为在那里他们可能会找到朋友。

en: Second, schools wouldn't stay the way they are, they'd get better, because we would have to start making them what they ought to be right now.
cn: 第二，学校不会一直是老样子，它们会变得越来越好，因为我们现在必须开始把学校变成它们应该成为的样子。

en: Last, if we stirred up our brains and gave children a little help, those who did not want to go to school could find other things to do, things many children now do during their holidays.
cn: 最后，如果我们开动脑筋给孩子们一点帮助，那些不想去学校的孩子就可以找到其他事情来做——很多孩子现在在假期里做的事情。

en: There's something easier we could do.
cn: 我们还能够做一件更容易的事。

en: We need to get kids out of the school buildings, give them a chance to learn about the world at first hand.
cn: 我们必须把孩子们从教学楼里解放出来，给他们直接了解世界的机会。

en: In Philadelphia and Portland, Oregon, plans are being drawn up for public schools that won't have any school buildings at all.
cn: 在费城和俄勒冈州的波特兰，人们正在拟定计划开办没有任何教学楼的公立学校。

en: That will take the students out into the city and help them to use it and its people as a resource.
cn: 这将使得学生们走出学校，走进城市，帮助他们将城市和城市里的人当作资源来利用。

en: In other words, students perhaps in groups, perhaps independently, will go to libraries, museums, exhibitions, courtrooms, radio and TV stations, meetings, businesses and laboratories to learn about their world and society at first hand.
cn: 也就是说，学生们将会（或许成群结队，或许独自一人）去图书馆、博物馆、展览馆、法庭、广播电台和电视台、会议中心以及企业和实验室，直接了解他们的世界和社会。

en: A small private school in Washington is already doing this.
cn: 华盛顿的一所小型私立学校已经在这样做了。

en: It makes sense.
cn: 这很有意义。

en: We need more of it.
cn: 需要更多的学校行动起来。

en: Before there was the written word, there was the language of dance.
cn: 在文字出现之前，就已经有了舞蹈的语言。

en: Dance expresses love and hate, joy and sorrow, life and death, and everything else in between.
cn: 舞蹈表达爱与恨、喜与悲、生与死，以及介于其间的一切情感。

en: Dance in America is everywhere.
cn: 在美国，舞蹈无处不在。

en: We dance from Florida to Alaska, from horizon to horizon and coast to coast.
cn: 我们从佛罗里达跳到阿拉斯加，从天际到天际，从东海岸到西海岸。

en: We dance at weddings, birthdays, office parties or just to fill the time.
cn: 我们在婚礼、生日派对、公司聚会上跳舞，或者只是为了消磨时光。

en: "I adore dancing," says Lester Bridges, the owner of a dance studio in a small town in Iowa. "I can't imagine doing anything else with my life."
cn: "我热爱舞蹈，"爱荷华州一个小镇舞蹈工作室的老板莱斯特·布里奇斯说，"我无法想象用其他方式度过我的人生。"

en: Bridges runs dance classes for all ages.
cn: 布里奇斯为各个年龄段的人开设舞蹈课。

en: "Teaching dance is wonderful.
cn: "教舞蹈是一件美好的事。

en: My older students say it makes them feel young.
cn: 我年纪较大的学员说，跳舞让他们感觉年轻。

en: It's marvelous to watch them.
cn: 看着他们跳舞真是妙不可言。

en: For many of them, it's a way of meeting people and having a social life.
cn: 对他们中的许多人来说，舞蹈是结识朋友、享受社交生活的一种方式。

en: So why do we dance?
cn: 那么，我们为什么要跳舞呢？

en: "I can tell you about one young couple," says Bridges.
cn: "我可以告诉你一对年轻夫妇的故事，"布里奇斯说。

en: "They arrive at the class in a bad mood and they leave with a smile.
cn: "他们带着沮丧的心情来上课，离开时却面带微笑。"

en: Dancing seems to change their mood completely."
cn: 舞蹈似乎能彻底改变他们的心情。"

en: So, do we dance in order to make ourselves feel better, calmer, healthier?
cn: 那么，我们跳舞是为了让自己感觉更好、更平静、更健康吗？

en: Andrea Hillier, a dance teacher, says, "Dance, like the rhythm of a beating heart, is life.
cn: 舞蹈老师安德里亚·希利尔说："舞蹈就像心跳的节拍，是生命本身。

en: Even after all these years, I want to get better and better.
cn: 即使经过了这么多年，我仍然想要不断进步。

en: I keep practicing even when I'm exhausted.
cn: 即便筋疲力尽，我也坚持练习。

en: I find it hard to stop!
cn: 我发现自己根本停不下来！

en: Dancing reminds me I'm alive."
cn: 舞蹈提醒我，我还活着。"

en: A message in a bottle sent out to sea by a New Hampshire man more than five decades ago was found 1,500 miles away and has been returned to his daughter. (31 words)
cn: 50多年前新罕布什尔州的一位男子把一张便条放进瓶子里并扔进大海，现在这个便条在1500英里以外的地方被发现了，并被送回到那位男子的女儿手里。

en: The long-lost message was discovered by Clint Buffington of Utah while he was vacationing. (15 words)
cn: 这条消失已久的消息是犹他州的克林特·巴芬顿在度假的时候发现的。

en: Buffington says he found a soda bottle half buried in the sand that looked like it had been there since the beginning of time. (23 words)
cn: 巴芬顿说，他发现一个苏打水瓶半掩埋在沙子里，看起来就像是一开始就属于那里一样。

en: The note inside the bottle said, "Return to 419 Ocean Street and receive a reward of $150 from Richard and Tina Pierce, owners of the Beachcomber Motel." (27 words)
cn: 瓶子里的便条上写着："请送到海洋大街419号，那里的巨浪汽车旅馆的老板理查德·皮尔斯和蒂娜·皮尔斯会给您150美元作为酬谢。"

en: The motel was owned by the parents of Paula Pierce in 1960. (12 words)
cn: 这家汽车旅馆是由宝拉·皮尔斯的父母于1960年开的。

en: Her father had written the note as a joke and had thrown it into the Atlantic Ocean. (17 words)
cn: 她的父亲当时开玩笑写了一张便条，并扔进了大西洋。

en: Buffington flew to New Hampshire to deliver the message to Paula Pierce. (12 words)
cn: 巴芬顿坐飞机到新罕布什尔州，把这条信息传递给宝拉·皮尔斯。

en: She held up to her father's promise, giving Buffington that reward. (11 words)
cn: 她遵守了父亲的承诺，赠予巴芬顿150美元的酬金。

en: But the biggest reward is the message in a bottle finding its way back home. (15 words)
cn: 但最大的报酬是瓶子里的信息终于回到家了。

en: Millions of bees have died in South Carolina during aerial insect-spraying operations that were carried out to combat the Zika virus. (21 words)
cn: 在南卡罗来纳州，为对抗寨卡病毒而实施的空中喷洒杀虫剂作业导致了上百万只蜜蜂死亡。

en: The insect-spraying over the weekend left more than 2 million bees dead on the spot in Dorchester County, South Carolina, where four travel-related cases of Zika disease have been confirmed in the area. (32 words)
cn: 周末喷洒的杀虫剂让南卡罗来纳州多切斯特县的两百多万只蜜蜂当场死亡；在多切斯特县，四起因旅行感染寨卡病毒的案例被确诊。

en: Most of the deaths came from Flower Town Bee Farm, a company in Somerville that sells bees and honey products. (20 words)
cn: 大多数死亡的蜜蜂主要来自鲜花镇蜜蜂养殖场，它是萨默维尔市一家销售蜜蜂和蜂蜜产品的公司。

en: Juanita Stanley who owns the company said the farm looks like it's been destroyed. (14 words)
cn: 该蜜蜂农场主胡安妮塔·斯坦利表示，农场简直就像被摧毁殆尽的样子。

en: The farm lost about 2.5 million bees. (7 words)
cn: 农场损失了约250万只蜜蜂。

en: Dorchester County officials apologized for the accidental mass killing of bees. (11 words)
cn: 多切斯特县的官员为此次杀死大量蜜蜂的意外事故表达了歉意。

en: Dorchester County is aware that some beekeepers in the area that was sprayed on Sunday lost their bee colonies. (19 words)
cn: 多切斯特县了解到，在周日喷洒杀虫剂的地区，一些养蜂人失去了他们的蜂群。

en: County manager Jason Ward said in a statement, "I'm not pleased that so many bees were killed." (17 words)
cn: 县负责人杰森·沃德在声明中说："这么多只蜜蜂被杀死，我感到非常遗憾。"

en: The world's largest aircraft has taken to the skies for the first time. (13 words)
cn: 世界上最大的飞行器已经完成了第一次试飞。

en: The Airlander 10 spent nearly two hours in the air, having taken off from Cardington airfield in Bedfordshire. (18 words)
cn: 天空登陆者10号在贝德福德郡的卡丁顿机场起飞，在空中飞行大约2小时。

en: During its flight it reached 3,000 feet and performed a series of gentle turns all over a safe area. (19 words)
cn: 在飞行过程中，它最高飞了3000英尺，在安全区域展现了一系列平稳的转弯。

en: The aircraft is massive—as long as a football field and as tall as six double decker buses and capable of flying for up to five days. (27 words)
cn: 该飞行器很庞大，有一个足球场那么长，有6个双层巴士的高度，飞行时间可以持续5天。

en: It was first developed for the U.S. government as a long-range spy aircraft, but was abandoned following budget cutbacks. (20 words)
cn: 天空登陆者10号最初是为美国政府开发设计的，原本是想利用它作远程监视侦测之用，但是后来因预算削减而被搁置。

en: The aircraft cost 25 million pounds and can carry heavier loads than huge jet planes while also producing less noise and emitting less pollution. (24 words)
cn: 该飞行器耗费2500万英镑，比大型喷气式飞机的载重量大，同时噪音小，污染少。

en: The makers believe it's the future of aircraft and one day we'll be using them to go places. (18 words)
cn: 制造商相信，它是飞行器的未来，总有一天，我们会坐上它去任何地方。

en: But there's still a long way to go. (8 words)
cn: 但它还有很长的路要走。

en: The Airlander 10 will need to have 200 hours' flying time before being allowed to fly by the aviation administration. (19 words)
cn: 天空登陆者10号在通过航空局的批准之前，必须飞行200个小时。

en: If it passes, though, we can hope we'll all get some extra legroom. (13 words)
cn: 不过，如果它获得批准，我们可以期待未来大家都会有更多的地方可以放脚了。

en: Do you feel like going out tonight? (7 words)
cn: 你今晚想外出吗？

en: Yeah, why not? (3 words)
cn: 好啊，为什么不去呢？

en: We haven't been out for ages. (6 words)
cn: 我们有一阵子没出去了。

en: What's on? (2 words)
cn: 打算去做什么呢？

en: Well, there's a film about climate change. Does it sound good to you? (13 words)
cn: 嗯，有一部关于气候变化的电影，你感兴趣吗？

en: No, not really. (3 words)
cn: 不，不太感兴趣。

en: It doesn't really appeal to me. (6 words)
cn: 它实际上并不吸引我。

en: What's it about? (3 words)
cn: 那部电影是讲什么的？

en: Just climate change? (3 words)
cn: 只是气候变化吗？

en: I think it's about how climate change affects everyday life. (10 words)
cn: 我想它可能是关于气候变化如何影响日常生活的吧。

en: I wonder how they make it entertaining. (7 words)
cn: 我想知道他们如何能把它拍出娱乐性。

en: Well, it sounds really awful. (5 words)
cn: 听起来真的很糟糕。

en: It's an important subject, I agree, but I am not in the mood for anything depressing. (15 words)
cn: 我认同这是一个重要的主题，但是我没有心情看任何令人压抑的东西。

en: What else is on? (4 words)
cn: 还有其他的吗？

en: There's a Spanish Dance Festival. (5 words)
cn: 还有一场西班牙舞蹈节。

en: Oh, I love dance. (4 words)
cn: 哦，我喜欢跳舞。

en: That sounds really interesting. (4 words)
cn: 这个听起来很有意思。

en: Apparently, it's absolutely brilliant. (4 words)
cn: 显然，它一定很精彩。

en: Let's see what it says in the paper. (8 words)
cn: 我们来看看报纸上是怎么评价的。

en: Anna Gomez leads in an exciting production of the great Spanish love story, Carmen. (14 words)
cn: 它是一部由安娜·戈麦斯领衔演出的令人兴奋的作品，演绎西班牙伟大的爱情故事《卡门》。

en: OK, then. What time is it on? (7 words)
cn: 好的，几点开始呢？

en: At 7:30. (2 words)
cn: 七点半。

en: Well, that's no good. (4 words)
cn: 那就不太好了。

en: We haven't got enough time to get there. (8 words)
cn: 我们没有足够的时间赶过去了。

en: Is there anything else? (4 words)
cn: 还有其他的吗？

en: There's a comedy special on. (5 words)
cn: 还有一场特别的喜剧节目。

en: Where is it on? (4 words)
cn: 在哪里上映呢？

en: It's at the City Theater. (5 words)
cn: 在城市剧院。

en: It's a charity comedy night with lots of different acts. (10 words)
cn: 它是一场由许多不同剧幕组成的慈善喜剧之夜。

en: It looks pretty good. (4 words)
cn: 看起来很不错。

en: The critic in the local paper says it's the funniest thing he's ever seen. (14 words)
cn: 当地报纸的评论家说这是他看过最有趣的了。

en: It says here Roger Whitehead is an amazing host to a night of fun performances. (15 words)
cn: 据说到时罗杰·怀特海德会惊艳出场，担任整晚搞笑表演的主持人。

en: Hmm... I am not keen on him. (7 words)
cn: 嗯……我并不是很喜欢他。

en: He is not very funny. (5 words)
cn: 他并不是很幽默。

en: Are you sure you fancy going out tonight? (8 words)
cn: 你确定今晚想出门吗？

en: You are not very enthusiastic. (5 words)
cn: 你兴致不高啊！

en: Perhaps you are right. (4 words)
cn: 也许你是对的。

en: Okay, let's go see the dance. (6 words)
cn: 好吧，我们去看舞蹈表演吧。

en: But tomorrow, not tonight. (4 words)
cn: 但是是明天，不是今晚。

en: Great, I'll book the tickets online. (6 words)
cn: 太好了，我会在网上订好票的。

en: Good morning, Mr. Lee. (4 words)
cn: 早上好，李先生。

en: May I have a minute of your time? (8 words)
cn: 我能占用您一会儿时间吗？

en: Sure, Katherine. (2 words)
cn: 当然可以，凯瑟琳。

en: What can I do for you? (6 words)
cn: 我能为你做什么呢？

en: I'm quite anxious about transferring over to your college. (9 words)
cn: 我非常担心转学到你们学院。

en: I'm afraid I won't fit in. (6 words)
cn: 我怕自己不适应。

en: Don't worry, Katherine. It's completely normal for you to be nervous about transferring schools. This happens to many transfer students. (20 words)
cn: 别担心，凯瑟琳，你对转学的事情感到担心是完全正常的，这种情况发生在许多转校生身上。

en: Yes, I know, but I'm younger than most of the students in my year. And that worries me a lot. (20 words)
cn: 是的，我知道，但是我比同级的大多数学生都小，这令我非常担忧。

en: Well, you may be the only younger one in your year, but you know, we have a lot of after-school activities you can join in, and so, this way, you'll be able to meet new friends of different age groups. (39 words)
cn: 嗯，你可能是你们年级唯一一个年纪小一些的学生，但是你知道我们有许多课外活动可供你参加，通过这种方式，你可以遇到不同年龄段的新朋友。

en: That's nice. I love games and hobby groups. (8 words)
cn: 那样太好了，我喜欢游戏以及兴趣小组。

en: I'm sure you do. So you'll be just fine. (9 words)
cn: 我相信你肯定喜欢，所以你会适应的。

en: Don't worry so much and try to make the most of what we have on offer here. Also, remember that you can come to me anytime of the day if you need help. (32 words)
cn: 不用太过担心，试着尽量充分把握我们所提供的活动，而且记住如果你需要帮助，可以随时来找我。

en: Thanks so much. I definitely feel better now. (8 words)
cn: 太感谢了，我现在确实感觉好多了。

en: As a matter of fact, I've already contacted one of the girls who would be living in the same house as me, and she seemed really nice. (27 words)
cn: 事实上，我已经联系了和我住一个房间的其中一个女孩，她看起来非常友善。

en: I guess living on campus, I'll have a chance to have a closer circle of friends, since we'll be living together. (21 words)
cn: 我猜住校会让我有机会交到一群更亲近的好朋友，因为我们将生活在一起。

en: All students are very friendly with new arrivals. (8 words)
cn: 所有的学生对新来的学生都非常友好。

en: Let me check who would be living with you in your flat. (12 words)
cn: 我来查查谁将和你住一间公寓。

en: Okay. (1 words)
cn: 好的。

en: There are Hannah, Kelly and Bree. (6 words)
cn: 她们是汉娜、凯莉和布里。

en: Bree is also a new student here, like you. (9 words)
cn: 布里和你一样，也是新来的学生。

en: I'm sure you two will have more to share with each other. (12 words)
cn: 我相信你们两个会有更多的话题可以互相分享。

en: Have you ever felt like you would do just about anything to satisfy your hunger? (15 words)
cn: 你是否曾经觉得自己为了消除饥饿感可以做任何事情？

en: A new study in mice may help to explain why hunger can feel like such a powerful motivating force. (19 words)
cn: 一项在老鼠身上进行的新研究可能有助于解释为什么饥饿感可以是一种如此强大的推动力。

en: In the study, researchers found that hunger outweighed other physical drives, including fear, thirst and social needs. (17 words)
cn: 在这项研究中，研究人员发现饥饿超过了其他的身体驱动力，包括恐惧、口渴和社交需求。

en: To determine which feeling won out, the researchers did a series of experiments. (13 words)
cn: 为了确定哪种感觉胜出，研究人员做了一系列实验。

en: In one experiment, the mice were both hungry and thirsty. (10 words)
cn: 在一个实验中，老鼠们又饿又渴。

en: When given the choice of either eating food or drinking water, the mice went for the food, the researchers found. (20 words)
cn: 研究人员发现，如果让老鼠在进食和喝水之间选择，它们会选择食物。

en: However, when the mice were well-fed but thirsty, they opted to drink, according to the study. (16 words)
cn: 然而，根据这项研究，当老鼠吃得很饱但又渴的时候，它们会选择喝水。

en: In the second experiment meant to pit the mice's hunger against their fear, hungry mice were placed in a cage that had certain "fox-scented" areas and other places that smelled safer (in other words, not like an animal that could eat them) but also had food. (45 words)
cn: 第二个实验是为了研究老鼠在饥饿和恐惧产生对抗时的反应，饥饿的老鼠被放进一个笼子里，笼子分成"有狐狸气味"的区域和闻起来更安全的区域（换句话说，闻起来不像能吃掉它们的动物的气味），但也有食物。

en: It turned out that, when the mice were hungry, they ventured into the unsafe areas for food. (17 words)
cn: 结果是，当老鼠饿了的时候，它们会冒险进入不安全的区域寻找食物。

en: But when the mice were well-fed, they stayed in areas of the cage that were considered "safe." (17 words)
cn: 但是当老鼠吃得很饱的时候，它们就待在笼子里它们认为"安全"的区域。

en: Hunger also outweighed the mice's social needs, the researchers found. (10 words)
cn: 研究人员发现，饥饿也超过了老鼠的社交需求。

en: Mice are usually social animals and prefer to be in the company of other mice, according to the study. (19 words)
cn: 根据这项研究，老鼠通常是群居动物，喜欢和其他老鼠在一起。

en: When the mice were hungry, they opted to leave the company of other mice to go get food. (18 words)
cn: 当老鼠饿的时候，它们选择离开其他老鼠的陪伴去寻找食物。

en: The United States has one of the best highway systems in the world. (13 words)
cn: 美国拥有世界上最发达的公路系统之一。

en: Interstate highways connect just about every large and mid-sized city in the country. (13 words)
cn: 州际公路连接全国几乎所有大中城市。

en: Did you ever wonder why such a complete system of excellent roads exists? (13 words)
cn: 你有没有想过为什么存在这样一个完善的道路系统？

en: For an answer, you would have to go back to the early 1920s. (13 words)
cn: 为了得到答案，你不得不回到20世纪20年代初。

en: In those years, just after World War I, the military wanted to build an American highway system for national defense. (20 words)
cn: 在第一次世界大战刚结束之后的那些年，军方想要建立一个美国公路系统，用于支持国防。

en: Such a system could, if necessary, move troops quickly from one area to another. (14 words)
cn: 如有必要，这一系统可以迅速将部队从一个地区转移到另一个地区。

en: It could also get people out of cities in danger of being bombed. (13 words)
cn: 它也可以将人们从存在被炸风险的城市疏散。

en: So-called roads of national importance were designated, but they were mostly small country roads. (14 words)
cn: 那些所谓的具有全国重要性的道路被确定了下来，但它们大多是狭窄的乡村道路。

en: In 1944, Congress passed a bill to upgrade the system, but did not fund the plan right away. (18 words)
cn: 1944年，国会通过了一项法案来升级该系统，但没有立即为该计划提供资金。

en: In the 1950s, the plan began to become a reality. (10 words)
cn: 在20世纪50年代，该计划开始成为现实。

en: Over $25 billion was appropriated by Congress, and construction began on about 40,000 miles of new roads. (17 words)
cn: 国会拨款250多亿美元，新建约4万英里长的道路。

en: The idea was to connect the new system to existing expressways and freeways. (13 words)
cn: 这个想法是将新系统与现有的高速公路连接起来。

en: And though the system was built mostly to make car travel easier, defense was not forgotten. (16 words)
cn: 虽然该系统的建立主要是为了让汽车出行更便利，但防御措施并没有被遗忘。

en: For instance, highway overpasses had to be high enough to allow trailers carrying military missiles to pass under them. (19 words)
cn: 例如，公路立交桥必须足够高，以允许携带军用导弹的拖车从下面通过。

en: By 1974, this system was mostly completed. (7 words)
cn: 到1974年，这个系统基本完工。

en: A few additional roads would come later. (7 words)
cn: 将来更多的道路将被修建。

en: Quick and easy travel between all parts of the country was now possible. (13 words)
cn: 现在全国各地之间快速而轻松的旅行已成为可能。

en: Texting while driving was listed as a major cause of road deaths among young Americans back in 2013. (18 words)
cn: 在2013年，边开车边发短信的行为被列为美国年轻人在交通事故中死亡的主要原因。

en: A recent study said that 40% of American teens claim to have been in a car when the driver used a cell phone in a way that put people in danger. (31 words)
cn: 最近的一项研究指出，40%的美国青少年称自己乘坐他人轿车时，遭遇过驾驶员使用手机的情形，这种行为将他人置于危险之中。

en: This sounds like a widespread disease but it's one that technology may now help to cure. (16 words)
cn: 这听起来就像是一种广泛传播的疾病，但是有一种科技或许可以帮忙解决这个问题。

en: T.J. Evarts, a 20-year-old inventor, has come up with a novel solution that could easily put texting drivers on notice. (20 words)
cn: T.J. 埃瓦茨是一名20岁的发明家，他已经提出一个新奇的解决方案，可以非常容易地向发短信的司机发出警告。

en: It's called Smart Wheel, and it's designed to fit over the steering wheel of most standard vehicles to track whether or not the driver has two hands on the wheel at all times. (33 words)
cn: 这种装置叫做智能方向盘，它适配大多数标准车辆的方向盘，用来追踪司机的双手是否一直放在方向盘上。

en: Evarts' invention warns the drivers with a light and a sound when they hold the wheel with one hand only, but as soon as they place the other hand back on the wheel the light turns back to green and the sound stops. (43 words)
cn: 埃瓦茨的发明以发光和发声的方式向只用一只手握方向盘的司机发出警告，但是当司机把另外一只手放回到方向盘上的时候，灯就变回绿色并且停止发声。

en: It also watches for what's called "close by hands", where both hands are close together near the top of the wheel so the driver can type with both thumbs and drive at the same time. (35 words)
cn: 这种装置也监控那种叫"双手靠近"的行为，即将双手靠近并且放在方向盘的最高处，这样司机就可以一边开车，一边用双手拇指编辑短信。

en: All the data Smart Wheel collects is also sent to a connected app. (13 words)
cn: 智能方向盘收集的所有数据也会被发送到与之相关联的手机应用程序中。

en: So any parents who install Smart Wheel can keep track of the teens' driving habits. (15 words)
cn: 所以，安装了智能方向盘的家长可以追踪孩子的驾驶习惯。

en: If they try to remove or damage the cover, that's reported as well. (13 words)
cn: 如果他们试图移开或者毁坏这个智能装置的表面，该装置也会进行报告。

en: A device that weighs less than one kilogram is part of a mission that will allow scientists to deliver fourth generation or 4G mobile coverage to the moon in 2019. (30 words)
cn: 一个重量不足一公斤的装置是一项（月球）任务的组成部分，该任务将使科学家们能够在2019年将第四代或者说4G移动网络覆盖到月球上。

en: If successful, the tiny device will provide the moon with its first-ever mobile phone network. (15 words)
cn: 若此举成功的话，这个微小的装置将会有史以来首次为月球提供移动手机网络。

en: The lunar network will support high-definition streaming of video and data between the moon and Earth. (16 words)
cn: 月球上的网络会支持月球和地球之间高清晰度的视频影像及数据的传输。

en: The network is part of Mission to the Moon. (9 words)
cn: 该网络是"月球任务"的一部分。

en: This is a project with the goal of landing the first privately paid-for mission to the moon. (17 words)
cn: "月球任务"是一个（太空）项目，其目标是实现首次私人付费登月任务。

en: The 4G mission is set to launch from Cape Canaveral in the United States on a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket in 2019. (23 words)
cn: 4G网络计划于2019年在美国卡纳维拉尔角由太空探索技术公司的猎鹰9号火箭送往月球。

en: Mission to the Moon intends to establish and test the first elements of a communications network on the moon. (19 words)
cn: 此次月球任务旨在在月球上建立并测试通信网络的第一批元件。

en: The scientists working on the project opted to build a 4G rather than a fifth generation or 5G network. (19 words)
cn: 致力于该项目的科学家选择建立4G网络，而非第五代（5G）网络。

en: This is because fifth generation networks are still in testing and trial phases. (13 words)
cn: 这是因为5G网络仍处于测试和试用阶段。

en: This means that a 5G network may not yet be stable enough to work on the moon's surface. (18 words)
cn: 那意味着5G网络还不够稳定，不足以在月球表面上使用。

en: Firefighters responded to a fire Wednesday night at an abandoned mall in Hayward. (13 words)
cn: 周三晚上，海沃德一座废弃的购物中心发生火灾，消防员随即出动。

en: The fire was reported at 9:26 pm at an old shopping center on Mission Avenue near St. Mary's Church. (19 words)
cn: 据报道，晚上9点26分，使命大道上圣玛丽教堂附近的一座年久的购物中心发生火灾。

en: Six fire engines, two trucks and two chiefs responded to the scene. (12 words)
cn: 六辆消防车、两辆卡车和两位消防官员到达现场。

en: Crews had the fire under control in about 45 minutes and managed to contain the fire to its point of origin. (21 words)
cn: 消防人员在大约45分钟内控制住了火势，并设法将火势控制在起火点。

en: There were some people inside the building when the fire broke out but there were no reports of any injuries. (20 words)
cn: 火灾爆发时，大楼里有一些人，不过没有任何人员受伤的报告。

en: Fire investigators have responded to the scene but have not yet determined the cause of the fire. (17 words)
cn: 火灾调查员们已经来到火灾现场，但还没有确定火灾起因。

en: Firefighters will remain on the scene until later this morning to ensure that the fire doesn't start up again. (19 words)
cn: 消防员们会继续守在现场直到今天早晨晚些时候，以确保火不会复燃。

en: The shopping mall had not been in use since 2002. (10 words)
cn: 这座购物中心自2002年起便不再使用。

en: In 2014, City Hall developed a plan to knock down the building and replace it with affordable housing. (18 words)
cn: 2014年，市政厅制定了一项计划，决定拆毁大楼并用经济适用房代替。

en: However, the plan was dropped due to lack of funds. (10 words)
cn: 然而，该计划由于缺乏资金而被放弃。

en: Potato chips in Japan are being sold for 6 times their normal price. (13 words)
cn: 日本的炸薯条目前售价是平常的6倍。

en: This is after the country's main manufacturer stopped sales due to a potato shortage. (14 words)
cn: 这一状况发生在因土豆短缺日本的主要制造商停止销售炸薯条之后。

en: Storms and floods in its main potato growing region last year caused the worst harvest in more than 3 decades. (20 words)
cn: 去年，日本主要土豆生产地区遭遇暴风雨和洪水灾害，导致该地区的土豆产量创30多年来的最低纪录。

en: Local media reports suggest Calbee and its main rival Koike-Ya are halting almost 50 products. (15 words)
cn: 当地新闻报道称，卡乐比及其主要竞争对手湖池屋即将停止销售近50种产品。

en: "We don't know when we'll be able to restart," a company spokesman said. (13 words)
cn: 一位公司的发言人说："我们不知道何时才可以重新开始生产。"

en: Snack lovers are panic buying and many supermarket shelves are bare. (11 words)
cn: 零食爱好者正在疯狂抢购，许多超市的货架被抢购一空。

en: Japanese laws limit the amount of imported potatoes that can be used in Japanese-made products. (15 words)
cn: 日本法律限制日本产品使用进口土豆的数量。

en: Japan says fear of disease is its main reason to block fresh imports. (13 words)
cn: 日本称，阻止进口新鲜土豆的主要原因是害怕引起（作物）疾病。

en: It still only allows potatoes from selected US states. (9 words)
cn: 日本仍然只允许进口来自美国某些州的土豆。

en: This is only at certain times and on condition that they are processed at factories based near Japanese ports. (19 words)
cn: 而且，这种情况也只是在特定的时间发生，条件是土豆要在日本港口附近的工厂经过加工处理。

en: But global warming has raised the possibility that domestic produce could be seriously affected by rare weather events more often. (20 words)
cn: 但全球变暖增加了国内农产品更频繁地受到罕见天气事件严重影响的可能性。

en: Mr. Brown's lectures are so boring. (6 words)
cn: 布朗先生的讲座太无聊了。

en: Yes, he is not a very exciting speaker. (8 words)
cn: 是的，他不是一个非常激动人心的演讲者。

en: But the subject is interesting. (5 words)
cn: 但这个科目很有趣。

en: During every one of these lectures, I try to listen, I really try. (13 words)
cn: 在每一次讲座中，我都尽力听，我真的尽力了。

en: But after about 10 minutes my mind begins to wander and I lose concentration. (14 words)
cn: 但大约10分钟后，我的思维就开始开小差了，我的注意力也不集中了。

en: But I see that you seem to be OK. (9 words)
cn: 但我看你似乎没事。

en: How do you stay focused through the entire hour? (9 words)
cn: 你是如何在整整一小时里保持专注的？

en: Well, what I do is keep my pen moving. (9 words)
cn: 嗯，我所做的就是让我的笔一直动。

en: What do you mean? (4 words)
cn: 你指的是什么？

en: It's a method of active concentration I read about. (9 words)
cn: 这是我读到的一种主动集中注意力的方法。
