en: One of the most effective ways to concentrate is to write things down. (13 words)
cn: 集中注意力最有效的方法之一就是写下来。

en: But it has to be done by hand, not typing on a keyboard. (13 words)
cn: 但必须手写完成，而不是在键盘上打字。

en: You see, writing by hand forces you to actually engage with what you're learning in a more physical way. (19 words)
cn: 你看，用手写字会迫使你以一种更依赖身体动作的方式让自己真正地投入到正在学习的东西中。

en: Do you review your notes afterwards then? (7 words)
cn: 之后你会复习你的笔记吗？

en: Sometimes, but that's not important. (5 words)
cn: 有时候会，但这并不重要。

en: My notes may or may not be useful, but the point is that by writing down what Mr. Brown says, I can follow his line of thinking more easily. (29 words)
cn: 我的笔记可能有用，也可能没有用，但重点是通过写下布朗先生所说的内容，我可以更轻松地跟随他的思路。

en: In fact, sometimes I draw a little, too. (8 words)
cn: 事实上，有时我也会画一画。

en: You draw in class, and that helps you pay attention? (10 words)
cn: 你在课堂上画画，而这有助于你集中注意力？

en: Yes, honestly, it works for me. (6 words)
cn: 是的，老实说，这对我有用。

en: I just draw little lines and nonsense really. (8 words)
cn: 我只是画细细的线条和一些无意义的东西。

en: It was also in that article I read. (8 words)
cn: 这也是我读过的那篇文章中提到的方法。

en: It can keep the mind active, prevent getting bored and help to concentrate. (13 words)
cn: 这可以让人保持头脑活跃，防止感到无聊，并有助于集中注意力。

en: Again, the point is to listen hard while keeping the pen moving. (12 words)
cn: 同样，关键是要在保持笔一直动的同时努力倾听。

en: If I'm at home and I need to study, what I do is read out loud. (16 words)
cn: 如果我在家需要学习的话，我采用的做法就是大声朗读。

en: It has a similar effect to writing by hand. (9 words)
cn: 这与用手书写效果相似。

en: It helps memorize information in a physical way. (8 words)
cn: 这有助于以一种依赖身体动作的方式记忆信息。

en: And, where's this? (3 words)
cn: 还有，这是哪儿？

en: These photos are from the Taj Mahal in India. (9 words)
cn: 这些照片都是在印度的泰姬陵拍摄的。

en: We went there about ten years ago for our honeymoon. (10 words)
cn: 大约十年前我们去那里度了蜜月。

en: Was it romantic? (3 words)
cn: 这地方浪漫吗？

en: Yeah. (1 words)
cn: 是的。

en: The Taj Mahal was a very romantic place. (8 words)
cn: 泰姬陵是一个非常浪漫的地方。

en: The guide told us there is a famous love story behind this building that all Indians learn in school. (19 words)
cn: 导游告诉我们，这座建筑背后有一个著名的爱情故事，所有的印度人在学校里都会学到它。

en: I think it was during the 1600s, and the princess at that time died while giving birth to her 14th child. (21 words)
cn: 我想这个故事发生在17世纪，当时的王妃在生第14个孩子的时候去世了。

en: The Emperor loved the princess so much and was so sad when she died, that he ordered the palace to be built in her honor. (25 words)
cn: 皇帝非常爱这位王妃，当她去世时他感到非常难过，于是下令建造这座宫殿来纪念她。

en: Wow! (1 words)
cn: 哇！

en: That sounds very romantic. (4 words)
cn: 这听起来非常浪漫。

en: It looks amazing. (3 words)
cn: 它看起来令人惊叹。

en: Yes, it's gorgeous. (3 words)
cn: 是的，很华丽。

en: It's also larger in real life than it looks in the photos. (12 words)
cn: 而且，它实际上比在照片中看起来更高大。

en: The building is very tall and there are gardens and a wall around it all. (15 words)
cn: 这座建筑很高，周围有花园和围墙。

en: It's all built in this white stone and some walls of the building are decorated with jewels. (17 words)
cn: 全部都是用这种白色石头建造成的，建筑物的一些墙壁上还装饰着珠宝。

en: It must have been very crowded when you were there. (10 words)
cn: 你在那里时一定非常拥挤。

en: Yes, it's a very famous tourist destination, so there are thousands of visitors every day. (15 words)
cn: 是的，这是一个非常著名的旅游目的地，所以每天都有成千上万的游客。

en: Was the rest of India crowded? (6 words)
cn: 印度的其他地方也很拥挤吗？

en: Yes, very crowded in many cities. (6 words)
cn: 是的，很多城市都非常拥挤。

en: It was sometimes so crowded that it was difficult to walk along the streets, especially through busy markets. (18 words)
cn: 有的时候太拥挤了，都很难沿着街道走，特别是穿过繁忙的市场时。

en: And there are so many cars. (6 words)
cn: 而且还有很多车。

en: Traffic was terrible but the people are friendly. (8 words)
cn: 交通很糟糕，但是人们很友好。

en: The culture is amazing and we had a great time. (10 words)
cn: 文化非常棒，我们度过了美好的时光。

en: What about the food? (4 words)
cn: 食物怎么样？

en: Indian food is great. (4 words)
cn: 印度菜很棒。

en: There are lots of different dishes to try and every region has its own special food. (16 words)
cn: 有许多不同的菜肴可供尝试，每个地区也都有自己的特色食品。

en: A Pew Research Center survey of more than 1000 Americans conducted in April 2016 finds that Americans continue to express largely positive views about the current state of their local public libraries. (32 words)
cn: 皮尤研究中心在2016年4月对1000多名美国人进行的一项调查发现，美国人仍然对当地公共图书馆的现状大体上持积极的看法。

en: For instance, around three quarters say that public libraries provide them with the resources they need, and 66 percent say the closing of their local public library would have a major impact on their community, although notably, just 33 percent say this would have a major impact on them personally or on their family. (54 words)
cn: 例如，约四分之三的人表示公共图书馆为他们提供了所需的资源，66%的人表示关闭当地公共图书馆会对他们的社区产生重大影响，尽管值得注意的是，只有33%的人称这会对他们个人或家庭产生重大影响。

en: A majority of Americans feel libraries are doing a good job of providing a safe place for people to hang out or spend time as well as opening up educational opportunities for people of all ages,  and roughly half think their libraries contribute a lot to their communities in terms of helping spark creativity among young people and providing a trusted place for people to learn about new technologies. (69 words)
cn: 大多数美国人认为，图书馆在提供安全场所供人们消遣，以及为所有年龄段的人提供教育机会方面做得很好，约一半的人认为图书馆在帮助激发年轻人创造力和为人们提供学习新技术的可靠场所方面为社区贡献很多。

en: As in past Pew Research Center surveys of library use the April 2016 survey also measured Americans' usage of and engagement with libraries. (23 words)
cn: 与皮尤研究中心过去的图书馆使用调查一样，2016年4月的调查也衡量了美国人对图书馆的使用和参与情况。

en: Overall, 53 percent of Americans aged 16 and older have had some interaction with a public library in the past year—either through an in-person visit or using a library Website. (30 words)
cn: 总体而言，53%的16岁及以上美国人在过去一年中与公共图书馆有过互动——通过亲自到访或使用图书馆网站。

en: Some 48 percent of adults specifically visited a library in the past 12 months. (14 words)
cn: 约48%的成年人在过去12个月中专门去过图书馆。

en: A modest increase from the 44 percent who said that in late 2015. (13 words)
cn: 这一比例较2015年底的44%略有上升。

en: A Savannah cat is a crossbreed between a domestic cat and a medium-sized wild African cat called the Serval. (19 words)
cn: 萨凡纳猫是家猫和被称为薮猫的中等体型的非洲野猫的杂交品种。

en: The unusual cross became popular among breeders at the end of the 1990s. (13 words)
cn: 这种不同寻常的杂交品种在20世纪90年代末开始受到饲养者的欢迎。

en: And in 2001, the International Cat Association accepted it as a new registered breed. (14 words)
cn: 2001年，国际猫协会接受了它作为一个新注册的品种。

en: The Savannahs are tall and slim and can weigh up to 9.1 kilograms, making them one of the largest breeds of cats that people can own. (26 words)
cn: 萨凡纳猫又高又瘦，体重可达9.1公斤，使其成为人类可拥有的最大的猫品种之一。

en: They have a spotted coat similar to that of many types of wild cats and their ears are very large. (20 words)
cn: 它们一身皮毛长有斑点，和许多类型的野猫相似，而且它们的耳朵非常大。

en: They are also commonly compared to dogs in their loyalty and can be trained to walk on a lead and to fetch. (22 words)
cn: 在忠诚度方面，它们也普遍可以和狗相媲美，而且，通过训练，它们能够被人用绳子牵着走，能够为人叼取东西。

en: An often noted characteristic of the Savannah is its jumping ability. (11 words)
cn: 萨凡纳猫经常被提及的特征就是它的跳跃能力。

en: They are known to jump on top of doors and high cabinets. (12 words)
cn: 人们熟知，它们会跳到门框上和高高的橱柜上。

en: Some can leap about 2.5 metres high from a standing position. (11 words)
cn: 有些萨凡纳猫能站着跳大约2.5米高。

en: Cats are typically known for being very inquisitive and so are the Savannahs. (13 words)
cn: 猫是典型的充满好奇心的动物，萨凡纳猫也是如此。

en: They often learn how to open doors and cupboards. (9 words)
cn: 它们经常学习如何打开门和橱柜。

en: Many Savannah cats do not fear water and will play with or even dive into water. (16 words)
cn: 许多萨凡纳猫不怕水，它们会玩水，甚至会潜入水中。

en: Some owners even shower with their Savannah cats. (8 words)
cn: 有些主人甚至和他们的萨凡纳猫一起冲澡。

en: Presenting a water bowl to a Savannah may also prove a challenge, as some will promptly begin to bat all the water out of the bowl until it is empty using their front paws. (34 words)
cn: 给萨凡纳猫一个喝水碗也可能是一项挑战，因为有些萨凡纳猫会立即开始用前爪将整个碗里的水拍打出去，直到碗里没有一滴水为止。

en: When children start school for the very first time, parents often feel a sense of excitement coupled with a touch of sadness at the end of an era. (28 words)
cn: 当孩子们第一次要上学的时候，父母们常常会觉得兴奋，还有一丝一个时期即将结束的悲伤感。

en: This is the start of a new adventure for children—playing and interacting with new friends, sharing, taking turns and settling into a new routine. (24 words)
cn: 对于孩子来说，上学是一次新冒险经历的起点——他们将和新朋友一起玩耍、互动、分享、依次轮流做事，并且逐渐适应一种新的日常生活。

en: But of course, this is not the start of your child's education which in fact began at birth. (18 words)
cn: 当然，这并不是你孩子教育的起点。事实上，孩子的教育在一出生就开始了。

en: Back then, you would have been your child's most influential teachers. (11 words)
cn: 那时，你可能是孩子最有影响力的老师。

en: During this time at home, your child would have learnt more than at any other period in their life. (19 words)
cn: 在（入学前）待在家里期间，孩子能学到的东西或许比他们生命中的任何时候都多。

en: During your child's first year in school much time will be spent in learning to read and they need to know that this is fun and worthwhile. (27 words)
cn: 入学后的第一年，孩子需要花大量时间来学习阅读，他们需要知道阅读是有意思的，也是值得的。

en: Your child will naturally copy you so it is important that you are seen reading and enjoying books, newspapers and magazines rather than just absorbed in screens. (27 words)
cn: 你的孩子会很自然地模仿你，所以让他们看到你在阅读并且享受读书、看报纸和杂志而不是只专注于屏幕是很重要的。

en: Ultimately an excellent education should be a close partnership between parents and teachers. (13 words)
cn: 归根结底，优秀的教育应该是家长和老师之间的密切合作。

en: A child's year splits fairly neatly into thirds: a third at school, a third asleep and a third awake at home or on holiday. (24 words)
cn: 孩子的一年被整齐地分成三份：三分之一在学校，三分之一在睡觉，三分之一醒着待在家里或在度假。

en: Irrespective of the quality of a school, a child's home life is of key importance. (15 words)
cn: 不管学校的教育质量如何，孩子的家庭生活是至关重要的。

en: It is the determining factor of their academic success. (9 words)
cn: 这是他们学业成功的决定性因素。

en: Your child may have started on a new journey but your work is far from finished. (16 words)
cn: 你的孩子可能已经开始了一段新的旅程，但你的工作还远远没有完成。

en: Rescue crews pulled a man to safety after a collapse at a construction site in Brooklyn on Tuesday. (18 words)
cn: 周二，布鲁克林区一处建筑工地发生了坍塌事故后，救援队将一名男子救至安全地带。

en: The incident happened on the 400 block of Rutland Road just after 12:30 p.m. (14 words)
cn: 事故发生在拉特兰路400街区，时间为午后12点半刚过。

en: The Fire Department of New York says the vacant 100-year-old building being pulled down partially collapsed. (16 words)
cn: 纽约消防局表示，这座拥有100年历史的空置建筑正在进行拆除时发生部分坍塌。

en: A man described as a "non-worker civilian" was buried up to his waist in the basement. (16 words)
cn: 一名被描述为"非施工人员"的男子被埋在地下室，腰部以下被埋。

en: The man was collecting building materials when the first floor collapsed underneath him. (13 words)
cn: 这名男子当时正在收集建筑材料，一楼在他脚下坍塌了。

en: He was trapped under a beam about 10 feet below the surface for nearly an hour and a half. (19 words)
cn: 他被困在距地面约10英尺的横梁下近一个半小时。

en: The man was then taken to hospital. (7 words)
cn: 这名男子随后被送往医院。

en: Officials said he is in stable condition with non-life-threatening injuries. (9 words)
cn: 官方称，他状况稳定，伤势没有危及生命。

en: The building was reportedly purchased by a neighboring church in 2011. (11 words)
cn: 据报道，这栋大楼在2011年由附近的教堂收购。

en: It was the site of a 2006 fire and has remained vacant ever since. (14 words)
cn: 2006年，这里曾经发生过火灾，从那之后就一直处于闲置状态。

en: "Millions of people are struggling to understand their paychecks or calculate money in shops," campaigners have said. (17 words)
cn: "数百万人一直弄不太明白自己的工资单或者在商店里算不太明白账，"参加活动的人说道。

en: Being bad at maths should no longer be seen as a badge of honor or down to genetics, according to National Numeracy, a new organization which aims to challenge the nation's negative view of the subject. (36 words)
cn: 按照英国国家数学能力中心的说法，数学不好不应再被视为"光彩之事"或者将其归因于遗传。英国国家数学能力中心是一个新的组织，旨在挑战国民对数学科目的消极看法。

en: Chris Humphries, chairman of the group, said that poor maths skills can affect an individual's life, leaving them at a higher risk of being excluded from school, or out of work. (31 words)
cn: 该组织的主席克里斯·汉弗莱斯说，数学差会影响个人生活，会增大他们被开除学籍或被炒鱿鱼的风险。

en: "Figures from a government survey, published last year, show that 17 million adults in England have basic maths skills that are, at best, the same as an 11-year-old," he said. (30 words)
cn: "去年公布的一项政府调查数据显示，英国1700万名成年人在表现最好的情况下，其基本的数学水平也就跟11岁的孩子一样，"他说道。

en: Speaking at the launch of National Numeracy, Mr. Humphries said, "That's a scary figure, because what it means is they often can't calculate or give change." (26 words)
cn: 汉弗莱斯先生在英国国家数学能力中心开幕式上说："这是一个可怕的数字，因为这意味着这些人通常不会计算，不会找零。"

en: Mike Ellicock, chief executive of National Numeracy, said, "We want to challenge this 'I can't do maths' attitude that is prevalent in the UK," adding that it was vital that all primary school teachers understand key maths concepts, as young children who fail to learn the basics will suffer later on. (51 words)
cn: 英国国家数学能力中心首席执行官迈克·艾利考克说："我们想挑战在英国非常普遍的‘我不会做算术’的观念，"他还补充说，所有小学老师都能理解关键的数学概念这一点至关重要，因为没有学会基础数学的孩子以后会吃苦头。

en: The Dutch king has revealed that for more than two decades, he has held down a part-time second job alongside his royal duties. (23 words)
cn: 荷兰国王透露，在过去的20多年里，他除了履行王室职责之外，还一直兼职做着第二份工作。

en: King Willem-Alexander of the Netherlands said that he recently ended his role as a regular "guest pilot" after 21 years with the national airline's fleet of now-outdated aircraft. (28 words)
cn: 荷兰国王威廉-亚历山大说，21年来他在国家航空公司的机队（如今其飞机已过时）里一直担任"客座飞行员"，最近他刚刚结束这份工作。

en: As a guest flier, the king worked about twice a month, always as co-pilot. (14 words)
cn: 作为一名客座飞行员，国王每月大约出勤两次，一直担任副驾驶。

en: He will now retrain to fly the bigger Boeing 737s as the old planes are being phased out of service. (20 words)
cn: 他现在将重新接受训练，执飞更大的波音737客机，因为旧飞机正被逐渐淘汰停用。

en: The 50-year-old father of three and king to 17 million Dutch citizens calls flying a "hobby". (16 words)
cn: 威廉-亚历山大今年50岁，是3个孩子的父亲，是1700万荷兰民众的国王，他说飞行是自己的爱好。

en: It lets him leave his royal duties on the ground and fully focus on something else. (16 words)
cn: 飞行可以让他把地面上的王室职责抛诸脑后，全身心投入到其他事情中。

en: "You have an aircraft, passengers and crew. You have responsibility for them," the king said. (15 words)
cn: "你要负责这架飞机，还有上面的乘客和机组人员，你要对他们负责，"国王说道。

en: "You can't take your problems from the ground into the skies. You can completely change focus and concentrate on something else. (21 words)
cn: "所以，不能把地面的烦恼带到天空。你可以完全改变关注点，专心做其他事情。

en: That, for me, is the most relaxing part of flying." (10 words)
cn: 这对我来说是飞行中最令人感到放松的部分。

en: Willem-Alexander said he is rarely recognised by passengers. (8 words)
cn: "威廉-亚历山大说他很少被乘客认出来。

en: Very few people pay attention to him as he walks through the airport in his airline uniform and cap. (19 words)
cn: 当他身穿航空公司制服、戴着帽子在机场中穿行时，很少有人会注意到他。

en: Morning, Ms Semenov. (3 words)
cn: 早上好，塞梅诺夫女士。

en: Welcome to our studio. (4 words)
cn: 欢迎来到我们的演播室。

en: Thanks. (1 words)
cn: 谢谢。

en: My pleasure. (2 words)
cn: 很荣幸。

en: OK, then, let me start by asking you how old your company is. (13 words)
cn: 好的，那么，首先我想问一下贵公司开办多久了。

en: My grandparents started the company in 1955. (7 words)
cn: 我的祖父母于1955年创办了这家公司。

en: Why did they decide to open a furniture plant in Bucharest? (11 words)
cn: 他们为什么决定在布加勒斯特开设家具厂呢？

en: At that time, there was a construction boom. (8 words)
cn: 当时，建筑业蓬勃发展。

en: There was a great need for furniture and my grandparents saw a business opportunity. (14 words)
cn: 家具的需求量很大，我的祖父母看到了这个商机。

en: Their aim was to provide quality, yet affordable wooden furniture. (10 words)
cn: 他们的目标是提供质优价廉的木制家具。

en: And this goal has never changed. (6 words)
cn: 这个目标从未改变过。

en: Do you still only work with wood? (7 words)
cn: 你们仍然只用木头制作家具吗？

en: That's right. (2 words)
cn: 没错。

en: It's what we know and what we do best. (9 words)
cn: 木头是我们所了解的，也是我们最擅长的。

en: If we started trying different materials, our quality would probably suffer. (11 words)
cn: 如果我们开始尝试不同的材料，我们的质量可能会受到影响。

en: And all the wood is local? (6 words)
cn: 所有的木头都是当地的吗？

en: Correct! (1 words)
cn: 对！

en: A hundred percent of our raw material comes from Romania. (10 words)
cn: 原材料百分之百来自罗马尼亚。

en: Could you please outline how the company has grown over time? (11 words)
cn: 您能否简单谈一下公司是如何随着时间的推移而成长起来的呢？

en: What have been the main challenges and opportunities that you have faced? (12 words)
cn: 你们遇到过的主要挑战和机遇是什么？

en: Well, back in the 50s and 60s, Romania was a lot poorer than it is today. (16 words)
cn: 嗯，这可以追溯到上世纪五六十年代，当时罗马尼亚比现在贫穷得多。

en: My grandfather and father did not have much capital and our customers didn't have much money, either. (17 words)
cn: 我的祖父和父亲没有太多资金，我们的客户也没有多少钱。

en: So that limited growth. (4 words)
cn: 这限制了公司的发展壮大。

en: The big change was in 2007, when Romania joined the European Union. (12 words)
cn: 当2007年罗马尼亚加入欧盟时，公司发生了重大变化。

en: Suddenly, our market exploded in size and we could now sell our products all across the continent. (18 words)
cn: 突然之间，我们的市场规模急剧扩大，我们现在可以在整个欧洲大陆销售我们的产品。

en: There was also more financial investment and, as a result, we went from having 20 employees to 200. (18 words)
cn: 我们也得到了更多的金融投资，因此，我们的员工从20名变成了200名。

en: Which countries are your biggest market? (6 words)
cn: 哪些国家是你们最大的市场？

en: Besides Romania, our biggest market is Germany. (7 words)
cn: 除罗马尼亚外，我们最大的市场是德国。

en: There is strong demand there for our traditional-styled furniture. (9 words)
cn: 在那里，我们传统风格的家具需求量很大。

en: Have you heard about the new restaurant, the Pearl? (9 words)
cn: 你听说过新餐厅——珍珠餐厅吗？

en: Susan and I are going to try it out this weekend. (11 words)
cn: 苏珊和我打算这周末去试吃一下。

en: We have a reservation on Saturday at 7 o'clock. (9 words)
cn: 我们预订了星期六7点的位置。

en: I can call to add two more to the table, if you would like. (14 words)
cn: 如果你愿意，我可以给餐厅打电话加两个位置。

en: That sounds great. (3 words)
cn: 听起来不错。

en: We'd love to join you. (5 words)
cn: 我们很乐意加入你们。

en: You always seem to know the best places to go. (10 words)
cn: 你似乎总是知道最好的去处。

en: Where do you hear about these things? (7 words)
cn: 你从哪里听到这些事的呢？

en: I have a habit of reading (614) Magazine. (8 words)
cn: 我有阅读《614》杂志的习惯。

en: It has all the information on local events within the (614) column code area. (14 words)
cn: 在《614》杂志的栏目代码区有本地事件的所有信息。

en: That's a clever name for the magazine, then. (8 words)
cn: 杂志的名称还挺巧妙的。

en: Does it only focus on new restaurant openings? (8 words)
cn: 它只关注新餐厅的开业吗？

en: They have other information, too. (5 words)
cn: 也有其他信息。

en: Things like concerts, festivals and small shops. (7 words)
cn: 像音乐会、节日和小商店介绍等。

en: I think the restaurant information and reviews are the most exciting, though. (12 words)
cn: 但我认为餐厅信息和点评是最令人兴奋的。

en: Each year they also sponsor a local event called Restaurant Week. (11 words)
cn: 每年他们还会赞助一个名为"餐厅周"的当地活动。

en: Restaurant Week? (2 words)
cn: "餐厅周"？

en: What's that? (2 words)
cn: 那是什么？

en: Oh, it's wonderful! (3 words)
cn: 哦，这个活动太棒了！

en: All the stylish restaurants participate. (5 words)
cn: 所有的时尚餐厅都参加。

en: They have special set menus for the week, usually in spring, at a number of different price points. (18 words)
cn: 这个活动通常在春天举行，时尚餐厅提供一周的特别套餐菜单，以不同的价格定位。

en: Susan and I go to at least 3 different places during the event. (13 words)
cn: 在活动期间，苏珊和我至少会去3个不同的地方。

en: It's a great opportunity to try some of the more expensive restaurants at a discounted price and try something new. (20 words)
cn: 这是一个可以以折扣价去一些昂贵餐厅就餐的大好机会，而且可以尝试新的菜品。

en: That's how we found the Pearl, actually. (7 words)
cn: 实际上，这就是我们怎么发现珍珠餐厅的。

en: Wow! (1 words)
cn: 哇！

en: That's an event I would be interested in. (8 words)
cn: 我对这个活动很感兴趣。

en: When will it be happening this year? (7 words)
cn: 今年什么时候举行？

en: You're in luck. (3 words)
cn: 你很幸运。

en: Restaurant Week starts in just a few days, the first Sunday in May. (13 words)
cn: "餐厅周"过几天就要开始了，在五月的第一个星期天。

en: Let's make sure to set a double date during the event. (11 words)
cn: 我们一定要在活动期间安排一场四人约会。

en: Just let me know what type of food you would like to try. (13 words)
cn: 只要告诉我你们想尝试什么样的食物就行。

en: OK. (1 words)
cn: 好的。

en: I will. (2 words)
cn: 我会的。

en: All parents know it is difficult to get children to eat their vegetables. (13 words)
cn: 所有的父母都知道让孩子吃蔬菜是很困难的。

en: Some of them offer rewards or treats for children finishing their share. (12 words)
cn: 一些父母会给吃完蔬菜的孩子奖励或惊喜。

en: But researchers have discovered that youngsters who are not praised for trying vegetables are more likely to eat them eventually. (20 words)
cn: 但研究人员发现，那些尝试蔬菜时没有受到表扬的孩子，最终更有可能吃蔬菜。

en: The study found that the best way to get children to eat food they do not like is simply to give them repeated exposure to it. (26 words)
cn: 研究发现，让孩子们吃他们不喜欢的食物的最好方法就是让他们反复接触这些食物。

en: Psychologists from Ghent University in Belgium studied 98 children. They gave them 5 kinds of vegetables to eat—mushrooms, peas, eggplants, carrots and cabbages. (23 words)
cn: 比利时根特大学的心理学家研究了98名儿童。他们给这些儿童5种蔬菜吃，分别是蘑菇、豌豆、茄子、胡萝卜和卷心菜。

en: The taste tests revealed that carrots were the least-liked vegetable among youngsters. (13 words)
cn: 品尝测试显示，胡萝卜是小孩最不喜欢吃的蔬菜。

en: The children were then given a bowl of boiled carrots and told to choose how much to eat. (18 words)
cn: 然后孩子们得到一碗煮熟的胡萝卜，并被告知自己选择吃多少。

en: After eight minutes, they were asked to rate the dish as delicious, just OK, or disgusting. (16 words)
cn: 八分钟后，他们被要求对菜肴给出评价：美味的、一般般的或者不好吃的。

en: The trial went on twice a week for a month with a follow-up taste test after 8 weeks. (18 words)
cn: 该试验每周进行两次，为期一个月，8周后进行后续的味道测试。

en: Children were split into three groups, with one group asked to try the bowl of carrots repeatedly with no further encouragement. (21 words)
cn: 孩子们被分成三组，一组在没有进一步鼓励的情况下被要求反复试吃胡萝卜。

en: The other two groups were given rewards of a toy or verbal praise. (13 words)
cn: 另外两组得到玩具或口头表扬作为奖励。

en: After the trial, 81% of children who simply tried the carrots consistently liked them. (14 words)
cn: 实验结束后，仅仅反复试吃胡萝卜的孩子中有81%的人喜欢它们。

en: This is in contrast to 68% for the group given the toy, and 75% for the group given verbal praise. (20 words)
cn: 相比之下，得到玩具的那组中有68%的孩子喜欢它们，得到口头表扬的那组中有75%的孩子喜欢它们。

en: One thing about the moon many people don't know is that it has a lot of garbage on its surface left over from human space exploration. (26 words)
cn: 关于月球，许多人不知道的一件事是，月球表面有许多由于人类探索太空留下的垃圾。

en: But how much garbage exactly have humans left on the moon? (11 words)
cn: 但是人类究竟在月球上留下了多少垃圾呢？

en: It's hard to be accurate, but the trash likely weighs more than 181,000 kilograms on Earth. (16 words)
cn: 这很难精确地计算出来，但这些垃圾可能在地球上重达18.1万多公斤。

en: Much of it was left by American astronauts who landed on the lunar surface between 1969 and 1972 during NASA's Apollo Missions. (22 words)
cn: 其中，很多是美国宇航员在1969年至1972年执行美国宇航局阿波罗号任务期间登陆月球表面留下的。

en: The other rubbish comes from missions that did not have human crews. (12 words)
cn: 其他垃圾来自没有人类乘员的任务。

en: These missions were conducted by various space exploring agencies including those from the US, Russia, Japan, India and Europe. (19 words)
cn: 这些任务由包括来自美国、俄罗斯、日本、印度和欧洲在内的多个太空探索机构执行。

en: Many of the older pieces are equipment sent to learn about the moon. (13 words)
cn: 许多较老的部件是用来探索月球的设备。

en: The equipment stayed there after its missions ended. (8 words)
cn: 这些设备在任务结束后被留在那里。

en: The moon is also home to lunar orbiters that mapped the moon before they crashed into its surface, adding to the garbage heap. (23 words)
cn: 月球也是月球轨道探测器的"故乡"，这些探测器用于测绘月球地形之后会坠毁到月球表面上，这增加了垃圾。

en: The objects left by the Apollo astronauts included the equipment that was no longer needed. (15 words)
cn: 阿波罗号宇航员们留下的物品包括不再需要的设备。

en: Bringing back unneeded equipment would have used up precious resources such as fuel. (13 words)
cn: 如果把不需要的设备带回来，就会消耗燃料等宝贵资源。

en: But as the saying goes, one person's trash is another's treasure. (11 words)
cn: 但俗话说，一个人的垃圾是另一个人的宝贝。

en: Researchers can study the garbage left on the moon to see how its materials weathered the radiation and vacuum of space over time. (23 words)
cn: 研究人员可以研究月球上遗留下来的垃圾，看看这些材料是如何随着时间的流逝经受住太空辐射和真空的。

en: Moreover, some of the objects on the moon are still being used, including a laser range reflector left by the Apollo 11 crew. (23 words)
cn: 此外，月球上的一些东西仍在被使用，包括阿波罗11号宇航员留下的激光测距反射器。

en: In my line of work, I receive a lot of emails. I also send a lot of emails. (18 words)
cn: 在我这行里，我收到许多电子邮件，也会发很多电子邮件。

en: Though social media and messaging apps have taken over some of the roles from email as a form of communication, email is likely to retain an important role for business communication in the future. (34 words)
cn: 尽管社交媒体和短信应用程序已经取代了电子邮件作为交流形式的一些角色，但是电子邮件可能会在未来的商业交流中继续扮演重要角色。

en: Surprisingly, though, a lot of companies and organizations lack formal guidelines for emailing. (13 words)
cn: 不过，令人感到意外的是，许多公司和组织都缺乏有关电子邮件的正式指南。

en: As most of you will soon be entering the workforce, I would like to share with you my own rules for emailing. (22 words)
cn: 由于你们大多数人都即将进入职场，我想和你们分享我自己的电子邮件规则。

en: If someone sends you an email, reply to them acknowledging the email. (12 words)
cn: 如果有人给你发电子邮件，要回复他们确认收到邮件。

en: A simple "thank you" lets the sender know that their email has arrived safely, that it has not been lost among what could be 50 other emails that have arrived in your email inbox that day. (36 words)
cn: 简单说声谢谢就会让发件人知道，他们的电子邮件已经安全到达，而不是埋没在当天可能收到的其他50封邮件中。

en: It's not necessary to reply to a mass email sent to numerous recipients. (13 words)
cn: 不必回复发送给众多收件人的群发电子邮件。

en: These emails are often informative rather than personalized correspondence requiring a response or action. (14 words)
cn: 这类电子邮件通常是告知性的，而不是需要回复或采取行动的个性化邮件。

en: But it's common politeness to respond to a personal message, preferably within 24 hours of receiving it. (17 words)
cn: 但是，在收到个人邮件后24小时内回复是一种基本的礼貌。

en: It's also important to use proper English. (7 words)
cn: 使用恰当的英语也很重要。

en: Just because emails are a quick form of communication doesn't mean emails, especially business emails, should be written using informal, shortened forms of words. (24 words)
cn: 仅仅因为电子邮件是一种快捷的交流方式，并不意味着邮件，尤其是商务邮件，应该使用非正式的、缩略的词语形式。

en: Think of an email as a letter. (7 words)
cn: 把电子邮件想象成一封信。

en: Spelling, grammar and punctuation should not be overlooked, and never use capitals to emphasize a word or words in an email. (21 words)
cn: 拼写、语法和标点符号都不应被忽视，而且永远不要在邮件中用大写字母来强调一个或多个单词。

en: It's the same as yelling. (5 words)
cn: 这和大喊大叫没有区别。

en: A 9-year-old Central California boy braved strong currents and cold water to swim from San Francisco to Alcatraz Island and back.
cn: 加利福尼亚州中部一名9岁男孩顶着强劲水流和冰冷的海水，从旧金山游到阿尔卡特拉斯岛后返回。

en: A California television station in Fresno reported Tuesday that James Savage set a record as the youngest swimmer to make the journey to the former prison.
cn: 加利福尼亚州弗雷斯诺的一家电视台周二报道，詹姆斯·萨维奇创下了游向这座前监狱的最年轻游泳者纪录。

en: The TV station reported that by completing the swim, the fourth-grade student from Los Banos broke a record previously held by a 10-year-old boy.
cn: 该电视台报道称，这位来自洛斯巴尼奥斯的四年级学生通过完成这次游泳，打破了此前由一名10岁男孩保持的纪录。

en: James said that waves in the San Francisco Bay hitting him in the face 30 minutes into his swim made him want to give up.
cn: 詹姆斯说，游泳开始30分钟后，旧金山湾的海浪不断拍打他的脸，让他想要放弃。

en: His father said he had offered his son $100 as a reward; to encourage his struggling son, he doubled it to $200.
cn: 他的父亲说，为鼓励挣扎中的儿子，他最初提出给100美元作为奖励，后来又翻倍至200美元。

en: James pushed forward, making it to Alcatraz Island and back in a little more than two hours.
cn: 詹姆斯继续向前，用了两个多小时完成了往返阿尔卡特拉斯岛的游泳。

en: Alcatraz is over a mile from the mainland.
cn: 阿尔卡特拉斯岛距大陆超过一英里。

en: On the 1st of January, new regulations will come into effect which eliminate an annual leave bonus for people who put off marrying until the age of 23 for women, and 25 for men, the South China Morning Post reports.
cn: 据《南华早报》报道，1月1日起，新规将正式生效，取消对推迟至女性23岁、男性25岁才结婚者所给予的年假奖励。

en: The holiday bonus was designed to encourage young people to delay getting married in line with China's one-child policy.
cn: 这一假期奖励旨在鼓励年轻人推迟结婚，以配合中国的独生子女政策。

en: But with that policy now being abolished, this holiday incentive is no longer necessary, the government says.
cn: 但政府表示，随着该政策的废除，这一假期激励措施已不再必要。

en: In Shanghai, a young couple at a marriage registration office told the paper that they decided to register their marriage as soon as possible to take advantage of the existing policy, because an extra holiday was a big deal for them.
cn: 在上海，一对在婚姻登记处的年轻夫妇告诉该报，他们决定尽快登记结婚，以利用现行政策，因为额外的假期对他们来说意义重大。

en: In Beijing, one registration office had about 300 couples seeking to get married the day after the changes were announced, rather than the usual number of between 70 and 80.
cn: 在北京，变化宣布次日，一家登记处迎来约300对前来登记结婚的夫妇，而平时每天仅有70至80对。

en: But one lawyer tells the paper that the changes still have to be adopted by local governments and these procedures take time.
cn: 但一位律师告诉该报，这些变化仍须由地方政府采纳，而这些程序需要时间。

en: So people who are rushing to register for marriage can relax.
cn: 因此，急于登记结婚的人可以放宽心了。

en: Everyone loves a good house party, but the cleaning-up the next morning isn't as enjoyable.
cn: 每个人都喜欢一场精彩的家庭聚会，但第二天早上的打扫工作可就没那么令人愉快了。

en: Now, however, a New Zealand-based start-up company aims to bring messy homes—and even splitting headaches—back to normal.
cn: 然而，现在一家总部位于新西兰的初创公司旨在让凌乱的家——甚至是严重的头痛——恢复正常。

en: The properly-named start-up Morning-After Maids was launched about a month ago in Auckland by roommates Rebecca Foley and Catherine Ashurst.
cn: 这家名副其实的初创公司"派对后女仆"约一个月前由室友丽贝卡·福利和凯瑟琳·阿什赫斯特在奥克兰创立。

en: Aside from cleaning-up, the two will also cook breakfast and even get coffee and painkillers for recovering merrymakers.
cn: 除了打扫卫生，她们还会做早餐，甚至为正在恢复中的聚会者提供咖啡和止痛药。

en: Although they are both gainfully employed, they fit cleaning jobs into their nights and weekends, which is when their service is in most demand anyway.
cn: 尽管她们都有稳定工作，仍将打扫任务安排在晚上和周末，而这恰好也是服务需求最旺盛的时候。

en: Besides being flooded with requests from across the country, Foley and Ashurst have also received requests from the U.S. and Canada to provide services there.
cn: 除了来自全国各地如潮水般涌来的预约，福利和阿什赫斯特还收到了来自美国和加拿大的服务邀请。

en: They are reportedly meeting with lawyers to see how best to take the business forward.
cn: 据报道，她们正在与律师会面，商讨如何最好地推动业务发展。

en: Kyle, how did your driver's theory exam go?
cn: 凯尔，你的驾驶理论考试考得怎么样？

en: It was yesterday, right?
cn: 是昨天考的，对吗？

en: Yes.
cn: 是的。

en: I prepared as much as I could, but I was so nervous since it was my second try.
cn: 我尽力做了充分准备，但因为这是第二次考，非常紧张。

en: The people who worked at the test center were very kind, though.
cn: 不过，考试中心的工作人员非常友善。

en: We had a little conversation which calmed me down a bit, and that was just what I needed.
cn: 我们随便聊了几句，这让我稍微平静下来，正是我所需要的。

en: Then, after the exam, they printed out my result, but I was afraid to open it until I was outside.
cn: 考试结束后，他们打印出了我的成绩，但我不敢在里面打开，直到走到外面才看。

en: It was such a relief to pass.
cn: 通过考试真是如释重负。

en: Congratulations!
cn: 恭喜你！

en: I knew you could do it!
cn: 我就知道你能做到！

en: I guess you underestimated how difficult it would be the first time, didn't you?
cn: 我猜你第一次低估了考试难度，不是吗？

en: I hear a lot of people make that mistake and go in underprepared, but good job in passing the second time.
cn: 我听说很多人都犯了这个错误，准备不足就去考试，但你第二次通过了，干得好。

en: I'm so proud of you.
cn: 我真为你骄傲。

en: Now, all you have to do next is your road test.
cn: 现在，你接下来要做的就是路考。

en: Have you had any lessons yet?
cn: 你已经上过驾驶课了吗？

en: Yes, thanks.
cn: 上了，谢谢。

en: I'm so happy to be actually on the road now.
cn: 我很高兴现在真的能在路上开车了。

en: I've only had two driving lessons so far, and my instructor is very understanding.
cn: 到目前为止我只上了两节驾驶课，我的教练非常体贴。

en: So I'm really enjoying it.
cn: 所以我真的很享受这个过程。

en: And I can't wait for my next session, although the lessons are rather expensive, £20 an hour.
cn: 我迫不及待地想上下一节课，尽管课费相当贵，每小时20英镑。

en: And the instructor says I'll need about 30 to 40 lessons in total.
cn: 教练说我总共需要大约30到40节课。

en: That's what—six to eight hundred pounds.
cn: 那就是六到八百英镑。

en: So this time I'll need to make a lot more effort and hopefully will be successful the first time.
cn: 所以这次我需要更加努力，希望能一次通过路考。

en: Well, good luck.
cn: 那么，祝你好运。

en: Emma, I got accepted to the University of Leeds.
cn: 艾玛，我被利兹大学录取了。

en: Since you're going to university in England, do you know how much it is for international students to study there?
cn: 你也要去英国上大学，你知道国际学生在那里读书要花多少钱吗？

en: Congratulations!
cn: 恭喜你！

en: Yes, I believe for international students, you'll have to pay around £13,000 a year.
cn: 是的，我相信国际学生每年需要支付约13，000英镑。

en: It's just a bit more than the local students.
cn: 这只比本地学生稍微多一点。

en: Okay, so that's about $17,000 for the tuition and fees.
cn: 好的，那就是约17，000美元的学费和杂费。

en: Anyway, I'm only going to be there for a year, doing my master's.
cn: 不管怎样，我只会在那里待一年，攻读硕士学位。

en: So it's pretty good.
cn: 所以还算不错。

en: If I stayed in the U.S., it'd take two years and cost at least $50,000 in tuition alone.
cn: 如果我留在美国，则需要两年时间，而且光学费就至少要花50，000美元。

en: Also, I have a good chance of winning a scholarship at Leeds, which would be pretty awesome, the benefits of being a music genius.
cn: 另外，我很有可能在利兹获得奖学金，那真的很棒——这就是作为音乐天才的好处。

en: Yeah, I heard you're a talented piano player.
cn: 是啊，我听说你是位很有天赋的钢琴演奏者。

en: So you're doing a postgraduate degree now?
cn: 那你现在是在攻读研究生学位吗？

en: I'm still in my last year, graduating next June.
cn: 我还在读最后一年，明年六月毕业。

en: Finally, I'll be done with my studies, and could go on to earning loads of money.
cn: 终于，我就要完成学业了，接下来可以去赚很多钱了。

en: Are you still planning on being a teacher?
cn: 你还打算当老师吗？

en: No money in that job then.
cn: 那份工作可不怎么赚钱。

en: You'd be surprised.
cn: 你会大吃一惊的。

en: I'm still going to be a teacher.
cn: 我仍然打算当老师。

en: But the plan is to work at an international school overseas, after I get a year or so of the experience in England.
cn: 但我的计划是，在英国积累一年左右经验后，去海外的国际学校任教。

en: It's better pay, and I get to travel, which reminds me I'm late for my class and I've got some documents I need to print out first.
cn: 薪资更高，而且还能旅行。说起这个，我想起我要上课要迟到了，我还有些文件需要先打印出来。

en: I'd better run.
cn: 我最好快点走了。

en: Scientists have identified thousands of known ant species around the world—and only a few of them bug humans.
cn: 科学家已在世界各地识别出数千种已知蚂蚁——但其中只有少数会给人类带来麻烦。

en: Most ants live in the woods or out in nature.
cn: 大多数蚂蚁生活在树林中或大自然里。

en: There, they keep other creatures in check, distribute seeds, and clean dead and decaying materials from the ground.
cn: 在那里，它们控制其他生物的数量，传播种子，并清理地面上的死亡和腐烂物质。

en: A very small percentage of ants do harm to humans.
cn: 只有极少数蚂蚁对人类有害。

en: But those are incredibly challenging to control.
cn: 但那些蚂蚁极难控制。

en: They are small enough to easily slip inside your house, live in colonies that number in the tens of thousands to the hundreds of thousands, and reproduce quickly.
cn: 它们体型极小，很容易溜进你的房子，生活在数以万计乃至数十万计的群落中，且繁殖速度极快。

en: That makes them good at getting in, and hard to kick out.
cn: 这使它们善于侵入，却难以驱逐。

en: Once they settle in, these insects start affecting your home.
cn: 一旦它们安定下来，这些昆虫就会开始影响你的家。

en: In addition to biting ants, other species can cause different kinds of damage.
cn: 除了会咬人的蚂蚁，其他种类也会造成各种损害。

en: Some, like carpenter ants, can undermine a home's structure, while others interfere with electrical units.
cn: 有些蚂蚁，如木工蚁，会破坏房屋结构，而其他种类则会干扰电气设备。

en: Unfortunately, our homes are very attractive to ants, because they provide everything the colony needs to survive, such as food, water, and shelter.
cn: 不幸的是，我们的家对蚂蚁极具吸引力，因为家里提供了蚁群生存所需的一切，如食物、水和住所。

en: So how can we prevent ants from getting into our homes?
cn: 那么，我们如何才能防止蚂蚁进入我们的家呢？

en: Most important of all, avoid giving ants any access to food, particularly sugary food, because ants have a sweet tooth.
cn: 最重要的是，不要让蚂蚁接触到任何食物，尤其是含糖食品，因为蚂蚁嗜甜。

en: We also need to clean up spills as soon as they occur and store food in airtight containers.
cn: 我们还需要在食物溢出时立即清理，并将食物存放在密封容器中。

en: Even garbage attracts ants, so empty your trash as often as possible, and store your outside garbage in a lidded can, well away from doors and windows.
cn: 就连垃圾也会吸引蚂蚁，所以要尽量经常清空垃圾桶，并将室外垃圾存放在有盖的垃圾桶中，远离门窗。

en: My research focus is on what happens to our immune system as we age.
cn: 我的研究重点是随着年龄增长，我们的免疫系统会发生什么变化。

en: So the job of the immune system is to fight infections.
cn: 免疫系统的功能是抵抗感染。

en: It also protects us from viruses and from auto-immune diseases.
cn: 它还能保护我们免受病毒和自身免疫疾病的侵害。

en: We know that as we get older, it's easier for us to get infections.
cn: 我们知道，随着年龄增长，我们更容易受到感染。

en: So, older adults have more chances of falling ill.
cn: 因此，老年人更容易生病。

en: This is evidence that our immune system really doesn't function so well when we age.
cn: 这说明我们的免疫系统在年老时功能确实有所下降。

en: In most of our work when we're looking at older adults who've got an illness, we always have to have health controls.
cn: 在我们研究患病老年人的大多数工作中，我们始终需要设立健康对照组。

en: So we work very closely with a great group of volunteers called "The 1,000 Elders."
cn: 因此，我们与一组名为"千名老人"的优秀志愿者密切合作。

en: These volunteers are all 65 or over but in good health.
cn: 这些志愿者均年满65岁，但身体状况良好。

en: They come to the university to provide us with blood samples, to be interviewed and to help us carry out a whole range of research.
cn: 他们来到大学为我们提供血液样本，接受采访，并帮助我们开展一系列研究工作。

en: The real impact of our research is going to be on health in old age.
cn: 我们研究的真正影响将体现在老年健康方面。

en: At the moment we're living much longer, life expectancy is increasing at two years for every decade.
cn: 目前，我们的寿命大幅延长，每十年预期寿命就增加两年。

en: That means an extra five hours a day.
cn: 这意味着每天多出五个小时。

en: I want to make sure that older adults are still able to enjoy their old age and that they're not spending time in hospital with infections, feeling unwell and being generally weak.
cn: 我希望确保老年人仍然能够享受晚年生活，而不是因为感染而住在医院里，感到不适、身体虚弱。

en: We want people to be healthy even when they are old.
cn: 我们希望人们即使年老也能保持健康。

en: When Ted Komada started teaching 14 years ago at Killip Elementary, he didn't know how to manage a classroom and was struggling to connect with students.
cn: 当泰德·科马达14年前开始在基利普小学任教时，他不知道如何管理课堂，也在努力与学生建立联系。

en: He noticed a couple of days after school that a group of kids would get together to play chess.
cn: 他注意到放学后有一群孩子会聚在一起下象棋。

en: "I know how to play chess.
cn: "我会下象棋。

en: Let me go and show these kids how to do it," he said.
cn: 让我去教这些孩子怎么下，"他说。

en: Now Komada coaches the school's chess team.
cn: 现在，科马达担任学校国际象棋队的教练。

en: The whole program started as a safe place for kids to come after school.
cn: 整个项目最初是作为孩子们课后来访的安全场所而设立的。

en: And this week dozens of those students are getting ready to head out to Nashville Tennessee, to compete with about 5,000 other young people at the SuperNationals of chess.
cn: 本周，数十名学生正准备前往田纳西州纳什维尔，参加"超级全国赛"，与约5，000名其他年轻棋手同台竞技。

en: The competition only happens every four years and the last time the team went, they won the third place in the nation.
cn: 该比赛每四年举办一次，上次该队参赛时获得了全国第三名。

en: Komada says chess gives him, and his students, control.
cn: 科马达说，国际象棋赋予了他和学生掌控感。

en: The school has the highest number of kids from low-income families.
cn: 这所学校有最多来自低收入家庭的孩子。

en: Police frequent the area day and night, as two months ago, a young man was shot just down the street.
cn: 警察全天候在该地区巡逻，因为两个月前，就在街道不远处发生了一起年轻人中枪事件。

en: Komada likes to teach his students that they should think about their move before they do it.
cn: 科马达喜欢教导学生，行动之前要先想好每一步棋。

en: The lessons prove valuable outside the classroom as well.
cn: 这些课程在课堂之外同样有价值。

en: Many parents see these lessons translate into the real world.
cn: 许多家长都看到这些课程转化为了现实中的影响。

en: Students are more likely to think about their actions and see whether they will lead to trouble.
cn: 学生们更倾向于在行动之前认真思考，判断自己的行为是否会惹麻烦。

en: France is facing potentially more than $1 billion in lost revenue this year due to huge declines in tourism.
cn: 法国今年因旅游业大幅下滑，面临超过10亿美元的潜在收入损失。

en: Safety concerns have been one of the biggest reasons why the country has lost over half a billion in revenue already in the first six months of 2016.
cn: 安全问题是法国在2016年前六个月已损失逾5亿收入的最主要原因之一。

en: The terror attacks in Paris last November were called Europe's worst in the past decade.
cn: 去年11月巴黎发生的恐怖袭击被称为过去十年欧洲最严重的恐袭事件。

en: Besides violence, workers' strikes and heavy floods are said to have also been why international tourists have stayed away.
cn: 据说，除暴力事件外，工人罢工和严重洪灾也是国际游客望而却步的原因。

en: So far in the Paris region, there's been a 46% decline in Japanese visitors, 35% fewer Russians and 27% fewer Italians.
cn: 迄今为止，巴黎地区日本游客减少了46%，俄罗斯游客减少了35%，意大利游客减少了27%。

en: American travelers seem the least affected.
cn: 美国游客似乎受影响最小。

en: Their numbers have only dropped by roughly 5%.
cn: 他们的数量仅下降了约5%。

en: According to the French government, the country is the No. 1 tourist destination in the world, and tourism is extremely important to the French economy.
cn: 据法国政府介绍，法国是世界第一大旅游目的地，旅游业对法国经济极为重要。

en: The sector represents roughly 9% of its GDP.
cn: 该行业约占法国国内生产总值的9%。

en: The head of Paris' tourism board said, "It's time to realize that the tourism sector is going through an industrial disaster."
cn: 巴黎旅游局局长表示："是时候认识到，旅游业正经历一场行业性灾难了。"

en: A small plane with two sick US workers arrived safely in Chile late Wednesday after leaving Antarctica in a daring rescue mission from a remote South Pole research station.
cn: 一架载有两名患病美国工作人员的小型飞机周三深夜安全抵达智利，此前它执行了一项大胆的救援任务，从南极偏远的南极点科研站起飞。

en: After making a stop for a few hours at a British station on the edge of Antarctica, the two workers were flown to the southernmost Chilean city of Punta Arenas.
cn: 在南极边缘的一个英国站短暂停留几个小时后，这两名工作人员被空运至智利最南端的城市蓬塔阿雷纳斯。

en: In a chaotic two days of flying, the rescue team flew 3,000 miles round-trip from the British station Rothera to pick up the workers at the US Amundsen-Scott station at the South Pole.
cn: 在紧张忙乱的两天飞行中，救援队从英国罗瑟拉站出发，往返飞行3，000英里，将工作人员从美国阿蒙森-斯科特南极站接回。

en: "The two patients aboard will be transported to a medical facility that can provide a level of care that is not available at Amundsen-Scott," says a spokesperson.
cn: "机上两名患者将被转运至一家医疗机构，该机构能够提供阿蒙森-斯科特站所没有的医疗条件，"一位发言人说。

en: Normally planes don't go to the polar post from February to October because of the dangers of flying in the pitch-dark and cold.
cn: 通常情况下，从2月到10月，飞机不会飞往极地站，因为在漆黑和极寒中飞行十分危险。

en: "Antarctica creates a hostile environment," says the operations director for the British Antarctic Survey.
cn: "南极洲是一个恶劣的环境，"英国南极调查局运营主任说。

en: "If you're not careful, it'll come round and bite you."
cn: "如果不小心，它就会反过来咬你一口。"

en: A pilot from Virginia removed his son's loose tooth using a helicopter.
cn: 弗吉尼亚州一名飞行员用直升机为儿子拔掉了一颗松动的牙齿。

en: Rick Rahim, from Virginia, flies helicopters for a living, and when his seven-year-old son's tooth became loose, he did not waste time by tying it to a door handle.
cn: 来自弗吉尼亚州的里克·拉希姆以驾驶直升机为生，当他七岁儿子的牙齿松动时，他没有浪费时间用门把手来拔牙。

en: Instead, Mr. Rahim tied one end of a string around his son's tooth and the other end to his full-sized commercial helicopter.
cn: 相反，拉希姆先生将一根绳子的一端绑在儿子的牙齿上，另一端绑在他的全尺寸商业直升机上。

en: The father of four posted a video clip of his playful venture on Facebook, advising parents to do fun and creative stuff with their kids.
cn: 这位四个孩子的父亲将这次有趣尝试的视频片段发布到了脸书上，建议父母多和孩子做一些有趣且有创意的事情。

en: The video shows him launching the helicopter into the air and flying just far enough to successfully remove the loose tooth.
cn: 视频显示，他将直升机升空，飞行了恰好足够的距离，成功地拔掉了那颗松动的牙齿。

en: At the end of the video, Mr. Rahim assures watchers that the circumstances were safe, and that he has 13 years of helicopter flying experience behind him.
cn: 在视频结尾，拉希姆先生向观看者保证，当时的情况是安全的，而且他有13年的直升机飞行经验。

en: "You've got to do everything safe in life, and that's what I did today," he said.
cn: "生活中做任何事都要保证安全，这就是我今天所做的，"他说。

en: Mr. Rahim later said that although some parents have used remote control helicopters to pull teeth before, he might be the first to use a full-sized aircraft, as he can't find evidence that it has been done before.
cn: 拉希姆先生后来说，虽然此前有些家长用遥控直升机拔过牙，但他可能是第一个使用全尺寸飞机来拔牙的人，因为他找不到先例。

en: Hi, Emma's speaking.
cn: 你好，我是艾玛。

en: Who's this?
cn: 请问你是哪位？

en: Hi, Emma.
cn: 你好，艾玛。

en: I'm Paul from Hermes Delivery Service.
cn: 我是汉内斯快递的保罗。

en: Here is a package for you.
cn: 这里有一个您的包裹。

en: Are you at home to collect it?
cn: 您在家取件吗？

en: Oh, sorry, Paul.
cn: 哦，抱歉，保罗。

en: I'm out at the moment.
cn: 我现在不在家。

en: Can you put it in my mailbox?
cn: 你能把它放进我的信箱吗？

en: I'm afraid I can't do that.
cn: 恐怕我不能这样做。

en: Sorry.
cn: 对不起。

en: The package is too big and it needs a signature to confirm you have received it, so I would need to deliver it at a time when you are in.
cn: 包裹太大了，而且需要您签字确认收货，所以我需要在您在家的时候再来投递。

en: Okay, well, I'm out all day today, but I should be in tomorrow morning before I go out for lunch.
cn: 好的，今天我整天都不在家，但我明天上午出去吃午饭之前应该在家。

en: And then I'll be at home again later in the afternoon.
cn: 然后下午晚些时候我也会在家。

en: Will either of those times be convenient for you?
cn: 这两个时间段哪个对你方便？

en: They're not, unfortunately.
cn: 很遗憾，这两个时间都不方便。

en: I'm sorry.
cn: 对不起。

en: I won't be in the area tomorrow as I have some other deliveries to make on the other side of town.
cn: 明天我不会在这个片区，因为我要在城市另一边送其他快递。

en: I could come the day after if that suits you.
cn: 如果方便的话，我可以后天来。

en: Okay.
cn: 好的。

en: Yes, that should be fine.
cn: 那应该没问题。

en: I have a friend coming round in the afternoon, but I'll be at home.
cn: 下午会有朋友来，但我会在家。

en: So the day after tomorrow will be great.
cn: 所以后天没问题，很方便。

en: Do I need to pay for the package?
cn: 我需要为这个包裹付款吗？

en: No, you don't.
cn: 不需要。

en: It says here that you paid for it when you ordered it online.
cn: 这里显示您在网上订购时已经付款了。

en: Oh, yes, I did.
cn: 哦，是的，我付了。

en: I got mixed up.
cn: 我弄混了。

en: So you just need to sign the form to say you've received it.
cn: 所以您只需要在表格上签名，确认已收到包裹即可。

en: Okay, great.
cn: 好的，太好了。

en: See you the day after tomorrow then.
cn: 那后天见。

en: Yes, see you then.
cn: 好的，到时见。

en: Hi, Emily, I hear you are leaving for Italy soon.
cn: 嗨，艾米莉，我听说你很快就要去意大利了。

en: Do you plan to have a going-away party before you disappear?
cn: 你打算在离开之前举办一个送别派对吗？

en: It'd be really nice for us to hang out together before you go.
cn: 在你离开之前我们能聚在一起真的很好。

en: I'm not sure.
cn: 我不确定。

en: I'm leaving in just two more days, and I'm going to miss all my friends here and especially this place.
cn: 再过两天我就出发了，我会想念这里所有的朋友，尤其是这个地方。

en: Why don't you come over?
cn: 你为什么不过来呢？

en: I'm feeling rather sad, actually.
cn: 说实话，我现在感到相当难过。

en: I'm currently sitting alone at a table outside the Black Cat Cafe, listening to the rain and watching people passing by.
cn: 我现在独自坐在黑猫咖啡馆外的桌子旁，听着雨声，看着行人走过。

en: I'm sorry.
cn: 对不起。

en: I can't just now.
cn: 我现在走不开。

en: I need to get this assignment finished by Monday, and I'm way behind.
cn: 我需要在周一前完成这份作业，而我已经严重落后了。

en: Anyhow, cheer up.
cn: 不管怎样，振作起来吧。

en: You're not leaving for good, and you'll absolutely love Italy.
cn: 你又不是永远离开，而且你一定会爱上意大利的。

en: Yeah, you're right.
cn: 是啊，你说得对。

en: But I just feel like I'm not quite ready to go.
cn: 但我只是感觉还没完全准备好出发。

en: And studying in a foreign country seems a bit overwhelming.
cn: 而且在异国他乡求学感觉有点难以招架。

en: Just think of your life in Milan.
cn: 想象一下你在米兰的生活。

en: In the mornings, you can go down to a small local cafe, soaking up the sun's rays and drinking coffee.
cn: 早上，你可以去当地的小咖啡馆，沐浴阳光，喝着咖啡。

en: I envy you.
cn: 我真羡慕你。

en: You can buy lots of gorgeous Italian clothes.
cn: 你可以买很多漂亮的意大利服装。

en: That does sound nice.
cn: 那听起来确实不错。

en: And of course I can keep in touch with everyone through Facebook.
cn: 当然，我可以通过脸书与大家保持联系。

en: Maybe you can all come visit me.
cn: 也许你们都可以来看我。

en: Of course we will.
cn: 当然了。

en: When is your flight?
cn: 你的航班是什么时候？

en: On Saturday, after lunch, at 1:45.
cn: 周六午饭后，1点45分。

en: Okay, I'll try and come to the airport on Saturday to see you off.
cn: 好的，我会努力周六去机场送你。

en: I'll give you a call that morning no matter what.
cn: 不管怎样，那天早上我一定给你打电话。

en: Mount Etna is one of the most active volcanoes on Earth.
cn: 埃特纳火山是地球上最活跃的火山之一。

en: The mountain has been in a state of near continuous eruption for half a million years.
cn: 这座火山已经处于近乎持续喷发的状态长达50万年。

en: Exploring the Etna geographical area reveals a history written in fire.
cn: 探索埃特纳地理区域，可以发现一段用火焰书写的历史。

en: Before the eruptions, it was covered by forests of pine trees.
cn: 在喷发之前，它曾被松树林覆盖。

en: Located in southern Italy, Etna is the highest active volcano in Europe.
cn: 埃特纳火山位于意大利南部，是欧洲最高的活火山。

en: However, its height often changes when volcanic material accumulates during eruptions and subsequently collapses.
cn: 然而，当火山喷出物在喷发期间积累后随之坍塌时，其高度经常会发生变化。

en: Few volcanoes in the world have an eruption history so thoroughly documented by historical records—Etna's eruption history dates back as far as 1500 BC.
cn: 世界上很少有火山的喷发历史像埃特纳这样被历史记录如此详尽地记载——埃特纳的喷发历史可追溯至公元前1500年。

en: Some 200 eruptions have been recorded down through the centuries, but compared with other volcanoes, most of its eruptions have so far been fairly light in terms of death and destruction.
cn: 几个世纪以来，约有200次喷发被记录在案，但与其他火山相比，其大多数喷发在伤亡和破坏方面相对较轻。

en: Only about 100 deaths have been attributed to the volcano.
cn: 该火山造成的死亡人数仅约100人。

en: The mountain hasn't been entirely harmless, however—in 1928 it destroyed the town of Mascali.
cn: 然而，这座火山并非完全无害——1928年，它摧毁了马斯卡利镇。

en: Over the centuries, Etna's lower slopes have been shaped by human hands to take advantage of rich soils for growing grapes, apples and nuts.
cn: 几个世纪以来，埃特纳火山的低坡已被人类改造，利用肥沃的土壤种植葡萄、苹果和坚果。

en: Local people have also carved out over 200 caves in the soft rock and used them for everything from sacred burial places to food storage.
cn: 当地人还在软岩中凿出了200多个洞穴，将其用于各种用途，从神圣的墓葬场所到食物储藏室。

en: Large mammals once wandered the volcano's slopes, but today foxes, wild cats, rabbits and mice are more common.
cn: 曾几何时，大型哺乳动物在火山坡上游荡，但如今更常见的是狐狸、野猫、兔子和老鼠。

en: Some of those small mammals help to sustain such big birds as golden eagles.
cn: 其中一些小型哺乳动物有助于维持金鹰等大型鸟类的生存。

en: My name is Brendan Leonard and I'm an author, magazine writer, filmmaker and public speaker.
cn: 我叫布伦丹·伦纳德，是一名作家、杂志撰稿人、电影制作人和公众演讲者。

en: I'm self-employed, which means I work for myself and I do what I love.
cn: 我是自由职业者，这意味着我为自己工作，做我热爱的事情。

en: We have a popular saying in America which goes, "Do what you love and you'll never work a day in your life."
cn: 在美国，有一句流行的话说："做你热爱的事，你这辈子就永远不用工作了。"

en: But I'm here to tell you that instead of focusing on doing what we love, I think we should focus on loving what we do.
cn: 但我想告诉你，与其专注于做我们热爱的事，不如专注于热爱我们所做的事。

en: In my line of work, you hear a lot about talent, which is an idea we've mostly invented to give ourselves an excuse to be lazy.
cn: 在我的行业里，你会听到很多关于天赋的说法，而这个概念大多是我们发明出来给自己懒惰找借口的。

en: Here's why—if you see someone doing something really well, you would say it's because they're talented.
cn: 原因如下——如果你看到有人把某件事做得非常好，你会说那是因为他们有天赋。

en: You think they're somehow special.
cn: 你认为他们有某种特别之处。

en: You discount the tremendous amount of work they've done to get to where they are.
cn: 你忽视了他们为达到现在的成就所付出的大量努力。

en: Research has shown that talent is nothing without hard work.
cn: 研究表明，没有努力，天赋就毫无意义。

en: I choose to believe in hard work, but not so much in talent.
cn: 我选择相信努力，而不是天赋。

en: There are no special people, just people who put in enough hard work until something special happens.
cn: 没有什么特别的人，只有那些付出足够努力直到特别的事情发生的人。

en: I can promise you one thing—whatever you choose to do for a career, if you work hard at it, eventually, special things will happen.
cn: 我可以向你保证一件事——无论你选择从事什么职业，只要你努力工作，终究会有特别的事情发生。

en: They may not happen as quickly as you'd like them to, and they may turn out to be completely different from the special things you imagined at the beginning, but they will happen.
cn: 它们可能不会像你希望的那样很快到来，也可能与你最初想象的特别之事完全不同，但它们终究会发生。

en: A question we often ask others and are also frequently asked by others is "What do you normally do after school or work?"
cn: 我们经常问别人、也经常被别人问到的一个问题是："你放学或下班后通常做什么？"

en: Some commonplace answers are, "Well, I go to the gym."
cn: 一些常见的回答是："嗯，我去健身房。"

en: "Um, I just go home and watch TV."
cn: "呃，我就回家看电视。"

en: "I meet my friends for dinner."
cn: "我和朋友出去吃饭。"

en: "Or I just go to bed because it's so late and I'm tired."
cn: "或者我就上床睡觉，因为太晚了，我累了。"

en: Unlike any of these typical responses, I'm proud to say that I love to dance salsa after a long and tiring day of work.
cn: 与这些典型回答不同，我很自豪地说，在漫长而疲惫的工作日结束后，我喜欢跳萨尔萨舞。

en: Salsa is a kind of dancing that evolved in the mid-1970s in New York.
cn: 萨尔萨舞是一种在20世纪70年代中期起源于纽约的舞蹈。

en: My dancing life began not because I wanted to do it, but because my mother was sick and tired of seeing me running around after school doing nothing.
cn: 我的舞蹈生涯开始并非出于自愿，而是因为我妈妈厌倦了看我放学后到处乱跑、无所事事。

en: So she enrolled me into a ballet course when I was six.
cn: 所以她在我六岁时为我报名参加了芭蕾舞课。

en: I fell in love with it instantly and continued with ballet dancing for about 10 years.
cn: 我立刻爱上了芭蕾，并坚持跳了约10年。

en: Then I left my native country of New Zealand to start my career as an English teacher, which eventually brought my dancing life to a halt.
cn: 后来我离开家乡新西兰，开始了英语教师的职业生涯，这最终使我的舞蹈生活陷入停滞。

en: It wasn't until I rediscovered salsa in a lovely studio while working in Asia that I renewed my passion for dancing.
cn: 直到我在亚洲工作时，在一家可爱的舞蹈工作室重新发现萨尔萨舞，才重拾了对舞蹈的热情。

en: Since then I have been trying to attend dancing classes twice a week after work.
cn: 从那以后，我一直努力在下班后每周参加两次舞蹈课。

en: It's a great way for me to relieve stress and pressure, and dance my way towards feeling energetic and happy again.
cn: 这是我缓解压力的绝佳方式，让我通过舞蹈重新感受到活力与快乐。

en: New York City police captured a cow on the loose in Prospect Park on Tuesday after the animal became an attraction for tourists while walking along the streets and enjoying the park facilities.
cn: 纽约市警察周二在展望公园抓获了一头四处游荡的奶牛，此前这头动物一边在街上漫步、享受公园设施，一边成了游客争相拍照的景观。

en: The confused creature and camera-holding humans stared at each other through a fence for several minutes.
cn: 这头困惑的动物和拿着相机的人类隔着栅栏对视了好几分钟。

en: At other times the cow wandered around the 526-acre park and the artificial grass field normally used for human sporting events.
cn: 其他时候，奶牛在这个526英亩的公园和通常用于人类体育活动的人工草坪上到处游荡。

en: Officers used soccer goals to fence the animal in.
cn: 警察用足球门来围住这头动物。

en: However, the cow then moved through one of the nets, knocking down a police officer in the process.
cn: 然而，奶牛随后冲破了其中一张网，在此过程中撞倒了一名警察。

en: Police eventually trapped the cow between two vehicles parked on either side of a baseball field's bench area.
cn: 警察最终将奶牛困在停在棒球场休息区两侧的两辆车之间。

en: An officer then shot an arrow to put it to sleep.
cn: 随后一名警察射出一支箭将其麻醉。

en: Then officers waited for the drug to take effect.
cn: 然后警察们等待药物发挥作用。

en: After it fell asleep, they loaded the cow into a horse trailer.
cn: 奶牛睡着后，他们将其装入一辆马车拖车。

en: It was not clear where the cow came from or how it got lost.
cn: 目前尚不清楚这头奶牛从哪里来，或者它是如何迷路的。

en: Police turned it over to the animal control department after they caught it.
cn: 警察抓获它后将其移交给动物控制部门。

en: Starting April 28th of this year, the National Museum of Natural History will begin renovating its fossil hall.
cn: 从今年4月28日起，国家自然历史博物馆将开始翻修其化石展厅。

en: The fossil hall, which displays some of the world's oldest and largest fossil specimens, receives more than 2 million visitors each year.
cn: 该化石展厅展示了世界上一些最古老、最大的化石标本，每年接待游客超过200万人次。

en: It's one of the museum's most famous attractions.
cn: 它是博物馆最著名的景点之一。

en: As a result, the museum plans to expand the hall as well as add to its ancient birds collection.
cn: 为此，博物馆计划扩建展厅，并增添古代鸟类藏品。

en: Bird lovers, both young and old, have already responded with excitement at the news.
cn: 爱鸟人士，无论老少，都已对这一消息做出了热烈响应。

en: The museum's social media account has been flooded with messages of support.
cn: 博物馆的社交媒体账号收到了大量支持留言。

en: In the meantime, the current collection will be closed.
cn: 与此同时，现有藏品展览将暂时关闭。

en: However, visitors will be compensated during the closure.
cn: 不过，在闭馆期间，游客将获得补偿。

en: Museum's special exhibition area will now be free of charge.
cn: 博物馆的特别展览区现在将免费开放。

en: This week the resident exhibition is a display of ancient wall paintings on loan from Australia.
cn: 本周的常设展览是一批从澳大利亚借来的古代壁画展。

en: They celebrate the cultural heritage of the country and will be available to view until Sunday.
cn: 这些壁画展现了澳大利亚的文化遗产，将展出至周日。

en: Next week the exhibition will be taken over by the Wildlife Photographer of the Year Competition.
cn: 下周，该展览将由年度野生动物摄影师大赛接替。

en: The winner of this year's competition will be awarded a preview of the new fossil hall as well as a cash prize.
cn: 今年大赛的获奖者将获得新化石展厅的预览参观机会以及现金奖励。

en: Six birds have just been trained to pick up rubbish at a French historical theme park.
cn: 法国一家历史主题公园刚刚训练了六只鸟来捡拾垃圾。

en: According to the park's manager, Mr. Villiers, the goal is not just to clear up the park.
cn: 据公园经理维利耶先生介绍，此举的目的不仅仅是清洁公园。

en: He says visitors are already good at keeping things clean.
cn: 他说，游客在保持清洁方面已经做得很好了。

en: Instead, he wants to show that nature itself can teach us to take care of the environment.
cn: 相反，他想展示大自然本身也能教我们爱护环境。

en: He says that rooks, the chosen birds, are considered to be particularly intelligent.
cn: 他说，被选中的秃鼻乌鸦被认为特别聪明。

en: In the right circumstances, they even like to communicate with humans and establish a relationship through play.
cn: 在适当情况下，它们甚至喜欢与人类交流，并通过玩耍建立关系。

en: The birds will be encouraged to clean the park through the use of a small box that delivers a small amount of bird food each time the rook deposits a cigarette end or a small piece of rubbish.
cn: 这些鸟儿将被一个小盒子所鼓励来清洁公园，每当秃鼻乌鸦放入一个烟蒂或一小片垃圾，盒子就会派发少量鸟食作为奖励。

en: So far, visitors to the theme park have been excited to see the birds in action.
cn: 迄今为止，主题公园的游客对看到这些鸟儿忙碌工作感到兴奋。

en: However, some parents are concerned that it encourages their children to drop litter so they can watch the birds pick it up.
cn: 然而，一些家长担心这会助长孩子乱扔垃圾的行为，以便看鸟儿把垃圾捡起来。

en: Villiers is not concerned about this criticism.
cn: 维利耶对这种批评并不担心。

en: He maintains most of the feedback he has received has been overwhelmingly positive.
cn: 他坚持认为，他收到的大多数反馈都是压倒性的好评。

en: He hopes now to train more birds.
cn: 他现在希望训练更多的鸟。

en: The name of the TV show we wish to produce is Science Nation.
cn: 我们希望制作的电视节目名叫《科学国度》。

en: Please tell us more.
cn: 请告诉我们更多详情。

en: What would Science Nation be about?
cn: 《科学国度》将讲述什么内容？

en: It will be about science, all sorts of science.
cn: 它将涉及科学，各种各样的科学。

en: Each episode will focus on a different area of science, and tell us what we know, how we know it, and what we still don't know.
cn: 每一集将聚焦于不同的科学领域，告诉我们我们知道什么、我们如何得知，以及我们仍然不知道什么。

en: The show will have one host only, and this will be Professor Susan Paul from Harvard University.
cn: 节目将只有一位主持人，即哈佛大学的苏珊·保罗教授。

en: She is a great public speaker.
cn: 她是一位出色的公众演讲者。

en: So, just be clear.
cn: 那么，请明确一下。

en: Will the show's format be like that of a documentary?
cn: 节目的形式会像纪录片吗？

en: Kind of.
cn: 有点像。

en: It will be like a documentary in the sense that it will be non-fiction and fact-based.
cn: 从非虚构和基于事实的角度来说，它会像纪录片。

en: However, our idea is for it to be also fun and entertaining, something which traditional documentaries aren't so much.
cn: 然而，我们的想法是让它同时也有趣且富有娱乐性，而这是传统纪录片所不太具备的。

en: Please keep in mind this will be a new TV show like nothing ever done before.
cn: 请记住，这将是一个前所未有的全新电视节目。

en: Okay, so it will be both educational and entertaining, and your audience will be anyone interested in science, right?
cn: 好的，所以它将既有教育意义又有娱乐性，你们的受众将是所有对科学感兴趣的人，对吗？

en: That's correct.
cn: 完全正确。

en: Yes.
cn: 是的。

en: Right, thank you.
cn: 好的，谢谢你。

en: So I think we're more or less clear what the show will be like.
cn: 我想我们对节目的大致形式已经比较清楚了。

en: Could you please tell us now what exactly you want from us?
cn: 能告诉我们你们具体需要我们做什么吗？

en: Yes, of course.
cn: 当然可以。

en: Basically what we need from you is financial support.
cn: 基本上我们需要你们提供的是资金支持。

en: In order to go ahead with this idea, we need two million dollars.
cn: 为了推进这个想法，我们需要200万美元。

en: This would cover the cost of making all 12 shows in the first season for the first year.
cn: 这将涵盖第一年第一季所有12集节目的制作费用。

en: If the show is a success, we can then look at making a second season for the following year.
cn: 如果节目取得成功，我们可以着手制作第二年的第二季。

en: What's up with you?
cn: 你怎么了？

en: You don't look very happy.
cn: 你看起来不太高兴。

en: I feel like I'm a failure.
cn: 我觉得自己是个失败者。

en: I can't seem to do anything very well.
cn: 我似乎什么都做不好。

en: I wouldn't say that.
cn: 我不这么认为。

en: You do very well in a lot of things.
cn: 你在很多方面都表现得很好。

en: That presentation you gave last week was excellent.
cn: 你上周做的那个演讲非常出色。

en: Yes, but I have this urge to strive for perfection.
cn: 是的，但我有一种追求完美的冲动。

en: I really want to push harder and progress further.
cn: 我真的想更加努力、取得更大的进步。

en: Well, that's very admirable.
cn: 嗯，这非常值得钦佩。

en: But be careful.
cn: 但要小心。

en: Over-concern with being perfect can damage our confidence if we never achieve it.
cn: 如果永远无法实现完美，对完美的过度追求会损害我们的自信。

en: Yes, I know.
cn: 是的，我知道。

en: I feel awful whenever I make a mistake in whatever I'm trying to do.
cn: 每当我在尝试做的事情上犯错时，我都感到很糟糕。

en: Well, think about it.
cn: 好好想想。

en: You can't make progress without making mistakes and learning from them.
cn: 不犯错误并从中学习，就无法取得进步。

en: Thomas Edison, the famous inventor, once said, "I've not failed. I've just found 10,000 ways that won't work."
cn: 著名发明家托马斯·爱迪生曾说："我没有失败。我只是找到了10,000种行不通的方法。"

en: You may well be right.
cn: 你可能说得对。

en: I guess I should recognize my mistakes and learn the lesson they teach me and move forward.
cn: 我想我应该承认自己的错误，从中汲取教训，然后继续前进。

en: Also, remember a successful ending is not the only thing worthy of a celebration.
cn: 另外，记住成功的结局并不是唯一值得庆祝的事情。

en: You need to recognize each step of progress you take towards achieving your goals, and no matter how tiny it is, it's still good.
cn: 你需要认可每一步向目标迈进的进步，无论多么微小，那都是好的。

en: I always feel down when I see others accomplishing things, and I feel miserable about my own achievements.
cn: 每当看到别人取得成就，我都感到沮丧，对自己的成绩也感到痛苦。

en: I'm always trying to be as good as others.
cn: 我总是试图和别人一样出色。

en: But I never seem to get there.
cn: 但我似乎从未能达到那个水平。

en: Listen, if you always compare yourself with others, you'll never feel good enough.
cn: 听着，如果你总是与别人比较，你永远不会感到足够好。

en: You're the only person you should be comparing yourself with.
cn: 你应该与之比较的唯一人是你自己。

en: When you compare your current status with the starting point, you'll find you've made progress, right?
cn: 当你把现在的状态与起点相比较，你会发现自己已经取得了进步，对吗？

en: That's good enough.
cn: 这就足够好了。

en: That's great advice.
cn: 这个建议太好了。

en: Thank you.
cn: 谢谢你。

en: I'm feeling better already.
cn: 我已经感觉好多了。

en: Single-sex education can have enormous benefits for female students.
cn: 单性别教育对女学生来说可以带来巨大的好处。

en: Numerous studies have shown that women who attend single-sex schools tend to have stronger self-confidence, better study habits and more ambitious career goals than women who attend coeducational schools.
cn: 大量研究表明，就读于单性别学校的女性往往比就读于男女混合学校的女性拥有更强的自信心、更好的学习习惯和更远大的职业目标。

en: Girls who graduate from single-sex schools are three times more likely to become engineers than those who attend coeducational schools.
cn: 从单性别学校毕业的女生成为工程师的可能性是就读于男女混合学校女生的三倍。

en: The reason is that all-girls schools encourage women to enter fields traditionally dominated by men, such as science, technology and engineering.
cn: 原因在于，全女子学校鼓励女性进入传统上由男性主导的领域，如科学、技术和工程。

en: In coeducational schools, girls are often expected to succeed only in humanities or the arts.
cn: 在男女混合学校，女生往往被期望只在人文或艺术方面取得成功。

en: Research has also shown that in coeducational settings, teachers are more likely to praise and give in-depth responses to a boy's comments in class.
cn: 研究还表明，在男女同校的环境中，教师更倾向于表扬男生的课堂发言并给予深入的回应。

en: In contrast, they might only respond to a girl's comments with a nod.
cn: 相比之下，他们对女生的发言可能只是点头回应。

en: They are also more likely to encourage boys to work through problems on their own, while they tend to step in and help girls who struggle with a problem.
cn: 他们也更倾向于鼓励男生独立解决问题，而对于遇到困难的女生则倾向于主动介入帮助。

en: In an all-girls setting, girls are more likely to speak up frequently and make significant contributions to class than in a coeducational setting.
cn: 在全女子学校的环境中，女生更可能频繁发言，在课堂上做出重要贡献。

en: Girls studying in a single-sex setting also earn higher scores on their College Board and Advanced Placement exams than girls who study in coeducational settings.
cn: 在单性别环境中学习的女生在大学委员会考试和高级先修课程考试中的成绩也高于在男女混合学校就读的女生。

en: All-girls schools tend to be smaller than coeducational schools, which means teachers will be able to tailor the materials to girl students' personal learning styles and interests.
cn: 女子学校往往比男女混合学校规模更小，这意味着教师能够根据女生的个人学习风格和兴趣定制教学材料。

en: Today I found out that Seattle doesn't really get that much rain compared with most US cities.
cn: 今天我发现，与大多数美国城市相比，西雅图的降雨量其实并不多。

en: In fact, Seattle ranks 44th among major US cities in average annual rainfall.
cn: 事实上，在美国主要城市年均降雨量排名中，西雅图排在第44位。

en: Cities that get more rainfall than Seattle include Houston, Memphis, Nashville, and pretty much every major city on the eastern coast, such as New York, Boston and Miami.
cn: 降雨量多于西雅图的城市包括休斯顿、孟菲斯、纳什维尔，以及东海岸几乎所有主要城市，如纽约、波士顿和迈阿密。

en: So why does everyone think of Seattle as a rainy city?
cn: 那么，为什么大家都认为西雅图是一座多雨城市呢？

en: The primary root of this misconception lies in that Seattle has a relatively large number of days per year with rainfall compared with New York and Boston, which get an average of about 16% more rain per year than Seattle, but also average between them about 36 fewer days a year of rainfall.
cn: 这种误解的根本原因在于，与纽约和波士顿相比，西雅图每年的降雨天数相对较多。纽约和波士顿的年均降雨量比西雅图多约16%，但两者每年的平均降雨天数比西雅图少约36天。

en: So it rains a lot less in Seattle, and the rain is spread out over more days than those cities.
cn: 所以西雅图的降雨量少得多，且雨水分散在比这些城市更多的日子里。

en: This is why few locals in Seattle carry an umbrella generally.
cn: 这就是为什么西雅图当地人一般很少带伞的原因。

en: When it does rain, it tends to be a very light rain.
cn: 当真的下雨时，往往只是毛毛细雨。

en: That isn't troublesome.
cn: 并不令人烦恼。

en: It almost never really rains as most people think.
cn: 几乎从未像大多数人想象的那样大雨倾盆。

en: On top of that, it never really storms in Seattle, either.
cn: 除此之外，西雅图也几乎从不发生暴风雨。

en: Seattle gets an average of a mere seven days a year with thunder.
cn: 西雅图每年平均只有区区7天有雷声。

en: So in short, if you like sunny but not too hot summers, mild winters but with lots of cloudy days, Seattle's the place to be.
cn: 总而言之，如果你喜欢晴朗但不太热的夏天，以及温和但多云的冬天，西雅图就是你的理想之地。

en: Anyway, if you visit Seattle, don't bring an umbrella.
cn: 总之，如果你去西雅图，不必带伞。

en: People will look at you, thinking you're funny.
cn: 人们会看着你，觉得你很奇怪。

en: After a tough workout or a day full of physical activity, it's common to find your muscles aching.
cn: 经过一番艰苦锻炼或充满体力活动的一天之后，肌肉酸痛是很常见的。

en: But where do these pains come from?
cn: 但这些疼痛从何而来？

en: According to a German professor, the soreness comes from straining your muscles in an uncommon way, for example, jumping on a bicycle for a ride, because you haven't ridden in a long time.
cn: 一位德国教授指出，酸痛来自于以不寻常的方式拉伸肌肉，例如，骑上自行车骑行，因为你已经很久没有骑了。

en: Soreness occurs since your leg muscles aren't used to that movement.
cn: 酸痛是因为你的腿部肌肉不习惯这种运动。

en: When muscles perform an activity they aren't regularly exposed to, the tiny fibres that are inside them are being torn apart.
cn: 当肌肉执行它们不经常进行的活动时，其内部的微小纤维会被撕裂。

en: As muscle soreness develops, the body has to work to repair the muscle tears.
cn: 随着肌肉酸痛的产生，身体必须努力修复这些肌肉撕裂。

en: But this doesn't happen immediately.
cn: 但这不会立即发生。

en: First, the body must realise the muscles are damaged.
cn: 首先，身体必须意识到肌肉受损。

en: When the body realises the muscles are hurt, the response is to increase blood flow to the area and increase body heat.
cn: 当身体意识到肌肉受伤时，其反应是增加该区域的血液流量并升高体温。

en: Damaged cells are then cleaned up and the body sends cells specially designed to break down the large muscle fibre fragments.
cn: 随后，受损细胞被清除，身体派出专门用于分解大型肌肉纤维碎片的细胞。

en: Healing can take place after this.
cn: 此后，愈合才能开始发生。

en: It takes about a day until these cells make it to your aching muscles.
cn: 大约需要一天时间，这些细胞才能到达你酸痛的肌肉。

en: That's why there is most often a delay associated with muscle soreness.
cn: 这就是为什么肌肉酸痛通常会有延迟。

en: Repair of damaged cells takes about two days, and afterwards the soreness disappears.
cn: 受损细胞的修复大约需要两天时间，之后酸痛感就会消失。

en: Unfortunately, there is little that can be done to relieve muscle soreness.
cn: 遗憾的是，几乎没有什么方法可以缓解肌肉酸痛。

en: Pain-relieving creams don't work, but a hot shower or warm bath can provide some relief.
cn: 止痛霜没有效果，但热水澡或温水浴可以提供一些缓解。

en: The British government has called for more men to consider a career in nursing.
cn: 英国政府呼吁更多男性考虑以护理为职业。

en: Figures show the number of male nurses has fallen in the last three years.
cn: 数据显示，男性护士的数量在过去三年中有所下降。

en: Now, the number of men working in the nursing sector has reached a seven-year low.
cn: 目前，从事护理行业的男性人数已降至七年来的最低点。

en: Numbers of male nurses increased between 2011 and 2014, and reached a peak of 7,168.
cn: 男性护士人数在2011年至2014年间持续增加，并达到7,168人的峰值。

en: This figure has dropped to only 6,924 in 2017.
cn: 这一数字在2017年下降至仅6,924人。

en: The UK Health Secretary said, "This is clearly a cultural problem, and probably one that exists in many parts of the world."
cn: 英国卫生部长表示："这显然是一个文化问题，而且可能在世界许多地方都存在。"

en: "But we can make efforts to change that now."
cn: "但我们现在可以努力改变这种状况。"

en: "We want to persuade males to think about career options of going into nursing.
cn: "我们希望说服男性考虑进入护理行业的职业选择。

en: There is absolutely no reason why men can't go into this profession."
cn: 男性进入这个行业完全没有理由不可以。"

en: The Health Secretary said that the government already has plans to attract a more varied workforce into nursing.
cn: 卫生部长表示，政府已经有计划吸引更多多元化的劳动力进入护理领域。

en: She stated, "We are leading the way on workforce planning."
cn: 她表示："我们在劳动力规划方面走在了前列。"

en: "We will become the first nation in Europe to publish a national health and care workforce strategy."
cn: "我们将成为欧洲第一个发布全国卫生和护理劳动力战略的国家。"

en: A man from Libya was enjoying a walk along the sands at Southport Beach.
cn: 一名来自利比亚的男子正在绍斯波特海滩的沙滩上悠闲散步。

en: When he was about half a mile out from the dock, he felt a bit tired.
cn: 当他距离码头约半英里时，感到有些疲倦。

en: So he lay down and fell asleep.
cn: 于是他躺下睡着了。

en: But the tide swept in quickly at the beach.
cn: 但海滩上的潮水涌来得很快。

en: And the man was shocked to wake up and find the tide had come in and completely surrounded him, cutting him off from the shore.
cn: 这名男子一觉醒来，震惊地发现潮水已经涌入，将他完全包围，与海岸隔绝。

en: Fortunately for him, the beach lifeguards were quickly on the scene to stop him from drowning.
cn: 幸运的是，海滩救生员迅速赶到现场，防止他溺水。

en: They acted professionally to ensure the man was comfortable until an ambulance arrived.
cn: 他们专业地行动，确保该男子安然无恙，直到救护车到达。

en: He was then taken to hospital.
cn: 随后他被送往医院。

en: He is now in a stable condition.
cn: 目前他状况稳定。

en: When interviewed, Keith Porter of the Southport Beach said, "Our beach is so flat that it's very common for the tide to come around the back of people and cut them off from the beach.
cn: 接受采访时，绍斯波特海滩的基思·波特表示："我们的海滩非常平坦，潮水绕到人们身后将其与海滩隔离的情况非常普遍。

en: Thankfully the emergency services have again worked well together to ensure a positive outcome."
cn: 感谢紧急服务部门再次携手合作，确保了积极的结果。"

en: "And we wish the gentleman a speedy recovery."
cn: "我们祝愿这位先生早日康复。"

en: A raccoon, a small cat-like animal, climbed to the top of a 25-storey skyscraper early on Wednesday.
cn: 一只浣熊——一种类似猫的小动物——于周三凌晨爬上了一栋25层高楼的顶部。

en: It was captured after becoming an online star across the world.
cn: 它在成为全球网络红星后被捕获。

en: At a little before 3 a.m., the animal made it to the roof of the building after it took a long break on a 17th floor window edge.
cn: 凌晨3时前不久，这只动物在17楼窗沿休息了很长时间后终于爬上了大楼屋顶。

en: At the top of the building, animal control officers put cat food in traps and captured the raccoon.
cn: 在楼顶，动物控制人员在陷阱中放置了猫粮并捕获了这只浣熊。

en: A private wildlife management company will release the animal into the wild.
cn: 一家私营野生动物管理公司将把它放归野外。

en: The raccoon's upward journey began on Monday.
cn: 这只浣熊的攀爬之旅始于周一。

en: The brown animal was spotted stuck on a narrow window edge of the office tower.
cn: 这只棕色动物被发现困在办公楼一个狭窄的窗沿上。

en: On Tuesday, the raccoon slowly climbed the building.
cn: 周二，这只浣熊缓慢地攀爬着大楼。

en: It reached the 23rd floor, and its legend continued to grow on social media with every floor it climbed.
cn: 它爬到了23楼，每爬升一层，它在社交媒体上的传奇就继续增长。

en: As it went up, people gathered on the sidewalk below to take photos and cheer for its safety.
cn: 随着它不断攀升，人们聚集在下方的人行道上拍照，为它的安全加油打气。

en: Online office workers posted photos and videos of the raccoon resting on window edges and climbing up the building's concrete exterior.
cn: 网上的上班族发布了浣熊在窗沿休息和攀爬大楼混凝土外墙的照片和视频。

en: One online post said that the raccoon has succeeded in uniting the country the way no politician could.
cn: 一篇网络帖子说，这只浣熊成功地以任何政客都无法做到的方式团结了全国人民。

en: I have really amazing news.
cn: 我有一个非常棒的消息。

en: I just got a text message from my bank, saying my salary has been deposited in my account.
cn: 我刚收到银行的短信，说我的工资已经打入账户了。

en: Getting paid is good.
cn: 拿到工资是好事。

en: But I don't understand why you're so excited.
cn: 但我不明白你为什么这么兴奋。

en: It happens every month.
cn: 这每个月都会发生的。

en: Well, I've been working for a few years.
cn: 嗯，我工作好几年了。

en: In fact, I worked all through university, but I only had part-time jobs then.
cn: 事实上，我在大学期间一直在打工，但那时只是兼职。

en: So this is the first time I've ever been paid for a month of full-time work.
cn: 所以这是我第一次领到整整一个月全职工作的薪水。

en: Wow, then you must feel great.
cn: 哇，那你一定感觉很棒。

en: I mean, it's been two decades, but I can still remember when I got my first real salary.
cn: 我是说，尽管已经过去二十年了，但我仍然记得我第一次拿到真正薪水时的感受。

en: I was happy for days.
cn: 我高兴了好几天。

en: I felt like it was a small fortune, even though it wasn't.
cn: 我觉得那简直就是一笔小财富，尽管实际上并不是。

en: Yeah, I've never earned so much money before.
cn: 是啊，我以前从未赚过这么多钱。

en: And there're so many things I'd like to do with it.
cn: 而且有太多事情我想用这笔钱来做。

en: What did you do with your first pay?
cn: 你拿到第一份薪水时做了什么？

en: I bought a new suit for work and took my parents to a nice restaurant to celebrate.
cn: 我买了一套新西装上班穿，并带父母去了一家不错的餐厅庆祝。

en: Maybe you could do the same.
cn: 也许你也可以这样做。

en: I have enough professional clothes.
cn: 我有足够的职业装了。

en: And my parents are across the country.
cn: 而且我父母在全国的另一头。

en: So seeing them is impossible.
cn: 所以见到他们是不可能的。

en: But some people from the office are members of a gym I want to join.
cn: 但办公室里有些人是一家我想加入的健身房的会员。

en: And my university classmates are arranging a trip to visit our old campus, and I'd love to go with them.
cn: 而且我的大学同学正在安排一次回访母校的旅行，我很想和他们一起去。

en: But I can't afford both.
cn: 但两者我负担不起。

en: If I were you, I'd join the gym, because it's a good way to stay healthy, and it might help you build a stronger relationship with your colleagues.
cn: 如果我是你，我会加入健身房，因为这是保持健康的好方法，而且可能有助于你与同事建立更牢固的关系。

en: And good relationships are key to a successful career.
cn: 良好的人际关系是职业成功的关键。

en: Hmm.
cn: 嗯。

en: You're right.
cn: 你说得对。

en: Thanks for the advice.
cn: 谢谢你的建议。

en: I'm taking it.
cn: 我会采纳的。

en: What's going on with you lately?
cn: 你最近怎么了？

en: You seem so distracted, like you aren't really listening to anything I say.
cn: 你看起来心不在焉的，好像根本没在听我说话。

en: I know.
cn: 我知道。

en: I'm sorry.
cn: 对不起。

en: I can't seem to focus on anything, because I still haven't decided if I should accept the offer for that PhD program in London, or if I should take the job offer in New York.
cn: 我似乎无法专注于任何事情，因为我仍然没有决定是否应该接受伦敦博士项目的录取通知，还是应该接受纽约的工作邀请。

en: Look, it's a tough decision.
cn: 听着，这是个艰难的决定。

en: But you're running out of time, aren't you?
cn: 但你的时间不多了，不是吗？

en: I thought you said the company expected an answer by the end of the month.
cn: 我以为你说公司期望在月底前得到答复。

en: Actually, it's the beginning of next month for the job, but the university needs a decision by the end of the week.
cn: 实际上，工作方面的截止日期是下个月初，但大学需要在本周末之前做出决定。

en: So I have to act quickly.
cn: 所以我必须迅速行动。

en: You definitely need advice for an important decision like this.
cn: 对于这样重大的决定，你肯定需要建议。

en: So who have you talked to about it?
cn: 那么你和谁谈过这件事了？

en: What does your family think?
cn: 你家人怎么看？

en: And your advisor for your master's program?
cn: 还有你硕士项目的导师呢？

en: I've asked their advice and that's part of the problem.
cn: 我已经征求了他们的意见，而这本身也是问题的一部分。

en: My parents want me to get the degree, but my advisor thinks it's time for me to get more work experience.
cn: 我父母希望我获得博士学位，但我的导师认为是时候让我获得更多工作经验了。

en: What do you mean by part of the problem?
cn: 你说的"也是问题的一部分"是什么意思？

en: Oh, wait.
cn: 哦，等等。

en: It's your girlfriend, isn't it?
cn: 是你的女朋友，不是吗？

en: You've been dating since your first year of university, so that's six years now.
cn: 你们从大学一年级就开始交往了，也就是说已经六年了。

en: She must have an opinion about all this.
cn: 她对这件事肯定有自己的看法。

en: I mean, isn't it time for you to think about getting married?
cn: 我是说，是不是该考虑结婚了？

en: Well, I do want to get married, but she thinks we need to wait until we've launched our careers.
cn: 嗯，我确实想结婚，但她认为我们需要等到各自的职业起步之后才行。

en: Plus, she's not sure what she'll be doing next year.
cn: 而且，她也不确定自己明年会做什么。

en: She's considering a job in England and one in Australia.
cn: 她在考虑英国的一份工作和澳大利亚的一份工作。

en: And her parents are pushing for the latter.
cn: 而她的父母倾向于后者。

en: Analytical skills are our ability to understand and solve problems using information we have available.
cn: 分析能力是我们利用现有信息理解和解决问题的能力。

en: These skills are extremely important for our professional, social, and intellectual lives.
cn: 这些技能对我们的职业、社交和智识生活极为重要。

en: What are the best ways to improve them?
cn: 提升这些能力的最佳方法是什么？

en: One way is to expand your world view.
cn: 一种方法是拓展你的世界观。

en: Unfortunately, this takes time.
cn: 遗憾的是，这需要时间。

en: Ultimately, it will help you better evaluate information and analyze different ideas and outcomes.
cn: 但最终，它会帮助你更好地评估信息，并分析不同的想法和结果。

en: Traveling is a great way to expand your world view, although it can be expensive.
cn: 旅行是拓展世界观的好方法，尽管可能花费不菲。

en: An entertaining way of enhancing your analytical skills is to engage them by playing brain games.
cn: 一种有趣的提升分析能力的方式是通过玩脑力游戏来锻炼它们。

en: These are games that challenge you to think deeply and to develop your analytical skills.
cn: 这些游戏能挑战你深入思考，并培养你的分析能力。

en: These games will get you used to thinking in a certain way.
cn: 这些游戏会让你养成某种固定的思维方式。

en: As a result, they will help improve your ability to think.
cn: 因此，它们将有助于提升你的思维能力。

en: However, opinions vary on whether video games are effective.
cn: 然而，关于电子游戏是否有效，众说纷纭。

en: The general consensus is that the best ones avoid mindless violence, and instead focus on strategy and challenge us to solve problems and achieve broad goals.
cn: 普遍共识是，最好的电子游戏应避免无意义的暴力，转而注重策略，挑战我们解决问题、实现更宏观的目标。

en: Joining a debate or reading club or group is also a good idea.
cn: 加入辩论社、读书俱乐部或读书小组也是个好主意。

en: This provides people with the opportunity to come together and discuss ideas, literature and problems.
cn: 这为人们提供了聚在一起讨论观点、文学和问题的机会。

en: Groups like these will help you refine your analytical skills and enable you to express yourself better.
cn: 这样的团体将帮助你磨练分析技能，使你能够更好地表达自己。

en: Any social group that encourages free exchange of ideas and pursuit of knowledge is beneficial.
cn: 任何鼓励自由交流思想、追求知识的社会团体都是有益的。

en: It helps you to actively develop your analytical skills.
cn: 它能帮助你积极地发展分析技能。

en: There's an endless amount of scientific data proving that dogs can develop strong bonds with their owners.
cn: 有大量科学数据证明，狗能与主人发展出牢固的情感纽带。

en: People aren't kidding when they say they "love" their dog, or their dog "loves" them.
cn: 当人们说他们"爱"他们的狗，或者他们的狗"爱"他们时，他们并不是在开玩笑。

en: But we're rather ignorant about the nature of the relationships that form between dogs.
cn: 但我们对狗与狗之间形成的关系的本质知之甚少。

en: In an effort to understand the matter further, I spoke with Dr. Marc Bekoff, a researcher and former professor of animal behavior.
cn: 为了进一步了解这个问题，我采访了动物行为研究员、前教授马克·贝科夫博士。

en: The doctor's response to the question of whether or not dogs can fall in love like humans do was a straight "Of course."
cn: 对于狗是否能像人类一样坠入爱河这一问题，这位博士的回答是直截了当的"当然。"

en: He went on to say that if love is defined as a long-term commitment—meaning dogs seek one another out when they're apart, they're happy when they're reunited, they protect one another, they feed one another, they raise their children together—then of course dogs love each other.
cn: 他进一步说，如果爱被定义为一种长期的承诺——意味着狗在分离时彼此寻找，重聚时彼此欢欣，相互保护，相互喂食，共同抚养后代——那么狗当然彼此相爱。

en: Now our furry friends don't really experience "romantic" love like in the movies, but they can form deep and lasting bonds with their fellow dogs as well as humans.
cn: 当然，我们的毛茸茸的朋友们并不真的体验电影里那种"浪漫"的爱情，但它们能与同类以及人类建立深厚而持久的情感联系。

en: In fact, evidence shows that most dogs stay with one partner their whole lives.
cn: 事实上，证据表明，大多数狗一生只与一个伴侣相守。

en: In actuality, love between dogs can be even more intimate than human relationships.
cn: 实际上，狗与狗之间的爱甚至可能比人类关系更为亲密。

en: When they interact, they aren't afraid to smell each other and will express themselves clearly and honestly.
cn: 当它们互动时，不害怕相互嗅闻，并且会清晰而诚实地表达自己。

en: Once again, it seems we have a lot to learn from dogs.
cn: 再一次，我们似乎有很多东西可以向狗学习。

en: A piece of history has been found thanks to a boy tripping on a rare, 1.2-million-year-old animal fossil.
cn: 由于一名男孩绊倒在一块罕见的、有120万年历史的动物化石上，一段历史被重新发现。
