en: Let's order Vietnamese right away.
cn: 我们马上点越南菜吧。

en: A new study carried out by the University of Lincoln has found a link between the personalities of cat owners and the behaviour and wellbeing of their cats.
cn: 林肯大学的一项新研究发现，猫主人的性格与猫的行为和健康状况之间存在关联。

en: The findings suggest that, just as a parent's personality can affect the personality of a child, the same is true for a cat and its owner.
cn: 研究结果表明，正如父母的性格可以影响孩子的性格一样，猫主人的性格对猫也有同样的影响。

en: Owners—defined as individuals with high levels of anxiety, fear, anger, depression and loneliness—were more likely to have cats with behavioural issues.
cn: 那些被界定为具有高度焦虑、恐惧、愤怒、抑郁和孤独感的主人，其猫更容易出现行为问题。

en: Such cats displayed more aggressive and anxious behavioural styles as well as more stress-related sickness.
cn: 这样的猫表现出更多攻击性和焦虑性的行为方式，以及更多与压力相关的疾病。

en: They were also more likely to have an ongoing medical condition and be overweight.
cn: 它们也更容易患有持续的疾病并且体重超标。

en: The research also found that mentally well-adjusted owners had calmer, happier and healthier cats.
cn: 研究还发现，心理调适良好的主人拥有更平静、更快乐、更健康的猫。

en: The researchers explained that "Many owners regard their pets as a family member, and form close social bonds with them."
cn: 研究人员解释说："许多主人将宠物视为家庭成员，与它们建立了亲密的社会纽带。"

en: The majority of owners want to provide the best care for their pets and it's therefore possible that pets could be affected by the way their owners interact with and manage them.
cn: 大多数主人希望为宠物提供最好的照料，因此宠物可能会受到主人与之互动和管理方式的影响。

en: The study highlights an important relationship between our personalities and the wellbeing of our pets.
cn: 该研究强调了我们的性格与宠物健康之间的重要关系。

en: Further research is needed to investigate the causal nature of this relationship and to look at how owners' personalities are directly influencing their pets' behaviour and wellbeing.
cn: 需要进一步研究来探究这种关系的因果性质，以及主人的性格如何直接影响宠物的行为和健康。

en: It is possible that the wellbeing of pets is driven by the underlying nature of the owner, not simply by their conscious decisions and behaviours.
cn: 宠物的健康状况可能是由主人的内在本性所驱动，而不仅仅是其有意识的决定和行为。

en: "One 60-minute run can add seven hours to your life."
cn: "跑步60分钟可以延长7小时寿命。"

en: This was a claim made by The Times last week.
cn: 这是《泰晤士报》上周的一则报道。

en: The claim was based on a new review of studies about the effects of running.
cn: 这一说法基于一项关于跑步效果的新综述研究。

en: The review concluded that on average runners live three years longer than non-runners and that running does more to extend life than any other form of exercise.
cn: 该综述得出结论：跑步者平均比非跑步者多活三年，跑步在延长寿命方面比任何其他形式的锻炼效果都更好。

en: But there's more to running than its health benefits.
cn: 但跑步的益处不仅仅在于健康方面。

en: Research published in recent years has shown that running changes your brain and mind in some fascinating ways, from increasing your brain function to regulating your emotions.
cn: 近年来发表的研究表明，跑步以一些迷人的方式改变着你的大脑和心智，从提升大脑功能到调节情绪。

en: However, the precise effects vary according to whether you engage in short, fast running or long-distance running.
cn: 然而，具体效果因你从事的是短距离快跑还是长距离跑步而有所不同。

en: For example, in one study, researchers compared participants' ability to learn new words after several minutes of intense running and after 40 minutes of gentle running.
cn: 例如，在一项研究中，研究人员比较了参与者在数分钟剧烈跑步和40分钟轻松跑步后学习新词的能力。

en: Participants were able to learn 20 percent faster after the intense running and they showed a superior memory when tested again a week later.
cn: 参与者在剧烈跑步后学习速度提高了20%，一周后再次测试时记忆力也表现更优。

en: In another study, researchers asked volunteers to jog for 30 minutes and then showed them clips from a sad movie.
cn: 在另一项研究中，研究人员让志愿者慢跑30分钟，然后给他们观看悲伤电影的片段。

en: Participants who usually struggled to handle negative emotions were more intensely affected by the sad clips, just as you'd expect.
cn: 通常难以应对负面情绪的参与者，受悲伤片段影响更强烈，这与预期一致。

en: But crucially, this was less so if they had completed the 30-minute jog.
cn: 但关键的是，如果他们完成了30分钟慢跑，这种影响就会减弱。

en: The researchers said moderate exercise appears to have helped those participants to be less vulnerable to the impact of the sad movie.
cn: 研究人员表示，适度锻炼似乎帮助这些参与者减弱了对悲伤电影的敏感程度。

en: Welcome to the tour of the Hill House.
cn: 欢迎参观希尔庄园。

en: This house built in 1904 is one of the most well-known works of Charles Hill, the famous architect.
cn: 这座建于1904年的房子是著名建筑师查尔斯·希尔最知名的作品之一。

en: It was designed and built for a local entrepreneur and his family.
cn: 它是为当地一位企业家及其家人设计和建造的。

en: Before starting the tour, let me give you a brief introduction about the design of this amazing building.
cn: 在开始参观之前，让我简要介绍一下这座令人惊叹的建筑的设计。

en: Prior to beginning his design, the architect spent some time in the client's old home, observing their life and studying their habits.
cn: 在开始设计之前，建筑师在客户的旧居中待了一段时间，观察他们的生活并研究他们的习惯。

en: This meant that he could design the house according to the needs of the family.
cn: 这意味着他可以根据家庭的需求来设计房子。

en: The client's main desire was to have a home with a unique design, so the architect was given complete freedom.
cn: 客户的主要愿望是拥有一座设计独特的住宅，因此建筑师被给予了充分的自由。

en: The building style is radically different from what was the fashion of the period.
cn: 建筑风格与当时的流行风格截然不同。

en: At the time, most large homes were constructed of timber and brick.
cn: 当时，大多数大型住宅都是用木材和砖块建造的。

en: This one, however, is made of concrete, a novel construction material in those days.
cn: 然而，这座房子是用混凝土建造的，这在当时是一种新颖的建筑材料。

en: The interior of the house, including fittings and furniture, was also designed by the same person.
cn: 房子的内部，包括配件和家具，也是由同一个人设计的。

en: Most of the furniture you will see is original and in good condition.
cn: 你将要看到的大部分家具都是原装的，保存完好。

en: However, those pieces in the children's bedrooms are copies built to the designs of the architect.
cn: 然而，儿童卧室里的那些家具是根据建筑师的设计制作的复制品。

en: Fortunately, all the blueprints for both the building and its contents have been preserved, so we've been able to replace badly damaged furniture.
cn: 幸运的是，建筑及其内部所有物品的蓝图都得以保存，因此我们能够更换严重损坏的家具。

en: Let's begin our tour, starting from the rooms.
cn: 让我们从房间开始参观吧。

en: A new study finds that beverages containing added sugar might be harmful.
cn: 一项新研究发现，含添加糖的饮料可能有害健康。

en: In the study, researchers analyzed information from over 80,000 women and 37,000 men.
cn: 在这项研究中，研究人员分析了来自8万多名女性和3.7万多名男性的信息。

en: Participants worked in the health profession.
cn: 参与者均从事医疗卫生行业。

en: They were followed for approximately three decades.
cn: 研究人员对他们进行了约三十年的跟踪调查。

en: They completed surveys about their diet every four years.
cn: 他们每四年完成一次关于饮食的调查。

en: They also answered questions about sleep and exercise and health every two years.
cn: 他们还每两年回答一次关于睡眠、运动和健康的问题。

en: The more beverages containing added sugar that people drank, the greater their risk of death was during the study period.
cn: 人们饮用含添加糖饮料越多，研究期间死亡风险就越高。

en: These beverages included soda, energy drinks and sports drinks.
cn: 这些饮料包括碳酸饮料、能量饮料和运动饮料。

en: Beverages like pure fruit juice which are sweet but do not contain added sugar were not part of the study.
cn: 像纯果汁这类虽有甜味但不含添加糖的饮料不在研究范围之内。

en: The findings held even after the researchers considered other factors that could affect people's health.
cn: 即使研究人员考虑了其他可能影响人们健康的因素后，这一发现依然成立。

en: These factors included lack of exercise and not eating enough vegetables.
cn: 这些因素包括缺乏锻炼和蔬菜摄入不足。

en: They also included consuming too much meat.
cn: 还包括肉类摄入过多。

en: The scientists say that their results support limiting beverages with added sugar.
cn: 科学家们表示，他们的研究结果支持限制含添加糖饮料的摄入。

en: They argue we should replace them with other drinks, with water being the best choice.
cn: 他们认为应用其他饮料来替代含糖饮料，其中水是最佳选择。

en: However, the researchers admit this is simply their recommendation.
cn: 然而，研究人员承认这只是他们的建议。

en: The study found only an association: It did not prove that drinks with added sugar cause early death.
cn: 该研究只发现了一种关联，并未证明含添加糖的饮料会导致早逝。

en: German police appealed Friday for information about the possible owners of two 17th-century oil paintings.
cn: 德国警方周五呼吁公众提供有关两幅17世纪油画可能所有者的信息。

en: Police said a 64-year-old man found the paintings in a garbage pile at a highway rest stop last month.
cn: 警方称，上个月一名64岁男子在高速公路休息站的垃圾堆中发现了这两幅画作。

en: He later handed them in to the Cologne police.
cn: 他随后将其交给了科隆警方。

en: An initial assessment by an art expert concluded the two framed paintings were originals, police said.
cn: 警方表示，一名艺术专家初步鉴定后认定这两幅有框画作为真迹。

en: One is a landscape painted by the Italian artist Pietro Bellotti dating to 1665.
cn: 其中一幅是意大利画家皮耶特罗·贝洛蒂创作于1665年的风景画。

en: The other is a painting of a boy by the 17th-century Dutch artist Samuel van Hoogstraten, date unknown.
cn: 另一幅是17世纪荷兰画家塞缪尔·范·霍赫斯特拉滕所绘的男孩肖像，创作日期不详。

en: Their combined worth is estimated to be around one million euros.
cn: 两幅画作的总估价约为100万欧元。

en: Authorities have not yet confirmed what will happen if the rightful owner is not found.
cn: 当局尚未确认如果找不到合法所有者将如何处理这两幅画作。

en: Nevertheless, it is speculated that they could either be handed over to the National Art Museum of Cologne or sold to the public by the local government.
cn: 尽管如此，有猜测认为它们可能会被移交给科隆国家艺术博物馆，或由地方政府向公众出售。

en: A four-year-old girl has walked eight kilometers through a snowy forest to seek help for her sick grandmother who later died of a heart attack.
cn: 一名四岁女孩穿越八公里积雪森林，为生病的祖母寻求帮助，她的祖母后来因心脏病发作去世。

en: The young girl braved the threat of bears, wolves and temperatures far below freezing.
cn: 这名小女孩不畏熊和狼的威胁以及远低于冰点的严寒气温。

en: She made the journey through a remote region in Siberia after waking up to find her grandmother motionless.
cn: 她醒来发现祖母一动不动后，穿越西伯利亚偏远地区踏上了这段旅程。

en: Named locally as Karla, she lives alone with her elderly grandmother and her blind grandfather.
cn: 当地人称她为卡拉，她和年迈的祖母及双目失明的祖父相依为命。

en: As a result, the girl's mother is facing a criminal case.
cn: 因此，女孩的母亲正面临刑事指控。

en: She stands accused of leaving a minor in danger in the care of the elderly.
cn: 她被指控将未成年人置于危险之中，交由老人照看。

en: She also faces investigation from childcare services, who will also be asking why Karla was left alone with her vulnerable relatives.
cn: 她还面临儿童服务机构的调查，他们将追问为何让卡拉独自与体弱的亲属在一起。

en: The journey took place in February when temperatures average negative 26 degrees Celsius.
cn: 这段旅程发生在二月，当时平均气温为零下26摄氏度。

en: Russian reports on social media suggest the forest may have been as cold as negative 34 degrees Celsius.
cn: 俄罗斯社交媒体上的报道显示，森林中气温可能低至零下34摄氏度。

en: The journey was only recently confirmed by authorities.
cn: 当局最近才证实了这段旅程。

en: But though she was suffering from the effects of extreme cold, the child reportedly suffered no life-threatening effects.
cn: 但据报道，尽管她承受着极度严寒的影响，这名孩子并未出现危及生命的后果。

en: Last year, a three-year-old boy survived alone for three days in a remote forest in the same region.
cn: 去年，同一地区一名三岁男孩曾在偏远森林中独自生存了三天。

en: I've made a new friend recently.
cn: 我最近交了一个新朋友。

en: Her name is Susan and she's from South Africa.
cn: 她叫苏珊，来自南非。

en: How did you meet her?
cn: 你们是怎么认识的？

en: We met over WeChat.
cn: 我们是通过微信认识的。

en: She has very cool photos on her social media.
cn: 她社交媒体上的照片很酷。

en: The photos of her hometown look amazing.
cn: 她家乡的照片看起来太美了。

en: What's her hometown called?
cn: 她的家乡叫什么？

en: It's called Cape Town.
cn: 叫开普敦。

en: It's in the southwest of South Africa.
cn: 位于南非西南部。

en: She says it's very green and windy.
cn: 她说那里绿意盎然，风很大。

en: The city was built by European settlers.
cn: 这座城市由欧洲定居者建造。

en: And there's a big mountain that overlooks the city.
cn: 有一座大山俯瞰全城。

en: The mountain is called Table Mountain because it's flat at the top.
cn: 这座山叫桌山，因为山顶是平的。

en: That sounds interesting.
cn: 听起来很有意思。

en: What are the people there like?
cn: 那里的人怎么样？

en: Well, Susan says South Africa is very mixed.
cn: 嗯，苏珊说南非是个非常多元化的地方。

en: There are black people and white people and Indian people.
cn: 有黑人、白人和印度人。

en: Susan is white.
cn: 苏珊是白人。

en: She says her ancestors were from Britain.
cn: 她说她的祖先来自英国。

en: Many languages are spoken in South Africa, but she only speaks English.
cn: 南非有很多种语言，但她只会说英语。

en: Didn't South Africa host the Football World Cup a few years ago?
cn: 南非几年前不是举办过足球世界杯吗？

en: They must play football a lot then, right?
cn: 那他们一定经常踢足球吧？

en: I think they play football, but it's not as popular as rugby.
cn: 我觉得他们也踢足球，但没有橄榄球受欢迎。

en: Rugby?
cn: 橄榄球？

en: What's rugby?
cn: 橄榄球是什么？

en: Rugby is a sport with two teams and the players carry the ball in their arms and throw it at each other.
cn: 橄榄球是两队比赛，球员用手臂抱着球互相传递。

en: The ball is not round and the players push each other.
cn: 球不是圆的，球员之间互相推撞。

en: I don't really understand the rules.
cn: 我不太懂规则。

en: I think it's very complicated.
cn: 我觉得很复杂。

en: That sounds like a very strange sport indeed.
cn: 这听起来确实是一项很奇特的运动。

en: Is it only South Africa that plays it?
cn: 只有南非才玩吗？

en: No, it's also popular in Britain and in other former British colonies like Australia and New Zealand.
cn: 不，它在英国以及澳大利亚、新西兰等其他前英国殖民地也很受欢迎。

en: Hi, Jennifer.
cn: 嗨，詹妮弗。

en: I'm really struggling with this semester's workload.
cn: 我真的难以应对这学期的学业负担。

en: Do you have any advice?
cn: 你有什么建议吗？

en: Have you considered making a study guide?
cn: 你有没有考虑过制作学习指南？

en: It's a tool you can make yourself to take the stress out of studying.
cn: 这是你自己可以制作的工具，能够减轻学习压力。

en: I've been using one since the start of last semester, and it has really helped relieve a lot of study pressure.
cn: 我从上学期开始一直在用，确实帮我缓解了很多学习压力。

en: Sounds like just what I need.
cn: 听起来正是我需要的。

en: My main problem is that my study folder is full of notes and worksheets, and is badly disorganized.
cn: 我的主要问题是学习文件夹里塞满了笔记和练习题，整理得一塌糊涂。

en: I don't know where to start.
cn: 我不知道从哪里开始。

en: Okay.
cn: 好的。

en: Well, the main thing is to have everything in the right place.
cn: 最重要的是把所有东西都放在合适的位置。

en: Whatever you're reviewing, it's important that it's arranged for your particular needs of that subject, and in the most user-friendly way you can.
cn: 无论你在复习什么，重要的是根据那门学科的特定需求来整理，以对你来说最方便的方式来安排。

en: What kind of learner are you?
cn: 你是哪种类型的学习者？

en: Um, I'm not sure.
cn: 嗯，我不确定。

en: Well, visual learners prefer using images, pictures, colors, and maps to organize information.
cn: 嗯，视觉型学习者倾向于使用图像、图片、颜色和思维导图来整理信息。

en: Logical learners have a linear mind and would rather use logic, reasoning and systems.
cn: 逻辑型学习者思维线性，更倾向于使用逻辑、推理和系统方法。

en: I'm an emotional learner, which means I need to connect to information emotionally to understand it.
cn: 我是情感型学习者，意味着我需要在情感上与信息产生联结才能理解它。

en: Oh!
cn: 哦！

en: I'm very much dependent on vision as a way of taking in information.
cn: 我非常依赖视觉来接收信息。

en: Well, I suggest reorganizing your notes using color-coded sections in your study guides, or using idea mapping to lay out the information and make it more quickly accessible.
cn: 嗯，我建议你在学习指南中用颜色分类来重新整理笔记，或者使用思维导图来布局信息，使其更易于快速获取。

en: So you think I should arrange my notes using color and pictures in place of text.
cn: 所以你认为我应该用颜色和图片而不是文字来整理笔记。

en: Yes, you'll probably start to grasp information a lot quicker that way.
cn: 是的，这样你可能会更快地掌握信息。

en: As an emotional learner, I organize my notes into a story that I can connect to and recite to myself.
cn: 作为情感型学习者，我把笔记整理成一个我能产生共鸣并能对自己复述的故事。

en: That's amazing.
cn: 太神奇了。

en: I didn't know there were so many different ways to learn.
cn: 我不知道还有这么多不同的学习方式。

en: The golden rule is a moral principle which states that you should treat others the way you want to be treated yourself.
cn: 黄金法则是一条道德准则，主张你应该以你希望别人对待你的方式来对待别人。

en: For example, if you want people to treat you with respect, you should treat them with respect.
cn: 例如，如果你希望别人尊重你，你就应该尊重他们。

en: Different people tend to be exposed to different forms of the golden rule, based on factors such as the religion in their society.
cn: 不同的人往往接触到不同形式的黄金法则，这取决于社会中的宗教等因素。

en: However, all forms of the golden rule revolve around the same concept.
cn: 然而，所有形式的黄金法则都围绕同一个概念。

en: Namely, they help you treat others better, by using the way you yourself would want to be treated as a guide of how to behave.
cn: 即它们通过将你自己希望被对待的方式作为行为准则，帮助你更好地对待他人。

en: A notable criticism of the golden rule is that its application can lead to undesirable outcomes, when it conflicts with laws and ethical principles.
cn: 对黄金法则的一个显著批评是，当它与法律和道德原则相冲突时，其应用可能导致不良后果。

en: For example, if someone breaks the law, the golden rule would suggest that we should let them go, because we would not want to be punished ourselves.
cn: 例如，如果有人违法，黄金法则会建议我们放过他们，因为我们自己也不希望受到惩罚。

en: However, this issue with the golden rule can be dealt with in a general manner, by viewing this principle as one of several principles that we use to guide our behavior as individuals and as a society.
cn: 然而，这一问题可以通过一种普遍的方式处理，即将这一原则视为我们作为个人和社会用来指导行为的几条原则之一。

en: Specifically, in the example described above, most individuals and societies choose to place laws and ethical principles above the golden rule.
cn: 具体而言，在上述例子中，大多数个人和社会选择将法律和道德原则置于黄金法则之上。

en: This means that they strive to implement the golden rule whenever possible, as long as it doesn't clash with a more important concept.
cn: 这意味着他们努力在尽可能的情况下践行黄金法则，只要它不与更重要的准则相冲突。

en: Today, many large corporations stress the importance of diversity on their websites, but current statistics show that the typical manager in America still tends to be white and male.
cn: 如今，许多大型企业在其网站上强调多样性的重要性，但目前的统计数据显示，美国典型的管理者仍然往往是白人男性。

en: Obviously, the desire to bring about diversity has not translated into corporate reality.
cn: 显然，推动多样性的愿望并未转化为企业现实。

en: A team of researchers from the University of Basel published their new study about people's attitudes towards diversity at work.
cn: 巴塞尔大学的一组研究人员发表了一项关于人们对职场多样性态度的新研究。

en: They found that people have a wide range of opinions concerning diversity.
cn: 他们发现，人们对多样性有着各种各样的看法。

en: On the one hand, many see value in diversity, which can contribute a variety of perspectives, encourage new ideas, and generate innovative solutions.
cn: 一方面，许多人看到了多样性的价值，它能贡献多元视角、激发新想法、产生创新解决方案。

en: On the other hand, they assume that it might be difficult to work with someone who has completely different views, speaks a different language, or has a different style of work.
cn: 另一方面，人们又担心与观点迥异、语言不通或工作风格不同的人合作可能会很困难。

en: The actual value they attribute to diversity depends on the decision-making perspective.
cn: 他们赋予多样性的实际价值取决于决策视角。

en: Doubts about the practicability of diversity have a greater weight if a person is directly affected.
cn: 如果一个人直接受到影响，对多样性可行性的疑虑就有更大的分量。

en: In other words, when a person's own work group is involved, they tend to prefer team members who are similar to themselves.
cn: 换句话说，当涉及自己所在的工作团队时，人们倾向于选择与自己相似的团队成员。

en: But when people make decisions for others, they typically put together a more diverse team.
cn: 但当人们为他人做决策时，他们通常会组建更多元化的团队。

en: These findings could help organizations become more diverse.
cn: 这些发现可以帮助企业实现更大的多样性。

en: Companies need to pay attention to who makes hiring and team decisions.
cn: 企业需要关注由谁来做招聘和团队决策。

en: These decisions should not only be made by those directly affected.
cn: 这些决策不应仅由直接受影响的人做出。

en: People who are not directly involved in the group's daily work should also take part.
cn: 未直接参与团队日常工作的人也应参与其中。

en: Communication can essentially be divided into two categories—the written and the spoken.
cn: 沟通本质上可以分为两类——书面沟通和口头沟通。

en: How the balance is struck between these two forms of communication—the point at which one needs to be exchanged for another—really depends on individual cultures.
cn: 这两种沟通形式之间如何取得平衡——在什么情况下需要从一种切换到另一种——实际上取决于不同的文化。

en: Understanding when it's appropriate to exchange one form for another can be a major key to success in international business.
cn: 了解何时适合将一种沟通方式转换为另一种，可能是国际商务成功的一大关键。

en: Many cultures place a much greater value on the spoken word than the American working culture does.
cn: 许多文化对口头表达的重视程度远超美国职场文化。

en: In parts of the Middle East, you'll find spoken word agreements are seen as seriously binding.
cn: 在中东部分地区，口头协议被视为具有严肃约束力。

en: A person's word is linked to their honor, so verbal agreements are seen as important, whereas written contracts are taken as memos of understanding.
cn: 一个人的诺言与其荣誉挂钩，因此口头协议被视为重要承诺，而书面合同则被看作是理解备忘录。

en: Western working culture tends to place a high value on the written word, and this reaches its highest level of intensity when it comes to contracts.
cn: 西方职场文化倾向于高度重视书面文字，这种重视在涉及合同时尤为突出。

en: In the US, France and Germany, written contracts tend to be seen as something that must be strictly carried out.
cn: 在美国、法国和德国，书面合同往往被视为必须严格执行的文件。

en: By contrast, other cultures may not see written contracts as quite so binding.
cn: 相比之下，其他文化可能不认为书面合同具有那么强的约束力。

en: It can prove a challenge to Western businesses if your business partner wants to renegotiate terms that you thought were already agreed on.
cn: 如果你的商业伙伴想要重新谈判你认为已经达成共识的条款，这对西方企业来说可能是一个挑战。

en: For example, a Japanese firm may have signed a contract, but they may not feel bound by every detail of it—particularly if circumstances later change.
cn: 例如，一家日本公司可能已经签署了合同，但他们可能不觉得受合同每个细节的约束——尤其是当情况后来发生变化时。

en: White meat, such as chicken, may raise blood cholesterol levels as much as red meat does.
cn: 鸡肉等白肉可能会像红肉一样提高血液胆固醇水平。

en: This finding surprised researchers, who admitted they didn't expect that eating white meat would lead to higher blood cholesterol levels.
cn: 这一发现让研究人员感到惊讶，他们承认没有想到吃白肉会导致更高的血液胆固醇水平。

en: In the study, researchers looked at 113 healthy people.
cn: 在这项研究中，研究人员观察了113名健康人。

en: The participants ate three different diets.
cn: 参与者食用了三种不同的饮食。

en: These were a red meat diet which is primarily beef, a white meat diet which is mostly chicken and turkey, and a vegetarian protein diet.
cn: 分别是红肉饮食（主要是牛肉）、白肉饮食（主要是鸡肉和火鸡）和素食蛋白饮食。

en: Each diet period was four weeks.
cn: 每种饮食周期为四周。

en: Between the diet periods, participants had a break, during which they ate their regular foods.
cn: 在饮食周期之间，参与者有一段休息期，期间他们正常饮食。

en: In addition, participants had blood tests at the start and finish of each new diet.
cn: 此外，参与者在每种新饮食开始和结束时都进行了血液检测。

en: The results showed that white and red meat diets had the same effects on blood cholesterol levels.
cn: 结果显示，白肉和红肉饮食对血液胆固醇水平的影响相同。

en: Further, both diets increased blood cholesterol levels compared with the diet built on vegetarian protein sources.
cn: 此外，与素食蛋白饮食相比，这两种饮食都提高了血液胆固醇水平。

en: The team acknowledged that it is possible that white meat is better for our health than red meat despite their findings.
cn: 研究小组承认，尽管他们的研究结果如此，白肉仍可能比红肉更有益于健康。

en: This is because other effects of red meat consumption could contribute to heart disease independent of cholesterol.
cn: 这是因为食用红肉的其他影响可能导致心脏病，与胆固醇无关。

en: Their main recommendations are that people eat less of both kinds of meat and more vegetarian protein.
cn: 他们的主要建议是人们少吃这两种肉类，多吃素食蛋白。

en: At around half past nine this morning, a trailer attached to a lorry turned over at the crossing of High Street in Milton.
cn: 今天上午九点半左右，一辆挂在卡车上的拖车在米尔顿商业街十字路口翻倒了。

en: Hundreds of frozen turkeys were spilled all over the road.
cn: 数百只冷冻火鸡散落在道路上。

en: It is reported that nobody was hurt in the incident, but police said it may affect traffic and Christmas dinners.
cn: 据报道，事故中无人受伤，但警方表示这可能会影响交通和圣诞晚餐。

en: With just one week to go before Christmas, there are worries that local supermarket supplies of this holiday favorite may be affected.
cn: 距离圣诞节只有一周了，人们担心当地超市这种节日最受欢迎食品的供应可能会受到影响。

en: A police spokeswoman said that officers were currently in attendance at the scene.
cn: 一名警方女发言人说，警官目前正在现场。

en: She stated that the driver of the lorry had been arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving.
cn: 她表示，卡车司机因涉嫌危险驾驶已被逮捕。

en: The crossing on High Street is a well-known accident blackspot.
cn: 商业街的十字路口是众所周知的事故多发地段。

en: This year alone, there have been seven traffic accidents at this location.
cn: 仅今年一年，这个地方就已发生了七起交通事故。

en: Thankfully, none of these accidents have resulted in serious injury.
cn: 幸运的是，这些事故都没有造成严重伤害。

en: India launched its helicopter taxi service on Monday, promising to ferry customers the 40 miles between Bangalore's Electronic City tech hub and the International Airport terminal in 15 minutes.
cn: 印度周一推出了直升机出租车服务，承诺在15分钟内将乘客从班加罗尔电子城科技中心运送到国际机场航站楼，全程40英里。

en: Customers can book their helicopter ride through a mobile app.
cn: 乘客可以通过手机应用程序预订直升机。

en: The service, which claims to be the first of its kind in India, offers only one route, but Bangalore airport will add more once it gets approval.
cn: 该服务据称在印度尚属首创，目前仅提供一条航线，但班加罗尔机场一旦获得批准将增加更多航线。

en: Helicopter taxi is not an affordable option for many travelers.
cn: 直升机出租车对许多旅客来说并非负担得起的选择。

en: A car ride for the same journey costs less than half as much.
cn: 同样行程的汽车费用不到其一半。

en: But Bangalore airport says it is a competitive alternative to a car ride for tech executives in a hurry.
cn: 但班加罗尔机场表示，对于匆忙赶路的技术高管来说，这是一种有竞争力的替代选择。

en: "A large number of high-class travelers, including CEOs, have to spend more than three hours by road to get there—and that is a loss of time," a Bangalore airport spokesperson said.
cn: 班加罗尔机场的一位发言人说："大量高端旅客，包括首席执行官，必须花费三个多小时才能到达那里——这是时间的浪费。"

en: "This is not a low cost option, but it is an option," she added.
cn: "这不是低成本选择，但确实是一个选择，"她补充道。

en: The helicopters ferried around eight customers to the airport on their first day.
cn: 直升机在首日运送了约八名乘客前往机场。

en: The company that owns and operates the service is called Thumby Aviation.
cn: 拥有并运营该服务的公司名为桑比航空。

en: It previously specialized in private charter flights for government officials.
cn: 该公司此前专门为政府官员提供私人包机服务。

en: Hi, I wish to buy some cheese for a barbecue this weekend.
cn: 你好，我想买些奶酪，周末烧烤用。

en: What kind would you like?
cn: 您想要哪种？

en: Sorry, I don't know much about cheese.
cn: 抱歉，我对奶酪不太了解。

en: What type do you think would be suitable for a barbecue?
cn: 您觉得哪种适合烧烤？

en: That's easy!
cn: 很简单！

en: For a barbecue, you could have any cheese you want.
cn: 烧烤的话，您可以选任何奶酪。

en: I imagine there will be different foods and people will just help themselves and eat at their own pace, right?
cn: 我想会有不同的食物，人们会自取并按自己的节奏吃，对吧？

en: Yes, exactly.
cn: 是的，没错。

en: It will be very casual.
cn: 会很随意。

en: We will just be a small group of friends gathering together at Washington Park.
cn: 我们只是一小群朋友在华盛顿公园聚会。

en: There will be around 20 of us, including children.
cn: 大约20人，包括孩子。

en: Great!
cn: 太好了！

en: So you could have different types of cheese.
cn: 那您可以选不同种类的奶酪。

en: How much would you like to spend?
cn: 您打算花多少钱？

en: Not very much.
cn: 不想花太多。

en: Let's say $30.
cn: 大概30美元吧。

en: I would suggest having at least one soft cheese and one hard cheese.
cn: 我建议至少买一块软奶酪和一块硬奶酪。

en: That will offer you a good variety to suit different people's tastes.
cn: 这样种类丰富，能满足不同人的口味。

en: That sounds good.
cn: 听起来不错。

en: What's the difference between a soft cheese and a hard cheese?
cn: 软奶酪和硬奶酪有什么区别？

en: Well, it depends.
cn: 嗯，这要看情况。

en: But generally speaking, soft cheeses are creamy and go well with sweet things like honey and jam.
cn: 但一般来说，软奶酪口感柔滑，适合搭配蜂蜜和果酱等甜食。

en: I would suggest something like this Spanish goat cheese.
cn: 我推荐这种西班牙山羊奶酪。

en: It's only $15, a very good price.
cn: 只要15美元，价格很实惠。

en: You can spread it on bread with a knife, and then add a tiny bit of honey on top.
cn: 你可以用刀把它抹在面包上，然后在上面加一点蜂蜜。

en: It's delicious.
cn: 味道很好。

en: Children love it.
cn: 孩子们喜欢。

en: Okay, great.
cn: 好的，不错。

en: What about a hard cheese?
cn: 那硬奶酪呢？

en: Yes, for hard cheese, I would recommend this Italian one here.
cn: 好的，硬奶酪的话，我推荐这款意大利奶酪。

en: It has a very strong smell and a dry flavor.
cn: 它的味道很浓郁，口感偏干。

en: You can cut it into thin slices and eat it on its own.
cn: 你可以切成薄片单独吃。
16美元。

en: Okay, I'll take both.
cn: 好的，两种我都要了。

en: Thank you for your help.
cn: 谢谢您的帮助。

en: Our school is replacing printed textbooks with e-textbooks next semester.
cn: 我们学校下学期要用电子课本取代纸质课本了。

en: I can't wait.
cn: 我等不及了。

en: Really?
cn: 真的吗？

en: What about the cost, not only buying all those tablets, but the software and electronic infrastructure that goes with it, not to mention retraining all the teachers and administration staff?
cn: 费用怎么办？不仅要买那些平板电脑，还要配套的软件和电子基础设施，更不用说对所有教师和行政人员进行再培训了。

en: Sure, the initial expenditure will be high, but much lower afterwards.
cn: 当然，初期支出会很高，但之后会低很多。

en: Besides that, tablet prices continue to drop and are becoming increasingly affordable.
cn: 此外，平板电脑的价格在持续下降，越来越便宜。

en: Anyway, tablets help students learn up to 80% faster.
cn: 不管怎样，平板电脑可以帮助学生提高高达80%的学习速度。

en: Not necessarily.
cn: 不一定。

en: Tablets have too many distractions.
cn: 平板电脑有太多让人分心的东西。

en: Students may pay attention to apps, games and websites instead of their teachers.
cn: 学生可能会关注应用程序、游戏和网站，而不是老师。

en: In fact, research suggests that people who read printed text comprehend more, remember more and learn 30% more than those who read digital text.
cn: 事实上，研究表明，阅读纸质文本的人比阅读数字文本的人理解更多、记得更多，学习效果也高出30%。

en: Yes.
cn: 是的。

en: But tablets contain many technological features that are not found in printed textbooks.
cn: 但平板电脑包含许多纸质课本没有的技术功能。

en: Think about it.
cn: 想想看。

en: Students are able to highlight and edit text, write notes and search for information much more quickly than they can with printed textbooks.
cn: 学生可以高亮和编辑文本、做笔记、搜索信息，比用纸质课本快得多。

en: And what about all those trees that are cut down to make printed books?
cn: 还有那些为了制造纸质书而被砍伐的树木呢？

en: Actually, manufacturing tablets is environmentally destructive and dangerous to human health.
cn: 事实上，制造平板电脑会破坏环境，而且对人类健康有害。

en: The health impacts from making one electronic reader are 70 times greater than those from making a single printed book.
cn: 制造一台电子阅读器对健康的影响是制作一本纸质书的70倍。

en: A lot of minerals are extracted from the earth to make electronic readers.
cn: 制造电子阅读器需要从地球中提取大量矿物。

en: It does far more damage to the environment.
cn: 它对环境造成的损害要大得多。

en: Yes.
cn: 是的。

en: But the software for electronic readers can be updated instantly without the need for buying a whole lot of new books.
cn: 但电子阅读器的软件可以即时更新，不需要购买大量新书。

en: That's better for the environment.
cn: 这对环境更好。

en: But the core curriculum doesn't change that much.
cn: 但核心课程变化没有那么大。

en: Printed textbooks that are not brand new, still contain the basic relevant information of core subjects.
cn: 即使不是全新的纸质课本，仍然包含核心科目的基本相关信息。

en: Well, I'm looking forward to the change.
cn: 嗯，我很期待这种变化。

en: I'll stick with my printed books.
cn: 我还是坚持用我的纸质书。

en: In social psychology, the term "person perception" refers to the mental processes that we use to form impressions of other people.
cn: 在社会心理学中，"个体知觉"一词指的是我们用来形成对他人印象的心理过程。

en: It includes not just how we form these impressions, but the conclusions we make about other people based on our impressions.
cn: 它不仅包括我们如何形成这些印象，还包括我们基于这些印象对他人做出的结论。

en: Consider how often you make this kind of judgment every day.
cn: 想想你每天做这种判断的频率有多高。

en: When you meet with a new coworker, you immediately begin to develop an initial impression of this person.
cn: 当你遇到新同事时，你会立即开始形成对这个人的初步印象。

en: When you visit the grocery store, you might draw conclusions about the cashier who checks you out.
cn: 当你去杂货店时，你可能会对为你结账的收银员做出判断。

en: Obviously, person perception is a very subjective process that can be affected by a number of variables, including the characteristics of the person you are observing, the context of the situation, your own personal traits, and your past experiences.
cn: 显然，个体知觉是一个非常主观的过程，会受到许多变量的影响，包括你正在观察的人的特征、情境背景、你自己的个人特质以及你的过往经历。

en: One of the techniques we use in person perception is social categorization.
cn: 我们在个体知觉中使用的一种技巧是社会分类。

en: In this process, we mentally categorize people into different groups based on common characteristics.
cn: 在这个过程中，我们根据共同特征在心理上将人分为不同的群体。

en: Problems with this technique include the fact that it can lead to errors and prejudice.
cn: 这种技巧的问题在于它可能导致错误和偏见。

en: Imagine that you are getting on a bus.
cn: 想象你正在上公交车。

en: There are only two seats available.
cn: 只有两个座位空着。

en: One is next to a small, elderly woman; the other is next to a muscular, fierce-looking man.
cn: 一个靠在一名瘦小的老妇人旁边，另一个靠在一个肌肉发达、面目凶狠的男人旁边。

en: You sit next to the elderly woman, who unfortunately turns out to be quite skilled at picking pockets.
cn: 你坐在老妇人旁边，不幸的是，她原来是个熟练的扒手。

en: Because of social categorization, you immediately judge the woman as harmless, and the man as threatening, leading to the loss of your wallet.
cn: 由于社会分类，你立即判断老妇人无害，而男人有威胁，最终导致钱包丢失。

en: Despite smartphones and social media, young people today are as socially competent as those from the previous generation.
cn: 尽管有智能手机和社交媒体，今天的年轻人在社交能力上与上一代人一样。

en: At least this is what a new study suggests.
cn: 至少一项新的研究表明如此。

en: For the study, researchers compared teacher and parent evaluations of American children who started kindergarten in 1998, with those who began school in 2010.
cn: 在这项研究中，研究人员比较了教师和家长对1998年开始上幼儿园的美国儿童与2010年开始上学的美国儿童的评估。

en: The former group entered kindergarten when mobile phones were luxuries.
cn: 前一组进入幼儿园时手机还是奢侈品。

en: The latter group started school when mobile devices were widespread.
cn: 后一组开始上学时移动设备已经普及。

en: Results showed both groups of children were rated similarly on important social skills.
cn: 结果显示，两组孩子在重要的社交技能方面得分相似。

en: These included their ability to form and maintain friendships and get along with people who are different.
cn: 包括建立和维持友谊的能力以及与不同的人相处的能力。

en: They were also rated similarly on self-control, such as the ability to regulate their temper.
cn: 他们在自控力方面得分也相似，比如控制脾气的能力。

en: In virtually every comparison made, ratings of social skills either remain constant or improved for the children born later.
cn: 在几乎所有比较中，后来出生的孩子的社交技能评分要么保持不变，要么有所提高。

en: There was one exception: Social skills were slightly lower for children who accessed online games and social networking sites many times a day.
cn: 有一个例外：每天多次访问在线游戏和社交网站的孩子社交技能略低。

en: Adults are worried when technological change starts to undermine traditional relationships, particularly the parent-child relationship.
cn: 当技术变革开始破坏传统关系，尤其是亲子关系时，成年人会感到担忧。

en: The introduction of telephones, automobiles and radio all led to moral panic among adults of the time, because the technology allowed children to enjoy more freedom.
cn: 电话、汽车和收音机的引入都曾引发当时成年人的道德恐慌，因为这些技术让孩子们享受了更多的自由。

en: Fears over screen-based technology represent the most recent panic in response to technological change.
cn: 对屏幕技术的担忧代表了最近一次对技术变革的恐慌。

en: But overall, the study found little evidence that time spent on screens was hurting social skills for most children.
cn: 但总体而言，这项研究发现几乎没有证据表明屏幕时间对大多数孩子的社交技能造成了伤害。

en: It's easy to spend all day searching for inspiration.
cn: 花一整天寻找灵感很容易。

en: You can find incredible videos, articles and news stories about the success of others.
cn: 你可以找到关于他人成功的令人惊叹的视频、文章和新闻报道。

en: The problem is that consuming the success and ideas of others is passive inspiration.
cn: 问题在于，消费他人的成功和想法是被动的灵感。

en: Every time you read an article or listen to an interview, you're practicing passive inspiration.
cn: 每当你阅读文章或听访谈时，你都在实践被动灵感。

en: You might learn something, but you don't actually have to do anything.
cn: 你可能会学到一些东西，但你实际上不需要做任何事情。

en: Hearing about other people's success isn't the same as creating your own.
cn: 听到别人的成功并不等于创造自己的成功。

en: Instead, it is through the process of active inspiration—the act of creating things, applying new ideas to our goals, and making mistakes—that we discover who we are and what is important to us.
cn: 相反，正是通过积极灵感的过程——创造事物、将新想法应用到我们的目标中、犯错——我们才能发现自己是谁以及什么对我们重要。

en: Furthermore, active inspiration is what results in long-term passion and enthusiasm.
cn: 此外，积极灵感才能带来长期的激情和热情。

en: Watching someone else's success might leave you feeling excited for a few minutes.
cn: 观看别人的成功可能会让你兴奋几分钟。

en: However, taking action and applying a new idea to your life will inspire you more than anything someone else can say.
cn: 然而，采取行动并将新想法应用到生活中，比任何别人说的话都更能激励你。

en: Learning and listening can help you think about things in a different way.
cn: 学习和倾听可以帮助你以不同的方式思考问题。

en: But creating, producing, and experimenting is what drives you forward.
cn: 但创造、生产和实验才是推动你前进的动力。

en: Passive inspiration can give you ideas, but active inspiration will give you power.
cn: 被动灵感可以给你想法，但积极灵感会给你力量。

en: Too often we spend our lives consuming the world around us instead of creating it.
cn: 我们常常花费生命去消费周围的世界，而不是去创造它。

en: And what matters is the power your actions have to inspire you.
cn: 重要的是你的行动对你的激励作用。

en: The best inspiration comes from the application of ideas, not the consumption of them.
cn: 最好的灵感来自想法的应用，而不是消费这些想法。

en: Operations at one of Australia's largest gold mines had to be temporarily suspended on Friday after a partial wall collapse at one of the mine's dams.
cn: 澳大利亚一处最大金矿的运营于周五被迫暂停，原因是该矿的一座拦水坝发生了局部坝墙坍塌事故。

en: The wall collapse at the Cadia mine came just a few days after two earthquakes hit the area.
cn: 卡迪亚矿山的坝墙坍塌发生在该地区遭受两次地震后短短数天内。

en: The damage to the dam wall was noticed in the late afternoon on Friday when workers found a section of the northern dam wall had collapsed into the southern dam.
cn: 周五傍晚，工人发现北侧坝墙有一部分坍塌进了南侧拦水坝，坝墙损坏情况由此被发现。

en: The dams contain waste products of mining and can contain materials which are harmful to the environment and human health.
cn: 这些拦水坝储存着采矿废料，其中可能含有对环境和人体健康有害的物质。

en: The dams are generally constructed using earth-fill and are gradually raised over time.
cn: 这类拦水坝通常采用土方填筑方式建造，随着时间推移逐步加高。

en: The company was unable to confirm whether the recent earthquakes had contributed to the dam's wall collapse, but said it was conducting a thorough investigation.
cn: 公司无法确认近期的地震是否导致了坝墙坍塌，但表示正在进行全面调查。

en: A company spokesperson said the operations at the site had been halted while the investigation is ongoing and that the break had posed no safety threat to workers.
cn: 公司发言人表示，调查期间该矿区的运营已经暂停，且此次坍塌未对工人造成安全威胁。

en: Two boys and four girls were born on Monday to the surprise of a young couple and doctors who had expected five babies.
cn: 周一，一对年轻夫妇迎来了两男四女六胞胎，令夫妇二人和原本预期生五胞胎的医生们都大吃一惊。

en: This was the first record of six babies being born at the same time in that region.
cn: 这是该地区有史以来首例六胞胎同时出生的记录。

en: The doctors prepared from early in the morning to help deliver five tiny citizens.
cn: 医生们从清晨就开始准备，迎接五名小生命的降生。

en: They were in the operating room with five teams of doctors, one for each baby.
cn: 手术室里备有五组医疗团队，每组负责一个婴儿。

en: The first five babies were delivered successfully, and all baby beds were occupied.
cn: 前五名婴儿顺利出生，所有婴儿床都已占满。

en: And then all of a sudden, it turned out there was another waiting to come out.
cn: 就在此时，突然发现还有一个婴儿在等待降生。

en: The doctor said the babies were in healthy condition, but could not go home immediately.
cn: 医生表示婴儿们状况良好，但暂时无法回家。

en: They needed to stay in the hospital for two to three months for medical supervision.
cn: 他们需在医院接受两到三个月的医疗监护。

en: The mother, who was in stable condition, could return home a day later if all physical tests came back normal.
cn: 母亲状况稳定，若各项体检指标正常，第二天即可出院。

en: The babies' mother commented that they had already prepared a room for five babies at home, so they will have to rearrange things for their happy surprise.
cn: 婴儿的母亲表示，家里已经为五个宝宝准备好了房间，现在需要为这个意外之喜重新布置。

en: The new parents have yet to name the sixth baby but are considering either Lily or Rose.
cn: 新晋父母尚未为第六个宝宝取名，正在考虑叫莉莉或罗丝。

en: A Spanish island called Palmador has been bought by a family from Europe for 18 million euros.
cn: 一个名为帕尔马多尔的西班牙小岛已被一个欧洲家庭以1800万欧元购得。

en: The island is often described as heaven on earth by holidaymakers.
cn: 这座岛屿常被度假者誉为人间天堂。

en: For decades tourists have been flocking to Palmador, which is located off the southeast coast of Spain.
cn: 数十年来，游客纷纷涌向位于西班牙东南海岸外的帕尔马多尔。

en: They come to enjoy its unspoiled beaches and crystal clear waters.
cn: 他们来此欣赏原始海滩和清澈海水。

en: Its natural beauty is protected as it lies inside a natural park.
cn: 由于地处自然公园内，岛上的自然美景受到保护。

en: Although Palmador is one of the most famous private islands in the world, its seafront is public land and is a favorite destination for famous people.
cn: 尽管帕尔马多尔是世界上最知名的私人岛屿之一，其海岸线属于公共土地，是名人们钟爱的目的地。

en: When the island was put up for sale, it was offered to the local government but proved too expensive for the local authorities.
cn: 该岛出售时曾向当地政府提出，但对地方当局而言价格过高。

en: It is said to have a remarkable location that few other private islands of this size can match, according to estate agents.
cn: 据房产中介表示，该岛拥有得天独厚的地理位置，同等规模的私人岛屿中几乎无出其右。

en: Palmador is the perfect place to retreat to, somewhere to get away from the city noise and relax in beautiful surroundings with zero stress.
cn: 帕尔马多尔是静心休憩的完美之所，远离城市喧嚣，在美丽的环境中毫无压力地放松身心。

en: Hi, Christie's Gym Center.
cn: 你好，克里斯蒂健身中心。

en: How can I help you?
cn: 请问有什么可以帮您？

en: Hi, I'm calling to ask about the newly scheduled gym classes.
cn: 你好，我打电话是想询问新开设的健身课程。

en: I'm just wondering if I can get a discount on them.
cn: 想知道是否能享受折扣。

en: Are you already a member?
cn: 您已经是会员了吗？

en: Yes, I signed up two months ago, but I haven't been to any of the group classes yet.
cn: 是的，我两个月前办了会员卡，但还没有参加过任何团体课。

en: Can I take your name please?
cn: 请问您的姓名？

en: Yes.
cn: 好的。

en: My name is Carol Friedman.
cn: 我叫卡罗尔·弗里德曼。

en: Carol Friedman.
cn: 卡罗尔·弗里德曼。

en: That's right.
cn: 好的。

en: And you signed up two months ago.
cn: 您是两个月前办的卡。

en: Currently we are offering existing members discounts off two of our brand new classes, hot yoga, and advanced spinning, but the discount doesn't apply to any of our regular classes, I'm afraid.
cn: 目前我们为现有会员提供两门全新课程的优惠——热瑜伽和高级动感单车，但恐怕折扣不适用于常规课程。

en: I'm only interested in the new classes.
cn: 我只对新课感兴趣。

en: So how much of a discount is there on these two new classes?
cn: 那这两门新课的折扣是多少？

en: The same discount of 20% is being offered to everyone at the door on a 'first come, first served' basis for the first month.
cn: 第一个月，所有现场报名者均可享受相同的八折优惠，先到先得。

en: It's a shame you missed out on the general discount.
cn: 可惜您错过了普通折扣活动。

en: But you can get 25% off if you sign up in advance.
cn: 但如果提前报名，您可以享受七五折优惠。

en: Which of the two classes are you thinking about?
cn: 您对这两门课中的哪一门感兴趣？

en: Well, I guess I am only really interested in hot yoga.
cn: 我想我只对热瑜伽真正感兴趣。

en: Can you sign me up for the 10-week course on Thursday evenings?
cn: 能帮我报名周四晚上那个为期10周的课程吗？

en: Sure.
cn: 当然可以。

en: Would you prefer to pay in advance?
cn: 您希望提前付款吗？

en: No, I don't like giving my card details over the phone anyway.
cn: 不了，我不喜欢通过电话透露银行卡信息。

en: Okay, then.
cn: 好的。

en: As you are already a member, the fee of the class will just be added to your monthly bill.
cn: 由于您已经是会员，课程费用将直接计入您的月账单。

en: Well, I think that was quite a successful trip in the end.
cn: 总体来说，我认为这次出差相当成功。

en: Don't you think, Jenny?
cn: 你觉得呢，珍妮？

en: Absolutely.
cn: 当然。

en: There are lots of great potential markets here in China.
cn: 中国市场潜力巨大。

en: So I'm sure that the head office in London will be pleased once we get back and present our research.
cn: 所以我相信，等我们回去汇报调研结果，伦敦总部一定会很满意的。

en: Okay.
cn: 好的。

en: We've got a bit of spare time now.
cn: 我们现在有点空闲时间。

en: Can we discuss the return trip to the head office?
cn: 能不能讨论一下返回总部的行程？

en: Sure.
cn: 当然。

en: I've checked the availability of flights from Beijing to London on the 22nd and you have a choice.
cn: 我查了22日从北京飞往伦敦的航班，您有两个选择。

en: There's a flight arriving the following morning, with a two-hour stopover in Dubai, or a flight arriving at 11:30 in the evening, with a five-hour stopover in Amsterdam.
cn: 一班是次日早晨到达，在迪拜中转两小时；另一班是晚上11点半到达，在阿姆斯特丹中转五小时。

en: Right.
cn: 好。

en: Well, that's obvious then, isn't it?
cn: 那显然选哪个很清楚了，对吧？

en: Okay, so that's Dubai.
cn: 好的，那就选迪拜转机的那班。

en: I've booked a room in a hotel about a mile from the office.
cn: 我已经在离办公室大约一英里处订好了酒店。

en: The nearest metro station is Earl's Court.
cn: 最近的地铁站是伯爵宫站。

en: Great.
cn: 太好了。

en: Can you find a map that shows where the hotel is and send it to me online?
cn: 你能找一张标注酒店位置的地图，在线发给我吗？

en: I've never been to the head office, you know.
cn: 你知道，我从来没去过总部。

en: I want to see if I can get one of those rental bicycles and ride to the office just for fun.
cn: 我想看看能不能租辆自行车骑去办公室，就当体验一下。

en: For the presentation, I'll bring my own laptop and hook it up to their projector.
cn: 汇报时我带自己的笔记本电脑，连接他们的投影仪。

en: Do you remember the capacity of their meeting room?
cn: 你还记得他们会议室的容纳人数吗？

en: No, but I'll check.
cn: 不记得了，不过我会查一下。

en: Just one more thing.
cn: 还有最后一件事。

en: I'll pay everything with my own card, right?
cn: 所有费用我用自己的卡支付，对吧？

en: And I'll submit my claims form afterwards.
cn: 之后再提交报销单。

en: No problem.
cn: 没问题。

en: Just remember to keep all your receipts.
cn: 记得保留所有收据。

en: You remember the trouble you had last time.
cn: 你记得上次出的麻烦吧。

en: A new study has demonstrated the importance of women's rights.
cn: 一项新研究揭示了女性权利的重要性。

en: The researchers behind the study state that many parts of the world have made good economic progress, but women's rights are often overlooked.
cn: 研究人员指出，世界许多地区在经济上取得了良好进展，但女性权利往往被忽视。

en: Thus, they wanted to determine if there was a link between protection of women's rights and public health.
cn: 因此，他们希望确定女性权利保护与公共健康之间是否存在关联。

en: The researchers analyzed databases which held information from 162 countries for the period 2004 to 2010.
cn: 研究人员分析了涵盖162个国家2004年至2010年间信息的数据库。

en: Countries were classified according to the respect they gave to women's economic and social rights.
cn: 各国根据其对女性经济权利和社会权利的尊重程度被分类。

en: There were three categories: high, moderate, and poor.
cn: 分为三类：高、中、低。

en: Analysis of the data showed that countries with strong women's rights had better health than those where women's rights were not as respected.
cn: 数据分析显示，女性权利保障较好的国家，其健康水平优于女性权利不受重视的国家。

en: The health indicators studied included disease prevention, reproductive health, death rates, and life expectancy.
cn: 研究所考察的健康指标包括疾病预防、生殖健康、死亡率和预期寿命。

en: Furthermore, in countries where women's rights were most respected, but access to hospitals and doctors was below average, health outcomes were still better than in countries rated as moderate or poor.
cn: 此外，在女性权利保障程度最高、但医疗资源低于平均水平的国家，其健康结果仍优于被评为中等或较差水平的国家。

en: This confirms that even with a lack of resources, if a country has strong women's rights, the health outcomes are better.
cn: 这证实了即便资源匮乏，只要女性权利得到有力保障，健康结果就会更好。

en: Thus, the researchers argued that gender equality is not just a women's rights issue.
cn: 因此，研究人员认为，性别平等不仅仅是女性权利问题。

en: It is also a development issue.
cn: 也是发展问题。

en: This is because better health aids economic development.
cn: 因为更好的健康状况有助于经济发展。

en: They note that the value of women's rights has often been questioned from an economic standpoint.
cn: 他们指出，女性权利的价值常常在经济层面受到质疑。

en: Some have argued that ensuring those rights would limit progress, but this study indicates the opposite.
cn: 有人认为保障女性权利会限制发展，但这项研究的结论恰恰相反。

en: Sunshine and high temperatures can mean picnics and parks and trips to beaches, but they can make your body react in some strange ways.
cn: 阳光和高温意味着野餐、公园和海滩之旅，但它们也会让你的身体产生一些奇怪的反应。

en: First, sunshine can actually affect your breath.
cn: 首先，阳光实际上会影响你的口气。

en: You may think that summer is the perfect time to go on a date or chat with an attractive boy or girl.
cn: 你可能觉得夏天是约会或与心仪的人聊天的好时机。

en: But excessive heat can cause you to lose water, which has been proven to have a pretty unattractive side effect—bad breath.
cn: 但过度高温会导致你失去水分，而这已被证明会带来一个相当令人尴尬的副作用——口臭。

en: When you are lacking water, your mouth becomes dry.
cn: 当你缺水时，口腔会变得干燥。

en: Bacteria accumulate because there isn't enough water in your mouth to wash it away.
cn: 由于口腔中没有足够的水分冲走细菌，细菌便会大量繁殖。

en: Sunshine can stop you from sweating, too.
cn: 阳光还可能导致你停止出汗。

en: The body's normal temperature is 36 to 37 degrees centigrade.
cn: 人体正常体温为36至37摄氏度。

en: But if it heats up to 40 to 41 degrees, you may find yourself getting heatstroke.
cn: 但一旦升至40至41摄氏度，你可能就会中暑。

en: At that point, your heat regulatory system can essentially quit, which stops you from sweating as your body tries to keep water around your vital organs.
cn: 此时，你的体温调节系统基本上会'罢工'，阻止你出汗，因为身体试图将水分保留在重要器官周围。

en: However, the sun can have a positive influence on your body by raising your energy levels.
cn: 然而，阳光也能对你的身体产生积极影响，提升你的能量水平。

en: You might feel like the sun is giving you extra energy for your day, which is actually happening.
cn: 你可能感觉阳光给了你一整天的额外活力，这种感觉实际上是真实发生的。

en: And vitamin D from sunshine can help your body to absorb certain minerals, which are linked to building stronger bones.
cn: 阳光中的维生素D还能帮助身体吸收某些矿物质，这与强健骨骼有关。

en: Therefore, I suggest you spend more time in the park with your friends, but make sure you apply lots of skin protection and fill up those water bottles, too.
cn: 因此，我建议你多和朋友在公园里活动，但一定要做好防晒，并记得多补充水分。

en: Left-handed people can find it inconvenient to do certain things, writing in a notebook for example, but there are a number of advantages of being left-handed.
cn: 左撇子在某些事情上可能会感到不便，比如在笔记本上写字，但左撇子也有许多优势。

en: Research found that they were overrepresented among fighters in combat sports.
cn: 研究发现，左撇子在格斗运动的参赛者中占比超出平均水平。

en: Left-handed fighters also had higher chances to win.
cn: 左撇子格斗选手的获胜概率更高。

en: This confirms the fighter theory.
cn: 这印证了格斗优势理论。

en: Left-handers may also be better at remembering events.
cn: 左撇子在记忆事件方面可能也更出色。

en: The explanation is that the two brain spheres of left-handers are more strongly connected.
cn: 原因在于左撇子的两个大脑半球之间的连接更强。

en: Being left-handed might be a factor in mathematical ability.
cn: 左撇子可能也是数学能力的影响因素。

en: An Italian study found that for simple arithmetic there was little difference between right- and left-handed performance, but for more difficult problem-solving, left-handers won out.
cn: 一项意大利研究发现，在简单运算方面，左撇子和右撇子的表现差异不大，但在较复杂的解题中，左撇子更胜一筹。

en: No one understands the reason for this.
cn: 原因尚不清楚。

en: Left-handed people may think differently.
cn: 左撇子的思维方式可能也与众不同。

en: In one study, researchers showed the participants columns of abstract illustrations and asked them which ones they would prefer.
cn: 在一项研究中，研究人员向参与者展示了几列抽象图案，询问他们更喜欢哪些。

en: Left-handed people were more likely to prefer the images on the left.
cn: 左撇子更倾向于选择左边的图案。

en: Right-handed people preferred the ones on the right.
cn: 右撇子则更喜欢右边的图案。

en: Both groups disliked stuff on their opposite side.
cn: 两组都不喜欢对侧的图案。

en: Left-handers are also overrepresented in professional, interactive sports.
cn: 左撇子在职业互动性运动中也占比偏高。

en: Researchers have looked at the influence of being left-handed on performance and interactive sports.
cn: 研究人员研究了左撇子对竞技互动运动成绩的影响。

en: Those that require the fastest reaction give left-handers the biggest advantage.
cn: 在需要最快反应速度的运动项目中，左撇子的优势最为显著。

en: So if you have a left-handed child, you should encourage them to play table tennis, baseball and tennis.
cn: 因此，如果你有一个左撇子孩子，应该鼓励他们打乒乓球、棒球和网球。

en: Being left-handed maximizes their chances of success in these sports.
cn: 左撇子在这些运动中的成功概率最高。

en: The World Pipe Band Championships will take place in Glasgow on Saturday.
cn: 世界风笛乐队锦标赛将于周六在格拉斯哥举行。

en: Over 120 of the world's best pipe bands will compete at the championships.
cn: 全球120余支顶尖风笛乐队将参加本次赛事。

en: Over 4,000 pipers and drummers are expected to descend on the city for the annual event.
cn: 预计超过4000名风笛手和鼓手将涌入这座城市参加这一年度盛会。

en: It will take place at the St. James Playing Fields in Glasgow on Saturday, 18 May from 10:00 am until 7:00 pm.
cn: 赛事将于5月18日周六上午10点至下午7点在格拉斯哥圣詹姆斯运动场举行。

en: The event is free.
cn: 活动免费入场。

en: Also, a free shuttle bus will run between the event car parks and the competition site.
cn: 同时设有免费接驳巴士往返于停车场与赛场之间。

en: Glasgow City Council says it is estimated to bring £300,000 to the local economy.
cn: 格拉斯哥市议会表示，预计此次赛事将为当地经济带来30万英镑的收益。

en: The first World Pipe Band Championships were held in Edinburgh in 1947.
cn: 首届世界风笛乐队锦标赛于1947年在爱丁堡举办。

en: The event first took place in Glasgow in 1948.
cn: 1948年首次移师格拉斯哥。

en: It has been held regularly in Glasgow since 1986.
cn: 自1986年起固定在格拉斯哥举行。

en: Summer doesn't begin for two more days, but scientists are already sounding the alarm about dangerous ice melts going on right now in Greenland.
cn: 距离夏季开始还有两天，但科学家们已经开始就格陵兰岛目前正在发生的危险冰川融化现象发出警报。

en: The vast island usually locks away enough fresh water in its ice sheet, which if melted can raise global sea levels by six meters.
cn: 这座广袤的岛屿通常在其冰盖中储存着大量淡水，一旦融化可使全球海平面上升六米。

en: And research shows that in recent years its ice has melted faster than ever before.
cn: 研究表明，近年来格陵兰冰川的融化速度比以往任何时候都快。

en: This month, as temperatures in northwestern Greenland approach all-time highs, researchers are encountering unusual, surprising levels of melting ice in the region.
cn: 本月，随着格陵兰西北部气温接近历史最高值，研究人员在该地区发现了异常惊人的冰川融化程度。

en: The most significant concern here is how early this is all happening.
cn: 这里最令人担忧的是这一切发生得太早了。

en: Greenland experiences annual ice melt and growth cycles.
cn: 格陵兰岛每年都会经历冰盖融化和生长周期。

en: But this year, the melting season began in early May.
cn: 然而今年，融冰季节早在五月初就开始了。

en: That's a month earlier than normal and something that's happened only once before in the historical record in 2016.
cn: 这比正常时间提前了一个月，在历史记录中仅有2016年出现过一次这种情况。

en: That means that not only is the ice melting very fast, it has more time to melt this summer than it would in a normal climate system.
cn: 这意味着不仅冰川融化速度很快，今夏冰川的融化时间也比正常气候条件下更长。

en: Longer melt seasons like this one seem to lead to much greater contributions to sea-level rise than in previous decades.
cn: 像今年这样漫长的融冰季节，似乎会比过去几十年导致更大幅度的海平面上升。

en: Bundles containing thousands of pounds in cash keep turning up on the streets of Blackhall Colliery in northern England, according to police.
cn: 据警方称，英格兰北部布莱克霍尔煤矿村的街头不断出现装有数千英镑现金的捆扎款项。

en: Residents of the village have been coming across bundles of £20 notes—usually worth £2,000—in the former mining village in County Durham.
cn: 达勒姆郡这座昔日采矿小镇的居民时常发现一捆捆20英镑面值的纸币，每捆通常价值2000英镑。

en: The latest discovery was on Monday, meaning four of these cash bundles have been handed in this year and 13 since 2014.
cn: 最近一次发现是在周一，这意味着今年已上交了四捆这样的现金，自2014年以来共上交了13捆。

en: The bundles are usually left in plain sight and have been scattered across the small coastal village.
cn: 这些钱捆通常被公开放置，散落在这座小型沿海村庄的各处。

en: The owner has two weeks to collect the cash, which is then returned to the finder if not claimed, according to Peterlee Police.
cn: 据彼得利警察局称，失主有两周时间认领，若无人认领，现金将归还给拾获者。

en: A Durham Police spokesperson said the money has been returned to the lucky finders in all cases except yesterday.
cn: 达勒姆警察局发言人表示，除昨天的案例外，所有现金均已归还给幸运的拾获者。

en: Policeman John Forster said in a statement: "The circumstances remain a mystery so we would welcome any information that will help us get to the bottom of these random incidents."
cn: 警察约翰·福斯特在一份声明中说："情况仍然是个谜，我们欢迎任何有助于查明这些随机事件真相的信息。"

en: He told The Northern Echo: "It isn't an affluent part of the world, so for them to find cash of that amount and instantly think about taking it to the police stations shows the community spirit there is."
cn: 他告诉《北方回声报》："这里并不是一个富裕的地方，所以当地居民发现这么多现金后，第一反应是送到警察局，这体现了当地的社区精神。"

en: It's your birthday next week.
cn: 下周是你的生日。

en: What have you got planned?
cn: 你有什么计划吗？

en: I'm not sure.
cn: 不确定。

en: I often feel strange on my birthday.
cn: 我生日那天常常感觉很奇怪。

en: It's like my brain decides to have a crisis.
cn: 就好像我的大脑决定要经历一次危机一样。

en: It's not entirely unusual to feel anxious or sad around your birthday.
cn: 在生日前后感到焦虑或悲伤并不罕见。

en: Birthdays can tap into a lot of things people worry about, including their achievements in life in the past decade, or their accomplishments of the past year.
cn: 生日会触发人们内心许多担忧，包括过去十年的人生成就，或过去一年的所有收获。

en: Many begin to search for the meaning of their existence, leading to behaviors such as ending or starting a relationship, or making plans, like starting a vigorous diet or fitness program.
cn: 许多人开始追问自己存在的意义，进而做出一些行为，比如结束或开始一段感情，或者制定计划，如开始严格节食或健身计划。

en: I have wonderful friends and I love celebrating their birthdays.
cn: 我有很好的朋友，我喜欢为他们庆祝生日。

en: But I don't like being the center of attention, receiving gifts and having a fuss made.
cn: 但我不喜欢成为关注的焦点，不喜欢收礼物，也不喜欢大张旗鼓地庆祝。

en: It seems to trigger a type of social anxiety.
cn: 这似乎会触发某种社交焦虑。

en: I think social media too can intensify things as birthdays now play out more publicly.
cn: 我觉得社交媒体也会加剧这种感觉，因为生日现在越来越公开化。

en: Well, to deal with the birthday blues, you should not isolate yourself.
cn: 要应对生日忧郁症，你不应该自我封闭。

en: It's best to gradually face your birthday with people you trust.
cn: 最好逐渐在信任的人陪伴下面对自己的生日。

en: Perhaps.
cn: 也许吧。

en: Or I could perceive my birthday as an opportunity to do something for others like asking people to make a donation instead of buying a gift.
cn: 或者，我可以把生日视为为他人做些事的机会，比如让大家捐款而不是买礼物。

en: Exactly.
cn: 没错。

en: Or even simply see your birthday as an opportunity to bring people together for them to have fun.
cn: 或者，就把生日当作一个把大家聚在一起开心的机会。

en: The metro was absolutely terrible this morning.
cn: 今天早上的地铁简直太糟糕了。

en: Oh, was there a delay?
cn: 哦，是晚点了吗？

en: No, but the train was so packed that I could barely move, and it was difficult to breathe too.
cn: 没有，但车厢太挤了，我几乎无法动弹，连呼吸都困难。

en: At every station, more people squeezed in and I got pushed further and further inside.
cn: 每到一站就有更多人挤进来，我被推得越来越靠里。

en: When I got to my station, I could hardly get out.
cn: 到了我的站，我几乎挤不出去。

en: Once I did get out, I was totally exhausted.
cn: 好不容易出来，我已经精疲力竭。

en: That sounds like a nightmare.
cn: 听起来真是噩梦般的经历。

en: Why didn't you take the bus?
cn: 你为什么不坐公交车？

en: The bus takes twice as long and it's just as crowded.
cn: 坐公交要花两倍时间，而且一样拥挤。

en: Well, what's the alternative?
cn: 那还有什么其他选择？

en: Haven't you got a car?
cn: 你没有车吗？

en: I've got a driver's license, but that's all.
cn: 我有驾照，但仅此而已。

en: I'm saving up to buy something reasonably small and cute, but it's still a bit expensive for me, and it'll take a while before I have enough money.
cn: 我在攒钱买一辆小巧可爱的车，不过对我来说还是有点贵，还得再等一段时间才能凑够钱。

en: Have you thought about getting an electric motorbike?
cn: 你有没有考虑过买电动摩托车？

en: I considered that for maybe a minute.
cn: 我大概考虑过一分钟。

en: But honestly, I've just seen too many horrible accidents involving those dangerous monsters.
cn: 但说实话，我见过太多涉及那些危险家伙的可怕事故。

en: What about those popular shared bikes?
cn: 那流行的共享单车呢？

en: You could register to use one.
cn: 你可以注册使用。

en: Yeah, that's a possibility.
cn: 是个办法。

en: There are always several of those bikes out in front of our apartment complex.
cn: 我们小区门口一直都有几辆共享单车。

en: Or you could just walk to work.
cn: 或者你可以步行上班。

en: Well, it's five kilometers from home to the office.
cn: 从家到办公室有五公里。

en: But you've given me a thought.
cn: 不过你给了我个想法。

en: I could take a change of clothes and jog to work.
cn: 我可以带件换洗衣服，慢跑去上班。

en: But at this time of year, the air pollution is a real problem.
cn: 但这个季节空气污染确实是个大问题。

en: Oh, yeah.
cn: 哦，是的。

en: I didn't think of that.
cn: 我没考虑到这点。

en: You take a taxi if you really have to.
cn: 如果实在没办法，你就打车吧。

en: Well, that's an expensive way to get to work.
cn: 打车上班太贵了。

en: Not if you use a ride sharing app.
cn: 如果用拼车应用就不贵了。

en: Good idea.
cn: 好主意。

en: I'll download one immediately.
cn: 我马上下载一个。

en: Thank you.
cn: 谢谢你。

en: Steve Miller began his career in IT back in the late 1980s.
cn: 史蒂夫·米勒的IT职业生涯始于20世纪80年代末。

en: Being a deaf person in tech required a huge amount of effort in organization.
cn: 作为一名聋人，在科技行业工作需要付出大量的组织协调努力。

en: Because there was no email or text message service, everything had to be done face to face, or by telephone.
cn: 由于当时没有电子邮件或短信服务，一切事务都必须面对面或通过电话进行。

en: Communicating in meetings was very difficult.
cn: 在会议中沟通非常困难。

en: He needed a sign language interpreter for every meeting, but it was a huge effort to coordinate.
cn: 他每次开会都需要手语翻译，但协调安排翻译本身就是一项繁重的工作。

en: These days, although challenges still remain, it's a good time to be a deaf person in tech, says Miller.
cn: 米勒表示，如今尽管挑战依然存在，但对聋人而言，正是投身科技行业的好时机。

en: Big advances in speech recognition technology have enabled communication tools to turn live speech into text in real time on your smartphone or laptop, and sign language into text as well.
cn: 语音识别技术的重大进步使得通讯工具能够在智能手机或笔记本电脑上实时将语音转化为文字，也能将手语转化为文字。

en: New tech coupled with improvements in hearing aid technology and medical advances means that Miller is able to focus far more on his work.
cn: 新技术与助听器技术的进步以及医疗发展相结合，使米勒能够更加专注于工作。

en: He has benefited to a great extent from a tiny hearing device in his ear.
cn: 他从耳内的微型助听设备中获益良多。

en: It gives him a degree of hearing, and he can use a variety of communication methods depending on the situation.
cn: 这使他具备了一定程度的听力，并可以根据不同情况选择多种沟通方式。

en: He can employ lip-reading and have meetings via video instead of on the phone.
cn: 他可以通过唇读，并通过视频而非电话参加会议。

en: These things have made a huge difference.
cn: 这些改变带来了巨大的不同。

en: He no longer has to worry about whether or not he can understand.
cn: 他不再需要担心自己是否能听懂。

en: He can just concentrate on how interesting the meeting might be and what he needs to get out of it in order to progress.
cn: 他只需专注于会议本身的内容，以及如何从中获取所需信息以推动工作进展。

en: Colour is now spreading through our homes, up staircases, across wood frames and ceilings, filling in neutral spaces.
cn: 色彩如今正蔓延至我们的家居各处——顺着楼梯延伸，覆盖木质框架和天花板，填满原本中性的空间。

en: According to one interior designer, when people return home, they want to see colours that cheer them up and give them a hug.
cn: 一位室内设计师表示，当人们回到家中，他们希望看到能让自己心情愉悦、如同被拥抱的色彩。

en: Pure white walls simply don't do that.
cn: 纯白色的墙壁做不到这一点。

en: They don't look after you.
cn: 它无法给人以慰藉。

en: Another interior designer commented that certain combinations can key into something on a deeper level, transporting you to a different moment in time.
cn: 另一位室内设计师则表示，某些色彩组合能触动人们内心更深层的东西，将你带入不同的时光。

en: That's the power of colour.
cn: 这就是色彩的力量。

en: If you are thinking to try colour on some of your neutral walls, the advice is refreshingly simple: Choose a colour you actually like.
cn: 如果你考虑在中性色调的墙面上尝试色彩，建议出人意料地简单：选择你真正喜欢的颜色。

en: Don't go for a colour because it's in fashion, or you've seen it in a magazine.
cn: 不要因为流行或在杂志上看到了就去选某种颜色。

en: If you're weary of full colour, test your tolerance with smaller spaces, such as the inside of a cupboard or a bright window frame.
cn: 如果你对大面积用色心存顾虑，可以从小空间开始试验，比如橱柜内部或明亮的窗框。

en: If it gives you joy every time you open the cupboard, you can start to take it further.
cn: 如果每次打开橱柜都让你感到喜悦，那就可以进一步扩大使用范围。

en: One can also paint the wooden frameworks the same colour as the walls, helping the rooms look bigger.
cn: 还可以将木质框架漆成与墙面相同的颜色，从而让房间看起来更宽敞。

en: In the kitchen, painting the overhead cupboards and the walls in the same colour can make it feel more spacious.
cn: 在厨房中，将吊柜和墙壁涂成同一颜色，能让空间感觉更开阔。

en: While painting the kitchen counters, a bold colour can make everything feel more open and lighter.
cn: 在粉刷厨房台面时，使用大胆的颜色能让一切感觉更开阔明亮。

en: Additionally, a painted ceiling is a magical thing without being too obvious and can affect how the space feels as well.
cn: 此外，粉刷天花板是一种神奇而不张扬的改变，同样能影响空间给人的感受。

en: Parents often hear that reading to their children is critical for supporting development, and the message is getting through to them.
cn: 父母经常听说为孩子朗读对其发展至关重要，这一理念正在逐渐被接受。

en: In fact, in the United States, a little over half of children between the ages of three and five were read to every day in 2007, and 83% of children in that age group in the same country were read to three or more times per week in 2012.
cn: 事实上，在美国，2007年有超过一半的3至5岁儿童每天都会被朗读，而2012年这一年龄段中83%的孩子每周被朗读三次或以上。

en: This is good news, because reading to young children helps their language and brain development.
cn: 这是个好消息，因为为幼儿朗读有助于其语言和大脑发育。

en: In fact, recent research has found that both the quality and quantity of shared book reading in infancy predicted later childhood vocabulary and reading skills.
cn: 事实上，近期研究发现，婴儿期共同阅读的质量和数量，都能预测孩子日后的词汇量和阅读能力。

en: In other words, the more time parents spend reading, the greater the developmental benefits in their four-year-old children.
cn: 换句话说，父母花在阅读上的时间越多，4岁孩子的发育收益就越大。

en: This is an important finding.
cn: 这是一项重要发现。

en: But does it matter what books parents read?
cn: 但父母读什么书重要吗？

en: A new study has investigated this question.
cn: 一项新研究对此进行了探讨。

en: It followed infants across the second six months of life and found that when parents showed babies books that had faces or objects with specific labels, they learned more.
cn: 该研究追踪了婴儿6至12月龄阶段，发现当父母给婴儿看有人脸或附有具体标签的物品图书时，婴儿学到的更多。

en: This is in contrast to books that did not name images, or books that had the same label under each image.
cn: 这与没有图像标注，或每张图下都使用相同标签的书籍形成对比。

en: Books that named different characters also promoted greater learning.
cn: 为不同角色标注名称的书籍同样能促进更多学习。

en: So what does this mean for parents?
cn: 那么这对父母意味着什么呢？

en: Not all books are created equal, so parents need to choose the books they share with their children with great care.
cn: 并非所有书籍的效果都相同，因此父母在为孩子选书时需要格外用心。

en: African leaders plan to turn the continent into a continent without borders.
cn: 非洲领导人计划将非洲大陆变成一个没有边界的大陆。

en: They will introduce a single passport policy, allowing free movement between countries.
cn: 他们将推行单一护照政策，允许人员在国家间自由流动。

en: The idea from the African Union has been modeled on the EU-Schengen Free Movement Deal.
cn: 非洲联盟的这一构想参照了欧盟-申根自由流动协议。

en: Europe has abolished many internal borders.
cn: 欧洲已废除许多内部边界。

en: This enables visa-free movement across the continent.
cn: 这使得整个欧洲大陆都可免签证通行。

en: Currently, 13 African countries have visa-free deals in place with each other.
cn: 目前，有13个非洲国家相互签订了免签证协议。

en: These allow citizens to visit another country without a visa.
cn: 这些协议允许公民无需签证即可访问其他国家。

en: Some countries offer visas on arrival.
cn: 部分国家提供落地签证。

en: In contrast, Americans are able to travel to 20 of the continent's countries without a visa or secure a visa on arrival.
cn: 相比之下，美国公民可免签或凭落地签证前往非洲大陆的20个国家。

en: The African Union, which represents 54 states, wants to abolish the requirement of a visa for Africans visiting other African countries.
cn: 代表54个国家的非洲联盟希望取消非洲人访问其他非洲国家的签证要求。

en: It also wants to establish a free-trade deal across the continent in the near future, as trade within the African continent cost more than any other region.
cn: 它还想在不久的将来在整个非洲大陆建立自由贸易协定，因为非洲大陆内部的贸易成本高于其他任何地区。

en: Researchers in Iceland found a new way of tackling climate change by pumping carbon dioxide underground and turning it into stone.
cn: 冰岛的研究人员发现了一种应对气候变化的新方法：将二氧化碳泵入地下并转化为石头。

en: Other carbon capture and storage methods store carbon dioxide as a gas, but problems include a high cost and concern about leaks.
cn: 其他碳捕获与封存方法将二氧化碳以气体形式储存，但存在成本高昂和泄漏风险等问题。

en: This new method of burying carbon dioxide and turning it into stone is cheaper and more secure, the Guardian reports.
cn: 据《卫报》报道，这种掩埋二氧化碳并使其变成石头的新方法更便宜、更安全。

en: To turn carbon dioxide into stone, researchers with the Carbfix project pumped the gas into volcanic rock and sped up the natural process in which the volcanic rock reacts with gas and forms carbon minerals.
cn: 为了将二氧化碳变为石头，Carbfix项目的研究人员将气体泵入火山岩中，加速了火山岩与气体反应并形成碳矿物的自然过程。

en: The gas turned into solid in just two years, much faster than the hundreds or thousands of years researchers had predicted.
cn: 气体在短短两年内就变成了固体，比研究人员预测的数百年或数千年要快得多。

en: The research took place at Iceland's Hellisheidi power plant.
cn: 这项研究在冰岛的赫利舍迪地热发电厂进行。

en: Already, the project in Iceland has been increased in scale to bury 10,000 tons of carbon dioxide each year.
cn: 冰岛的这个项目已扩大规模，每年可封存1万吨二氧化碳。

en: One potential difficulty is that for each ton of carbon dioxide buried, the technique requires 25 tons of water.
cn: 一个潜在的问题是，每封存一吨二氧化碳，该技术需要25吨水。

en: However, the lead researcher said sea water could be used.
cn: 不过，首席研究员表示可以使用海水。

en: People in France are keeping away from the narrow French stick loaf in favor of healthier, cheaper options, a miller's association has said.
cn: 法国一家磨坊主协会表示，法国人正逐渐远离细长的法式长棍面包，转而选择更健康、更便宜的选择。

en: The National Association of French Millers says bread consumption is on the decline, with French people eating nine grams less than in the previous year.
cn: 法国全国磨坊主协会表示，面包消费量正在下降，法国人的面包摄入量比前一年减少了9克。

en: The association is concerned about the effects this trend will have on their trade, and suggests three reasons why this happening.
cn: 该协会担心这一趋势对行业造成的影响，并提出了三个原因。

en: Firstly, the association cited changing diets, in particular, the switch to those low in calories, as a factor in the reduction of bread consumption.
cn: 首先，该协会指出，饮食习惯的变化，尤其是转向低卡路里饮食，是面包消费量减少的一个因素。

en: This could explain why the difference in consumption between genders is so big.
cn: 这可以解释为什么男女之间的消费差异如此之大。

en: Nowadays, men eat an approximate average of 140 grams of bread daily, whereas women eat 80 to 90 grams.
cn: 如今，男性平均每天食用约140克面包，而女性则食用80至90克。

en: The second reason, they say, is lifestyle changes in the country, with people dedicating less time to breakfast when bread would traditionally be eaten with butter and jam.
cn: 第二个原因是生活方式的改变，人们在早餐上花费的时间减少，而传统上早餐会搭配黄油和果酱食用面包。

en: Finally, the rising cost of bread is considered to be a factor, with the price of a French stick loaf increasing by nearly 25% in the last 10 years.
cn: 最后，面包价格上涨也被视为一个因素，过去10年间法式长棍面包的价格上涨了近25%。

en: Next, please.
cn: 下一位。

en: Yes.
cn: 好的。

en: I'd like to book two train tickets to London tomorrow morning, please.
cn: 我想订两张明天上午去伦敦的火车票。

en: OK, what time would you like to go?
cn: 好的，您想坐几点的车？

en: Well, after the rush hour, I think.
cn: 嗯，我想在高峰时段之后。

en: We'd like to avoid the crowds if possible.
cn: 如果可能的话，我们想避开人群。

en: So probably sometime around 10 o'clock.
cn: 所以大概10点左右吧。

en: No problem.
cn: 没问题。

en: Just give me a minute.
cn: 请稍等。

en: There's one here at 9:47, then one at 10:12, and then a third at 10:26.
cn: 9点47分有一班，然后10点12分有一班，第三班是10点26分。

en: The one at 10:12 sounds good.
cn: 10点12分那班听起来不错。

en: All right.
cn: 好的。

en: Would you like to sit in first or second class?
cn: 您想坐一等座还是二等座？

en: Second class is fine.
cn: 二等座就可以了。

en: Thanks.
cn: 谢谢。

en: Is there any chance we could have a window seat for one of those?
cn: 有可能给我们一个靠窗的座位吗？

en: No problem.
cn: 没问题。

en: And I've booked those seats next to each other for you.
cn: 我已经为你们订了相邻的座位。

en: The total price is 36 pounds 50 cents.
cn: 总共是36英镑50便士。

en: Is there anything else?
cn: 还有其他需要吗？

en: Yes, actually.
cn: 是的，有的。

en: We'll be taking our bicycles with us.
cn: 我们会带上自行车。

en: What is the arrangement for that?
cn: 怎么安排？

en: And will it cost extra?
cn: 需要额外收费吗？

en: It's no extra cost.
cn: 没有额外费用。

en: The price will be the same.
cn: 价格不变。

en: All you need to do is wait at the far end of the platform.
cn: 您只需要在站台远端等候。

en: When the train arrives, tell the train guard where you're going and he will help you secure the bicycles in the last carriage and give you a ticket.
cn: 火车到站后，告诉列车员您的目的地，他会帮您把自行车固定在最后一节车厢并给您一张票。

en: Then you can walk down through the train to your carriage and take your seats.
cn: 然后您可以穿过火车走到您的车厢就座。

en: When you arrive in London, hand the ticket to the guard and he will return the bicycles to you.
cn: 到达伦敦后，把票交给列车员，他会把自行车还给您。

en: Thank you for the information.
cn: 谢谢您提供的信息。

en: That's very helpful.
cn: 这非常有帮助。

en: Good morning.
cn: 早上好。

en: Our guest today is Karen Brooke.
cn: 我们今天的嘉宾是凯伦·布鲁克。

en: Karen is the managing director of Cube Movie Theater located on Underhill Road.
cn: 凯伦是昂德希尔路上立方电影院的总经理。

en: Thank you for coming, Karen.
cn: 谢谢你的到来，凯伦。

en: Thank you for having me.
cn: 谢谢你们的邀请。

en: So tell us about your cinema, Cube Movie Theater.
cn: 那跟我们介绍一下你的电影院吧，立方电影院。

en: Sure.
cn: 好的。

en: Cube Movie Theater has been around now for 11 years.
cn: 立方电影院已经经营了11年了。

en: It's located in what used to be a hat factory.
cn: 它位于一个曾经的帽厂里。

en: Oh, really?
cn: 哦，真的吗？

en: Yeah.
cn: 是的。

en: There used to be many hat factories in Britain until around the 1950s.
cn: 直到20世纪50年代左右，英国曾有许多帽厂。

en: But fashion changed and most people stopped wearing hats.
cn: 但时尚变了，大多数人不再戴帽子。

en: So practically, all of those factories had to close down.
cn: 所以实际上，所有这些工厂都不得不关闭。

en: This one in particular was closed for 47 years before we transformed it into a movie theater.
cn: 这一家特别有意思，在我们把它改造成电影院之前，它已经关闭了47年。

en: I see.
cn: 明白了。

en: I hear there's something else that makes your theater special.
cn: 我听说还有别的东西让你的影院很特别。

en: What is it that sets you apart from other theaters?
cn: 是什么让你们与其他影院不同呢？

en: We are the only movie theater in the whole country that only shows foreign movies.
cn: 我们是全国唯一一家只放映外国电影的电影院。

en: Is there enough demand for that?
cn: 有足够的需求吗？

en: I would have thought that in London most people don't speak foreign languages.
cn: 我还以为在伦敦大多数人不会说外语呢。

en: Sure, there's enough demand.
cn: 当然，需求充足。

en: The fact that we have been open and in business for all these years proves it.
cn: 我们这些年一直营业的事实就证明了这一点。

en: London is a very large and international city.
cn: 伦敦是一座非常大的国际化城市。

en: There are lots of people interested in watching such movies.
cn: 有很多人对看这类电影感兴趣。

en: Furthermore, I might add, all movies come with English text at the bottom of the screen.
cn: 此外，我想补充一点，所有电影屏幕底部都有英文字幕。

en: So even if you don't understand what the actors say, you can still read it.
cn: 所以即使您听不懂演员在说什么，仍然可以看懂。

en: Of course.
cn: 当然。

en: What movie are you showing right now?
cn: 你们现在在放映什么电影？

en: This week we're showing a musical from Pakistan.
cn: 本周我们正在放映一部来自巴基斯坦的音乐剧。

en: It's very popular.
cn: 很受欢迎。

en: Love them or hate them, smartphones have become an integral part of our daily lives, but should they be left outside the classroom?
cn: 无论爱也好恨也罢，智能手机已成为我们日常生活中不可或缺的一部分，但它们应该被留在教室外吗？

en: Nick Gibb, minister for school standards in England, believes schools should ban their pupils from bringing in smartphones.
cn: 英国学校标准部长尼克·吉布认为，学校应该禁止学生携带智能手机入校。

en: Astrid Natalie, a secondary school math teacher, incorporates phones into her classroom.
cn: 阿斯特丽德·娜塔莉是一名中学数学老师，她将手机融入课堂教学。

en: "My school doesn't have money for tablets," She says.
cn: "我的学校没有钱买平板电脑，"她说。

en: "When students use their phones for research, they learn they have a powerful tool in their hands.
cn: "当学生用手机进行研究时，他们会意识到自己手中有一个强大的工具。

en: If we stop children using phones, we are rejecting something they care about."
cn: 如果我们阻止孩子使用手机，我们就是在拒绝他们关心的事物。"

en: Meanwhile, Helen Lockhart, a registered nurse working for community education, supports a complete ban.
cn: 与此同时，从事社区教育的注册护士海伦·洛克哈特支持全面禁止。

en: "I'm banned from mobile use at work, and my phone must be handed in.
cn: "我被禁止在工作中使用手机，手机必须上交。

en: If I'm caught with it in my pocket, I will be subject to disciplinary procedure, which will impact on my career.
cn: 如果被发现口袋里装着手机，我将受到纪律处分，这会影响我的职业生涯。

en: We need to teach children how to behave like the professionals they're striving to become."
cn: 我们需要教会孩子如何表现得像他们努力成为的专业人士一样。"

en: Richard Stone, an English teacher, thinks there should be a clear separation between school and home.
cn: 英语老师理查德·斯通认为学校和家庭之间应该有明确的界限。

en: "Students should do things differently in the two environments.
cn: "学生在这两种环境中应该有不同的行为方式。

en: Children are getting more than enough screen time in their lives without the need to bring their phone into the classroom.
cn: 孩子们在生活中已经有了足够的屏幕时间，不需要把手机带进教室。

en: The internet is too easy and too unreliable a research tool.
cn: 互联网作为研究工具太简单也太不可靠了。

en: So let's leave phones and laptops at home, and show them a different world in their lessons—one of books and pens," he says.
cn: 所以让我们把手机和笔记本电脑留在家里，在课堂上给他们展示一个不同的世界——书和笔的世界，"他说。

en: Kate, a 6-year-old girl, helped her brother wash windows to get a reward promised by her mother, a purple doll that she wanted.
cn: 凯特是一个6岁的小女孩，她帮哥哥擦窗户以获得妈妈承诺的奖励——一个她想要的紫色洋娃娃。

en: She watched her mother order the doll online.
cn: 她看着妈妈在网上订购了洋娃娃。

en: The next day, Kate asked if she could check the shipping status, so her mom clicked on the web page and then walked out of the room.
cn: 第二天，凯特问是否可以查看发货状态，于是妈妈点开了网页，然后走出了房间。

en: Kate saw that her doll would be arriving the next afternoon, but then she noticed something else, suggestions about other dolls and toys she could order.
cn: 凯特看到她的洋娃娃将在第二天下午送到，但她还注意到其他东西——关于她可以订购的其他洋娃娃和玩具的推荐。

en: 15 minutes and a few clicks later, with more than $350 worth of dolls in her cart, Kate placed the order and ran off to play.
cn: 15分钟和几次点击之后，凯特的购物车里有价值超过350美元的洋娃娃，她下了单就跑出去玩了。

en: The next day, while checking on another online order, her mother noticed a long list of dolls on the way.
cn: 第二天，妈妈在查看另一个网购订单时，注意到有一长串洋娃娃在运送途中。

en: She was able to cancel two of them, but it was too late to cancel the rest.
cn: 她成功取消了其中两个，但取消其余订单已经太迟了。

en: She told her daughter that they were going to be returned.
cn: 她告诉女儿那些娃娃会被退回去。

en: When the packages arrived, Kate wanted to open them, but her parents said no.
cn: 包裹到达时，凯特想打开它们，但父母不同意。

en: Instead of sending back the dolls, her father suggested giving them to the local children's hospital.
cn: 父亲建议把娃娃送给当地的儿童医院，而不是退回去。

en: So the next week, Kate's family loaded up their car and took all the dolls to the playroom at the children's hospital.
cn: 于是接下来的一周，凯特一家装好车，把所有娃娃都送到了儿童医院的游戏室。

en: Kate was depressed at first, but then she sat with some girl patients, and they opened up all the boxes together, laughing and playing.
cn: 凯特起初很沮丧，但后来她和一些患病的小女孩坐在一起，她们一起打开所有盒子，笑着玩着。

en: She had a lot of fun and learned a really good lesson.
cn: 她玩得很开心，也学到了宝贵的一课。

en: Can the date you were born affect how successful your life is?
cn: 你出生的日期会影响你一生的成功程度吗？

en: According to recent research done in Australia, the answer is yes.
cn: 根据澳大利亚最近的一项研究，答案是肯定的。

en: The researchers found that the time when a person starts school has an enduring impact on their lives.
cn: 研究人员发现，一个人开始上学的时间对其一生有着持久的影响。

en: Those who are relatively old compared to their classmates have certain advantages over them.
cn: 那些与同学相比年龄相对较大的孩子拥有一定的优势。

en: Previous research has found older students achieve better results.
cn: 此前的研究发现，年龄较大的学生成绩更好。

en: They are also more likely to attend university and become professional athletes, chief executives, and even important politicians.
cn: 他们也更有可能上大学，成为职业运动员、首席执行官，甚至重要的政治家。

en: But the Australian researchers wanted to discover what was driving these differences.
cn: 但澳大利亚的研究人员想探究是什么因素导致了这些差异。

en: They suspected older, more mature students obtained more self-confidence than their peers, because they achieved better grades.
cn: 他们推测年龄较大、更成熟的学生因成绩更好而比同龄人更有自信。

en: To test this out, they conducted two studies.
cn: 为了验证这一假设，他们进行了两项研究。

en: One was with high school students and the other with more than a thousand Australian adults, aged between 24 and 60 years old.
cn: 一项研究对象是高中生，另一项涉及1000多名年龄在24岁至60岁之间的澳大利亚成年人。

en: In the first study, more than 600 high school students were surveyed about their tendency to take risks and feel confident.
cn: 在第一项研究中，对600多名高中生进行了关于冒险倾向和自信度的调查。

en: In the second study, those born on both sides of the cutoff date for starting school were asked to complete online math questions and rate their performance.
cn: 在第二项研究中，那些出生在入学截止日期前后的人被要求完成在线数学题并评估自己的表现。

en: They were also asked about the risks they took while riding bicycles and managing their finances.
cn: 他们还被问及骑自行车和理财时所冒的风险。

en: The researchers found that older students displayed greater risk-taking tendencies.
cn: 研究人员发现，年龄较大的学生表现出更强的冒险倾向。

en: While risk-taking can be considered a negative attribute, it's also a characteristic of successful people, including athletes, political leaders and entrepreneurs.
cn: 尽管冒险可能被视为一种负面特质，但它也是成功人士的特征之一，包括运动员、政治领袖和企业家。

en: A woman was charged with allegedly violating a Rhode Island city law against feeding wild animals.
cn: 一名妇女被指控涉嫌违反罗德岛州一项禁止喂养野生动物的城市法律。

en: The 55-year-old woman's neighbors blame her for making the area's rat problem worse.
cn: 这位55岁妇女的邻居指责她使该地区的老鼠问题更加严重。

en: Newly installed cameras captured several rats active in the middle of the day.
cn: 新安装的摄像机捕捉到了几只白天活动的老鼠。

en: Neighbors say that it's even worse during the night.
cn: 邻居们说晚上的情况更加糟糕。

en: The woman and her parents, who own the home, told reporters that she's being charged for feeding birds.
cn: 这名女子和她的父母是这所房子的主人，他们告诉记者，她是因为喂鸟而被起诉的。

en: "Who would have known just loving animals gets you that much trouble," she said.
cn: "谁会想到仅仅因为热爱动物就会给你带来这么多麻烦，"她说。

en: It is prohibited to feed any wild animals, including birds in Rhode Island City.
cn: 在罗德岛市，禁止喂养任何野生动物，包括鸟类。

en: Nevertheless, while the woman's intention was to feed birds, it is clear that rats were also benefiting.
cn: 然而，尽管这位妇女的目的是喂鸟，但很明显老鼠也从中受益了。

en: Anthony Moretti, director of the city administration, said he saw more than 20 rats near the woman's home.
cn: 城市管理主任安东尼·莫雷蒂说，他在这位妇女家附近看到了20多只老鼠。

en: He said it will take months to get the problem under control.
cn: 他表示，要控制住这个问题需要数月时间。

en: To prepare for eventually sending astronauts to Mars, NASA began taking applications Friday for four people to live for a year in Mars Dune Alpha.
cn: 为了准备最终将宇航员送上火星，美国宇航局于周五开始接受四人在"火星沙丘阿尔法"居住一年的申请。

en: That's a 1,700-square-foot Martian habitat inside a building in Houston.
cn: 那是位于休斯顿一栋建筑内的一个1700平方英尺的火星栖息地。

en: The paid volunteers will work in an environment similar to Mars.
cn: 这些有偿志愿者将在类似火星的环境中工作。

en: They will have limited communications with family, restricted food and resources.
cn: 他们将与家人进行有限的通信，食物和资源也将受到限制。

en: NASA is planning three experiments with the first one starting in the fall next year.
cn: 美国宇航局计划进行三次实验，第一次将于明年秋季开始。

en: Food will all be ready-to-eat space food.
cn: 所有食物都将是即食太空食品。
