en: Some plants will be grown, but not potatoes like in the movie The Martian.
cn: 会种植一些植物，但不会像电影《火星救援》中那样种土豆。

en: "We want to understand how humans perform in them," said lead scientist Grace Douglas.
cn: "我们想了解人类在这些环境中如何表现，"首席科学家格蕾丝·道格拉斯说。

en: "We're looking at Mars realistic situations."
cn: "我们正在研究火星上的现实情况。"

en: The application process opened Friday and they're not seeking just anybody.
cn: 申请程序于周五启动，他们并不是随便找人。

en: The requirements are strict, including a master's degree in a science, engineering or math field, or pilot experience.
cn: 申请要求严格，包括拥有科学、工程或数学领域的硕士学位，或有飞行员经验。

en: Only American citizens or permanent U.S. residents are acceptable.
cn: 只有美国公民或美国永久居民才符合资格。

en: Applicants must be between 30 and 55 and in good physical health.
cn: 申请人年龄必须在30至55岁之间，且身体健康。

en: "Attitude is key," said former Canadian astronaut Chris Hadfield.
cn: "态度是关键，"前加拿大宇航员克里斯·哈德菲尔德说。

en: He said the participants need to be super competent, resourceful, and not rely on other people to feel comfortable.
cn: 他表示，参与者需要能力超强、足智多谋，并且不依赖他人来获得舒适感。

en: A Japanese mayor apologized Thursday for biting the Olympic gold medal of a softball player.
cn: 一名日本市长周四为咬了一名垒球运动员的奥运金牌而道歉。

en: Nagoya mayor Takashi Kawamura had praised athlete, Miu Goto, during a public media event.
cn: 名古屋市长河村隆之在一次公共媒体活动中称赞了运动员后藤希友。

en: He asked her to put the medal around his neck.
cn: 他让她把金牌挂在他的脖子上。

en: Kawamura then bit into it.
cn: 河村随后咬了下去。

en: Biting a medal in front of journalists and photographers has become a common pose for Olympic medalists.
cn: 在记者和摄影师面前咬奖牌已成为奥运奖牌得主的常见姿势。

en: However, it is only for the winners themselves, not others.
cn: 然而，这仅限于获胜者本人，而非他人。

en: "I'm really sorry that I hurt the treasure of the gold medalist," Kawamura told reporters Thursday.
cn: "我真的很抱歉伤害了金牌得主的宝贝，"河村周四对记者说。

en: The mayor said the medal was undamaged, though he offered to pay for the cost of a new one.
cn: 市长表示奖牌没有损坏，但他提出愿意支付新奖牌的费用。

en: Goto, however, has accepted the International Olympic Committee's offer of a replacement, according to Japanese media reports.
cn: 然而，据日本媒体报道，后藤已经接受了国际奥委会提出的替换方案。

en: The scene broadcast on television prompted thousands of complaints to city hall.
cn: 电视上播出的这一画面引发了数千起向市政厅的投诉。

en: Some Olympians said they treat their medals as treasures and that it was disrespectful and unacceptable for Kawamura to bite one.
cn: 一些奥运选手表示，他们视奖牌为珍宝，河村咬奖牌是不尊重且不可接受的。

en: "I would cry if that happened to me," said another athlete, Naohisa Takato.
cn: "如果这种事发生在我身上，我会哭的，"另一位运动员高藤直久说。

en: "I handle my own gold medal so gently that I would not scratch it."
cn: "我对待自己的金牌非常轻柔，绝不会刮伤它。"

en: What's that orange thing on your computer screen?
cn: 你电脑屏幕上那个橙色的东西是什么？

en: It's something I bought yesterday.
cn: 这是我昨天买的东西。

en: It's a plastic sheet that blocks blue light.
cn: 这是一块能阻挡蓝光的塑料片。

en: I have one that I use to cover my phone screen too.
cn: 我也有一块用来遮盖手机屏幕。

en: What do you mean by blue light?
cn: 你说的蓝光是什么意思？

en: Blue light includes natural light, but it also includes light that isn't natural, for example, from computers, phones, televisions, and other electronic devices.
cn: 蓝光包括自然光，但也包括非自然光，例如来自电脑、手机、电视和其他电子设备的光。

en: So blue light is harmful, and that's why you want to block it.
cn: 所以蓝光是有害的，这就是你想屏蔽它的原因。

en: It isn't that simple.
cn: 事情没那么简单。

en: Blue light isn't necessarily bad for us.
cn: 蓝光对我们来说不一定是有害的。

en: In fact, we need blue light during the day to be healthy, but too much blue light, especially from electronic devices, can harm our health by weakening our vision and making it harder for us to fall asleep.
cn: 事实上，白天我们需要蓝光来保持健康，但过多的蓝光，尤其是来自电子设备的蓝光，会损害我们的健康——它会削弱视力并使我们更难入睡。

en: And poor sleep can cause all sorts of health problems.
cn: 而睡眠不好会导致各种健康问题。

en: I'm not so sure that sleep is nearly as important as people always say it is.
cn: 我不太确定睡眠是否像人们常说的那么重要。

en: I haven't slept enough in months because I have too much work to do.
cn: 我好几个月都没睡够觉了，因为我有太多工作要做。

en: And I feel fine.
cn: 我感觉很好。

en: And it's the same for most of my friends.
cn: 我的大多数朋友也是如此。

en: Poor sleep might be a problem for older people, but surely young people can handle late nights.
cn: 睡眠不好可能是老年人的问题，但年轻人肯定能熬夜。

en: Well, the research I've read shows that sleep is probably even more important than we thought, and that not having enough sleep can contribute to serious health problems like obesity and heart disease.
cn: 嗯，我读到的研究表明，睡眠可能比我们想象的更重要，睡眠不足会导致严重的健康问题，如肥胖和心脏病。

en: And all the artificial blue light from electronic devices means we have to try harder to sleep well.
cn: 而所有来自电子设备的人造蓝光意味着我们必须更加努力才能睡好觉。

en: Maybe you're right.
cn: 也许你是对的。

en: I'm on my computer very late most nights, and that's probably why I don't sleep enough.
cn: 大多数晚上我都对着电脑到很晚，这可能就是我睡眠不足的原因。

en: As a kid, did you know what job you wanted to do when you grew up?
cn: 小时候，你知不知道长大后想做什么工作？

en: No, I didn't.
cn: 不，我不知道。

en: And I got sick every time adults asked me what I wanted to be when I grew up.
cn: 每次大人问我长大后想做什么时，我都会感到厌烦。

en: It's the same with me.
cn: 我也是这样。

en: And I'm tired of people asking that question of my 10-year-old daughter.
cn: 我也厌倦了别人问我10岁的女儿这个问题。

en: My daughter's stock answers are basketball player, pop singer, mechanical engineer.
cn: 我女儿惯常的回答是篮球运动员、流行歌手、机械工程师。

en: Adults love that last one, as it's the perfect mix of the sensible and the ambitious.
cn: 成年人喜欢最后一个，因为它是理智和抱负的完美结合。

en: When she was much younger, my daughter used to say she wanted to be Queen of the Clouds, which I loved.
cn: 她更小的时候，曾经说想当"云朵女王"，我很喜欢这个回答。

en: That's the kind of goal-setting I like to see in children, springing from their boundless imaginations.
cn: 那才是我喜欢在孩子们身上看到的目标设定，源于他们无限的想象力。

en: Yes.
cn: 是的。

en: We grown-ups can be tedious and limiting in our need for reality.
cn: 我们成年人对现实的需求可能既乏味又有限制。

en: And we teach a very gloomy image of adulthood that whatever our children's future holds, it must be seen within the context of a job.
cn: 我们向孩子传递了一种非常悲观的成年形象——无论他们的未来如何，都必须在工作的背景下来看待。

en: How utterly overwhelming and dull!
cn: 多么令人难以忍受和乏味！

en: When people ask my son what he wants to be when he grows up, I have to swallow the urge to say, "Hey, back off my kids dreams!"
cn: 当人们问我儿子长大后想做什么时，我不得不压抑住想说的冲动："嘿，别干涉我孩子的梦想！"

en: We can't dismiss the idea that teenagers have to plan to do something after they finish school.
cn: 我们不能否认青少年在毕业后必须计划做些什么。

en: And parents are entitled to hope it's more than simply spending 10 hours a day playing computer games.
cn: 而且父母有权希望那不仅仅是每天花10个小时玩电脑游戏。

en: But asking "What do you want to be?" isn't going to lead a child to fulfilled life, rather leads to false expectations and a high chance of disappointment.
cn: 但问"你想成为什么样的人？"不会让孩子过上充实的生活，反而会导致错误的期望和很高的失望几率。

en: Exactly.
cn: 没错。

en: We should be helping our kids understand who they are, even if that means letting go of who we think they should be.
cn: 我们应该帮助孩子了解他们是谁，即使那意味着要放弃我们认为他们应该成为的样子。

en: Greater Internet access correlates directly with improved health care, education and economic development.
cn: 更广泛的互联网接入与医疗、教育和经济发展的改善直接相关。

en: People living in rural areas, however, lag behind in online use, which limits their access to government services, banking and job opportunities.
cn: 然而，生活在农村地区的人们在网络使用方面落后，这限制了他们对政府服务、银行服务和就业机会的获取。

en: Nowhere is this challenge clearer than in Africa.
cn: 这一挑战在非洲最为明显。

en: Most Africans live in rural areas that are tough to wire for Internet access.
cn: 大多数非洲人生活在难以铺设互联网线路的农村地区。

en: Now some phone companies are trying to introduce Internet-ready phones into African markets.
cn: 现在，一些电话公司正试图将可上网的手机引入非洲市场。

en: Certain companies have started selling simple smartphones for only $20.
cn: 一些公司已经开始销售仅售20美元的简易智能手机。

en: Previously, the lowest price had been around $40, well out of reach for many people.
cn: 此前，最低价格约为40美元，很多人根本负担不起。

en: These devices are powered by software from the giant electronics company, KaiOS Technologies Limited.
cn: 这些设备搭载的是大型电子公司KaiOS Technologies Limited的软件。

en: Most companies are trying to make phones ever more powerful and capable.
cn: 大多数公司都在努力让手机变得更加强大和功能丰富。

en: But KaiOS went the other way.
cn: 但KaiOS走了另一条路。

en: It made every effort to keep the essential capabilities of smartphones, but strip out costs and preserve battery life for people who likely have inadequate access to electricity.
cn: 它尽一切努力保留智能手机的基本功能，同时削减成本，并为那些可能用电不足的人延长电池寿命。

en: The KaiOS devices offer an alternative to the more expensive models that remain out of reach of many Africans and contribute to the digital divide.
cn: KaiOS设备提供了一种替代更昂贵机型的方案，那些机型仍然是许多非洲人无法企及的，并加剧了数字鸿沟。

en: The body of KaiOS phones is as basic as it gets.
cn: KaiOS手机的机身极其基础。

en: Instead of a touchscreen, they're controlled with an old-school keypad.
cn: 它们没有触摸屏，而是用老式键盘控制。

en: They're designed for 3G networks because 4G coverage doesn't reach two thirds of Africa's customers.
cn: 它们是为3G网络设计的，因为4G网络覆盖不到非洲三分之二的用户。

en: In total, KaiOS phones are made from about $15 worth of parts, while Apple's top-of-the-line iPhone has $390 worth of stuff.
cn: 总的来说，KaiOS手机由价值约15美元的零部件制成，而苹果的顶级iPhone则用了价值390美元的零部件。

en: For years, using recycled plastic to make plastic products was cheap.
cn: 多年来，使用回收塑料制造塑料制品价格低廉。

en: By contrast, fossil fuel plastic was more expensive.
cn: 相比之下，化石燃料塑料更昂贵。

en: Thus, the sustainable option was an economic option, too.
cn: 因此，可持续的选择也是一种经济的选择。

en: But now it is cheaper for major manufacturers to use new plastic.
cn: 但现在，大型制造商使用新塑料的成本更低。

en: According to one recent business report, recycled plastic now costs an extra $72 a ton compared with newly-made plastic.
cn: 根据最近的一份商业报告，如今回收塑料比新制造的塑料每吨贵72美元。

en: This may be because of consumer demands.
cn: 这可能是因为消费者的需求。

en: They are pushing for more recycled plastics in new products.
cn: 他们正在推动在新产品中使用更多的回收塑料。

en: Meanwhile, new plastic is becoming cheaper.
cn: 与此同时，新塑料正变得越来越便宜。

en: This is because of a boom in petroleum chemical production from the U.S.
cn: 这是因为美国石油化工生产的繁荣。

en: The price increase of recycled plastic could cost sustainable manufacturers an extra $250 million a year.
cn: 回收塑料的价格上涨可能会使可持续制造商每年额外损失2.5亿美元。

en: Smaller manufacturers may also be forced to use new plastic to reduce costs.
cn: 较小的制造商也可能被迫使用新塑料来降低成本。

en: Makers of clear plastic bottles may also opt for new fossil-fuel based plastic to save money.
cn: 透明塑料瓶的制造商也可能选择基于化石燃料的新塑料来节省开支。

en: Plastic packaging makers are being pressured to use more recycled plastic.
cn: 塑料包装制造商正面临压力，要求他们使用更多的回收塑料。

en: This is done in hopes of reducing the enormous amount of plastic pollution in the oceans.
cn: 这样做是为了减少海洋中大量的塑料污染。

en: The UK government plans to tax companies which don't use at least 30% recycled plastic in their products.
cn: 英国政府计划对产品中回收塑料含量低于30%的公司征税。

en: Additionally, the government is planning to increase the quantity of recycled plastic in the market.
cn: 此外，政府还计划增加市场上回收塑料的数量。

en: This could mean incentives for new recycling plants.
cn: 这可能意味着对新回收工厂的激励措施。

en: Additionally, recycling facilities may be improved at a local council level, and recycled plastic could be imported.
cn: 此外，地方议会层面的回收设施可能会得到改善，并且可以进口回收塑料。

en: This would help increase the amount of recycled plastic in circulation.
cn: 这将有助于增加循环中的回收塑料数量。

en: At the Dreamory, a business in Manhattan, naps are for sale.
cn: 在曼哈顿的一家名为Dreamory的店铺里，午睡是可以出售的。

en: A 45-minutes session in a darkened enclosure with peace and quiet costs $25.
cn: 在一个安静、黑暗的隔间里进行45分钟的午睡，收费25美元。

en: To be clear, this institution is no hotel.
cn: 需要明确的是，这个机构不是酒店。

en: This is a nap joint.
cn: 这是一个午睡场所。

en: It sells the idea of the nap as much as the nap itself.
cn: 它销售的不仅是午睡本身，还有午睡的理念。

en: Is a nap worth $25?
cn: 一次午睡值25美元吗？

en: The answer is obviously yes.
cn: 答案显然是肯定的。

en: Here, at this point in the argument, it's traditional for me to bring up all the studies that show the benefits of napping.
cn: 在辩论中说到这里，我通常会列举所有证明午睡好处的研究。

en: But do you really need experts to tell you that?
cn: 但你真的需要专家来告诉你这些吗？

en: Just look at the world around you at 2:30 in the afternoon.
cn: 只需看看下午两点半你周围的世界就知道了。

en: I've been working from home for more than 10 years now, and the quality and quantity of work I can do emerges directly from my ability to concentrate.
cn: 我已经在家工作十多年了，我所能完成的工作质量和数量直接取决于我集中注意力的能力。

en: I don't understand how people have creative careers without napping.
cn: 我不理解人们怎么能不午睡还能从事创造性职业。

en: Every day at about 1 p.m., everyone faces the same choice: sleep until 2 p.m. and then work until 5, or daydream and drift around social media and attend pointless meetings until 7 p.m.
cn: 每天下午1点左右，每个人都面临同样的选择：睡到下午2点然后工作到5点，或者做白日梦、在社交媒体上闲逛、参加毫无意义的会议直到晚上7点。

en: The friends I have who still work in offices inform me their bosses insist that they take the second option, and that napping is associated with laziness.
cn: 我那些还在办公室工作的朋友告诉我，他们的老板坚持让他们选择后者，而且认为午睡与懒惰有关。

en: I genuinely find it odd, for if you nap properly, it's like waking up from a full night sleep, and you can double your day's worth of concentration.
cn: 我真的觉得这很奇怪，因为如果你午睡得当，就像从一整夜的睡眠中醒来一样，你可以让一天的专注力翻倍。

en: Police have reported a man being bitten by a 4-foot snake when he lifted his toilet seat on Sunday morning.
cn: 据警方报道，周日早上，一名男子在掀起马桶座圈时被一条4英尺长的蛇咬伤。

en: The snake was not poisonous, so the man did not have to go to the hospital, but his arm was medically treated at the scene.
cn: 这条蛇没有毒，所以这名男子不必去医院，但他的手臂在现场接受了医疗处理。

en: The police officer interviewed told news reporters the snake didn't belong to the man and it was unclear how it got into the apartment.
cn: 接受采访的警官告诉记者，这条蛇不是该男子的，也不清楚它是如何进入公寓的。

en: The snake was eventually captured by the local animal handlers and taken to an animal hospital afterward.
cn: 这条蛇最终被当地的动物管理员捕获，随后被送往动物医院。

en: It was being treated for an outer skin infection.
cn: 它正在接受表皮感染的治疗。

en: It was unclear who the owner was.
cn: 目前尚不清楚主人是谁。

en: The snake may be taken to a local zoo for care if the owner does not come forward.
cn: 如果主人不出面，这条蛇可能会被送往当地动物园照料。

en: Over the years, other creatures like frogs and fish have found their way into toilets.
cn: 多年来，青蛙、鱼类等其他生物也曾进入过马桶。

en: But this was the first instance of a snake in recent years.
cn: 但这是近年来首次出现蛇的情况。

en: Every week since last April, Andrea Belcher has been doing something slightly unusual and amusing when she takes out her trash.
cn: 自去年四月以来，安德里亚·贝尔彻每周倒垃圾时都会做一些有点不寻常且有趣的事情。

en: It all started off when a movie star shared a photo of herself putting her trash bins out in a ball gown.
cn: 这一切始于一位电影明星分享了一张她穿着舞会礼服把垃圾桶拖出去的照片。

en: This inspired Andrea to get dressed up to take out the trash.
cn: 这激发了安德里亚穿上盛装去倒垃圾的想法。

en: She was too embarrassed to do it during the day.
cn: 她白天不好意思这样做。

en: So one dark evening, she put on her black off-the-shoulder gown and put her trash bin out.
cn: 于是，在一个漆黑的夜晚，她穿上黑色露肩礼服，把垃圾桶拖了出去。

en: Her daughter filmed it and the whole family laughed, but it seemed to go down well.
cn: 她的女儿拍下了这一幕，全家人都笑了，但反响似乎不错。

en: The following weeks, she found other outfits in her dressing-up box, and dressed up as different characters and famous people, sharing her exploits on social media.
cn: 接下来的几周，她在化妆箱里找到了其他服装，打扮成不同的角色和名人，并在社交媒体上分享她的"壮举"。

en: Before long, people started offering up their own fancy dresses for her to wear.
cn: 不久之后，人们开始拿出自己的奇装异服给她穿。

en: And before she knew it, she had done 20 weeks.
cn: 在她还没意识到的时候，已经做了20周了。

en: Explaining why she has kept up the videos, Andrea explained how nice it was to have a little bit of fun and craziness that made people smile.
cn: 在解释为什么一直坚持拍这些视频时，安德里亚说，有一点乐趣和疯狂，让人们微笑，是多么美好的事。

en: Besides, it also helps to remind people in the community to put out their trash bins each week.
cn: 此外，这也有助于提醒社区居民每周把垃圾桶拖出去。

en: No money but still hungry?
cn: 没钱但还饿着？

en: No problem!
cn: 没问题！

en: Welcome to Frank's restaurant where customers are paying for meals and leaving receipts on a board.
cn: 欢迎来到弗兰克的餐厅，这里的顾客在付餐费后会把收据留在公告板上。

en: Anyone who is hungry and wants something to eat can take one, no questions asked and hand it to the staff for some food.
cn: 任何饥饿想吃东西的人都可以取一张，无需任何问题，把它交给工作人员换取食物。

en: The idea for the board of free meals started after a donor came in with $100 for each member of its staff.
cn: 免费餐食公告板的创意始于一位捐赠者为每位员工带来了100美元。

en: After two staffers returned to their share, there was $700 leftover according to Tarah Morris, the owner of the restaurant, so they decided to do something more by creating the board.
cn: 据餐厅老板塔拉·莫里斯说，在两名员工退回了他们那份之后，还剩700美元，所以他们决定通过创建公告板来做更多的事情。

en: The board of free meals inside the restaurant shows a host of potential meals already paid for by customers, each costing about $10.
cn: 餐厅内的免费餐食公告板展示了许多顾客已预付的潜在餐食，每餐约10美元。

en: The board has messages of kindness like, "If you want more kindness in the world, put it here."
cn: 公告板上写着善意的信息，比如："如果你想让世界上有更多善意，就把善意放在这里。"

en: The drive has been going on for two weeks and Morris said just under 50 customers have picked up a free meal.
cn: 这项活动已经进行了两周，莫里斯说只有不到50名顾客领取了免费餐食。

en: There have been no reports of anyone taking advantage of the situation.
cn: 目前还没有任何人利用这一情况占便宜的报道。

en: In fact, there are a lot more people giving tickets than receiving.
cn: 事实上，给票的人比收票的人多得多。

en: It seems people want to help and are driven by helping others.
cn: 似乎人们想要帮助他人，并且受到帮助他人的驱动。

en: Welcome to our program, Friends and Relationships.
cn: 欢迎收听我们的节目《朋友与关系》。

en: Our guest today is psychologist Steve Pinker from McGill University.
cn: 我们今天的嘉宾是麦吉尔大学的心理学家史蒂夫·平克。

en: Glad to be here, Jane.
cn: 很高兴来到这里，简。

en: Hi.
cn: 嗨。

en: Steve.
cn: 史蒂夫。

en: Our question today is why friends suddenly disappear.
cn: 我们今天的问题是：为什么朋友会突然消失？

en: They may block us on their social media accounts and stop responding to our emails.
cn: 他们可能会在社交媒体账户上屏蔽我们，不再回复我们的邮件。

en: They simply vanish without a trace.
cn: 他们就那样消失得无影无踪。

en: The answer may lie in childhood, the way the person related to their mom and dad.
cn: 答案可能在于童年时期，在于一个人与父母相处的方式。

en: It's related to their attachment styles.
cn: 这与他们的依恋类型有关。

en: Attachment styles?
cn: 依恋类型？

en: Yeah.
cn: 是的。

en: There are two different attachment styles: an anxious attachment style and an avoidant attachment style.
cn: 有两种不同的依恋类型：焦虑型依恋和回避型依恋。

en: When there is a relationship breakdown with their parents, children with an anxious attachment style scream and cry to get their parents to come back.
cn: 当与父母的关系出现破裂时，焦虑型依恋的孩子会尖叫哭闹，想让父母回来。

en: But other children simply shut down and try to deal with their emotions by ignoring the situation.
cn: 但其他孩子则会封闭自己，试图通过忽视这种情况来处理情绪。

en: And these attachment styles carry on into adulthood.
cn: 这些依恋类型会延续到成年期。

en: Does avoidance reduce their stress levels?
cn: 回避能降低他们的压力水平吗？

en: Not really.
cn: 不一定。

en: Their stress levels are actually the same as those experienced by the children who yell and scream.
cn: 他们的压力水平实际上与那些大喊大叫的孩子所经历的是一样的。

en: And I assume both might be termed insecure.
cn: 我想这两者都可以被称为不安全的。

en: Exactly.
cn: 没错。

en: And it's a very insecure attachment.
cn: 这是一种非常不安全的依恋。

en: How does an insecure attachment affect relationships between friends, co-workers and romantic relationships?
cn: 不安全的依恋如何影响朋友、同事和恋爱关系？

en: It's the same as conflicts.
cn: 这和冲突一样。

en: So if you have a disagreement with a securely attached person, they're not going to panic.
cn: 所以如果你和安全型依恋的人有分歧，他们不会惊慌。

en: They're able to hear what the other person is saying and express their own feelings and thoughts effectively.
cn: 他们能够倾听对方在说什么，并有效地表达自己的感受和想法。

en: However, an insecurely attached person won't.
cn: 然而，不安全依恋的人则不会。

en: They might either attack you, get defensive or just disappear from your life.
cn: 他们可能会攻击你、采取防御姿态，或者干脆从你的生活中消失。

en: To them, a difference, no matter how small in your eyes, signals the end of the relationship.
cn: 对他们来说，一个分歧——无论在你看来多么微不足道——都标志着关系的终结。

en: That explains why they suddenly disappear.
cn: 这就解释了为什么他们会突然消失。

en: I hear you're going to Japan soon.
cn: 我听说你很快要去日本了。

en: Yes, that's right.
cn: 是的，没错。

en: Could I ask you a favor?
cn: 我能请你帮个忙吗？

en: Sure.
cn: 当然。

en: What is it?
cn: 什么事？

en: I was wondering if you could get me some jeans while you're there.
cn: 我在想你在那里的时候能不能帮我买几条牛仔裤。

en: I'll pay you back, of course.
cn: 当然，我会还你钱的。

en: A pair of jeans?
cn: 一条牛仔裤？

en: Okay.
cn: 好的。

en: I don't see why not.
cn: 我觉得没什么不可以的。

en: But what's wrong with jeans here?
cn: 但这里的牛仔裤有什么问题吗？

en: Well, I just love good jeans and Japan happens to make the best in the world.
cn: 嗯，我就是喜欢好的牛仔裤，而日本恰好生产世界上最好的牛仔裤。

en: My friend brought me a pair from there five years ago, and they still look new.
cn: 我朋友五年前从那里给我带了一条，现在看起来还是新的。

en: Really?
cn: 真的吗？

en: I had no idea Japan made jeans.
cn: 我不知道日本也生产牛仔裤。

en: I would have thought America made the best jeans because it's a typical American garment.
cn: 我还以为美国生产的牛仔裤最好，因为它是典型的美国服装。

en: Yeah, I thought so too.
cn: 是啊，我以前也这么想。

en: But it turns out Japan still has some very old mills with the traditional weaving tools used to make jeans the original way.
cn: 但事实证明，日本仍然有一些非常古老的工厂，使用传统编织工具，以原始方式制造牛仔裤。

en: It's a slower process of making clothing.
cn: 这是一个更慢的制衣过程。

en: But the end result is surely superior.
cn: 但最终结果肯定是更优质的。

en: Also, the fabric they use is of a higher quality and the dyes are natural.
cn: 此外，他们使用的布料质量更高，染料也是天然的。

en: They have a denser weave, and are more durable than any other jeans in the world.
cn: 它们的织法更紧密，比世界上任何其他牛仔裤都更耐穿。

en: That sounds cool.
cn: 听起来很酷。

en: What size do you want and how much are they?
cn: 你要多大尺寸？多少钱？

en: I have a 34 waist and size 30 or 32 in length.
cn: 我腰围34，长度30或32都行。

en: Either is fine.
cn: 都行。

en: They should be around $500.
cn: 大概500美元左右。

en: But make double certain they are made in Japan.
cn: 但一定要确保是日本制造的。

en: Boy, that's expensive.
cn: 天哪，真贵。

en: Do you typically spend that much on a pair of casual trousers?
cn: 你通常花那么多钱买一条休闲裤吗？

en: They are a little pricey, yes.
cn: 它们是有点贵，是的。

en: But they are very special.
cn: 但它们很特别。

en: Bear in mind: they will last me several years and they're very fashionable too.
cn: 记住：它们能穿好几年，而且也很时尚。

en: I think they're totally worth it.
cn: 我觉得它们完全值得。

en: Every time I walk out of a superhero movie, I feel the same way.
cn: 每次我走出超级英雄电影，我都有同样的感觉。

en: I experience a sense of longing, realizing that there should be more in life.
cn: 我体验到一种渴望，意识到生活中应该有更多的东西。

en: The desire for adventure is a human one.
cn: 对冒险的渴望是人之常情。

en: Superhero films capture this desire perfectly.
cn: 超级英雄电影完美地捕捉了这种渴望。

en: The plot of each superhero film has become relatively predictable: the world is in peril, the world needs a hero, the hero is in peril, the hero resolves the peril, the hero saves the world.
cn: 每部超级英雄电影的情节都变得相对可预测：世界陷入危机，世界需要英雄，英雄陷入危机，英雄化解危机，英雄拯救世界。

en: Each film has an attractive lead, several expensive explosions, a few jokes to lighten the mood, and numerous punches that land unrealistically well.
cn: 每部电影都有一个有魅力的主角、几场昂贵的爆炸场面、一些缓解气氛的笑话，以及大量精准得不现实的拳击场面。

en: Even though we basically know what will happen, we keep coming back for more.
cn: 即使我们基本上知道会发生什么，我们还是会不断回来寻求更多。

en: The elites of our society have rejected superhero films.
cn: 我们社会的精英们已经拒绝了超级英雄电影。

en: They say the films lack any form of artistry.
cn: 他们说这些电影缺乏任何形式的艺术性。

en: These movies are criticized as being too simple.
cn: 这些电影被批评为过于简单。

en: But they give the fans what they want — entertainment.
cn: 但它们给了粉丝们想要的东西——娱乐。

en: No matter the form in which they reveal themselves, hero stories will always be present in life.
cn: 无论以何种形式呈现，英雄故事将永远存在于生活中。

en: It's not just about being entertained, but also being inspired.
cn: 这不仅是为了娱乐，也是为了获得启发。

en: One author has mentioned that women desire to play an irreplaceable role in a great adventure.
cn: 一位作家曾提到，女性渴望在伟大的冒险中扮演不可替代的角色。

en: "Most young women want to be a part of something grand, something important."
cn: "大多数年轻女性都想参与一些宏伟的、重要的事情。"

en: It seems clear that this principle applies to men, as well.
cn: 很明显，这一原则也适用于男性。

en: So next time you see your favorite superhero film, be entertained, but also be inspired.
cn: 所以，下次你看你最喜欢的超级英雄电影时，既要娱乐，也要受到启发。

en: Let that small longing you feel motivate you to make a difference.
cn: 让你感受到的那份小小的渴望激励你去做出改变。

en: Telling stories is one of the most powerful means leaders have to influence, teach and inspire.
cn: 讲故事是领导者影响、教育和激励他人的最有力手段之一。

en: Storytelling forges connections among people.
cn: 讲故事能在人与人之间建立联系。

en: When it comes to our countries, our communities, and our families, we understand instinctively that the stories we hold in common are an important part of the ties that bind.
cn: 当涉及我们的国家、社区和家庭时，我们本能地明白，我们共同拥有的故事是维系我们关系的重要组成部分。

en: This understanding also holds true in the business world, where an organization's stories, and the stories its leaders tell, help solidify relationships in a way that factual statements don't.
cn: 这种理解在商业世界也同样适用——一个组织的故事及其领导者讲述的故事，能够以事实陈述无法做到的方式巩固关系。

en: Good stories do more than create a sense of connection.
cn: 好故事不仅仅是创造一种联系感。

en: They build familiarity and trust.
cn: 它们还能建立熟悉感和信任。

en: They allow the listener to enter the story, making them more open to learning.
cn: 它们让听众进入故事，使他们更乐于学习。

en: Good stories can contain multiple meanings, so they're surprisingly economical in conveying complex ideas in graspable ways.
cn: 好故事可以包含多重含义，因此在以易于理解的方式传达复杂思想方面，它们出奇地高效。

en: And stories are more engaging than the recital of data points or a discussion of abstract ideas.
cn: 而且，故事比背诵数据点或讨论抽象概念更吸引人。

en: Stories about professional mistakes and what leaders learned from them are another great avenue for learning.
cn: 关于职业错误以及领导者从中吸取教训的故事是另一个很好的学习途径。

en: Because people identify so closely with stories, they can imagine how they would have acted in similar circumstances.
cn: 因为人们与故事产生如此强烈的共鸣，他们可以想象自己在类似情况下会如何行动。

en: They're able to work through situations in a way that's risk free.
cn: 他们能够以一种无风险的方式去应对各种情况。

en: There are extra benefits for leaders: with a simple personal story, they can convey fundamental values.
cn: 对领导者来说还有额外的好处：通过一个简单的个人故事，他们可以传达基本的价值观。

en: They can offer insight into the evolution of their own experience and knowledge, presenting themselves as more approachable and then they are more likely to inspire others to want to know more.
cn: 他们可以展现自身经验和知识的演变过程，让自己显得更平易近人，从而更有可能激发他人想要了解更多。

en: The U.S. was founded by successive waves of immigrants, and immigrants are still contributing to America today—statistics prove it.
cn: 美国是由一波又一波的移民建立的，而移民至今仍在为美国做贡献——统计数据证明了这一点。

en: On two key measures of financial performance, immigrants outperform native-born Americans.
cn: 在财务表现的两个关键指标上，移民的表现优于本土出生的美国人。

en: First, they are more likely to be entrepreneurs.
cn: 首先，他们更有可能成为企业家。

en: From 1996 to 2016, the pace at which immigrants started businesses was double that of U.S.-born individuals.
cn: 从1996年到2016年，移民创业的速度是美国出生者的两倍。

en: Immigrants aren't just becoming entrepreneurs more frequently.
cn: 移民不仅更频繁地成为企业家。

en: They're often succeeding.
cn: 他们往往也能成功。

en: Over 40% of Fortune 500 companies had a founder who was either an immigrant or the child of one.
cn: 超过40%的财富500强公司的创始人要么是移民，要么是移民的子女。

en: Another key measure of financial strength is debt level.
cn: 衡量财务实力的另一个关键指标是债务水平。

en: Immigrants do better in this area too.
cn: 移民在这方面也表现得更好。

en: Immigrants use credit less often for purchasing cars, homes or starting businesses.
cn: 移民在购车、购房或创业时较少使用信贷。

en: This results in significantly lower levels of debt than native-born Americans.
cn: 这使得他们的债务水平显著低于本土出生的美国人。

en: For example, 34% of Americans born in Latin America report no credit card or installment loan debt.
cn: 例如，34%出生于拉丁美洲的美国人报告没有信用卡或分期贷款债务。

en: This can be compared to just 19% of the general population.
cn: 相比之下，总人口中这一比例仅为19%。

en: Why are immigrants doing so well?
cn: 为什么移民做得这么好？

en: The values and habits they bring from their own homelands help explain some of the success.
cn: 他们从祖国带来的价值观和习惯有助于解释他们的部分成功。

en: Unemployment tends to be higher in developing countries.
cn: 发展中国家的失业率往往更高。

en: That means more people must become entrepreneurs.
cn: 这意味着必须有更多的人成为企业家。

en: Credit is also scarcer in most developing countries.
cn: 在大多数发展中国家，信贷也更加稀缺。

en: This means individuals must save more in order to achieve their goals, or they borrow money from friends and family rather than a bank.
cn: 这意味着个人必须储蓄更多来实现目标，或者他们从朋友和家人那里借钱，而不是从银行。

en: That means less debt and potentially better credit outcomes when they reach the U.S.
cn: 这意味着当他们到达美国时，债务更少，信用记录可能更好。

en: A police officer in the U.S. stopped a large SUV car that was going very slowly and drifting across lanes on a highway.
cn: 美国一名警察在高速公路上拦下了一辆行驶非常缓慢并在车道上漂移的大型SUV。

en: He expected to find the driver who was either very drunk or having a medical emergency.
cn: 他原以为司机要么是喝得烂醉，要么是有紧急医疗情况。

en: Instead, the officer discovered a five-year-old boy sat on the edge of the driver's seat.
cn: 相反，警察发现一位5岁的男孩坐在驾驶座边上。

en: His feet could barely reach the brake, and his head was only just high enough to see out of the windows.
cn: 他的脚几乎够不到刹车，头也刚好高到可以看到窗外。

en: The child had taken the keys to the family car while his teenage sister was napping.
cn: 这个孩子趁他十几岁的姐姐打盹的时候拿了家里汽车的钥匙。

en: He then drove three kilometers across town before getting on the highway.
cn: 然后他驱车三公里穿过城镇，上了高速公路。

en: The boy later told confused officers that he was planning to travel to California and buy a Lamborghini sports car.
cn: 这名男孩后来告诉困惑的警察，他计划去加利福尼亚买一辆兰博基尼跑车。

en: Although he only had 3 dollars in his wallet, at least he was driving in the right direction.
cn: 虽然他钱包里只有3美元，但至少他开对了方向。

en: Mobile phones have changed the way we live—how we read, work, communicate, and shop.
cn: 手机已经改变了我们的生活方式——我们如何阅读、工作、交流和购物。

en: But we already know this.
cn: 但这一点我们已经知道了。

en: What we have not yet understood is the way the tiny machines in front of us are changing our skeletons, possibly altering not just the way we behave, but even the very shape of our bodies.
cn: 我们还不了解的是，我们面前的微型机器正在改变我们的骨骼，可能不仅改变我们的行为方式，甚至改变我们身体的形状。

en: New scientific research at the University of the Sunshine Coast in Queensland, Australia, suggests that young people are developing extra pieces of bone at the backs of their heads.
cn: 澳大利亚昆士兰阳光海岸大学的一项新的科学研究表明，年轻人的后脑勺正在长出额外的骨头。

en: These pieces of bone are caused by the way people bend their heads when they use the phone.
cn: 这些骨头是由人们使用手机时低头的方式造成的。

en: This shifts weight onto the muscles at the back of the head and causes the bone to grow in a way that is not normal.
cn: 这将重量转移到脑后的肌肉上，导致骨骼以一种不正常的方式生长。

en: This process can be compared to the way the skin hardens in response to constant rubbing or pressure.
cn: 这个过程可以与皮肤在不断摩擦或压力下变硬的方式相比较。

en: The result is a piece of bone like a horn that sticks out from the head by the neck.
cn: 结果是一块像角一样的骨头从脖子处伸出来。

en: A village is going to throw a birthday party for an orange cat named Wilbur, who has become famous for making regular appearances at local shops.
cn: 一个村庄将为一只名叫威尔伯的橙色猫举办生日派对，这只猫因经常出现在当地的商店而闻名。

en: Wilbur has his own Internet pages as he approaches his 10th birthday on July 7.
cn: 7月7日，威尔伯即将迎来他10岁生日，他有了自己的网页。

en: Wilbur is both bold and friendly.
cn: 威尔伯既勇敢又友好。

en: He spends most of his time in shops and businesses around the village.
cn: 他大部分时间都在村里的商店和企业里度过。

en: He'll just take himself into any shop, anywhere.
cn: 他会光顾任意一家商店，去任意一个地方。

en: There was one time when the doctor's receptionist came back and he was sitting on her chair.
cn: 有一次，医生的接待员回来了，他坐在她的椅子上。

en: Among his favorite haunts are a local hairdresser, two pubs, and the Nottingham Primary School.
cn: 他最喜欢去的地方包括当地的一家理发店、两家酒吧和诺丁汉小学。

en: Lesley Harper, who runs one of the pubs, said the cat has been a big hit with their customers.
cn: 其中一家酒吧的老板莱斯利·哈珀说，这只猫很受顾客欢迎。

en: "He's been a regular visitor for most of this year," she told the Press Association.
cn: "在今年的大部分时间里，他都是我们的常客，"她告诉美联社。

en: "He's a very relaxed cat, happy for customers and villagers young and old to come in and say hello."
cn: "它是一只非常放松的猫，很高兴顾客和村民老少进来打招呼。"

en: She also said he is a cat of expensive tastes, who likes his high-priced cat food.
cn: 她还说他是一只品味昂贵的猫，喜欢他的高价猫食。

en: Sarah Godfrey, who is organizing Wilbur's party, told the local newspaper, "Wilbur is part of our lives, as he is for everyone who lives in the village."
cn: 组织威尔伯派对的莎拉·戈弗雷告诉当地报纸，"威尔伯是我们生活的一部分，就像他对村里的每一个人一样。"

en: So, where do you want to go for lunch?
cn: 那么，你想去哪里吃午饭？

en: I don't know.
cn: 我不知道。

en: Do you have anything in mind?
cn: 你有什么想法吗？

en: What about the sandwich place on Camden Street?
cn: 卡姆登街上的三明治店怎么样？

en: Um, no, sorry.
cn: 嗯，不，抱歉。

en: I don't feel like sandwiches today.
cn: 我今天不想吃三明治。

en: It's a great place, but I think we go there too often.
cn: 那是一个很棒的地方，但是我觉得我们去得太频繁了。

en: That's true.
cn: 没错。

en: Remember, that's where we saw Bridget Clark, the famous movie star.
cn: 记得吗，我们就是在那里见到著名影星布里奇特·克拉克的。

en: Of course.
cn: 当然记得。

en: How could I ever forget?
cn: 我怎么会忘记呢？

en: There were crowds of people around her, asking for a photo with her.
cn: 有一大群人围着她，要求和她合影。

en: What about hamburgers, then?
cn: 那汉堡包呢？

en: There's that American style diner on the way to the mall.
cn: 去商场的路上有一家美式餐厅。

en: I like that place.
cn: 我喜欢那个地方。

en: Their chips are great, but their service takes a long time, and I need to get back by 2:30 for a conference call.
cn: 他们的薯条很不错，但服务时间太长，我两点半前得赶回去开电话会议。

en: How about trying something new?
cn: 试试新东西怎么样？

en: We could try Mario's, the new Italian restaurant on the corner.
cn: 我们可以试试街角新开的意大利餐厅Mario's。

en: It looks all right.
cn: 看起来不错。

en: Have you been there?
cn: 你去过那里吗？

en: No, I haven't, but I've noticed that it has great reviews on the internet.
cn: 没有，但是我注意到网上对它的评价很好。

en: It's supposed to be one of the best Italians in town.
cn: 应该是镇上最好的意大利餐厅之一。

en: I think Jeremy has been there and said it was amazing.
cn: 我想杰里米去过那里，他说那里太棒了。

en: I'm up for that.
cn: 我愿意去。

en: Cool.
cn: 棒极了。

en: Have you asked Jeremy if he would like to come with us?
cn: 你问过杰里米是否愿意和我们一起去吗？

en: I already have.
cn: 我已经问过了。

en: He says he can't.
cn: 他说他去不了。

en: He has brought his own lunch today, so he will stay in.
cn: 他今天自己带了午餐，所以他将会留下来。

en: I think his wife made him soup.
cn: 我想他妻子给他做了汤。

en: Poor Jeremy.
cn: 可怜的杰里米。

en: His wife is a terrible cook.
cn: 他的妻子是一个糟糕的厨师。

en: He should throw that soup in the bin and join us.
cn: 他应该把汤扔进垃圾桶，加入我们。

en: Hi there.
cn: 嗨，您好。

en: How are you today?
cn: 您今天怎么样？

en: Do you have a reservation with us already?
cn: 您已经在我们这里预订了吗？

en: Good afternoon.
cn: 下午好。

en: Yes, we reserved our rooms yesterday morning on your website for three nights.
cn: 是的，我们昨天早上在你们的网站上预订了三个晚上的房间。

en: The name's Patterson.
cn: 我叫帕特森。

en: Okay, let me have a look.
cn: 好的，我看一下。

en: Yes, we have it here.
cn: 是的，我们这里有。

en: You brought the whole family with you, I see.
cn: 你把家人都带来了。

en: Yes, the two kids, my wife and I, and her parents too.
cn: 是的，两个孩子，我和我妻子，还有她的父母。

en: Great.
cn: 太好了。

en: So, we have a family room for you and your wife and the kids, and another double room for your parents-in-law.
cn: 我们有一间家庭房给您、您的妻子和孩子，还有一间双人房给您的岳父岳母。

en: They are right next to each other on the ground floor, since you mentioned in your message that they have trouble with stairs.
cn: 他们在一楼，而且紧挨着，因为您在留言中提到他们上楼梯有问题。

en: That's wonderful.
cn: 那太好了。

en: My father-in-law has had terrible problems getting up and down stairs since his knee operation last April.
cn: 我的岳父自从去年四月做了膝盖手术后，上下楼梯就有了严重的问题。

en: I'm sorry to hear that, and if you need any help to find transportation for the whole family, we can definitely recommend someone for you.
cn: 很遗憾听到这个消息，如果您在为全家寻找交通工具方面需要任何帮助的话，我们绝对可以为您推荐。

en: We were thinking of renting a car, but we will explore all the options available for sure.
cn: 我们在考虑租一辆车，但我们肯定会探索所有可行的选择。

en: So yes, that would be very helpful in comparing prices.
cn: 是的，这对价格对比很有帮助。

en: We're also wondering what tours and day trips are available.
cn: 我们还想知道有哪些旅行和一日游。

en: We have bunches of brochures here.
cn: 我们这里有很多小册子。

en: I would recommend getting out on a boat trip.
cn: 我建议乘船旅行。

en: The kids will love it, and there are so many islands nearby to explore.
cn: 孩子们会喜欢的，而且附近有很多岛屿可以探索。

en: There's also a great night market further into town that has all kinds of food and cool little shops selling souvenirs and local jewelry and clothing made by hand.
cn: 还有一个很棒的夜市，那里有各种各样的食物和很酷的小商店，出售纪念品和当地手工制作的珠宝和服装。

en: That all sounds marvelous.
cn: 听起来太棒了。

en: Now, all I need is to photocopy your passports, and then I can get you all checked in and show you to your rooms.
cn: 现在，我只需要复印你们的护照，然后就可以帮你们办理入住手续，并带你们去房间。

en: Artificial intelligence agents play ever more influential roles in our lives.
cn: 人工智能代理在我们的生活中扮演着越来越重要的角色。

en: They do everything from suggesting new friends to recommending purchases.
cn: 从推荐新朋友到推荐商品，他们无所不包。

en: They're even beginning to drive our cars.
cn: 他们甚至开始驾驶我们的车了。

en: Another role that they are expected to take over is negotiating on our behalf in commercial transactions or legal disputes.
cn: 他们预计将承担的另一个任务是代表我们在商业交易或法律纠纷中进行谈判。

en: So, it's important to know whether using an artificial intelligence agent might affect how we negotiate.
cn: 所以，了解使用人工智能代理是否会影响我们的谈判方式是很重要的。

en: Research indicates that it does.
cn: 研究表明确实如此。

en: In a new study, participants were told to imagine that they were negotiating for something important to them, like a house.
cn: 在一项新的研究中，参与者被要求想象他们正在为一些对他们来说很重要的东西进行谈判，比如房子。

en: Next, they were told either that they would negotiate for themselves, or they would program an artificial intelligence agent to negotiate for them.
cn: 接下来，他们被告知要么自己谈判，要么编写一个人工智能代理程序来替他们谈判。

en: Participants then completed a survey, indicating how tough, deceptive, and pleasant or otherwise they wanted to be, or wanted their agent to be in the negotiations.
cn: 然后，参与者完成了一项调查，表明他们希望自己有多强硬、有多具有欺骗性、有多友善或不友善，或者有多希望他们的代理人在谈判中表现如何。

en: For example, participants could choose to be tough by making an opening demand far greater than what they'd be willing to accept.
cn: 例如，参与者可以选择强硬一点，提出一个远远超过他们愿意接受的初始要求。

en: They could also choose to express sympathy with their opponent, to appear pleasant.
cn: 他们也可以选择表达对对手的同情，表现得友善。

en: But they could also indicate that they, or their agent, would strategically express anger toward the opponent to gain advantage, or they could opt to convey dissatisfaction with the encounter so that the other party would think they were losing interest.
cn: 但他们也可以表示，他们或他们的代理人会策略性地表达对对手的愤怒以获得优势，或者他们可以选择表达对这次遭遇的不满，这样对方就会认为他们失去了兴趣。

en: These are both examples of deceptive strategies.
cn: 这些都是欺骗策略的例子。

en: Participants were more willing to employ deceptive strategies when assigned an agent to negotiate on their behalf.
cn: 当被指派代理人代表他们进行谈判时，参与者更愿意采用欺骗策略。

en: New research has studied the effects of a seven-week healthy cooking course.
cn: 一项新的研究调查了七周健康烹饪课程的效果。

en: Academics measured the program's effect on cooking confidence and self-perceived mental health.
cn: 学者们评估了该项目对烹饪自信和自我认知心理健康的影响。

en: Researchers also measured participants' overall satisfaction around cooking and diet-related behaviors.
cn: 研究人员还评定了参与者对烹饪和饮食相关行为的总体满意度。

en: What were the findings?
cn: 调查结果是什么？

en: Course participants saw significant improvements in general health.
cn: 课程参与者的总体健康状况有了显著改善。

en: They also reported improved mental health and subjective vitality immediately after the program.
cn: 他们还报告说，在项目结束后，他们的心理健康和主观活力都得到了改善。

en: These benefits remained six months after the completion of the course.
cn: 这些好处在课程结束后六个月仍然存在。

en: What caused these improvements?
cn: 是什么带来了这些改善？

en: Researchers have previously found the link between eating more fruits and vegetables, and improved longer term mental health.
cn: 研究人员此前发现，多吃水果和蔬菜与改善长期心理健康之间存在联系。

en: This would imply that the participants in the current study may have felt better due to improved diet.
cn: 这意味着目前研究中的参与者可能因为饮食的改善而感觉更好。

en: However, the study showed participants' mental health improved even if their reported diets did not change after completing the program.
cn: 然而，研究表明，即使参与者报告的饮食在完成该计划后没有改变，他们的心理健康状况也有所改善。

en: Also, the mental health benefits were equal among participants who were overweight or obese, and those in a healthy weight range.
cn: 此外，在超重或肥胖的参与者和体重正常的参与者中，心理健康的益处是相同的。

en: This suggests a link between cooking confidence and satisfaction around cooking and mental health benefits.
cn: 这表明，烹饪自信和烹饪满意度与心理健康益处之间存在联系。

en: Who benefits most from learning to cook?
cn: 谁从学习烹饪中获益最大？

en: Gender plays a part.
cn: 性别起了一定作用。

en: At the start of the program, 77 percent of female participants were confident about cooking, but just 23 percent of males were confident.
cn: 在项目开始时，77%的女性参与者对烹饪有信心，但只有23%的男性有信心。

en: At the end of the program, cooking confidence and skills were equal across both counterparts.
cn: 在项目结束时，两组参与者的烹饪信心和技巧不相上下。

en: This change in confidence could lead to a gender balance in home cooking.
cn: 这种信心的变化可能会导致家庭烹饪中的性别平衡。

en: This, in turn, could reduce consumption of unhealthy, high calorie processed meals.
cn: 反过来，这可以减少不健康、高热量加工食品的消费。

en: What is personal space?
cn: 什么是个人空间？

en: We often think of it as an invisible bubble of space surrounding us that others can't enter without causing discomfort.
cn: 我们通常认为它是一个围绕在我们周围的看不见的空间气泡，其他人进入就会让我们感到不舒服。

en: Research shows, however, that we actually have bubbles of different sizes.
cn: 然而，研究表明，我们实际上有不同大小的气泡。

en: Each of these bubbles applies to a different set of people.
cn: 每个气泡都适用于不同的人群。

en: The smallest zone, called intimate space, extends outward from our bodies 18 inches in every direction.
cn: 最小的区域，被称为亲密空间，从我们的身体向各个方向延伸18英寸。

en: Only family, pets and one's closest friends may enter it.
cn: 只有家人、宠物和最亲密的朋友才能进入。

en: A mere acquaintance entering our intimate space makes us uncomfortable.
cn: 仅仅是一个熟人进入我们的私密空间会让我们感到不舒服。

en: Next is the bubble, called personal space, extending from 1.5 feet to 4 feet away.
cn: 下一个是被称为个人空间的气泡，从1.5英尺延伸到4英尺远。

en: Friends and acquaintances can comfortably occupy this zone, especially during informal conversations.
cn: 朋友和熟人可以轻松地占据这个区域，尤其是在非正式的谈话中。

en: But strangers are forbidden.
cn: 但陌生人则被禁止进入。

en: Extending from 4 to 12 feet away from us is social space.
cn: 距离我们4到12英尺的是社交空间。

en: Here, people feel comfortable conducting routine social interactions with new acquaintances or total strangers.
cn: 在这里，人们与新认识的人或完全陌生的人进行日常社交活动感到很舒服。

en: Those are the average sizes of Americans' personal bubbles, anyway.
cn: 不管怎么说，这些都是美国人个人气泡的平均大小。

en: It is important to keep in mind that personal space varies depending on culture and context.
cn: 重要的是要记住，个人空间因文化和环境而异。

en: Furthermore, there are significant individual differences.
cn: 此外，还存在显著的个体差异。

en: As we all know, cultural or individual differences in personal bubble diameters are all too often the cause of discomfort.
cn: 我们都知道，个人气泡直径的文化差异或个体差异往往是造成不适的原因。

en: How did these personal bubbles arise?
cn: 这些个人气泡是如何产生的？

en: According to research, we begin to develop our individual sense of personal space around age 3 or 4.
cn: 根据研究，我们在3岁或4岁左右开始发展个人空间感。

en: The sizes of our bubbles are fixed by our teens.
cn: 我们气泡的大小是在青少年时期固定的。

en: These bubbles are constructed and monitored by the brain region involved in fear.
cn: 这些气泡是由大脑中与恐惧有关的区域制造和监控的。

en: Have you noticed how similar you are to your friends?
cn: 你有没有注意到你和你的朋友有多么的相似？

en: It may be because your brains operate in harmony with each other.
cn: 这可能是因为你们的大脑运转协调一致。

en: We know that friends are more likely to be the same age, gender, and ethnic background as each other.
cn: 我们知道，朋友们更可能有相同的年龄、性别和种族背景。

en: Now it seems their brains are alike too.
cn: 现在看来，他们的大脑也很相似。

en: Researchers at the University of California scanned the brains of 42 classmates while they watched videos intended to provoke varying responses.
cn: 加州大学的研究人员扫描了42位同学的大脑，同时让他们观看旨在引起不同反应的视频。

en: Some people might find a romantic scene touching, for instance, while others would feel it was embarrassing.
cn: 例如，有些人可能会觉得浪漫的场景很感人，而另一些人则会觉得尴尬。

en: The activity of friends' brains was more similar than that of people who didn't know each other, particularly in regions involved in attention, emotion, and language.
cn: 朋友之间的大脑活动比不认识的人更相似，尤其是在涉及注意力、情感和语言的区域。

en: This similarity was strong enough that it could be used to predict whether two people were already friends or not.
cn: 这种相似性非常强，可以用来预测两个人是否已经是朋友。

en: The relationship probably goes two ways.
cn: 这种关系可能是双向的。

en: We are drawn to people who think like us.
cn: 我们会被和我们想法相似的人吸引。

en: We then influence their thoughts over time, which may push their brain activity into more closely resembling our own.
cn: 随着时间的推移，我们会影响他们的想法，这可能会使他们的大脑活动更接近我们自己的大脑活动。

en: Two men who have been best friends for 60 years have just realized they are actually brothers.
cn: 两个男人做了60年的好朋友，最近才意识到他们其实是兄弟。

en: It's reported that Alan Robinson and Walter McDonald met in the 6th grade at a school in Hawaii.
cn: 据报道，艾伦·罗宾逊和沃尔特·麦克唐纳六年级时在夏威夷的一所学校认识。

en: They have been best friends ever since.
cn: 从那以后，他们一直是最好的朋友。

en: Alan was given away for adoption soon after he was born, and Walter never knew his father.
cn: 艾伦出生后不久就被别人收养了，沃尔特不知道他的父亲是谁。

en: So recently, they made separate attempts on DNA matching websites to discover more about their ancestry.
cn: 所以最近，他们分别在DNA匹配网站上进行了尝试，以发现更多关于他们祖先的信息。

en: Walter was astonished to find that he matched with website user Robi737.
cn: 沃尔特惊讶地发现他与网站用户Robi737匹配。

en: He knew immediately that this was his best friend, Alan, whose friends call him Robi, and who flew 737 airplanes when he was a pilot.
cn: 他随即就知道了这是他最好的朋友艾伦。艾伦的朋友们都称艾伦为罗比。他曾是一名飞行员，驾驶过737系列飞机。

en: The pair were born to the same mother 15 months apart.
cn: 这两个人是由同一位母亲所生，时间相差15个月。

en: Amid all the election drama, air pollution problems and disease outbreaks, five tourists' good work is being spread online.
cn: 在所有选举闹剧、空气污染问题和疾病爆发的背景下，五名游客的善举正在网上传播。

en: Yesterday, 2 male and 3 female tourists were spotted walking the kilometer-long beach, picking up trash.
cn: 昨天，两名男性和三名女性游客被发现在长达一公里的海滩上捡垃圾。

en: One of the male tourists from Australia commented that although there was a lot of trash, nobody was doing anything.
cn: 一名来自澳大利亚的男游客评论说，虽然有很多垃圾，但没有人采取任何行动。

en: The beach was not as nice or beautiful as it should be.
cn: 海滩并不像它应有的那么漂亮。

en: He felt so sad to see such a gorgeous place littered with so much trash.
cn: 看到这么漂亮的地方到处都是垃圾，他感到很难过。

en: Thus, he and his friends decided to grab a few trash bags and clean it all up.
cn: 因此，他和他的朋友们决定拿几个垃圾袋把它清理干净。

en: A man passing by decided to video their good deed and put it on the Internet.
cn: 一名路过的男士决定把他们的善举拍下来放到网上。

en: It was unclear where the rest of the group was from, but they were most likely traveling together.
cn: 目前还不清楚这群人的其他成员来自哪里，但他们很可能是一起旅行的。

en: One local woman commented on being embarrassed that tourists were cleaning up their beach.
cn: 一位当地的女士评论说，游客正在清理他们的海滩，她感到很羞愧。

en: Another mentioned that it was actually the natives who brought food and drinks, then left trash all along the island.
cn: 另一个人提到，实际上是当地人带来了食物和饮料，然后在岛上到处扔垃圾。

en: Hello, Benjamin.
cn: 你好，本杰明。

en: Dan and I will be going for a run along the canal Saturday morning.
cn: 丹和我星期六早上要沿着运河跑步。

en: Would you like to join us?
cn: 你想加入我们吗？

en: I'd love to, but I hurt my ankle last weekend playing football with work colleagues.
cn: 我很想去，但是我上周末和同事踢足球时扭伤了脚踝。

en: Oh dear, is it serious?
cn: 哦，天哪，严重吗？

en: No, not at all.
cn: 不，一点也不严重。

en: I landed badly during a fall and twisted it a little, but it's no big deal.
cn: 我摔倒时落地姿势不好，有点扭伤，但没什么大不了的。

en: It's just a little swollen and I should be fine for next Saturday if you still want to go for a jog then.
cn: 只是有点肿。如果你下周六还想去慢跑的话，我应该没问题。

en: I won't be here next Saturday.
cn: 下周六我不在这。

en: I'm going to the zoo.
cn: 我要去动物园。

en: The zoo?
cn: 动物园？

en: Yeah.
cn: 是的。

en: My little nephew turns six, and he loves the zoo.
cn: 我的小侄子六岁了，他喜欢动物园。

en: So the whole family is going.
cn: 所以全家都要去。

en: Oh, okay then.
cn: 哦，那好吧。

en: I haven't been to a zoo since I was a kid.
cn: 我从小就再也没有去过动物园了。

en: They are nowhere near as popular as they used to be when we were children.
cn: 它们远没有我们小时候那么受欢迎了。

en: I personally feel sorry for the poor animals stuck in cages.
cn: 我个人为那些被困在笼子里的可怜动物感到难过。

en: But there's no denying they are fun and educational for children.
cn: 但不可否认，它们对孩子们来说既有趣又有教育意义。

en: Do you know if Dan will be around next Saturday?
cn: 你知道丹下周六是否会来吗？

en: Yeah, I think he will.
cn: 我想他会的。

en: Just send him a text message.
cn: 给他发个短信就行。

en: He's always keen on physical activities.
cn: 他一直热衷于体育活动。

en: That's true.
cn: 没错。

en: Dan is extremely fit and healthy.
cn: 丹非常健康。

en: He goes to the gym most days, plus tennis two or three times a week.
cn: 他大多数日子都去健身房，每周还打两三次网球。

en: So, what have you been doing to stay busy while you've had that swollen ankle?
cn: 那么，在你脚踝肿起来的这段时间里，你都在忙些什么呢？

en: I've been catching up on some reading.
cn: 我一直在读书。

en: I was given three books over Christmas, and I'm only now getting around to reading them.
cn: 圣诞节期间我收到了三本书，现在才抽出时间读。

en: Our guest on today's Book Talk is John Black, the author of the new bestseller Retire Early.
cn: 我们今天《书论》节目的嘉宾是约翰·布莱克，他是最新畅销书《早早退休》的作者。

en: Thanks for having me on the show, Lisa.
cn: 谢谢你邀请我参加节目，丽莎。

en: John, your book is getting a lot of attention, partly because you write that most people can retire by 40.
cn: 约翰，你的书很受关注，部分原因是你写道，大多数人可以在40岁退休。

en: Is that realistic?
cn: 这现实吗？

en: Definitely.
cn: 当然。

en: When researching this book, I interviewed hundreds of people who retired by 40.
cn: 在写这本书做研究时，我采访了数百名40岁就退休的人。

en: Okay.
cn: 好的。

en: But how much money does a person need to retire?
cn: 但是一个人需要多少钱才能退休呢？

en: I've read articles recommending one million dollars as a good figure for retirement.
cn: 我读过一些文章，里面建议说比较不错的退休金额是100万美元。

en: While most financial planners do give numbers, I don't think that's useful, as people are living in different areas with different costs of living, and have different needs and wants, which is why I suggest that people aim for financial independence.
cn: 虽然大多数理财规划师会给出具体的数字，但我认为这没有用。因为人们生活在不同的地区，生活成本不同，需求和欲望也不同，这就是为什么我建议人们以经济独立为目标。

en: What do you mean by financial independence?
cn: 你说的经济独立是什么意思？

en: Having investment income that's greater than monthly expenses.
cn: 投资收益大于每月支出。

en: That sounds risky to me.
cn: 我觉得这听起来很冒险。

en: What if an accident happens or you get ill and need medical treatment?
cn: 如果发生意外或者你生病需要治疗怎么办？

en: Shouldn't people have extra cash for emergencies?
cn: 人们不应该有多余的现金以备不时之需吗？

en: Too many people spend their lives working on jobs they hate because they're afraid.
cn: 太多人一辈子都在做他们讨厌的工作，因为他们害怕。

en: So I counsel people to take risks.
cn: 所以我建议人们去冒险。

en: Retirement doesn't have to be permanent.
cn: 退休不一定是永久性的。

en: And if people need to, they can go back to work.
cn: 如果人们需要，他们可以回去工作。

en: But it's not always easy to get back into the workforce after an extended absence.
cn: 但是在长时间的休假后，重新回到工作岗位并不总是那么容易。

en: True, but if you keep current with your skills, you will be attractive to employers.
cn: 没错，但是如果你的技能能跟上时代的发展，你对雇主就会很有吸引力。

en: Maybe.
cn: 也许吧。

en: But how can anyone save enough to retire by 40 when most people can't retire at 60?
cn: 但是，在大多数人无法在60岁退休的情况下，人们如何能在40岁之前攒够退休的钱呢？

en: Simple.
cn: 简单。

en: By cutting housing, food, and transport expenses and investing half your monthly income.
cn: 通过削减住房、食物和交通费用，并投资你每月收入的一半。

en: That sounds impossible.
cn: 听起来不可能。

en: I admit it's difficult, but it has worked for thousands.
cn: 我承认这很难，但这个方法对数千人奏效。

en: New research from America studies the role that the presence of individuals from different social or racial groups has in influencing consumers' food choices.
cn: 美国的一项新研究调查了如果有不同社会或种族的个体在场，会对消费者的食物选择产生什么影响。

en: This research found college students were more likely to choose healthy food in the presence of an observer of a different race, as opposed to an observer from their own race.
cn: 这项研究发现，大学生更有可能在不同种族的观察者面前选择健康食品，而不是在自己种族的观察者面前这样做。

en: The same was true when they were with someone from a different university compared to someone from their own.
cn: 当他们和来自不同大学的人在一起，而不是和自己大学的人在一起时，情况也是如此。

en: Researchers say this was because participants anticipated more negative judgment from an outsider group.
cn: 研究人员说，这是因为参与者预期外部群体会有更多的负面评价。

en: In contrast, they felt less judged by members of their own group.
cn: 相比之下，他们觉得自己的群体成员对他们的评价更少。

en: In one experiment, participants were offered the choice between candy and fruit as a snack.
cn: 在一项实验中，参与者可以选择糖果和水果作为零食。

en: When in the presence of an unknown student from their own university, only 12 percent of students selected the healthier option.
cn: 当有来自自己大学的陌生学生在场时，只有12%的学生选择了更健康的零食。

en: However, this number was 31 percent when in the presence of an unknown student from another university.
cn: 然而，当有来自其他大学的陌生学生在场时，这一数字为31%。

en: Other experiments showed similar results based on racial group.
cn: 其他基于种族的实验也显示了类似的结果。

en: What's the reason for this pattern?
cn: 这种模式的原因是什么？

en: The study found that people feel judged to a larger extent by members of other groups.
cn: 研究发现，人们在更大程度上感到被其他群体的成员评判。

en: Because of this, they strategically use healthy food choices to make a positive impression.
cn: 正因为如此，他们策略性地选择健康的食物来给人留下积极的印象。

en: There have been many attempts to help consumers make healthier choices, but consumers often struggle to maintain a healthy diet.
cn: 已经有很多尝试帮助消费者做出更健康的选择，但消费者往往难以保持健康的饮食。

en: This research finds that one way to promote a healthy diet could be to advertise the social benefits of healthy choices.
cn: 这项研究发现，推广健康饮食的一种方法可能是宣传健康选择的社会效益。

en: For college students under pressure, a dog may be the best stress fighter around, according to the finding of a recent study.
cn: 最近的一项研究发现，对于有压力的大学生来说，狗可能是最好的减压工具。

en: "It's a really powerful finding," said Patricia Pendry, who led the study.
cn: "这是一个非常有力的发现，"领导这项研究的帕特里夏·彭德里说。

en: Universities are doing a lot of great work trying to help students succeed academically, especially those who may be at risk due to a history of mental health issues or academic and learning issues.
cn: 大学正在做很多伟大的工作，试图帮助学生在学业上取得成功，尤其是那些可能因心理健康问题或学术和学习问题而面临风险的学生。

en: This study shows that traditional stress management approaches aren't as effective for this population compared with programs that focus on providing opportunities to interact with therapy dogs.
cn: 这项研究表明，与专注于提供与治疗犬互动机会的项目相比，传统的压力管理方法对这一人群并不有效。

en: The researchers measured executive functioning in the students involved in the study.
cn: 研究人员测量了参与研究的学生的执行功能。

en: Executive function is a term for the skills one needs to plan, organize, motivate, concentrate, and memorize.
cn: 执行功能是一个术语，指的是一个人需要计划、组织、激励、集中和记忆的技能。

en: These are skills students need to succeed in college.
cn: 这些都是学生在大学取得成功所需要的技能。

en: The researchers found that students who were most at risk had the most improvements in executive functioning after interacting with therapy dogs.
cn: 研究人员发现，在与治疗犬互动后，风险最大的学生在执行功能方面的改善最大。

en: These results remained when researchers followed up six weeks later.
cn: 当研究人员在六周后进行随访时，这些结果仍然存在。

en: Many universities provide academic stress management programs and workshops.
cn: 许多大学提供学业压力管理课程和研讨会。

en: These are traditionally very similar to college classes.
cn: 传统上，这些课程与大学课程非常相似。

en: They often talk about ways to get more sleep, set goals, or manage stress or anxiety.
cn: 它们经常谈论如何获得更多的睡眠、设定目标或管理压力或焦虑。

en: Pendry acknowledges that these are really important topics, and these workshops help typical students succeed.
cn: 彭德里承认这些都是非常重要的话题，这些研讨会帮助普通学生取得成功。

en: But they're less helpful for struggling students.
cn: 但它们对学习困难的学生帮助不大。

en: Pendry believes those students may experience the programs as another lecture and feel even more stressed.
cn: 彭德里认为，这些学生可能会把这些课程当成另一场讲座，甚至感到压力更大。

en: Taking risks in business does not mean going into business blindly and then expecting great results.
cn: 在商业中承担风险并不意味着盲目地进入商业，然后期待极好的结果。

en: On the contrary, taking risks in entrepreneurship involves careful planning and hard work.
cn: 相反，在创业中承担风险需要仔细规划和努力工作。

en: Nobody can really be sure if risks will be met with success, no matter how calculated they may be.
cn: 没有人能真正确定风险是否会获得成功，无论它们是如何经过计算的。

en: But this should not stop you from taking risks, as risks are necessary if you want your business to succeed.
cn: 但这不应该阻止你承担风险，因为如果你想让你的企业成功，冒险是必要的。

en: Some risks may not work out, but an optimistic risk-taker will always look at failure as an opportunity to learn.
cn: 有些冒险可能不会成功，但乐观的冒险者总是把失败视为学习的机会。

en: The willingness to experiment with new ideas is key to business growth.
cn: 愿意尝试新想法是企业发展的关键。

en: As the old saying goes, "nothing ventured, nothing gained."
cn: 俗话说："不入虎穴，焉得虎子。"

en: Failure will teach you how to think and plan strategically.
cn: 失败会教会你如何战略性地思考和计划。

en: But just remember that not all risks are good ones, and when you fail, learn from it and move forward.
cn: 但请记住，并非所有的风险都是好的，当你失败时，从中吸取教训，继续前进。

en: Since most people tend to avoid risk, businesses that are brave enough to take risks already have a competitive advantage.
cn: 由于大多数人倾向于规避风险，勇于承担风险的企业已经具有竞争优势。

en: They are the ones setting the standard with new ideas, fresh offers and bold inventions.
cn: 他们是用新想法、新提议和大胆发明设定标准的人。

en: Risk takers are best at adapting in difficult times.
cn: 冒险者最善于适应困难时期。

en: Simply put, when most individuals stay away from risk, it means less competition for risk-takers.
cn: 简单地说，当大多数人远离风险时，就意味着风险承担者的竞争会减少。

en: We don't know if you'll achieve what these risk-takers have achieved, but for as long as you want to stay safe, and for as long as you are content with where your business is right now, you will never find out.
cn: 我们不知道你是否会取得这些冒险者所取得的成就，但只要你想保持安全，只要你对自己的业务现状感到满意，你就永远不会知道答案。

en: A JetBlue Airlines flight from West Palm Beach to New York City was forced to turn around and land Sunday morning after the plane struck a bird.
cn: 周日上午，一架从西棕榈滩飞往纽约市的捷蓝航空航班撞上一只鸟，被迫返航降落。

en: The flight from Palm Beach International Airport to LaGuardia Airport turned around just minutes after takeoff following the strike.
cn: 这架从棕榈滩国际机场飞往拉瓜迪亚机场的航班在起飞仅几分钟后就因撞鸟而返航。

en: No injuries were reported on the plane, and the flight took off once again, 7.5 hours after the first attempt.
cn: 据报道，飞机上没有人员受伤，在第一次起飞尝试7.5小时后，航班再次起飞。

en: "It was like a split second of panic that resulted in this nervous reaction on the plane," said passenger Brian Healy.
cn: 乘客布莱恩·希利说："那一瞬间的恐慌导致了飞机上的紧张反应。"

en: There was total quiet.
cn: 机舱里完全安静下来。

en: And then there was relief when the plane came to a stop.
cn: 然后飞机停下来时，大家才松了一口气。

en: An email from JetBlue read, "our team is working to accommodate customers on later flights."
cn: 捷蓝航空发来的邮件写道："我们的团队正在努力安排乘客搭乘后续航班。"

en: A deadly snake, which had finally been tracked down after escaping a zoo has slipped away for the second time.
cn: 一条致命的蛇在逃离动物园后终于被追踪到，但却第二次溜走了。

en: The poisonous snake forced the closure of the attraction last week when staff noticed the disappearance.
cn: 上周，当工作人员注意到这条毒蛇失踪时，该景点被迫关闭。

en: After six days of desperate searching, he was eventually found and placed in a supposedly secure area.
cn: 经过六天的全力搜寻，它终于被找到了，并被安置在一个据称安全的地方。

en: But it seems the animal is no fan of the zoo, because yet again, he is out on the loose.
cn: 但这只动物似乎并不喜欢动物园，因为它再次在外面乱跑。

en: The snake is a relative newcomer to the zoo, but has already been frustrating its staff.
cn: 这条蛇是动物园的新成员，但已经让动物园的员工们感到挫败了。

en: The staff believe he squeezed himself out of a gap located around new energy saving bulbs installed inside the snake house.
cn: 工作人员认为，它是通过蛇舍内安装的新节能灯泡周围的一个缝隙挤出去的。

en: He was only found the first time around because staff brought in a special machine to trace him inside a wall opening.
cn: 它第一次被找到是因为工作人员使用了一台特殊的机器，在墙洞处追踪到了它。

en: This kind of snake is one of the most deadly and poisonous in the wild, and they can range from 3 to 5 meters in length.
cn: 这种蛇是野外最致命最有毒的品种之一，它们的长度可以从3到5米不等。

en: Electric bikes have been the craze in downtown Jacksonville since they were first introduced earlier this month as a one-year pilot program.
cn: 自本月初电动自行车作为为期一年的试点项目首次推出以来，在杰克逊维尔市中心掀起了一股热潮。

en: But they're leading to safety concerns, mainly at night when some riders don't follow the rules of the road.
cn: 但它们也引起了人们对安全的担忧，尤其是在夜间，因为一些骑手不遵守交通规则。

en: As the night goes on, groups of riders are often seen traveling in just about every direction in the streets and on pedestrian paths.
cn: 随着夜幕降临，经常可以看到成群的骑手在街道和人行道上向各个方向行进。

en: That is increasing the probability of dangerous accidents.
cn: 这增加了发生危险事故的概率。

en: Electric bike riders have to follow all the same rules as you would if you were in an automobile.
cn: 骑电动自行车的人必须遵守和开车一样的规则。

en: That means no running red lights or traveling in the opposite direction of traffic on one-way streets.
cn: 这意味着不能闯红灯，也不能在单行道上逆行。

en: City Council Member Anna Cumber was instrumental in introducing the electric bikes to Jacksonville as a way to bring new life into downtown.
cn: 市议会成员安娜·坎伯在将电动自行车引入杰克逊维尔的过程中发挥了重要作用，并将其作为一种为市中心注入新活力的方式。

en: And she's aware of the concerns.
cn: 她也意识到了这些担忧。

en: Cumber said, people can have fun, but both drivers and riders are responsible for paying attention while on the road.
cn: 坎伯表示，人们可以玩得开心，但司机和骑行者都有责任在路上保持警惕。

en: And never assume the driver is going to stop or see you.
cn: 永远不要认为司机会停下来或看到你。

en: What's the best way to teach children how to save and spend their money?
cn: 教孩子如何储蓄和花钱的最佳方式是什么？

en: You should make money a regular topic of discussion.
cn: 你们应该把钱作为一个经常讨论的话题。

en: It's best to start young, so it's instinctive rather than a scary subject.
cn: 最好从小就开始，所以这是一种本能，而不是一个可怕的话题。

en: In our family, we talk openly about things like the budget for holidays, how taxes reduce your income, and how to shop around for the best deals.
cn: 在我们家，我们会公开谈论诸如度假的预算、税收如何减少你的收入，以及如何货比三家找到最优惠的交易。

en: Indeed.
cn: 的确。

en: It's also essential to make money real for children through practical examples.
cn: 通过实际的例子让孩子们对金钱有真实的感受也很重要。

en: Working out how much we save using discount pizza coupons, for example, is much more relevant than abstract sums.
cn: 例如，计算我们使用披萨折扣券节省了多少钱，比抽象的计算更有意义。

en: We also give our kids pocket money, and the amount they get is linked to chores, such as putting the bins out and emptying the dishwasher.
cn: 我们也给孩子零花钱，零花钱的多少和他们做家务有关，比如把垃圾桶拖出去和清空洗碗机。

en: We do that too.
cn: 我们也这样做。

en: And it's paid according to their age.
cn: 而且根据他们的年龄给钱。

en: Two pounds for each year, so they can see some progression.
cn: 每年两英镑，这样他们就能看到一些进展。

en: Teaching them to save is important.
cn: 教他们储蓄很重要。

en: We opened a savings account when they were young.
cn: 当他们还小的时候，我们开了一个储蓄账户。

en: After birthdays and Christmas, they would go to the branch and deposit their gift money.
cn: 生日和圣诞节后，他们会去银行存入他们的礼金。

en: Oh, I hadn't considered doing that.
cn: 哦，我还没有考虑过那样做。

en: In our house, we have transparent money boxes for them to put small change in, so they can see their savings grow.
cn: 在我们家里，我们有透明的钱箱，他们可以把零钱放进去，这样他们就可以看到自己的储蓄在增长。

en: When the time is right, I'll start talking to our children about investing and show them how the money saved for their further education has grown.
cn: 时机成熟的时候，我会开始和孩子们谈论投资，让他们看看为他们继续教育而存的钱是如何增长的。

en: I am always talking to my elder daughter about the importance of saving into a pension.
cn: 我一直和我的大女儿谈论存养老金的重要性。

en: She's just started a part-time job and was thinking of not contributing to her pension.
cn: 她刚刚开始了一份兼职工作，曾考虑过不缴纳养老金。

en: Luckily, I managed to persuade her otherwise.
cn: 幸运的是，我成功说服了她。

en: Yes, it's such an important lesson to learn.
cn: 是的，这是非常重要的一课。

en: Welcome to Books in Review.
cn: 欢迎来到《书评》。

en: Our guest today is John Banks, the author of the best-selling new book, Rewarding Success.
cn: 今天我们的嘉宾是畅销新书《嘉奖成功》的作者约翰·班克斯。

en: Glad to be here, Jane.
cn: 很高兴来到这里，简。

en: Your book has sold 2 million copies, but before we discuss why it's getting so much attention, let's talk about your background.
cn: 你的书已经卖出了200万本，但在我们讨论为什么它会受到如此关注之前，先谈谈你的背景吧。

en: You're an economist and spent two decades teaching at universities?
cn: 你是个经济学家，在大学里教了二十年书？

en: I spent 25 years as a professor, actually.
cn: 实际上，我当了25年的教授。

en: And then, for the last 10 years, I've worked as a political consultant, advising politicians at the national level about problems in our country.
cn: 然后在过去的10年里，我一直担任政治顾问，就我们国家的问题向国家层面的政治家提供建议。

en: You discuss three of those problems in the book, improving public education, reducing our nation's health care burden, and increasing personal savings.
cn: 你在书中讨论了其中的三个问题：改善公共教育、减少国家医疗负担和增加个人储蓄。

en: But your ideas about education are the most controversial.
cn: 但是你关于教育的观点是最有争议的。

en: Absolutely.
cn: 当然。

en: A lot of people think I'm trying to punish students who aren't doing well, when actually my goal is to give all students more incentive to succeed.
cn: 许多人认为我是在惩罚那些学习不好的学生，而实际上我的目的是给所有学生更多的动力去取得成功。

en: I'm not sure I agree with you.
cn: 我不确定我是否同意你的观点。

en: Your proposal to pay cash rewards to students who get good grades is a particular problem.
cn: 你提出的给成绩好的学生现金奖励的建议特别有问题。

en: What about students who don't get good grades?
cn: 那么那些成绩不好的学生呢？

en: It seems like you're blaming them for not succeeding, when poor performance in school isn't a child's fault.
cn: 这似乎是你在责备他们没有成功，而在学校表现不佳并不是孩子的错。

en: But my proposal is not just to reward students with good grades, but also students who show improvement.
cn: 但是我的建议不仅仅是奖励成绩好的学生，还包括那些有进步的学生。

en: Okay, another criticism of the plan is the cash rewards themselves.
cn: 好的，对该计划的另一个批评是现金奖励本身。

en: Where will the money come from?
cn: 钱从哪里来？

en: If students do better, we'll spend less on schooling.
cn: 如果学生表现更好，我们在教育上的花费就会减少。

en: So, in the end, the rewards will pay for themselves.
cn: 所以，最终，奖励将会自我支付。

en: What about now?
cn: 那现在呢？

en: How will we fund the rewards in the meantime?
cn: 在此期间，我们将如何为这些奖励提供资金？

en: Well, by increasing taxes or moving money from other areas of the budget into education.
cn: 嗯，通过增加税收或从其他预算领域转移资金到教育领域。

en: I met three different people today, and each time, when I asked, how are you, the reply was exactly the same.
cn: 今天我见了三个人，每次我问他们"你怎么样"，他们的回答都是一样的。

en: I'm busy.
cn: "我很忙。"

en: Honestly, I hear the same answer from the vast majority of people I meet.
cn: 说实话，我听到的大多数人都是这样回答的。

en: So I started to think, guess what?
cn: 所以我开始思考，猜猜看？

en: Everybody's busy.
cn: 每个人都很忙。

en: I'm busy.
cn: 我很忙。

en: You're busy.
cn: 你很忙。

en: Everybody's busy.
cn: 每个人都很忙。

en: So you being busy doesn't make me sympathetic at all, because busy is the state of the world.
cn: 所以你说你很忙并不能引起我的同情，因为忙是这个世界的常态。

en: So I'm launching a campaign to stop people complaining about being "busy".
cn: 因此，我发起了一项运动，防止人们抱怨自己"忙碌"。

en: It may sound harsh, but the truth is, nobody cares.
cn: 这听起来可能有些严厉，但事实是，没有人真正关心。

en: In a busy world, being busy doesn't stand out, nor does it mean productive, creative, accomplished, or professional.
cn: 在一个繁忙的世界里，忙碌并不突出，也不意味着高效、有创造力、有成就或专业。

en: Steve Maraboli once said, "When someone tells you they are too busy, it's not a reflection of their schedule, it's a reflection of your spot on their schedule."
cn: 史蒂夫·马拉伯利曾说过："当有人告诉你他们太忙了，这不是他们时间表的反映，而是你在他们时间表中的位置的反映。"

en: Donna Lynn Hope has also remarked, "Busy doesn't mean better.
cn: 唐娜·林恩·霍普也曾说过："忙碌不等于更好。

en: I have never envied a busy person - the one who likes to point out their busy lives to others."
cn: 我从来不羡慕那些忙碌的人——那些喜欢向别人展示他们忙碌生活的人。"

en: The reality is, nobody's too busy.
cn: 现实情况是，没有人真的太忙了。

en: It's just about priorities.
cn: 这只是优先事项的问题。

en: So the next time someone asks you how you are, maybe respond differently.
cn: 所以下次有人问你怎么样时，也许可以换一种方式回答。

en: In my experience, the "I'm busy" response is really covering up the fact that they're not actually accomplishing their real purpose.
cn: 根据我的经验，"我很忙"的回答实际上是在掩盖他们并没有真正达成自己的目标。

en: And being busy is the lie they tell themselves about why they can't achieve it.
cn: 而忙碌是他们对自己撒的谎，是关于为什么他们不能实现目标的借口。

en: More and more people are taking up extreme sports like snowboarding, skateboarding, mountain biking and many more.
cn: 越来越多的人开始从事极限运动，如单板滑雪、滑板、山地自行车等等。

en: Why are these sports becoming so popular?
cn: 为什么这些运动变得如此受欢迎呢？

en: One thing that extreme sports do better than perhaps anything else is to help you stop being afraid.
cn: 极限运动比其他任何事物都更能帮助你克服恐惧。

en: It may sound strange to say that their main function is to reduce fear.
cn: 说它们的主要功能是减少恐惧听起来可能有些奇怪。

en: But after a time, your fear response to other things in life will be dramatically reduced.
cn: 但是过一段时间后，你对生活中其他事情的恐惧反应会大大减少。

en: After all, if you can jump out of a plane or off a bridge, then you can face anything else easily.
cn: 毕竟，如果你能跳下飞机或桥梁，那么你可以轻松面对其他任何事情。

en: When doing extreme sports, you have to become more focused.
cn: 进行极限运动时，你必须更加专注。

en: You'll be pushed to your limits.
cn: 你会被逼到极限。

en: And if you aren't focused, you'll make dangerous mistakes.
cn: 如果你不专注，就会犯下危险的错误。

en: Learning to be this focused when enjoying extreme sports will help you to be focused at work, keeping you more productive and ultimately more successful.
cn: 学会在享受极限运动时保持专注，也会帮助你在工作中保持专注，让你更加高效，最终更成功。

en: It's great to stay fit and healthy.
cn: 保持身材和健康是很好的。

en: But standard exercise routines and sports only work the same muscles repeatedly.
cn: 但标准的锻炼方式和运动只会重复性地锻炼相同的肌肉。

en: With extreme sports, you'll be working entirely different muscles.
cn: 通过极限运动，你会锻炼完全不同的肌肉。

en: And that means you get an all-over workout.
cn: 这意味着你会进行全身锻炼。

en: Extreme sports also burn a lot more calories than other sports.
cn: 极限运动还会比其他运动消耗更多的卡路里。

en: Skateboarding, for example, can burn as many as 500 calories per hour.
cn: 比如，滑板每小时可以燃烧多达500卡路里。

en: Basketball burns around 300 in the same time.
cn: 篮球在同样时间内燃烧大约300卡路里。

en: When you find that you can overcome the physical or mental challenges involved in extreme sports, you'll feel superhuman and your self-confidence will be at an all-time high.
cn: 当你发现自己能够克服极限运动中涉及的身体或心理挑战时，你会感觉自己像超人，你的自信心也会达到前所未有的高度。

en: Most of us have been in teams or organizations where we've had conflict with the people that we're working with around the ideas or decisions that we're discussing.
cn: 我们中的大多数人都曾在团队或组织中与同事就我们讨论的想法或决定发生过冲突。

en: Conflict is natural.
cn: 冲突是自然的。

en: We all bring different life and work experiences to the table.
cn: 我们都有不同的生活和工作经历。

en: We all have different personality, preferences and tendencies.
cn: 我们每个人都有不同的个性、偏好和倾向。

en: We're not all going to have the same ideas on how to approach policies, programs or problems.
cn: 对于如何处理政策、项目或问题，我们并非都有相同的想法。

en: But too often, we get caught in this place where conflict is perceived to be negative - something we want to avoid so that we can maintain the harmony of our workplace.
cn: 但是，太多时候，我们陷入了一个把冲突视为负面的境地——我们想要避免冲突，以维护工作场所的和谐。

en: This could be because some people want to avoid conflict at all costs.
cn: 这可能是因为有些人想不惜一切代价避免冲突。

en: After all, they still have to work together.
cn: 毕竟，他们还要一起工作。

en: But this kind of artificial harmony isn't the answer.
cn: 但这种人为的和谐不是解决办法。

en: Productive conflict is a vital part of teams and organizations that want to push forward and do more.
cn: 对于想要向前推进、做得更多的团队和组织来说，富有成效的冲突是至关重要的部分。

en: Without conflict, we're often stuck in this artificial harmony where people don't express potentially innovative ideas for fear that they may start conflict with others.
cn: 没有冲突，我们常常停留在这种人为的和谐中，人们因为害怕与他人发生冲突而不表达可能具有创新性的想法。

en: But if you're in a place where you have a basis of trust, conflict can be extremely productive.
cn: 但是，如果你处在一个有信任基础的地方，冲突可能非常具有成效。

en: It can lead to increased innovation and greater trust on teams.
cn: 它可以促进创新，增强团队之间的信任。

en: It may be an uncomfortable process, but good leaders and healthy teams recognize the productive and healthy conflict is an important part of how they function.
cn: 这可能是一个令人不舒服的过程，但优秀的领导者和健康的团队意识到，富有成效和健康的冲突是他们运作方式的重要组成部分。

en: Six people had to move away from their home to another place after a fire broke out in a building on Main Street Saturday, officials said.
cn: 官员称，周六主街一栋建筑发生火灾后，六人不得不从家搬到另一个地方。

en: Firefighters responded to the three-story building shortly after 1 p.m. for a reported structure fire, according to Norwalk Deputy Fire Chief Adam Markiewicz.
cn: 据诺沃克副消防队长亚当·马基维茨称，消防队员在下午1点后不久对这栋三层楼的建筑出动了救援，因为有报告称建筑起火。

en: Markiewicz said crews encountered heavy smoke coming from the second floor when they arrived.
cn: 马基维茨说，工作人员到达时发现二楼冒出浓烟。

en: A team of about 25 firefighters then spent about 25 minutes extinguishing the flames.
cn: 随后，一支由约25名消防员组成的队伍花了大约25分钟扑灭了大火。

en: Officials described the structure as a mixed-use building that features commercial businesses on the first floor and residential on the second and third floors.
cn: 官员们将该建筑描述为一座多功能建筑，一楼是商业区，二楼和三楼是住宅区。

en: Town records list four apartments in the building.
cn: 城镇记录显示这栋楼里有四套公寓。

en: Due to smoke and heat damage, the four apartments were declared uninhabitable, and the six residents had to move to another place, officials said.
cn: 官员们说，由于烟雾和高温损坏，这四套公寓被宣布无法居住，六名居民不得不搬到另一个地方。

en: No injuries were reported in connection with the fire.
cn: 没有人员伤亡的报道。

en: The Norwalk Fire Marshal is investigating the cause and origin of the fire.
cn: 诺沃克消防队长正在调查火灾的原因和起火点。

en: A new study has cast doubt on historic research, suggesting that the season or month of someone's birth is associated with an increased risk of certain mental health conditions.
cn: 一项新研究对历史研究提出了质疑，该研究表明，一个人出生的季节或月份与某些心理健康状况的风险增加有关。

en: The study looks at symptoms of anxiety and depression among more than 70,000 older adults in Europe.
cn: 这项研究调查了欧洲7万多名老年人的焦虑和抑郁症状。

en: A number of past studies have found the link between season of birth and mental health diagnoses.
cn: 过去的一些研究发现，出生季节与心理健康诊断之间存在联系。

en: Researchers have suggested that such links could arise from various things.
cn: 研究人员认为，这种联系可能源于多种因素。

en: These include nutrient intake, sun exposure, climate and disease exposure, varying across the course of the year.
cn: 这些因素包括营养摄入、阳光照射、气候和疾病接触，这些因素在一年中各不相同。

en: However, evidence has been mixed.
cn: 然而，证据不一。

en: More recent studies have suggested that factors such as social class or economic background have more to do with these diagnoses than month of birth.
cn: 最近的研究表明，社会阶层或经济背景等因素与这些诊断的关系比出生月份更大。

en: Overall, the new study found no significant relationship between participants' month of birth and symptoms of depression or anxiety.
cn: 总的来说，这项新研究发现，参与者的出生月份与抑郁或焦虑症状之间没有明显的关系。

en: There was some variability in some countries.
cn: 在一些国家存在一些差异。

en: In Poland, depressive symptoms fluctuated a little depending on birth month.
cn: 在波兰，随着出生月份的不同，抑郁症状略有波动。

en: In the Czech Republic, the same was true of anxiety symptoms.
cn: 在捷克共和国，焦虑症状也是如此。

en: But on the whole, there was no systematic pattern.
cn: 但总的来说，没有系统的模式。

en: Genetic researchers in China have made a clone of a star police dog.
cn: 中国的遗传学研究人员克隆了一只明星警犬。

en: The clone was born in a laboratory in Beijing in December.
cn: 该克隆狗于12月在北京的一个实验室出生。

en: Tests show that the clone and her mother are almost identical genetically.
cn: 测试显示，这只克隆狗和她的母亲在基因上几乎相同。

en: The mother dog helped solve multiple murders and many other crimes.
cn: 这只狗妈妈曾帮助破获多起凶杀案及其他犯罪案件。

en: The clone has already performed better than traditionally bred dogs on several tests.
cn: 这只克隆狗在多个测试中表现优于传统培育的狗。

en: If the clone continues to perform as well as expected, it could mean a huge reduction in the training time for police dogs, which usually takes about five years.
cn: 如果克隆狗继续表现如预期那样好，这可能意味着警犬训练时间的大幅缩短，目前警犬通常需要大约五年的训练时间。

en: The ultimate goal of scientists is to produce clones of talented police dogs that can be trained in months instead of years.
cn: 科学家们的最终目标是克隆出可以在几个月而不是几年的时间训练出来的天才警犬。

en: However, this goal is not yet possible due to the current costs of the technology.
cn: 然而，由于当前技术成本的限制，这一目标尚未实现。

en: This is not the first time a clone has been made of a star police dog.
cn: 这并不是第一次克隆明星警犬。

en: In South Korea, six clones began working with the police in 2008.
cn: 2008年，韩国已有六只克隆狗开始与警方合作。

en: Tom, did you see the article online about the new TV series based on the book The Three Body Problem?
cn: 汤姆，你看过网上关于那部根据《三体》改编的新电视剧的文章了吗？

en: A colleague mentioned the book, but I've been so busy writing my thesis that I haven't been able to read for pleasure in months.
cn: 一位同事提到过这本书，但我一直忙着写论文，几个月来都没能看书消遣。

en: Well, sounds like if you're going to read anything for fun, this is the book.
cn: 嗯，听起来如果你想读点有趣的书，那就是这本书了。

en: It's written by a Chinese science fiction writer.
cn: 这本书是由一位中国科幻作家写的。

en: I can't remember his name, but he's written three books in all, and The Three Body Problem is the first in the series.
cn: 我不记得他的名字了，但他一共写了三本书，《三体》是这个系列的第一本。

en: I don't want to say too much and spoil it for you, but it's definitely got some amazing technological and sociological concepts in it.
cn: 我不想说太多以免剧透，但它确实包含了一些惊人的技术和社会概念。

en: It does sound like it would suit my taste, but if they are making a TV series based on it now, I don't know if I should read the book or watch the show first.
cn: 这听起来确实很适合我的口味，但如果他们现在正在制作一部基于它的电视剧，我不知道是应该先读书还是先看剧。

en: I think it's better to read the book first.
cn: 我觉得最好先读书。

en: It's rare for the show or movie to be better than the book.
cn: 很少有电视剧或电影比原著更好。

en: And then, you just end up ruining the book for yourself, if the show isn't very good.
cn: 如果电视剧不好看，那你就会毁了对这本书的体验。

en: When is the show supposed to start?
cn: 电视剧什么时候开始播出？

en: I'm a bit overwhelmed with the amount of data I still need to collect to finish my thesis.
cn: 我还需要收集大量数据来完成我的论文，有点不堪重负。

en: But I still need to relax sometimes.
cn: 但我仍然需要有时放松一下。

en: I can't remember exactly.
cn: 我不记得确切时间了。

en: It's pretty soon, and it's going to be quite long.
cn: 很快就会上映，而且会很长。

en: There are 24 episodes.
cn: 有24集。

en: Well, maybe you could download an electronic copy of the book and try to read it before the show starts.
cn: 也许你可以下载电子版的书，在电视剧开始之前尝试读一读。

en: That's a good idea.
cn: 这是个好主意。

en: And then, maybe we can watch the series together.
cn: 然后，也许我们可以一起看这部电视剧。

en: Thanks for the tip, Alice.
cn: 谢谢你的建议，艾丽斯。

en: No problem.
cn: 不客气。

en: Hello, good afternoon.
cn: 下午好。

en: I have an inquiry to make.
cn: 我要做一个咨询。

en: It's about the Vegetarian Food Festival you are holding on the 19th of August at the Newcastle City Hall.
cn: 是关于你们将于8月19日在纽卡斯尔市政厅举办的素食节。

en: Yes, of course.
cn: 当然。

en: My name's Philip.
cn: 我叫菲利普。

en: How can I help you?
cn: 我能为您做些什么？

en: It says on your website that you are still looking for vendors, and I grow organic vegetables on my farm, as well as doing my own home baking.
cn: 你们网站上说你们还在寻找供应商，我在农场种植有机蔬菜，还在家里烘焙。

en: Would I be able to sell both the vegetables and items baked from them at the festival?
cn: 我能在节日上同时销售蔬菜和用这些蔬菜制成的烘焙食品吗？

en: That's exactly the type of thing we are looking for.
cn: 这正是我们在寻找的东西。

en: We're getting close to the deadline, however.
cn: 不过，截止日期快到了。

en: Do you prefer to fill out an application on the web, or to print it out and fill it in by hand and then post it back to us?
cn: 你是喜欢在网上填写申请，还是打印出来手动填写然后邮寄给我们？

en: Remember that you will have to have all your certificates to hand when you are filling out the forms, as the standards are high and they will be carefully checked before anyone will be able to sell their produce at the event.
cn: 请记得在填写表格时需要把所有证书准备好，因为我们的标准很高，在任何人可以在活动上销售产品之前，这些证书都会被仔细检查。

en: I should be fine with doing it on your website, and I already have all my certificates, as we run a small farm shop too.
cn: 我想在你们网站上填写，我也已经有全部的证书了，因为我们还经营一个小型农场商店。

en: But can you give me your details anyway?
cn: 不过你能把你的详细信息给我吗？

en: Sure.
cn: 当然。

en: Please address it to the Organic Organization, Vendor Applications, 112 Queen's Road, Newcastle, Northumbria.
cn: 请寄给"有机组织，供应商申请，皇后路112号，纽卡斯尔，诺森布里亚"。

en: The postcode is NU 293LJ.
cn: 邮编是NU 293LJ。

en: Remember that the closing date is next Tuesday, the 28th of June.
cn: 请记得截止日期是下周二，6月28日。

en: That's absolutely wonderful.
cn: 非常棒。

en: Thank you so much for your help.
cn: 谢谢你的帮助。

en: Goodbye.
cn: 再见。

en: Supporters call it wild camping.
cn: 支持者称其为野营。

en: Opponents call it illegal camping.
cn: 反对者则称其为非法露营。

en: What both sides accept is that there has been a boom in the past few months, with increasing numbers of visitors pitching their tents on any bit of land they fancy in the UK.
cn: 双方都认可的是，最近几个月野营现象激增，越来越多的游客在他们喜欢的英国任何一块土地上搭起帐篷。

en: In part, this reflects the fact that official campsites have been wholly or partially closed, or are overflowing, in a summer when fewer people are going abroad.
cn: 在某种程度上，这反映了这样一个事实，即在出国人数较少的夏季，官方营地已经全部或部分关闭，或者人满为患。

en: It is also cheap, at a time when many are worried about what the economic future holds.
cn: 同时，这也是在许多人对经济前景感到担忧时的一种廉价选择。

en: But it may also be an expression of a desire for going outdoors - a response to the months of lockdown.
cn: 但这也可能是一种对户外活动的渴望的表达——对几个月封锁生活的一种回应。

en: Most of the coverage of the boom in wild camping has been negative.
cn: 关于野营激增的报道大多是负面的。

en: Camping in public parks has now been banned for August and the early part of September, because campers dump litter, human waste, and even their tents on the grassland.
cn: 因为露营者乱扔垃圾、人类排泄物，甚至帐篷在草地上，因此在公共公园野营已经在8月和9月初被禁止。
