en: Similar action has been taken even in Scotland, where camping is usually permitted on most of its open land.
cn: 类似的措施甚至在苏格兰也有采取，尽管苏格兰通常在其大部分开放土地上允许露营。

en: Clearly, there have to be rules.
cn: 显然，必须制定规则。

en: It would make sense that wild campers need to ask for permission to camp from landowners, especially outside Scotland, where the law is far more restrictive.
cn: 野营者需要向土地所有者请求露营许可，这是有道理的，特别是在苏格兰以外法律更加严格的地方。

en: It would be common sense for people to use small tents and leave no trace of their visit.
cn: 常识是使用小帐篷并不留下痕迹。

en: They have been attracted by a patch of land that is close to wilderness, and it is their responsibility to keep it that way.
cn: 他们被一块接近荒野的土地所吸引，而保持这片土地的原貌是他们的责任。

en: Imagine boating down the Amazon River, minding your own business, calmly keeping an eye out for alarmingly large snakes, and a curious pink dolphin appears to swim alongside.
cn: 想象一下，在亚马逊河上划船，想着自己的事儿，冷静地留意那些令人惊讶的大蛇，这时一只好奇的粉红海豚出现在旁边游来游去。

en: While this may seem like a mythical creature, pink dolphins do exist in the Amazon region.
cn: 尽管这可能看起来像是神话中的生物，但粉红海豚确实存在于亚马逊地区。

en: The Amazon River Dolphin is a giant among its species.
cn: 亚马逊河豚是其物种中的巨人。

en: It can measure up to 2 meters long and weigh around 204 kilograms.
cn: 它可以长达2米，重约204公斤。

en: Size isn't the only thing that sets the Amazon River Dolphin apart.
cn: 而且不仅仅是体型让亚马逊河豚与众不同。

en: Thriving in South American rivers and temporary lakes caused by seasonal flooding, this freshwater dolphin is sometimes shockingly pink.
cn: 它们生活在南美的河流和雨季洪泛后形成的暂时湖泊中，有时甚至令人惊讶地呈现出粉红色。

en: Although born gray, males of their species are easily identified as they enter adulthood by a decisive pink shade.
cn: 虽然天生是灰色的，但进入成年后的雄性海豚可以通过鲜明的粉红色调轻松辨认出来。

en: Their unusual coloring is believed to be the result of scar tissue from dolphin fights, whether playfighting or a serious bid for a mate.
cn: 它们不寻常的颜色被认为是海豚打斗后留下的疤痕组织的结果，无论是嬉戏打斗还是为了争夺配偶而进行的严肃斗争。

en: The deeper the pink, the more attractive the males are believed to be, and the older the male, the more pink he will have.
cn: 粉红色越深，表明雄性海豚越有吸引力；雄性海豚越老，粉红色越多。

en: There's also a theory that this color helps the dolphins more readily blend in with their surroundings.
cn: 还有一种理论认为，这种颜色帮助海豚更容易融入周围环境。

en: During heavy rains, rivers along the Amazon rainforest turn a pink shade, and with their pink coloring, male dolphins are harder to detect.
cn: 大雨期间，亚马逊雨林沿岸的河流会变成粉红色，雄性海豚的粉红色使其更难被察觉。

en: The Amazon wetland system, fed by the Amazon River, is a crucial place for pink dolphins to breed, and since 2018, has been granted internationally protected status.
cn: 亚马逊湿地系统由亚马逊河滋养，是粉红海豚繁殖的重要场所，并且自2018年以来，已经被授予国际保护地位。

en: In a new Merrill Lynch Age Wave survey, a full 70% of the early adults said they've received financial support from their parents in the past year, and 58% said they couldn't afford their current lifestyles without it.
cn: 在美林一项新的"年龄浪潮"调查中，足足70%的年轻成年人表示，他们在过去一年中得到了父母的经济支持，58%的人表示，如果没有父母的支持，他们负担不起目前的生活方式。

en: The most common types of financial support include cell phone plans, food, school costs and car expenses.
cn: 最常见的经济支持类型包括手机计划、食物、学费和汽车费用。

en: Parental financial support of early adults, said Ken Dychtwald, CEO of Age Wave, is "the new normal".
cn: Age Wave的首席执行官肯·迪希特瓦尔德表示，父母对年轻成年人的经济支持是"新常态"。

en: But 64% of the young adults surveyed said parents' financial support to children aged 25-34 is a bad thing, because it makes those kids dependent.
cn: 但在接受调查的年轻人中，64%的人认为父母对25-34岁孩子的经济支持是件坏事，因为这会使这些孩子变得依赖。

en: By contrast, only 29% thought supporting men and women aged 18-24 is bad.
cn: 相比之下，只有29%的人认为支持18-24岁的人是不好的。

en: The remaining 71% thought that assistance helps the adult children get ahead.
cn: 剩下的71%则认为这种帮助可以让成年子女取得成功。

en: Dychtwald believes the young women and men surveyed were saying that by 25, young adults ought to be financially independent.
cn: 迪希特瓦尔德认为，受访的年轻男女表示，到25岁时，年轻人应该在经济上独立。

en: In fact, the respondents said financial independence defines adulthood.
cn: 事实上，受访者认为经济独立是成年的标志。

en: "Financial independence is something they were struggling with and challenged by.
cn: "经济独立是他们一直在挣扎和挑战的问题。

en: And it scared them a bit," Dychtwald said.
cn: 这让他们有点害怕，"迪希特瓦尔德说。

en: One big reason they're struggling is attributed to college loans, of which the average amounts to $37,000.
cn: 他们苦苦挣扎的一个重要原因是大学贷款，平均贷款金额为37000美元。

en: Many of the parents have taken on college loans for the kids too, sometimes at the expense of their own finances.
cn: 许多父母也为孩子承担了大学贷款，有时甚至以牺牲自己的财务为代价。

en: In the survey, 60 percent of early adults define financial success as being debt-free.
cn: 调查中，60%的年轻成年人将财务成功定义为没有债务。

en: Whether that's likely, or even possible, anytime soon, is anyone's guess.
cn: 无论这种愿望是否可能在近期实现，都是个未知数。

en: The City of Fayetteville is making a special effort to recognize its bus drivers, ahead of the newly proclaimed Transit Driver Appreciation Day, happening Saturday.
cn: 费耶特维尔市正在特别努力表彰其公交车司机，以迎接新宣布的交通司机感谢日，该节日将于周六举行。

en: As part of the event, the city is celebrating its longest-serving driver on the force.
cn: 作为此次活动的一部分，该市正在庆祝其服务时间最长的司机。

en: That driver is Sherry Christian.
cn: 这名司机是谢里·克里斯蒂安。

en: Christian has been a driver for 25 years.
cn: 克里斯蒂安已经当了25年的司机。

en: The Fayetteville native believes driving a school bus allows her to give back to her community.
cn: 作为费耶特维尔本地人，她认为开校车可以让她回馈社区。

en: She says that the best part of the job is watching the children who ride her bus grow up.
cn: 她说这份工作的最好部分是看着乘坐她的校车的孩子们长大。

en: Transit Driver Appreciation Day has been celebrated across the country as far back as 2009.
cn: 全国范围内自2009年以来一直在庆祝公交司机感谢日。

en: However, this week, the City of Fayetteville issued a proclamation for the day to take place March 18.
cn: 然而，本周，费耶特维尔市发布了一项公告，将该日定为3月18日。

en: Officials said they want bus drivers to know how important they are to Fayetteville, serving almost 1.6 million riders a year.
cn: 官员们表示，他们希望公交车司机们知道自己对费耶特维尔有多么重要，他们每年为近160万乘客服务。

en: The Wilton School Board has proposed a 5.99% spending increase.
cn: 威尔顿学区董事会提出了一项增加5.99%开支的提案。

en: If approved, it would be the largest jump in at least eight budget cycles.
cn: 如果获得批准，这将是至少八个预算周期以来最大的增幅。

en: The 5.99% request more than doubles the highest previous year-over-year increase in the last eight years, which was 2.99% for the 2021 to 2022 school year.
cn: 该5.99%的请求是过去八年中年度增幅最高的两倍多，前一个最高涨幅是2021到2022学年的2.99%。

en: The biggest driver of the 91.8 million proposed budget remains teachers' salaries.
cn: 9180万美元的提议预算中最大的推动因素依然是教师工资。

en: These account for 64% of the total request at 59 million dollars.
cn: 这一部分占总请求的64%，即5900万美元。

en: The 59 million dollars is up from the 56.7 million dollars budgeted for the current school year.
cn: 与当前学年预算的5670万美元相比，这一数字有所上升。

en: There are some factors that could affect the budget moving forward.
cn: 未来有一些因素可能会影响预算。

en: One of those is total enrollment.
cn: 其中一个是总入学人数。

en: The district will have a total enrollment of 3,742 students.
cn: 学区总入学人数将为3742名学生。

en: Almost all of these students will be in kindergarten through high school, but 66 will be in prekindergarten and other programs.
cn: 几乎所有这些学生都将在幼儿园到高中阶段，但有66名学生将在学前班和其他项目中。

en: This represents 47 fewer students than the current year.
cn: 这比当前学年少了47名学生。

en: Fewer students mean less federal and state funding.
cn: 学生减少意味着联邦和州政府的资金减少。

en: A rare thundersnow event has taken place in Scotland.
cn: 苏格兰发生了一起罕见的雷雪事件。

en: And alarmed locals contacted police, thinking they had heard bombs going off.
cn: 惊慌失措的当地居民纷纷报警，以为是炸弹爆炸的声音。

en: The phenomenon happens when thunder and lightning mix with a heavy snowstorm—sometimes causing loud claps that can be confused with explosions.
cn: 这种现象发生在雷电与暴风雪交织之时，有时会引发巨大的轰鸣声，容易让人误以为是爆炸。

en: One person described it as a loud boom, similar to a plane crash.
cn: 有人描述称，那声音如同飞机坠毁般的巨响。

en: Another person was woken up in the middle of the night by what he thought was early construction work starting.
cn: 还有人则在半夜被惊醒，误以为清晨的建筑施工已经开始。

en: The noise was powerful enough to shake buildings and set off car alarms.
cn: 巨大的声响甚至足以震动建筑物并触发汽车警报。

en: The police were flooded with many calls from the public.
cn: 警方接到了大量公众的来电。

en: And they sent out a message asking people to remain calm.
cn: 随后，警方发布消息，呼吁民众保持冷静。

en: The police assured everyone that it was just thunder and lightning rather than some military exercise.
cn: 警方明确表示这只是雷电现象，而非军事演习。

en: The weather was the coldest it had been for the season, so people were warned to be careful when traveling outside.
cn: 此次天气是本季以来最寒冷的一次，因此人们被警告外出时要格外小心。

en: In particular, dangerous conditions such as icy roads or wet ground could cause difficulty for drivers.
cn: 特别是结冰的道路或湿滑的地面等危险情况，可能会给驾驶员带来困难。

en: The rail service also announced potential disruptions to trains due to the deep snow.
cn: 铁路部门也宣布，由于积雪深厚，铁路服务可能会受到影响。

en: Some roads were also closed because of the severe weather.
cn: 部分道路也因恶劣天气而关闭。

en: I'm going to the city centre to buy a new phone today.
cn: 我今天要去市中心买一部新手机。

en: Didn't you buy a new phone just two months ago?
cn: 你不是两个月前刚买了一部新手机吗？

en: It was three months ago, and I already know what you're going to say.
cn: 那是三个月前的事了，而且我已经知道你要说什么了。

en: You're thinking I shouldn't replace my phone this soon.
cn: 你在想我不应该这么快就换手机。

en: No, actually, I was wondering how you could possibly afford a new phone.
cn: 不，实际上，我在想你怎么可能买得起一部新手机。

en: But, now that you mention it, I do think getting another phone so soon is wasteful, regardless of the cost.
cn: 不过，既然你提到了，我确实认为这么快就换手机是浪费的，不管成本如何。

en: Maybe you're right, but the thing is, everyone at the office has a nice, expensive phone, and I'm a little embarrassed by mine.
cn: 也许你是对的，但问题是，办公室里的每个人都有一部漂亮、昂贵的手机，而我对我的手机感到有点尴尬。

en: I just got a credit card, so I thought I might as well buy a new phone.
cn: 我刚拿到一张信用卡，所以我想我不妨买一部新手机。

en: I don't think buying a phone on credit is a good idea.
cn: 我认为用信用卡买手机不是个好主意。

en: Look, you've only been working for five months now.
cn: 你看，你才工作了五个月。

en: People understand that you are a recent graduate, and I doubt anyone cares about your phone other than yourself.
cn: 人们理解你是刚毕业的，我怀疑除了你自己之外，没人在乎你的手机。

en: Maybe you're right, but the credit card has a very good special offer, where I don't pay any interest for six months.
cn: 也许你是对的，但信用卡有一个非常好的特别优惠，我在六个月内不需要支付任何利息。

en: I'll be able to pay for the phone well before that period is over.
cn: 我肯定能在那个期限之前付清手机的钱。

en: I still think it's a bad idea to use a credit card for something you don't need.
cn: 我仍然认为用信用卡买你不需要的东西是个坏主意。

en: One of my colleagues bought a lot of things on credit during her first year of work, and it became a bad habit, and she accumulated a lot of debt.
cn: 我的一个同事在工作第一年用信用卡买了很多东西，这成了她的坏习惯，她积累了很多债务。

en: Well, I can see how that might happen to someone, and I'm sure she regrets it, but I know it won't happen to me.
cn: 嗯，我能理解这种情况可能会发生在某些人身上，我相信她会后悔的，但我知道这不会发生在我身上。

en: Welcome to The Morning Show.
cn: 欢迎来到《晨间秀》。

en: Our guest today is a popular blog writer and a major figure in the tiny home community.
cn: 我们今天的嘉宾是一位受欢迎的博客作者，也是微型住宅社区的重要人物。

en: Welcome, Bob Jones.
cn: 欢迎你，鲍勃·琼斯。

en: Hi, Mary.
cn: 嗨，玛丽。

en: Hi, Bob.
cn: 嗨，鲍勃。

en: You're an advocate of the tiny home movement.
cn: 你是微型住宅运动的倡导者。

en: A lot of people don't know about this movement.
cn: 很多人对这个运动不太了解。

en: Can you tell our audience what it's about?
cn: 你能告诉我们的观众这是什么吗？

en: Well, it's mainly about increasing home ownership and protecting the environment.
cn: 嗯，这主要是关于增加房屋拥有率和保护环境。

en: Of course, those are great goals.
cn: 当然，这些都是伟大的目标。

en: But I've seen your blog, and you write about houses that are as small as 20 square meters.
cn: 但我看过你的博客，你写的房子小到只有20平方米。

en: That's not a realistic size for families.
cn: 对于家庭来说，这个大小是不现实的。

en: I do talk about very small homes, but there's no set definition of a tiny home.
cn: 我确实谈论过非常小的房子，但微型住宅并没有固定的定义。

en: And other people include homes that are much larger, say, 60 square meters.
cn: 其他人也包括更大的房子，比如60平方米。

en: And you'd be surprised.
cn: 你会惊讶的。

en: Many families of four are happy living in houses that are under 30 square meters.
cn: 许多四口之家住在不到30平方米的房子里也很开心。

en: But I think most of us want spacious homes.
cn: 但我认为我们大多数人都想要宽敞的房子。

en: The average new house in this area is 150 square meters.
cn: 这个地区的新房子平均是150平方米。

en: And that's what people dream of owning.
cn: 这是人们梦想拥有的。

en: Yes, but I think that dream needs to change, considering the cost of housing.
cn: 是的，但考虑到住房成本，我认为这个梦想需要改变。

en: Housing costs are high, but do people really save that much by having a smaller home?
cn: 住房成本很高，但人们真的通过拥有更小的房子节省那么多吗？

en: Absolutely.
cn: 绝对是的。

en: Many people who can only afford to rent a larger home are able to buy a tiny home.
cn: 许多只能租得起大房子的人能够买得起微型住宅。

en: In this city, the average home costs $200,000, and a tiny home costs just $50,000.
cn: 在这个城市，普通房子的平均价格是20万美元，而微型住宅只需5万美元。

en: Those are huge savings.
cn: 这些节省是巨大的。

en: So, tiny homes might not be for everyone, but they're a good option for many.
cn: 所以，微型住宅可能不适合所有人，但对许多人来说是一个很好的选择。

en: You mentioned the environment earlier.
cn: 你之前提到了环境。

en: How does this benefit the planet?
cn: 这对地球有什么好处？

en: Well, if people have smaller homes, they use less land and fewer resources to build them.
cn: 嗯，如果人们有更小的房子，他们使用的土地和建造资源就会更少。

en: Kids need time every day to run, jump, stretch and play.
cn: 孩子们每天都需要时间来跑、跳、伸展和玩耍。

en: These experiences have been shown to build children's confidence and pleasure in physical activities, develop their motor skills and even improve emotional well-being.
cn: 这些经历已被证明可以建立孩子们对体育活动的信心和乐趣，发展他们的运动技能，甚至改善情绪健康。

en: To begin with, children seem to have a natural desire to overcome challenges and take risks.
cn: 首先，孩子们似乎有一种克服挑战和冒险的自然愿望。

en: Taking healthy risks through physical movement builds children's confidence and ability to solve problems and persist through frustration.
cn: 通过身体运动进行健康的冒险可以建立孩子们的信心和解决问题的能力，并坚持克服挫折。

en: Secondly, movement activities build children's big body skills such as coordination and balance, as well as the fine motor skills they need for tasks like writing, tying their shoes, or throwing and catching a ball.
cn: 其次，运动活动可以培养孩子们重要的身体技能，如协调和平衡，以及他们在写字、系鞋带或投掷和接球等任务中所需的精细运动技能。

en: Thirdly, according to the American Psychological Association, regular physical activity, and especially outdoor activity, reduces children's stress and depression and improves their ability to focus and learn.
cn: 第三，根据美国心理协会的说法，定期的体育活动，尤其是户外活动，可以减少孩子们的压力和抑郁，并提高他们的专注和学习能力。

en: Regular exercise can significantly improve self-regulation and decrease disciplinary consequences for negative behavior.
cn: 定期锻炼可以显著提高自我调节能力，并减少因负面行为而受到的纪律处分。

en: Physical activity provides a positive outlet for frustration, anxiety or anger and can become a healthy coping skill throughout life.
cn: 体育活动为挫折、焦虑或愤怒提供了一个积极的宣泄途径，并可以成为一生的健康应对技能。

en: Finally, we know that physical activity is important for our physical and mental health and cultivating the habit of physical activity starts early.
cn: 最后，我们知道体育活动对我们的身心健康很重要，而培养体育活动的习惯从小就开始。

en: Children are more likely to develop a lifelong love of physical activity from frequent positive early experiences.
cn: 孩子们更有可能从频繁的积极早期经历中发展出对体育活动的终身热爱。

en: Not every child enjoys competitive sports or playing with balls, and that's okay.
cn: 不是每个孩子都喜欢竞技运动或玩球，这没关系。

en: There are plenty of other options, such as imaginative play, noncompetitive games, and gardening or nature experiences.
cn: 还有很多其他选择，比如想象游戏、非竞技游戏和园艺或自然体验。

en: A new study finds that job seekers are even willing to explore jobs with lower salaries, when companies are more diverse.
cn: 一项新研究发现，当公司更加多元化时，求职者甚至愿意探索薪水较低的工作。

en: It finds that sharing information about diversity makes job postings more attractive to job seekers, even when pay is lower.
cn: 研究发现，分享关于多元化的信息使职位发布对求职者更具吸引力，即使薪酬较低。

en: To conduct the study, the team partnered with an online job listings platform, which emails postings relevant to individuals and their job search criteria.
cn: 为了进行这项研究，团队与一个在线职位列表平台合作，该平台通过电子邮件发送与个人及其求职标准相关的职位列表。

en: For the course of the 11-week study, the platform emailed job listings to some 180,000 users placed in one of two conditions.
cn: 在为期11周的研究过程中，该平台向大约18万用户发送了职位列表，这些用户被分配到两种条件之一。

en: In the baseline condition, participants saw emails in the normal format, with no information on diversity.
cn: 在基线条件下，参与者看到的电子邮件是正常格式的，没有关于多元化的信息。

en: In the diversity condition, participants saw a diversity score for each listing: information about the race, gender, education, and language skills of a company's workforce compared to others in the same sector and location.
cn: 在多元化条件下，参与者看到每个列表的多元化评分：与同一行业和地区的其他公司相比，该公司员工的种族、性别、教育程度和语言技能的信息。

en: Information was then gathered on whether the email was opened and which job listings were clicked on by each user.
cn: 然后收集了关于电子邮件是否被打开以及每个用户点击了哪些职位列表的信息。

en: Participants in the diversity condition tended to click on job listings from companies with slightly higher diversity scores than those in the baseline condition.
cn: 在多元化条件下的参与者倾向于点击那些多元化评分略高于基线条件的公司的职位列表。

en: That is, participants seemed to be paying attention to information about diversity.
cn: 也就是说，参与者似乎在关注关于多元化的信息。

en: And using this, when deciding whether to click on the listing.
cn: 并在决定是否点击列表时使用这些信息。

en: And the team also found that participants were willing to look at listings with lower salaries, if they came from companies with a higher diversity score.
cn: 团队还发现，如果职位来自多元化评分较高的公司，参与者愿意查看薪水较低的职位列表。

en: A new study from Oregon State University found that dogs tend to match their behavior with the children in their family.
cn: 俄勒冈州立大学的一项新研究发现，狗往往会与家中的孩子行为相匹配。

en: The findings are important because there is a growing body of evidence that dogs can help children in many ways.
cn: 这些发现很重要，因为有越来越多的证据表明，狗可以在许多方面帮助孩子。

en: These include helping with social development, increasing physical activity, managing anxiety or serving as a source of attachment in the face of changing family structures.
cn: 这些包括帮助社交发展、增加体育活动、管理焦虑或在家庭结构变化时作为依恋的来源。

en: Yet very little research has focused on how dogs perceive and socially engage with children.
cn: 然而，很少有研究关注狗是如何感知和与孩子进行社交互动的。

en: "The great news is that this study suggests dogs are paying a lot of attention to the kids that they live with," said Monique Udell, the lead author of the study.
cn: 该研究的主要作者莫尼克·乌德尔说："好消息是这项研究表明狗非常关注它们一起生活的孩子。"

en: "One interesting thing we have observed is that dogs are matching children's behaviour, but less frequently than what we have seen between dogs and adults.
cn: "我们观察到的一件有趣的事情是，狗正在匹配孩子的行为，但比我们看到的狗和成人之间的匹配频率要低。

en: This suggests that while dogs may view children as social companions, there are also some differences that we need to understand better."
cn: 这表明，虽然狗可能将孩子视为社交伴侣，但也存在一些我们需要更好地理解的差异。"

en: While research has found dogs can have a lot of positive impacts on a child's life, there are also risks associated with a dog-child relationship.
cn: 虽然研究发现狗可以对孩子的生活产生许多积极影响，但狗与孩子的关系也存在风险。

en: For example, other studies have found dogs are more likely to bite children versus adults.
cn: 例如，其他研究发现狗更有可能咬孩子而不是成人。

en: "We still have a lot to learn about the dog-child relationship," Udell said.
cn: "关于狗与孩子的关系，我们还有很多需要学习的地方，"乌德尔说。

en: But research does show that kids are very capable of training dogs.
cn: 但研究确实表明孩子们非常有能力训练狗。

en: Across the U.S. families are looking to the winter with fear, as energy costs soar.
cn: 全美各地的家庭都怀着恐惧的心情迎接冬天，因为能源成本飙升。

en: A number of factors are creating a bad situation.
cn: 多种因素正在造成一个糟糕的局面。

en: Global energy consumption is up, but supplies have been reduced.
cn: 全球能源消耗上升，但供应却减少了。

en: The Energy Department projects heating bills will jump 28% this winter, for those who rely on natural gas.
cn: 能源部预测，对于那些依赖天然气的家庭来说，今年冬天的取暖费用将上涨28%。

en: Natural gas is used by nearly half of U.S. households for heat.
cn: 近一半的美国家庭使用天然气取暖。

en: Heating oil is projected to be 27% higher and electricity 10% higher.
cn: 预计取暖油的价格将上涨27%，电力将上涨10%。

en: That comes against inflation rates that accelerated last month, with consumer prices growing 6.6%.
cn: 与此同时，通货膨胀率在上个月加速上升，消费者价格上涨6.6%。

en: That's the fastest pace in four decades.
cn: 这是四十年来的最快增速。

en: The pain will be especially acute in parts of the country that heavily rely on heating oil to keep homes warm.
cn: 在那些严重依赖取暖油来保持家庭温暖的地区，这种痛苦将尤为剧烈。

en: It's projected to cost more than $2,300 to heat a typical home with heating oil this winter.
cn: 预计今年冬天用取暖油为一个典型家庭取暖的费用将超过2300美元。

en: Last month, the federal government added $1 billion in funding to Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program, bringing the total to $4.8 billion.
cn: 上个月，联邦政府向低收入家庭能源援助计划增加了10亿美元的资金，使总额达到48亿美元。

en: But that represents a reduction from last year's energy assistance package of over $8 billion.
cn: 但这比去年超过80亿美元的能源援助计划有所减少。

en: Many Americans think they make healthy food choices, but they may be viewing their diet too optimistically.
cn: 许多美国人认为他们做出了健康的食物选择，但他们可能对自己的饮食过于乐观。

en: That's the main finding of a new study by researchers at the U.S. Department of Agriculture in Stoneville, Mississippi.
cn: 这是密西西比州斯通维尔市美国农业部研究人员的一项新研究的主要发现。

en: The study aimed to identify disconnects between how healthily Americans think they eat and how they actually do.
cn: 该研究旨在识别美国人对自己饮食健康程度的看法与实际之间的脱节。

en: For the study, the researchers asked participants to rate their diet as excellent, very good, good, fair, or poor.
cn: 为了这项研究，研究人员要求参与者将自己的饮食评为优秀、非常好、好、一般或差。

en: Folks also completed 24-hour food questionnaires.
cn: 人们还完成了24小时食物问卷。

en: Then, the researchers compared answers to see how well responses to the two exercises matched.
cn: 然后，研究人员比较了答案，看看这两项练习的回答匹配得如何。

en: Of more than 9,700 people, roughly 85 percent were off base when asked to rate the quality of their diet, and almost all overestimated how healthy it was.
cn: 在超过9700人中，大约85%的人在评价自己饮食质量时偏离了基准，几乎所有人都高估了自己饮食的健康程度。

en: Those who rated their diet as poor tended to be far more accurate.
cn: 那些将自己的饮食评为差的人往往更准确。

en: Their rating match that of the researchers more than nine times out of ten.
cn: 他们的评分在超过九成的情况下与研究人员的评分相匹配。

en: It was a heartwarming moment that dozens of Indian rescuers rallied together to use a crane in order to save an elephant trapped at the bottom of a 20-foot well.
cn: 这是一个温暖人心的时刻，数十名印度救援人员齐心协力使用起重机来拯救一头被困在二十英尺深井底部的大象。

en: The massive rescue effort took place last week close to an army camp.
cn: 这次大规模的救援行动发生在上周，靠近一个军营。

en: The elephant wandered out of the jungle and fell into the well.
cn: 大象从丛林中走出来，掉进了井里。

en: The army officers heard a noise coming from the well and realized an elephant was trapped deep inside.
cn: 军官们听到井里传来的声音，意识到一头大象被困在了深处。

en: The officers then threw in some food for the creature and called the local forest department for help.
cn: 军官们随后给这头动物扔了一些食物，并打电话给当地森林部门寻求帮助。

en: Video of the rescue operation shows how the team used a crane to lift up the huge animal out of the well and onto the back of a truck.
cn: 救援行动的录像显示，团队如何使用起重机将这头巨大的动物从井中吊起并放到卡车的后部。

en: It was then taken to an examining room for evaluation of any injuries.
cn: 然后它被带到一个检查室进行伤情评估。

en: The elephant was kept under close supervision for a few days before it was successfully released back into the wild.
cn: 这头大象在被成功放回野外之前，受到了几天的密切观察。

en: I need to stop at the bank to withdraw some cash.
cn: 我需要在银行停一下，取一些现金。

en: Why not just pay with your phone?
cn: 为什么不直接用手机支付呢？

en: Well, actually, I've stopped using online payments for the past three months now.
cn: 嗯，实际上，我已经停止使用在线支付三个月了。

en: Stopped paying online? Oh, you must be worried that online payments aren't secure.
cn: 停止在线支付？哦，你一定是在担心在线支付不安全。

en: No, they are safe. But paying online is too convenient and I spent too much money on things I didn't need.
cn: 不，它们是安全的。但是在线支付太方便了，我在不需要的东西上花了太多钱。

en: Oh, impulse purchases can be an issue for me too. I've definitely bought clothes and shoes I didn't need because they were on sale, and paying with my phone was so easy. But I've found that if I review my spending every night, that keeps me from spending too much.
cn: 哦，冲动消费对我来说也是个问题。我确实买了一些不需要的衣服和鞋子，因为它们在打折，而且用手机支付太容易了。但我发现如果我每天晚上回顾我的消费，这可以防止我花太多钱。

en: I tried that strategy, but it just didn't work, because I'd be busy studying all day. Then, when I was tired and hungry, I'd use my phone to order food, like burgers and other junk, instead of going to the canteen, where I could get a healthier meal for half the price.
cn: 我试过这个策略，但它就是不起作用，因为我整天都在忙着学习。然后，当我又累又饿的时候，我会用手机点餐，比如汉堡和其他垃圾食品，而不是去食堂，在那里我可以以一半的价格买到更健康的饭菜。

en: Well, what do you do now then? It seems like you'd have the same problems with cash.
cn: 那么，你现在怎么做呢？看起来你用现金也会有同样的问题。

en: I go to the bank once a week, and the rest of the time I keep my bank card at home, so I can't get more cash out. And I also have a notebook where I record my expenses.
cn: 我每周去一次银行，其余时间我把银行卡放在家里，所以我不能取出更多的现金。我还有一个笔记本，记录我的开支。

en: But what prevents you from just going to the bank and getting more money, if you want to buy something?
cn: 但是如果你想买东西，是什么阻止你去银行取更多的钱呢？

en: The first month I did withdraw extra cash twice, but I felt guilty about it. And after that I refused to spend more than what I had budgeted, and by now it's just a habit.
cn: 第一个月我确实两次取出了额外的现金，但我对此感到内疚。之后，我拒绝花费超过我预算的钱，到现在这已经成了一个习惯。

en: Please hear me out. I don't want our son to spend his afternoons doing something he hates, even if it might prepare him for the future. What about getting him to join a sport, like soccer? From all the running and training, he could become quite athletic. Not to mention the great physical benefits from exercising outside every day.
cn: 请听我说完。我不想让我们的儿子下午做他讨厌的事情，即使这可能为他的未来做准备。让他参加一项运动怎么样，比如足球？通过所有的跑步和训练，他可能会变得很有运动天赋。更不用说每天在户外锻炼带来的巨大身体好处了。

en: I don't think he should be doing something so challenging with all his breathing issues. What about playing an indoor sport, like badminton? The environment is easier to control, and he can still get a good workout, in addition to improving his hand-eye coordination. Besides, I could teach him some of the basics from my time as a badminton player.
cn: 我认为他不应该做这么有挑战性的事情，因为他有呼吸问题。参加室内运动怎么样，比如羽毛球？环境更容易控制，他仍然可以得到很好的锻炼，同时提高他的手眼协调能力。此外，我可以教他一些我作为羽毛球运动员时学到的基本知识。

en: Um, I'm thinking team sports should be the way to go. There's nothing like playing as part of a unit to accomplish a goal like winning a game or even a championship. He could try basketball since many of the courts are indoors now and it's a sport that could help him understand team spirit while cooperating with others. Maybe he could even join the school basketball team when he's ready.
cn: 嗯，我认为团队运动应该是正确的选择。没有什么比作为一个团队的一部分来实现赢得比赛甚至冠军的目标更好的了。他可以尝试篮球，因为现在很多球场都在室内，这是一项可以帮助他在与他人合作的同时理解团队精神的运动。也许当他准备好的时候，他甚至可以加入学校篮球队。

en: Oh, oh, what about volleyball? It's a team sport and they often have mixed gender teams so he could socialize with both girls and boys. It's not as popular as some sports, which means he has better odds of possibly getting an athletic scholarship in the future. I also believe you were a beach volleyball athlete yourself not so long ago.
cn: 哦，哦，排球怎么样？这是一项团队运动，他们经常有混合性别的队伍，所以他可以和女孩和男孩都社交。它不像一些运动那么受欢迎，这意味着他未来有可能获得体育奖学金的机会更大。我也相信你自己不久前还是一名沙滩排球运动员。

en: As I've said many times before, beach volleyball and indoor volleyball are completely different.
cn: 正如我之前多次说过的，沙滩排球和室内排球是完全不同的。

en: Lift-off is usually the most environmentally harmful stage of any space mission, with vast quantities of fuel burnt up in a matter of minutes.
cn: 火箭发射通常是任何太空任务中对环境危害最大的阶段，因为在几分钟内会燃烧大量燃料。

en: For instance, SpaceX's Falcon 9 gets through 112 tons of refined fuel, emitting about 336 tons of CO2.
cn: 例如，SpaceX的猎鹰9号消耗了112吨精炼燃料，排放了约336吨二氧化碳。

en: This is the equivalent produced by your average car driving almost 70 times around the world, as well as greenhouse gases.
cn: 这相当于普通汽车绕地球行驶近70圈所产生的二氧化碳，以及温室气体。

en: Rocket engines emit particles that destroy ozone.
cn: 火箭发动机排放的颗粒会破坏臭氧层。

en: These issues are growing more pressing with the emergence of commercial spaceflight.
cn: 随着商业航天的出现，这些问题变得越来越紧迫。

en: There were 114 space launches in 2020, but there may be up to 1,000 per year in future.
cn: 2020年有114次太空发射，但未来可能每年多达1000次。

en: Sustainable fuels are the top priority to enable greener space travel.
cn: 可持续燃料是实现更环保太空旅行的首要任务。

en: Current spacecraft use a variety of fuels, but most are based on fossil fuels.
cn: 目前的航天器使用各种燃料，但大多数基于化石燃料。

en: One potentially greener option is liquid hydrogen and oxygen.
cn: 一个潜在的更环保选择是液态氢和氧。

en: Hydrogen can be obtained sustainably by using solar power to break water down into oxygen and hydrogen.
cn: 通过使用太阳能将水分解成氧气和氢气，可以可持续地获得氢气。

en: Reusable rockets can cut down on some of the waste associated with spaceflight.
cn: 可重复使用的火箭可以减少与太空飞行相关的一些浪费。

en: Traditionally, boosters, fuel tanks, and other components are treated as expendable.
cn: 传统上，助推器、燃料箱和其他组件被视为一次性使用。

en: But guiding them back to Earth in a controlled manner opens new possibilities—most components from the Falcon 9 can be reused up to 100 times.
cn: 但以受控方式将它们引导回地球开辟了新的可能性——猎鹰9号的大多数组件可以重复使用多达100次。

en: Truly environmentally friendly space travel is still some way off.
cn: 真正环保的太空旅行还有一段路要走。

en: But we already have many of the technologies needed to start limiting its impact on our planet.
cn: 但我们已经拥有了许多开始限制其对地球影响所需的技术。

en: Helping to look after a pet can facilitate numerous aspects of a child's emotional development.
cn: 帮助照顾宠物可以促进孩子情感发展的许多方面。

en: Research shows that reading to a loyal and non-judgmental companion, such as a dog or cat, can encourage reluctant readers to read aloud, which will in turn boost their self-confidence.
cn: 研究表明，给忠诚且不带评判性的伴侣（如狗或猫）读书可以鼓励不愿意朗读的孩子大声朗读，从而提高他们的自信心。

en: Having a companion to talk to about their feelings can also help children feel secure and develop communication skills.
cn: 有一个伴侣可以谈论他们的感受也可以帮助孩子感到安全并发展沟通技巧。

en: A household pet can also cultivate a child's sense of responsibility, as their parent explains the necessary processes of keeping their pet happy and healthy.
cn: 家庭宠物还可以培养孩子的责任感，因为父母会解释保持宠物快乐和健康的必要过程。

en: As a child matures, they can then take on more of the daily responsibilities, boosting their sense of independence.
cn: 随着孩子的成熟，他们可以承担更多的日常责任，增强他们的独立感。

en: Pets also provide a fantastic subject for research and learning.
cn: 宠物还为研究和学习提供了绝佳的主题。

en: Parents can encourage their child to research their favorite pets at the library or during a supervised internet search.
cn: 父母可以鼓励孩子在图书馆或在有监督的互联网搜索中研究他们最喜欢的宠物。

en: Taking children along to the pet shop to buy food and supplies will support their cognitive development as their passion for learning flourishes.
cn: 带孩子一起去宠物店购买食物和用品会支持他们的认知发展，同时他们的学习热情也会增长。

en: A child's physical development can benefit greatly from taking pets for walks in the fresh air.
cn: 带宠物在新鲜空气中散步可以极大地有益于孩子的身体发展。

en: Even their fine motor skills can be utilized in taking care of a beloved animal.
cn: 即使是精细的运动技能也可以通过照顾心爱的动物而得到利用。

en: When responsibilities are well paced and communicated, a child can benefit greatly from involvement in bringing up a happy and healthy pet.
cn: 当责任分配恰当并传达清楚时，孩子可以从参与养育快乐健康的宠物中受益良多。

en: And of course, if a child doesn't have a pet in their own household, they can still benefit from all of the above when visiting a friend who does.
cn: 当然，如果孩子自己家里没有宠物，他们在拜访有宠物的朋友时仍然可以从上述所有方面受益。

en: A new bill in the Ohio legislature would require state public colleges and universities to send prospective students a packet of information.
cn: 俄亥俄州立法机构的一项新法案将要求州立公立学院和大学向潜在学生发送一套信息资料。

en: This would include costs of college grants and scholarships.
cn: 这将包括大学助学金和奖学金的费用。

en: It would also include expected monthly loan payments and projected salary after college.
cn: 它还将包括预期的每月贷款还款和大学毕业后的预计工资。

en: State Representative Adam Mathews is one of the two legislators who proposed the bill.
cn: 州代表亚当·马修斯是提出该法案的两位立法者之一。

en: He said it would give prospective students more information about what to expect once they graduate.
cn: 他说，这将为潜在学生提供更多关于毕业后期望的信息。

en: "Putting that information in front of them will give them the best opportunity to match their skills and their dreams to what our schools can provide," said Mathews.
cn: 马修斯说："把这些信息摆在他们面前，将使他们有最好的机会将他们的技能和梦想与我们的学校能够提供的内容匹配起来。"

en: He notes that the state can only regulate public institutions in this way, but he hopes private institutions in Ohio follow the lead of the state and post similar information.
cn: 他指出，州只能以这种方式监管公立机构，但他希望俄亥俄州的私立机构跟随州的领导并发布类似的信息。

en: He believes giving out this information will help Ohio's colleges and universities to be more competitive.
cn: 他认为提供这些信息将有助于俄亥俄州的学院和大学更具竞争力。

en: The information will highlight what a great value they have for their very reasonable cost.
cn: 这些信息将突出显示他们以非常合理的成本提供的巨大价值。

en: Ohio's schools are already competitive. The state attracts more undergraduate students than it sends to colleges out of state.
cn: 俄亥俄州的学校已经具有竞争力。该州吸引的本科生比它送到外州大学的学生多。

en: Many colleges and universities currently provide similar information on their websites. This includes tuition, fees, graduation rates, and more.
cn: 许多学院和大学目前在其网站上提供类似的信息。这包括学费、费用、毕业率等。

en: But students need to search for the information.
cn: 但学生需要搜索这些信息。

en: This bill would require the universities and colleges to send a packet directly to students.
cn: 该法案将要求大学和学院直接向学生发送这一套信息。

en: Everything changed for 7-year-old Tariq when he slapped some butter on an ear of corn.
cn: 当7岁的塔里克往一穗玉米上抹了些黄油后，一切都变了。

en: He knew it tasted good, but butter made it better.
cn: 他知道玉米本身就很好吃，但加了黄油之后味道更棒了。

en: His passion for produce got him a position as South Dakota's official Corn Ambassador.
cn: 他对农产品的热爱为他赢得了南达科他州官方玉米大使的职位。

en: Tariq's profession of love for his favorite vegetable earned him the name the "Corn Kid".
cn: 塔里克对自己最爱的蔬菜的深情告白让他获得了"玉米小子"的称号。

en: This was after his online interview attracted millions of views and was made into a song.
cn: 这是在他的线上采访吸引了数百万次观看并被改编成歌曲之后发生的事。

en: South Dakota is one of the top corn producers in America.
cn: 南达科他州是美国主要的玉米产区之一。

en: The corn provides nourishment across the globe.
cn: 这里的玉米为全球提供着营养。

en: Tariq said not everyone has to like corn, but everyone should definitely try it, especially with butter.
cn: 塔里克说，并非每个人都必须喜欢玉米，但每个人绝对都应该尝一尝，尤其是抹了黄油的玉米。

en: Tariq and his family were invited to South Dakota to attend the honorary ceremony at the state's Corn Palace.
cn: 塔里克和他的家人受邀前往南达科他州，参加在该州玉米宫殿举行的荣誉仪式。

en: Officials wanted to highlight South Dakota's two largest industries, tourism and agriculture.
cn: 官员们希望借此突出南达科他州的两大产业——旅游业和农业。

en: Tariq couldn't believe his eyes when he saw the palace made of corn.
cn: 当塔里克看到这座由玉米建成的宫殿时，他简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。

en: Two arrests were announced Thursday.
cn: 周四宣布了两起逮捕事件。

en: The arrests were in connection with a string of mail thefts from U.S. Post Services collection boxes in Marion County and for the possession of a stolen postal key, according to the Department of Justice.
cn: 据司法部称，这些逮捕与马里恩县美国邮政服务收集箱发生的一系列邮件盗窃案有关，还涉及持有被盗的邮政钥匙。

en: Jordan Jax and Tarod Goodman, both 23, were arrested after evidence gathered in an investigation showed the pair stole mail on multiple occasions using a postal key, according to a news release.
cn: 一份新闻稿显示，23岁的乔丹·贾克斯和塔罗德·古德曼被逮捕，因为调查中收集到的证据表明，这两人多次使用邮政钥匙盗窃邮件。

en: Jax and Goodman stole mail for around four months.
cn: 贾克斯和古德曼的邮件盗窃行为持续了约四个月。

en: Investigators reviewed videos of the collection boxes.
cn: 调查人员查看了收集箱的监控视频。

en: The video showed the two men loading the stolen mail into Jax's vehicle.
cn: 视频显示这两名男子将被盗邮件装进贾克斯的车里。

en: Investigators were also able to recover the key that was used to open the collection boxes.
cn: 调查人员还找回了用于打开收集箱的钥匙。

en: Jax and Goodman each face up to five years in federal prison in the mail thefts and up to ten years for possession of postal key.
cn: 贾克斯和古德曼各自因邮件盗窃罪最高可被判处五年联邦监禁，因持有邮政钥匙罪最高可被判处十年监禁。

en: Can fast-fashion be sustainable?
cn: 快时尚能做到可持续发展吗？

en: Researchers think yes.
cn: 研究人员认为可以。

en: Identifying why the fast-fashion business model creates waste and determining whether regulators can establish incentives for consumers and manufacturers are steps to reduce waste.
cn: 找出快时尚商业模式产生浪费的原因，并确定监管机构能否为消费者和制造商制定激励措施，是减少浪费的步骤。

en: Recently, the clothing industry has come under attack for creating a waste problem with serious environmental consequences.
cn: 最近，服装行业因造成具有严重环境后果的浪费问题而遭到抨击。

en: In the absence of environmentally and economically feasible recycling options, fast-fashion manufacturers pump out low-quality clothes produced in high volumes that are worn only a few times and then discarded.
cn: 在缺乏既环保又经济可行的回收方案的情况下，快时尚制造商大量生产低质量服装，这些服装只穿几次就被丢弃。

en: The researchers put forth policy contributions, ranging from sustainable disposal of leftover stock to production tax, to incentivize both manufacturers and consumers to be more waste conscious.
cn: 研究人员提出了一系列政策建议，从剩余库存的可持续处理到生产税，以激励制造商和消费者都更具废物意识。

en: In order to devise effective policies to curb the environmental impact of the clothing industry, it is important to identify the source of the problem in the supply chain.
cn: 为了制定有效的政策来遏制服装行业对环境的影响，找出供应链中问题的根源至关重要。

en: Manufacturers, consumers, and regulatory bodies can then take an informed approach to recognize the environmental impact of fast-fashion and to design an ecosystem to reduce waste, incentivize innovation, and create new business models to manage waste.
cn: 这样一来，制造商、消费者和监管机构就能采取有依据的方法，认识到快时尚对环境的影响，并构建一个生态系统，以减少浪费、激励创新，以及创造管理废物的新商业模式。

en: Hey, Mary.
cn: 嘿，玛丽。

en: You seem to be very much annoyed.
cn: 你好像很生气啊。

en: What happened?
cn: 发生什么事了？

en: Rush hour in this city is killing me.
cn: 这个城市的交通高峰期快把我折磨死了。

en: Ah, yes.
cn: 啊，是啊。

en: Rush hour is terrible, especially in the morning between 8:00 and 9:00.
cn: 交通高峰期太可怕了，尤其是早上8点到9点之间。

en: But what else can you expect in a city this big?
cn: 但在这么大的城市里，你还能指望什么呢？

en: Well, I think the local government could help improve things.
cn: 嗯，我觉得当地政府可以帮忙改善一下。

en: I mean, getting rid of rush hour may be impossible, but it could be made more tolerable.
cn: 我的意思是，消除交通高峰期可能不太可能，但可以让它变得更能让人忍受。

en: Don't you think?
cn: 你不觉得吗？

en: Hmm, but I'm not sure how.
cn: 嗯，但我不确定该怎么做。

en: Well, for example, the subway system could have air conditioning.
cn: 嗯，比如说，地铁系统可以装空调啊。

en: I know many cities in the world have air conditioning in their subway.
cn: 我知道世界上很多城市的地铁都有空调。

en: So why can't we?
cn: 那我们为什么不能有呢？

en: It gets so hot in the summer.
cn: 夏天的时候地铁里特别热。

en: I can hardly breathe down there, and add to that the rush-hour crowds with strangers packed close together in the subway carriages.
cn: 我在下面几乎喘不过气，再加上交通高峰期的人群，陌生人在地铁车厢里挤在一起。

en: The whole thing is just horrible.
cn: 这整个情况简直太糟糕了。

en: Ah, yes.
cn: 啊，是啊。

en: You are completely right.
cn: 你说得太对了。

en: The trains here are too old.
cn: 这里的火车太旧了。

en: The government should definitely invest in new ones with air conditioning.
cn: 政府绝对应该投资购置带空调的新列车。

en: I guess I'm fortunate I take the bus instead.
cn: 我想我很幸运，我坐公交车。

en: Oh, that's much better.
cn: 哦，那好多了。

en: Yeah, it's more convenient.
cn: 是啊，更方便。

en: Bus No. 36 goes straight from my house to the office.
cn: 36路公交车从我家直达办公室。

en: It's a 30-minute ride, and I don't have to make any changes.
cn: 车程30分钟，而且我不用换乘。

en: That sounds nice.
cn: 听起来不错。

en: I tell you my current commute is killing me.
cn: 跟你说，我现在的通勤快把我折磨死了。

en: Maybe I should move closer to the office.
cn: 也许我应该搬到离办公室近一点的地方。

en: Well, I know a great housing agent.
cn: 嗯，我认识一个很棒的房屋中介。

en: I found the flat I am living in now through him, and I love it.
cn: 我现在住的公寓就是通过他找到的，我很喜欢。

en: Hmm, could you send me his number, please?
cn: 嗯，你能把他的电话号码发给我吗？

en: Sure thing.
cn: 没问题。

en: Just tell him exactly what you are looking for.
cn: 你只要告诉他你确切想要什么样的房子就行。

en: And I'm sure he will find something good.
cn: 我相信他会找到合适的。

en: Did you hear about Johnny?
cn: 你听说约翰尼的事了吗？

en: No, why?
cn: 没有，怎么了？

en: Is he okay?
cn: 他还好吗？

en: He had some plastic surgery done.
cn: 他做了些整容手术。

en: What?
cn: 什么？

en: Why?
cn: 为什么呀？

en: Do you remember he had a scar on his face?
cn: 你记得他脸上有块疤痕吗？

en: Yes, of course.
cn: 当然记得。

en: He always had that.
cn: 他一直都有。

en: I've known him since primary school, and I always remember him having that on his cheek.
cn: 我从小学就认识他了，我一直记得他脸颊上有那块疤痕。

en: Well, he had it fixed.
cn: 嗯，他把它修复了。

en: Fixed?
cn: 修复？

en: What do you mean?
cn: 你什么意思？

en: You can't fix a scar.
cn: 疤痕是无法修复的。

en: You know what I mean.
cn: 你懂我的意思。

en: He had an operation done on it, plastic surgery, in order to cover it and make it less noticeable.
cn: 他做了个手术，整容手术，为的是遮住疤痕，让它没那么显眼。

en: Oh, well, that's ridiculous, isn't it?
cn: 哦，这也太荒唐了，不是吗？

en: It was noticeable, sure, but it wasn't an ugly scar.
cn: 那疤痕确实能看出来，但并不丑。

en: It never occurred to me that he should have it taken care of like that.
cn: 我从来没想过他需要那样去处理它。

en: I agree.
cn: 我同意。

en: I can understand some scars and physical defects can be ugly and distracting, but not Johnny's.
cn: 我能理解有些疤痕和身体缺陷可能很丑，会让人分心，但约翰尼的不是这样。

en: In fact, I thought it added character, like it gave him a certain uniqueness.
cn: 事实上，我觉得那疤痕为他增添了个性，让他有种独特的气质。

en: He must have felt differently, though.
cn: 不过他肯定不这么觉得。

en: He must have felt self-conscious and insecure, perhaps.
cn: 或许他觉得很不自在，没有安全感吧。

en: No, no, that's not the reason.
cn: 不，不是的。

en: He was totally fine with his scar.
cn: 他对自己的疤痕完全不在意。

en: As you said, he had had it for most of his life.
cn: 就像你说的，他大半辈子都带着这个疤痕。

en: Then why did he have the operation?
cn: 那他为什么要做手术呢？

en: Because his girlfriend wanted him to.
cn: 因为他女朋友想让他做。

en: What?
cn: 什么？

en: That's so superficial and selfish of her.
cn: 她也太肤浅、太自私了。

en: If Johnny's girlfriend doesn't like him for who he is, then she does not deserve to be his girlfriend.
cn: 如果约翰尼的女朋友不是因为他本来的样子而喜欢他，那她就不配做他的女朋友。

en: You're right.
cn: 你说得对。

en: So he is insane to give in to her like that.
cn: 所以他就这么迁就她，真是疯了。

en: But when I told him, he said he loves her and would just do what she wants him to.
cn: 但我跟他说的时候，他说他爱她，愿意做她想让他做的事。

en: What a fool he is!
cn: 他真是个傻瓜！

en: Talking is unique to humans.
cn: 说话是人类独有的能力。

en: An animal might make ten different sounds, but an adult human knows more than 20,000 words.
cn: 动物可能会发出十种不同的声音，但一个成年人认识的单词超过20,000个。

en: Additionally, we're the only animal that expresses thoughts in full sentences.
cn: 此外，我们是唯一能用完整句子表达思想的动物。

en: Researchers don't think language was invented.
cn: 研究人员认为语言并非被发明出来的。

en: Instead, they think it evolved.
cn: 而是逐渐进化而来的。

en: How did talking evolve?
cn: 说话是如何进化的呢？

en: There are two main theories.
cn: 主要有两种理论。

en: The first theory is that language started with people making different sounds, mostly imitating the things around them, like animal calls, nature sounds and the sounds of tools.
cn: 第一种理论认为，语言始于人们发出不同的声音，大多是模仿周围的事物，比如动物的叫声、自然界的声音以及工具发出的声音。

en: Perhaps they made the sound of wind to comment on the weather or imitated the sound of a bird to tell a friend that there was a bird nearby.
cn: 或许他们会发出风声来评论天气，或者模仿鸟叫声来告诉朋友附近有一只鸟。

en: Then over hundreds of thousands of years, those sounds turned into words that people began to learn as part of their language.
cn: 然后在几十万年间，这些声音逐渐变成了单词，成为人们语言中需要学习的一部分。

en: At some point, people started stringing the words together to form sentences.
cn: 在某个时候，人们开始把单词串联起来组成句子。

en: The other main theory, which is more recent, is that people started off by gesturing—pointing at things with their hands and imitating actions using their bodies.
cn: 另一种主要理论出现得较晚，该理论认为人类最初是通过手势交流的——用手指着东西，用身体模仿动作。

en: Eventually, these gestures turned into full sign language.
cn: 最终，这些手势演变成了完整的手语。

en: This theory guesses that after developing sign languages, people eventually started making sounds along with their gestures.
cn: 该理论推测，在发展出手语之后，人们最终开始在做手势的同时发出声音。

en: At some point, they switched to mostly making sounds that became words instead of just using their bodies.
cn: 在某个阶段，他们主要转向发出声音，这些声音变成了单词，而不再仅仅依靠身体交流。

en: The reason they switched to making sounds, the theory goes, is that talking out loud lets you communicate with someone even when you can't see them.
cn: 该理论认为，他们转向发出声音的原因是，大声说话能让你在看不见对方的情况下也能与之交流。

en: Is it a good idea to display luxury brands and other signals of status?
cn: 展示奢侈品牌和其他身份地位的象征物是个好主意吗？

en: It depends on the situation.
cn: 这要视情况而定。

en: Studies have shown that people who appear to be wealthy tend to be considered more intelligent, disciplined and competent than those who do not.
cn: 研究表明，那些看起来很富有的人往往会被认为比不富有的人更聪明、更自律、更有能力。

en: But new research found that people believe someone who shows off their social status cares more about benefiting themselves than helping others.
cn: 但新的研究发现，人们认为那些炫耀自己社会地位的人更在乎为自己谋利，而不是帮助他人。

en: This means people are less willing to collaborate with them.
cn: 这意味着人们不太愿意与他们合作。

en: Modesty may be key when cooperation is essential, but the researchers also found that in some cases, status signaling has advantages.
cn: 当合作至关重要时，谦虚可能是关键，但研究人员也发现，在某些情况下，身份地位的展示是有好处的。

en: Experiments showed that participants were less likely to choose someone who signals their wealth or status to join a group seeking cooperative members, but participants were more likely to choose that person when they were looking for a competitive team member.
cn: 实验表明，当参与者要挑选成员加入一个寻求合作的团队时，他们不太可能选择那些炫耀财富或地位的人，但当他们在寻找竞争性团队成员时，就更有可能选择这样的人。

en: These findings suggest that people should change how they present themselves depending on their social goal.
cn: 这些研究结果表明，人们应该根据自己的社交目标来改变自我展示的方式。

en: This is the era of social media.
cn: 现在是社交媒体时代。

en: People can easily share their wealth and status to large audiences, but they need to consider the consequences.
cn: 人们可以很容易地向大量受众炫耀自己的财富和地位，但他们需要考虑这样做的后果。

en: Posting about luxury purchases and expensive vacations online may help you to persuade others and frighten competitors, but it could also signal to potential friends or future employers that you are unlikely to think about the needs of others.
cn: 在网上发布购买的奢侈品和昂贵的度假经历可能会帮助你说服他人、震慑竞争对手，但也可能向潜在的朋友或未来的雇主传递出你不太可能考虑他人需求的信号。

en: This makes things tricky for people who may want to impress others while also demonstrating that they are a team player.
cn: 这让那些既想给别人留下深刻印象，又想证明自己是团队合作者的人陷入了两难境地。

en: Human fascination with animals goes back as far as humans do.
cn: 人类对动物的迷恋可以追溯到人类诞生之初。

en: Of the oldest cave paintings discovered, some are up to 40,000 years old, and there are more images of animals than humans.
cn: 在已发现的最古老的洞穴壁画中，有些距今已有4万年历史，其中动物的形象比人类的多。

en: At some point, humans began to capture and hold animals.
cn: 在某个时期，人类开始捕捉并圈养动物。

en: The first known collections were held by royalty and were not open to the public.
cn: 已知最早的动物收藏由皇室拥有，并不对公众开放。

en: In Egypt, researchers have found buildings from around 3500 B.C. containing the remains of animals, including elephants, which were not native to Egypt, but life wasn't easy for these animals.
cn: 在埃及，研究人员发现了公元前3500年左右的建筑，里面有动物的遗骸，包括并非埃及本土物种的大象，但这些动物的生活并不轻松。

en: They probably had short lives, and the remains show evidence of severe injuries.
cn: 它们的寿命可能很短，而且遗骸上有严重受伤的痕迹。

en: The first public exhibit of animals may have been created by Egypt's Queen Hatshepsut around 1480 B.C.
cn: 最早的公共动物展览可能是由埃及的哈特谢普苏特女王在公元前1480年左右创办的。

en: Researchers think the zoo was started with animals brought home from a far-off land known as Punt.
cn: 研究人员认为，这个动物园最初的动物是从一个名为蓬特的遥远国度带回来的。

en: It's unclear why the Queen built the zoo, but it might have been to show off her wealth and power.
cn: 目前还不清楚女王为什么要建这个动物园，但有可能是为了炫耀她的财富和权力。

en: Early zoos are found all over the world.
cn: 世界各地都有早期动物园的踪迹。

en: In China, Emperor Wen-Wang is said to have built a Garden of Intelligence around 1060 B.C. It included deer, birds and many fish.
cn: 在中国，据说周文王在公元前1060年左右建造了"灵囿"，里面有鹿、鸟类和许多鱼类。

en: In England, King Henry I set up a collection of animals in about 1110 as a part of the royal estate.
cn: 在英国，亨利一世国王大约在1110年建立了一个动物收藏地，作为王室庄园的一部分。

en: His collection included tigers and lions.
cn: 他的收藏包括老虎和狮子。

en: This collection eventually moved to the Tower of London in 1235.
cn: 这个收藏地最终在1235年迁至伦敦塔。

en: The collection stayed at that location for 600 years.
cn: 并在那里存在了600年。

en: A Florida teenager and an Atlanta woman won the overall men's and women's divisions Saturday at the annual 7 Mile Bridge Run.
cn: 周六，在一年一度的7英里大桥跑比赛中，一名佛罗里达州的少年和一名亚特兰大的女子分别夺得男子组和女子组的总冠军。

en: Vaclav Bursa, 15, of Big Pine Key, Florida, finished first overall.
cn: 来自佛罗里达州大松礁岛、15岁的瓦茨拉夫·布尔萨获得了全场第一名。

en: He completed the race in 41 minutes and one second and claimed the top spot in the men's division.
cn: 他以41分1秒的成绩完成比赛，夺得男子组冠军。

en: Bursa won third place in the 2022 race.
cn: 布尔萨在2022年的比赛中获得了第三名。

en: He is a student at Marathon High School.
cn: 他是马拉松高中的一名学生。

en: Joanna Stephens, 28, of Atlanta, completed the course in 41 minutes and 12 seconds.
cn: 来自亚特兰大、28岁的乔安娜·斯蒂芬斯以41分12秒的成绩完成了全程。

en: She won the women's division title and placed second overall.
cn: 她赢得了女子组冠军，总排名第二。

en: The race drew competitors from 41 U.S. states.
cn: 这场比赛吸引了来自美国41个州的参赛者。

en: There were also runners from other countries, including Canada, the UK and Switzerland.
cn: 还有来自其他国家的跑步者，包括加拿大、英国和瑞士。

en: The run closed the span between the Middle and Lower Keys to traffic for three hours Saturday.
cn: 周六，这段连接中群岛和下群岛的桥梁封闭了三个小时，禁止车辆通行。

en: The April contest is one of the most popular running events in the southeastern United States.
cn: 这场四月的比赛是美国东南部最受欢迎的跑步赛事之一。

en: The race field filled within minutes after online registration opened in January.
cn: 今年1月在线注册通道开启后，比赛名额在几分钟内就满了。

en: British astronaut Tim Peake is stepping down permanently from his role as a European astronaut.
cn: 英国宇航员蒂姆·皮克将永久辞去欧洲宇航员的职务。

en: He's going to take up a full-time position as ambassador for science and space instead—work he has been doing since 2019.
cn: 他将转而担任科学与太空全职大使——自2019年以来他就一直在从事这项工作。

en: The former British Army Air Corps helicopter pilot was selected as a European Space Agency astronaut in 2009.
cn: 这位前英国陆军航空兵直升机飞行员于2009年被选为欧洲航天局宇航员。

en: He flew to the space station for a 6-month tour in 2015.
cn: 2015年，他飞往空间站执行了为期6个月的任务。

en: The tour saw him control a robot on Earth remotely from orbit.
cn: 在这次任务中，他从轨道上远程操控了地球上的一个机器人。

en: He also helped dock two spacecraft.
cn: 他还协助对接了两艘航天器。

en: Tim said, "Being an astronaut has been the most extraordinary experience.
cn: 蒂姆表示："成为一名宇航员是一段极为非凡的经历。

en: I've had the privilege of working with an exceptional team of individuals during the past 13 years with the agency.
cn: 在过去13年里，我有幸与该机构里一群杰出的人组成的团队共事。

en: It has been incredibly exciting and rewarding.
cn: 这段经历令人无比兴奋且收获满满。

en: By assuming the role of an ambassador for human flights to space, I'll continue to support the European and the UK Space Agencies."
cn: 通过担任载人太空飞行大使这一角色，我将继续为欧洲航天局和英国航天局提供支持。"

en: An Asda store in Wales is now home to five cats after they wandered in and made themselves comfortable.
cn: 威尔士的一家阿斯达超市如今成了五只猫咪的家，这些猫咪溜进超市后，在里面过得舒舒服服。

en: The supermarket is known for its loyal customers but now has a different kind of visitor that has appeared over the last year.
cn: 这家超市向来以拥有忠实顾客而闻名，但在过去一年里，却出现了一种不同类型的访客。

en: Regular shoppers at the supermarket are familiar with the sight of several cats settling down in the shop aisles.
cn: 超市的常客们对几只猫咪在货架通道里安顿下来的景象已经习以为常。

en: The unusual situation started about 12 months ago, when one cat routinely started visiting the store.
cn: 这种不寻常的情况大约始于12个月前，当时有一只猫开始经常光顾这家店。

en: Local newspapers reported that puzzled customers posted on Facebook groups to try to find out if the cat was lost.
cn: 当地报纸报道称，困惑的顾客们在脸书群组上发帖，想弄清楚这只猫是不是迷路了。

en: But its owner assured the concerned customers it was very much loved and fed at home.
cn: 但它的主人向关切的顾客们保证，这只猫在家里备受宠爱，吃得也很好。

en: It just enjoyed visiting the shop.
cn: 它只是喜欢来店里逛逛。

en: Staff did their best to discourage the pet from hanging around.
cn: 工作人员曾尽力阻止这只宠物在店里逗留。

en: But instead of leaving and never coming back, it invited its friends round.
cn: 但它非但没有一去不回，反而把它的朋友们也邀了过来。

en: There are now at least five different cats who come almost on a daily basis.
cn: 现在，每天几乎都有至少五只不同的猫会来店里。

en: They visit the store so much that staff have been forced to put up signs asking their customers not to feed them.
cn: 这些猫来得太频繁，工作人员不得不张贴告示，要求顾客不要喂它们。

en: I've been thinking about moving off campus next semester.
cn: 我一直在考虑下学期搬出校园。

en: Hmm, I don't know if that's a good idea as your mother and I would worry about you living all by yourself in an apartment so far from home.
cn: 嗯，我不知道这是不是个好主意，因为我和你妈妈会担心你一个人住在离家这么远的公寓里。

en: And then there's the expense too.
cn: 而且还有费用问题。

en: I'm not sure we can afford it.
cn: 我不确定我们能不能负担得起。

en: Well, I wouldn't be alone, actually.
cn: 其实，我不会一个人住的。

en: Three of my friends from the dormitory would share the place with me.
cn: 我宿舍的三个朋友会和我一起合租。

en: And with four of us, it wouldn't cost any more than living in the dorm.
cn: 我们四个人住的话，花费不会比住在宿舍里多。

en: Are you sure about that?
cn: 你确定吗？

en: Rents in big cities are high, and then there's the cost of electricity and gas.
cn: 大城市的房租很高，而且还有电费和燃气费。

en: Have you factored those in?
cn: 这些你都考虑进去了吗？

en: We've budgeted for those and for Internet and transportation.
cn: 我们已经把这些费用以及网费和交通费都做了预算。

en: And if we move far enough from the city center, the rent is low enough for us to afford all of it.
cn: 而且如果我们搬到离市中心足够远的地方，房租就会低到我们能负担得起所有费用。

en: What about the commute to and from campus?
cn: 那往返校园的通勤呢？

en: It sounds like you'll be wasting several hours every day on the road instead of studying.
cn: 听起来你每天要在路上浪费好几个小时，而不是学习。

en: It's about an hour to campus.
cn: 到校园大约要一个小时。

en: But there's no reason I can't study on the bus.
cn: 但我没理由不能在公交车上学习啊。

en: After all, I did that during high school, and my commute was even longer then.
cn: 毕竟，高中的时候我就这么做过，而且那时候通勤时间更长。

en: That's true.
cn: 这倒是真的。

en: But I'm not sure why you want to leave campus and go through all that trouble when the cost is the same.
cn: 但我不明白，既然花费一样，你为什么要离开校园，经历这么多麻烦。

en: For a lot of reasons.
cn: 原因有很多。

en: We'd have a kitchen, so we could cook ourselves.
cn: 我们会有一个厨房，这样就可以自己做饭了。

en: And we'd each have our own bedroom where we could study, instead of going to the library.
cn: 而且我们每个人都会有自己的卧室，可以在里面学习，不用去图书馆了。

en: We'd just have more space and privacy.
cn: 我们会有更多的空间和隐私。

en: I'm not convinced that the benefits are greater than the disadvantages, but I'll discuss this with your mother.
cn: 我不觉得好处大于坏处，但我会和你妈妈商量一下这件事。

en: Good morning.
cn: 早上好。

en: I'm looking for a present for my nephew, Lawrence.
cn: 我在给我的侄子劳伦斯找礼物。

en: Hi.
cn: 您好。

en: Do you have anything in mind?
cn: 您有什么想法吗？

en: I'm not sure.
cn: 我不太确定。

en: No.
cn: 没有。

en: Do you know what boys aged around 10 typically like?
cn: 您知道10岁左右的男孩通常喜欢什么吗？

en: For that age group, our biggest seller this year has been this action figure.
cn: 对于这个年龄段的孩子，我们今年最畅销的是这款动作人偶。

en: It's called Bobo Man, and it's incredibly popular.
cn: 它叫波波侠，非常受欢迎。

en: Does it do anything?
cn: 它有什么功能吗？

en: Not by itself.
cn: 本身没什么功能。

en: It has no batteries, if that's what you mean.
cn: 如果您是问这个的话，它不用电池。

en: There's a Bobo Man cartoon popular amongst young children, you see.
cn: 您知道，有一部叫《波波侠》的卡通片在小孩子中间很受欢迎。

en: And this toy is the lead character from the show.
cn: 这个玩具就是这部动画片里的主角。

en: Oh, I understand now.
cn: 哦，我现在明白了。

en: I've never heard of it, but I do know little Lawrence loves cartoons.
cn: 我从没听说过这个，但我知道小劳伦斯很喜欢卡通片。

en: Do you have any other popular toys, perhaps something educational?
cn: 你们还有其他受欢迎的玩具吗，比如有教育意义的？

en: Yes, of course.
cn: 当然有。

en: Right over here, we have dozens of puzzles for children of all ages.
cn: 就在这边，我们有几十种适合各个年龄段孩子的拼图。

en: They are fun, great for exercising the mind and can be played either alone or in groups.
cn: 它们很有趣，对锻炼思维很有好处，而且既可以一个人玩，也可以几个人一起玩。

en: I like this sort of idea.
cn: 我喜欢这种想法。

en: Lawrence has a sister who is slightly older, so maybe a game that they can play together would be good.
cn: 劳伦斯有个姐姐，年纪稍大一点，所以或许一个他们可以一起玩的游戏会不错。

en: What do you think of battleships then?
cn: 那您觉得战舰游戏怎么样？

en: It's a total classic.
cn: 这绝对是经典款。

en: It has been around since the 1930s.
cn: 从20世纪30年代就有了。

en: Oh yeah.
cn: 哦，是啊。

en: We had one of those when growing up.
cn: 我们小时候就有一个。

en: Of course you did.
cn: 您当然有过了。

en: Everyone did.
cn: 每个人都有过。

en: And kids enjoy it just as much today as you and I did when we were young.
cn: 现在的孩子和我们小时候一样喜欢玩这个。

en: Some games just never get old.
cn: 有些游戏永远不会过时。

en: I suppose you are right.
cn: 我想您说得对。

en: I have fond memories playing battleships when it was raining outside, and we had to stay indoors.
cn: 我还记得小时候外面下雨，我们不得不待在屋里玩战舰游戏的美好回忆。

en: That's decided then.
cn: 那就定这个了。

en: How much?
cn: 多少钱？

en: 19 pounds and 90 pence, please.
cn: 19英镑90便士。

en: There you are.
cn: 给您。

en: Have a nice day.
cn: 祝您今天愉快。

en: Thank you.
cn: 谢谢。

en: You too.
cn: 也祝您愉快。

en: We assume that if we offer our customers more choices, then they'll be more likely to buy our products.
cn: 我们假设，如果给客户提供更多选择，他们就更有可能购买我们的产品。

en: But here's the paradox of choice.
cn: 但这就涉及到选择的悖论。

en: If a person is presented with too many choices, they are actually less likely to buy.
cn: 如果给一个人提供的选择过多，他们实际上购买的可能性反而会降低。

en: In 2012, psychologists published a study about jams.
cn: 2012年，心理学家发表了一项关于果酱的研究。

en: On a regular day at a local food market, people would find a display table with 24 different kinds of jams.
cn: 在当地一家食品市场的平常日子里，人们会看到一个展示台，上面摆放着24种不同的果酱。

en: Then on another day, at that same food market, people were given only 6 different types of jam choices.
cn: 后来在同一天市场的另一天，只给人们提供6种不同的果酱选择。

en: Guess which display table led to more sales?
cn: 猜猜哪个展示台带来了更多的销售额？

en: The study found that while the bigger display table created more interest, people were almost 10 times less likely to purchase a jar of jam than in the case of the smaller display.
cn: 研究发现，虽然更大的展示台引发了更多关注，但人们购买果酱的可能性几乎是小展示台情况下的十分之一。

en: Customer satisfaction takes a hit as well.
cn: 客户满意度也受到了影响。

en: In the study, the bigger display of jams leads to lower customer satisfaction than the smaller display.
cn: 研究中，更大的果酱展示台比小展示台带来的客户满意度更低。

en: In an extensive study published in 2015, researchers analyzed a total of 99 choice studies and specifically looked at those cases in which reducing choices helped to boost sales.
cn: 在2015年发表的一项广泛研究中，研究人员分析了总共99项关于选择的研究，特别关注了那些通过减少选择来促进销售的案例。

en: They found four rules that motivate consumers to buy—when people want to make a quick and easy choice, when the product is complex, when it's difficult to compare alternatives, and when consumers don't have clear preferences.
cn: 他们发现了四个能促使消费者购买的规则：当人们想快速轻松地做出选择时、当产品很复杂时、当难以比较替代品时，以及当消费者没有明确偏好时。

en: So as you can see, when it comes to choices, less is more.
cn: 所以你可以看出，在选择方面，少即是多。

en: The New Year has come and gone, and many may have already forgotten what they had resolved to do on January 1st.
cn: 新年来了又走了，很多人或许已经忘记了自己在1月1日许下的决心。

en: But if that resolution was to volunteer more, now is the best time to start.
cn: 但如果那个决心是多做志愿服务，那么现在就是开始的最佳时机。

en: Volunteering can drop after the holiday season, and by February, some organizations lack the volunteers they had in surplus just a month ago.
cn: 假期过后，志愿服务的参与度可能会下降，到了2月，一些组织的志愿者数量就会比一个月前充裕的时候有所短缺。

en: According to one survey, only 26% of Americans volunteer, despite reports that many Americans view volunteering as worthwhile.
cn: 一项调查显示，只有26%的美国人参与志愿服务，尽管有报道称很多美国人认为志愿服务是有价值的。

en: Why such a disconnect?
cn: 为什么会存在这样的脱节呢？

en: Most people cite time and conflicting work schedules as major barriers, but employees and employers would actually benefit if companies made employee volunteering part of the job.
cn: 大多数人认为时间和冲突的工作安排是主要障碍，但如果公司能将员工志愿服务纳入工作范畴，员工和雇主其实都会从中受益。

en: Researchers have found donating our time and talent to others can lower blood pressure, boost happiness and improve mental and physical health.
cn: 研究人员发现，把自己的时间和才能奉献给他人有助于降低血压、提升幸福感，并改善身心健康。

en: Studies have also linked employee volunteer programs with more productive employees.
cn: 研究还表明，员工志愿项目能让员工的工作效率更高。

en: With so much emphasis on employee wellness these days, company volunteer programs could be the perfect 2025 resolution.
cn: 如今，人们非常重视员工的健康，公司志愿项目或许会成为2025年的完美决心。

en: But for volunteering to benefit employees and the workplace, the entire organization needs to be involved.
cn: 但要让志愿服务给员工和工作场所带来益处，就需要整个组织都参与进来。

en: By allowing employees to donate their time during work hours, the workplace becomes an outlet for personal fulfillment without affecting personal time.
cn: 允许员工在工作时间投身志愿服务，能让工作场所成为实现个人价值的渠道，同时又不会影响个人时间。

en: In one survey, 89% of employees perceived companies that sponsored volunteer activities as creating a better working environment, and 75% said volunteering was critical to their well-being.
cn: 在一项调查中，89%的员工认为赞助志愿活动的公司能创造更好的工作环境，75%的员工表示志愿服务对他们的幸福安康至关重要。

en: The vast majority of the UK's 200,000 tons of retail sector's annual food waste comes from supermarkets, but it's a problem that impacts independent luxury food suppliers, too.
cn: 英国零售业每年20万吨的食品浪费中，绝大多数来自超市，但这一问题也影响着独立的高档食品供应商。

en: The scale is small.
cn: 规模虽小。

en: It's estimated at less than 1% of the UK's food waste total, but the quality from these suppliers is high.
cn: 据估计不到英国食品浪费总量的1%，但这些供应商产生的浪费食品质量很高。

en: Everything from specialist cheeses to sought-after coffee beans gets thrown away every day in the current food system.
cn: 在当前的食品体系中，从特制奶酪到备受追捧的咖啡豆，各类高档食品每天都在被丢弃。

en: This is where French entrepreneur, Sophie André, comes in.
cn: 这正是法国企业家索菲·安德烈发挥作用的地方。

en: In 2016, she moved to London and began by setting up a business, delivering luxury hand-made food across the city.
cn: 2016年，她搬到伦敦，最初创办了一家企业，在全市范围内配送高档手工食品。

en: "Food delivery seems to be a big thing here," she says, "So I started delivering products by bicycle.
cn: "食品配送在这里似乎是件大事，"她说，"所以我开始骑自行车配送产品。

en: Talking with local producers, I learned that a small part of the production is sometimes wasted due to problems with size or shape, but the quality of the products remains unchanged."
cn: 在与当地生产商交流时，我了解到，由于大小或形状问题，生产过程中总会有一小部分产品被浪费，但产品质量并未改变。"

en: Unlike many food waste projects that have sprung up in recent years, the idea is not simply to redistribute waste food, but to provide a high-quality product.
cn: 与近年来涌现的许多食品浪费处理项目不同，这个理念并非简单地重新分配废弃食品，而是提供高品质的产品。

en: André's company, Elysia, offers breakfasts and snacks specifically aimed at business meetings and events.
cn: 安德烈的公司Elysia专门为商务会议和活动提供早餐及零食。

en: Once sourced, Elysia uses waste products to create simple, natural, straightforward meals and snacks.
cn: Elysia采购到这些废弃食材后，会用它们制作简单、天然、朴实的餐食和零食。

en: Perhaps unlike other waste food, the supply is regular.
cn: 或许与其他废弃食品不同，这里的供应很稳定。

en: Suppliers will always have a certain amount of surplus.
cn: 供应商总会有一定量的过剩产品。

en: So the menus remain regular, too.
cn: 因此菜单也保持固定。

en: André believes this benefits both her business and her customers.
cn: 安德烈认为，这对她的企业和客户都有好处。

en: A terrified cat has survived a 5-mile round trip under the engine cover of a car on a school run.
cn: 一只受惊的猫在一次上学接送途中，藏在汽车引擎盖下完成了5英里的往返旅程，最终幸存了下来。

en: The black cat was found curled up under the engine cover of David King's car when he decided to do an oil check after dropping his grandson off at school in Kent.
cn: 这只黑猫是在肯特郡，大卫·金送孙子到学校后决定检查机油时，被发现在他的汽车引擎盖下蜷缩着。

en: Mister King's wife said her husband had come running in, and was shouting for me to come have a look.
cn: 金先生的妻子说，她丈夫跑进来，大喊着让她过去看看。

en: "We weren't even sure it was alive, so I gently pushed it with a stick to check it was breathing, and saw it was a terrified little cat.
cn: "我们甚至不确定它还活着，所以我用一根棍子轻轻推了推它，检查它是否还有呼吸，然后发现那是一只吓坏了的小猫。

en: It reversed even further into the engine and was stuck.
cn: 它往引擎更深处退去，结果卡住了。

en: I tried to reach it, but it was too far down, and there wasn't any way I could get it out."
cn: 我试着去够它，但它藏得太深了，我根本没办法把它弄出来。"

en: Following a rescue by UK charity Cats Protection, the 4-year-old cat was later reunited with its owner, Mr King's neighbor.
cn: 在英国慈善机构"猫咪保护协会"的救助下，这只4岁的猫后来与它的主人——金先生的邻居团聚了。

en: In less than a month, the Special Olympic Spring Games will make a return to Fayetteville.
cn: 不到一个月，特奥春季运动会将重返费耶特维尔。

en: The games are coming back for the first time in five years.
cn: 这是该运动会五年来的首次回归。

en: The event will take place at Methodist University.
cn: 赛事将在卫理公会大学举行。

en: Event organizer Benjamin Kowalczyk says he's excited that athletes will get a chance to come back and demonstrate their abilities.
cn: 赛事组织者本杰明·科瓦尔奇克表示，他很高兴运动员们能有机会回来展示自己的能力。

en: Organizers expect about 100 athletes will come out to compete in Fayetteville.
cn: 组织者预计约有100名运动员将前来费耶特维尔参赛。

en: They will have a variety of events to choose from, including running, throwing, and jumping.
cn: 他们将有多种项目可供选择，包括跑步、投掷和跳跃。

en: There will also be a fun tent for children.
cn: 此外，还将为孩子们设立一个趣味帐篷。

en: Kowalczyk said it's rewarding to see athletes with special needs triumph in the games.
cn: 科瓦尔奇克说，看到有特殊需求的运动员在比赛中取得胜利，这是很有意义的事。

en: For anyone who wants to help make this year's games a massive success, there are still opportunities to volunteer for Fayetteville's Special Olympics.
cn: 对于任何想助力今年赛事取得巨大成功的人来说，目前仍有机会成为费耶特维尔特奥会的志愿者。

en: Organizers encourage them to visit the game's website to sign up.
cn: 组织者鼓励他们访问赛事官网进行报名。

en: A German supermarket has been ordered to destroy its chocolate rabbits after it lost a court battle with a Swiss chocolate manufacturer.
cn: 一家德国超市在与一家瑞士巧克力制造商的法庭纠纷中败诉，被勒令销毁其销售的巧克力兔子。

en: The Swiss firm had argued its gold-wrapped chocolate rabbit deserved copyright protection from a similar product sold by the budget supermarket.
cn: 这家瑞士公司称，其金色包装的巧克力兔子应受版权保护，以防止这家平价超市销售类似产品。

en: Switzerland's highest court agreed, and overturned a ruling last year by the country's commercial court that had sided with the supermarket.
cn: 瑞士最高法院表示认同，并推翻了该国商事法院去年作出的支持该超市的裁决。

en: It ordered that all the imitation rabbits be destroyed, but suggested the chocolate needn't be wasted—it could be melted for use in other products.
cn: 最高法院下令销毁所有仿冒的巧克力兔子，但建议不必浪费巧克力——这些巧克力可以熔化后用于其他产品。

en: It said even though there are some differences between the two products, there was still the possibility of confusion for consumers.
cn: 法院称，尽管这两款产品存在一些差异，但仍有可能让消费者产生混淆。

en: The Swiss manufacturer's rabbit has a red bow and bell, while the German supermarket's has a green bow and bell.
cn: 这家瑞士制造商的巧克力兔子系着红色的蝴蝶结和铃铛，而德国超市的巧克力兔子则系着绿色的蝴蝶结和铃铛。

en: The color of the wrapper is similar, as are the illustrations of the features.
cn: 不过，两者的包装颜色相似，外观图案也相近。

en: The chocolate company has been to court before to protect its popular chocolate treat.
cn: 这家巧克力公司此前就曾为保护其广受欢迎的巧克力产品而诉诸法庭。

en: Last year, a German federal court said the shade of the gold wrapping was also protected.
cn: 去年，德国联邦法院称，金色包装的色调也受保护。

en: Can you please hand me that book over there?
cn: 你能把那边那本书递给我吗？

en: It has instructions for making a winter bean salad.
cn: 那本书上有冬季豆类沙拉的做法说明。

en: My sister's boyfriend is coming over for dinner.
cn: 我妹妹的男朋友要来家里吃晚饭。

en: He's vegetarian, so I need to make a lot of vegetable dishes.
cn: 他是素食主义者，所以我需要做很多素菜。

en: He only eats vegetables, no meat?
cn: 他只吃蔬菜，不吃肉吗？

en: That doesn't sound like a very balanced diet.
cn: 这听起来不像是很均衡的饮食啊。

en: How can he get enough protein?
cn: 他怎么获取足够的蛋白质呢？

en: What does he do to strengthen his muscles and all that?
cn: 他是怎么增强肌肉之类的呢？

en: Apparently, that's no problem.
cn: 显然，这不成问题。

en: He's explained this to me when we first met.
cn: 我们第一次见面的时候，他就跟我解释过了。

en: He eats a variety of different vegetables and nuts, especially those with high amounts of protein.
cn: 他吃各种各样的蔬菜和坚果，尤其是那些蛋白质含量高的。

en: It sounds a bit difficult, but he's done his research, I suppose.
cn: 听起来有点难，但我想他肯定做过研究。

en: What's his reasoning for being vegetarian?
cn: 他吃素的原因是什么呢？

en: Is it his religion, health condition or lifestyle?
cn: 是因为宗教信仰、健康状况还是生活方式？

en: He's an animal activist.
cn: 他是一名动物保护活动家。

en: He's always been very sensitive and sympathizes with animals.
cn: 他一直都很有同情心，很同情动物。

en: He's even written to his state senator about the torture of dolphins in sea parks.
cn: 他甚至还写信给州参议员，反映海洋公园里海豚遭受虐待的情况。

en: He says that keeping animals in zoos and parks causes them great distress.
cn: 他说把动物关在动物园和公园里会给它们带来极大的痛苦。

en: That's a little gloomy, but I can understand that to a point.
cn: 这听起来有点让人难受，但在某种程度上我能理解。

en: Not all zoos and animal parks have the most favorable conditions.
cn: 并不是所有的动物园和动物公园都有最理想的条件。

en: But without them, it just wouldn't be feasible to learn about animals and their environments.
cn: 但如果没有它们，想要了解动物及其生存环境就不太现实了。

en: Besides, I don't think I could ever give up a good hot dog at a baseball game.
cn: 此外，我觉得我永远都放不下棒球赛上的美味热狗。

en: Honestly, I agree, but just don't let him hear you say that.
cn: 说实话，我同意你的看法，但别让他听到你这么说。

en: He's the spokesperson for his local animal rights group.
cn: 他是当地动物权利组织的发言人。

en: Did you see that television program on air travel last night?
cn: 你昨晚看那个关于航空旅行的电视节目了吗？

en: Yes, the part about overcoming jet lag was interesting.
cn: 看了，关于克服时差反应的部分很有意思。

en: I was surprised that the expert recommended not eating for the entire journey and avoiding sleeping on the plane.
cn: 我很惊讶专家建议在整个旅程中不要吃东西，并且不要在飞机上睡觉。

en: I was too, as I read an article on the subject in the past that suggested the opposite.
cn: 我也是，因为我过去读过一篇关于这个话题的文章，说法正好相反。

en: It claimed that it was important not to miss meals and that taking a nap on the plane was the best way to adjust to a new time zone.
cn: 那篇文章称，不要错过正餐很重要，而且在飞机上小睡一会儿是适应新时区的最佳方法。

en: Well, the expert on the show did cite research supporting her recommendations.
cn: 嗯，节目里的专家确实引用了研究来支持她的建议。

en: So, I guess I'll give it a try next time I fly a long distance.
cn: 所以，我想下次长途飞行时我会试试。

en: Jet lag is a big problem for me, and has been for the last few years, even though I never suffered from it before.
cn: 时差对我来说是个大问题，过去几年一直都是，尽管我以前从未受此困扰。

en: Well, she did say that jet lag often becomes more of a problem after 40.
cn: 嗯，她确实说过40岁以后，时差问题往往会变得更严重。

en: So, I guess I'm lucky that I can still adjust to different time zones well.
cn: 所以，我想我很幸运，还能很好地适应不同的时区。

en: My problem is I'm afraid to fly.
cn: 我的问题是我害怕坐飞机。

en: Oh, I didn't know that.
cn: 哦，我以前不知道。

en: Actually, my mother is terrified of airplanes to the point where she can't even fly.
cn: 其实，我妈妈特别怕飞机，到了根本不能坐飞机的地步。

en: So our family vacations were always by car or train.
cn: 所以我们家的假期总是开车或乘火车出行。

en: I'm not as bad as that, I just get anxious before I fly, and feel nervous the whole time we're in the air.
cn: 我没那么严重，我只是在坐飞机前会焦虑，而且在飞行过程中全程都感到紧张。

en: Which is why I was hoping the television program would cover that topic more than it did.
cn: 这就是为什么我希望那个电视节目能更多地报道这个话题。

en: Yeah, that segment was too brief, especially as so many people have that problem.
cn: 是啊，那部分太简短了，尤其是有这么多人都有这个问题。

en: She said 20 percent of people are afraid to fly.
cn: 她说有20%的人害怕坐飞机。

en: Actually, it was a quarter of people.
cn: 实际上，是四分之一的人。

en: So the problem really is widespread and deserves attention.
cn: 所以这个问题确实很普遍，值得关注。

en: The most common question I'm asked always centers around how to get started in user experience design.
cn: 我被问到的最常见的问题总是围绕着如何开始从事用户体验设计。

en: To which my response is always that nothing can substitute real world experience.
cn: 对此，我的回答始终是，没有什么能替代现实世界的经验。

en: Building the skills required of a user experience designer takes time, patience, and commitment.
cn: 培养用户体验设计师所需的技能需要时间、耐心和投入。

en: Higher education is a great way to equip yourself with some core skills, but it will not prepare you for actual challenges you'll face with client's work.
cn: 高等教育是让自己掌握一些核心技能的好方法，但它无法让你为在客户工作中将要面临的实际挑战做好准备。

en: In other words, being proficient with a design tool and a few methods doesn't make you a user experience designer.
cn: 换句话说，熟练使用一种设计工具和几种方法并不意味着你就是一名用户体验设计师。

en: That simply isn't a one size fits all process.
cn: 这根本不是一个"一刀切"的过程。

en: Being effective requires adaptability—something you don't really learn in school, much less in a 6-month training camp.
cn: 要想高效工作，就需要具备适应能力，而这种能力在学校里是学不到的，更不用说在一个为期六个月的训练营里了。

en: It's gained through experience on the job, and learning what's appropriate given the needs of the project.
cn: 这种能力是通过工作中的经验以及根据项目需求了解什么是合适的做法而获得的。

en: I found my way to user experience through graphic design, and slowly, over many different roles and experiences, that led me to become a user experience designer.
cn: 我是通过平面设计进入用户体验领域的，慢慢地，在经历了许多不同的角色和体验后，我成为了一名用户体验设计师。

en: It took time and commitment to continue to pursue roles within teams that I knew could teach and challenge me.
cn: 我花了时间和精力，不断在那些我知道能给我带来教导和挑战的团队中寻求职位。

en: That's not to say that I think my path is the only one.
cn: 这并不是说我认为我的道路是唯一的。

en: But once again, nothing can substitute real world experience.
cn: 但再强调一次，没有什么能替代现实世界的经验。

en: You can start anywhere, as long as you know your end goal, and you commit to actively pursuing opportunities to learn and grow along the way.
cn: 你可以从任何地方开始，只要你知道自己的最终目标，并且致力于在这个过程中积极寻求学习和成长的机会。

en: When planning for this year, our principal asked what needed to change to engage students more in their learning.
cn: 在规划今年的工作时，校长问需要做出哪些改变才能让学生更投入到学习中。

en: I responded in a whisper: Flexible seating.
cn: 我小声回答：灵活的座位安排。

en: Thinking about our then current classroom.
cn: 回想我们当时的教室。

en: It had rows of desks with blue chairs and name plates, reminding each student where they should be sitting.
cn: 里面是一排排配有蓝色椅子和姓名牌的课桌，这时刻提醒着每个学生他们应该坐在哪里。

en: This began a journey to transform our practice and challenge the ways of learning for a group of Year 6 students used to sitting in desks and rows for years.
cn: 这开启了一段改变我们教学实践的旅程，也挑战了一群六年级学生多年来习惯于坐在成排课桌前的学习方式。

en: Flexible seating has been defined as movable furniture to create an engaging learning environment.
cn: 灵活的座位安排被定义为通过可移动的家具来创造一个有吸引力的学习环境。

en: It is a shift in practice from being teacher focused to student focused learning.
cn: 这是一种教学实践上的转变，从以教师为中心转向以学生为中心的学习。

en: For us, flexible seating has meant removing most of the traditional chairs and desks, and introducing a variety of different seating options to promote student engagement.
cn: 对我们来说，灵活的座位安排意味着移除大部分传统的椅子和课桌，引入各种不同的座位选择，以促进学生的参与度。

en: The use of rows and their minimal adaptations to U shape were traditionally intended to maximize on-task behavior, and reduce distraction from the teacher.
cn: 传统上，采用成排的座位安排以及将其稍作调整为U形，目的是最大限度地提高学生的专注度，减少对教师的干扰。

en: Teachers tend to still use this format because of either the need to control students or the belief that the teacher is the most important person in the room.
cn: 教师们倾向于仍然使用这种形式，要么是因为需要控制学生，要么是认为教师是教室里最重要的人。

en: Now, our students have a range of different seating options, including a floor desk, couches, stools, bean bags, and the traditional desk and chair.
cn: 现在，我们的学生有了一系列不同的座位选择，包括地板课桌、沙发、高脚凳、豆袋椅，以及传统的课桌和椅子。

en: From our experience so far, flexible seating enhances student ownership of space and engagement in learning, while reducing rates of student disengagement and disciplinary actions.
cn: 从我们目前的经验来看，灵活的座位安排增强了学生对空间的归属感和学习参与度，同时降低了学生的不投入率和纪律处分率。

en: It is a win for all concerned.
cn: 这对所有相关人员来说都是一件好事。

en: Dozens of British students arriving for their first day of school on Tuesday were sent home over their shoes.
cn: 周二，数十名英国学生在开学第一天因鞋子问题被遣送回家。

en: About 30 students were turned away from Tavaram High School in Norfolk, England.
cn: 英国诺福克郡的塔瓦拉姆高中约有30名学生被拒之门外。

en: Head teacher, Dr Roger Harris confirmed that this was due to a change in the school's uniform policy.
cn: 校长罗杰·哈里斯博士证实，这是由于学校校服政策发生了变化。

en: Harris, who became head teacher this year, said he notified parents of the updated rules in an email in June.
cn: 今年刚担任校长的哈里斯表示，他在6月份就通过电子邮件将更新后的规定通知了家长。

en: The price of school uniforms can spark panic among families struggling with the high cost of living.
cn: 对于那些在高昂生活成本中挣扎的家庭来说，校服的价格可能会引发他们的恐慌。

en: Nearly all British schools have uniforms.
cn: 几乎所有的英国学校都有校服。

en: They cost parents an average of £337 per year for each secondary school child.
cn: 每个中学生的家长每年平均要为此花费337英镑。

en: According to the new rules, students of Tavaram are required to wear smart black shoes appropriate for the workplace.
cn: 根据新规定，塔瓦拉姆高中的学生必须穿着适合职场的得体黑鞋。

en: Harris held that strengthened rules around school uniforms improved student outcomes and behavior.
cn: 哈里斯认为，加强校服相关规定能改善学生的成绩和行为。

en: But for some parents, the school's restrictions are an unnecessary burden.
cn: 但对一些家长来说，学校的这些限制是不必要的负担。

en: As annual inflation climbs over 10%, many households are on tight budgets.
cn: 随着年度通货膨胀率攀升至10%以上，许多家庭的预算都很紧张。

en: Private rental prices in Britain rose 3.2% over the 12 months to July 2022, the largest jump since 2016.
cn: 截至2022年7月的12个月里，英国的私人租金价格上涨了3.2%，这是2016年以来的最大涨幅。

en: Soaring energy bills have made things worse.
cn: 飙升的能源账单让情况雪上加霜。

en: Lucinda May, mum of a Tavaram student, said that she had to ask her parents for £65 to buy her child the correct pair of shoes.
cn: 塔瓦拉姆高中一名学生的母亲露辛达·梅说，她不得不向父母要65英镑给孩子买一双符合规定的鞋子。

en: May said that the school's uniform policy showed a lack of regard for parents dealing with the high cost of living.
cn: 梅表示，学校的校服政策表明其没有考虑到那些正应对高昂生活成本的家长。

en: Customs and Border Protection officials are seeing a rise in people illegally bringing eggs from Mexico into border states such as Texas.
cn: 美国海关和边境保护局官员发现，从墨西哥非法携带鸡蛋进入得克萨斯州等边境州的人数有所增加。

en: The U.S. average price for a dozen large eggs last month hit $4.25.
cn: 上个月，美国一打大鸡蛋的平均价格达到4.25美元。

en: That's more than double their $1.78 price in December 2023.
cn: 这一价格是2023年12月1.78美元的两倍多。

en: Meanwhile, 30 eggs in Mexico sell for just $3.40.
cn: 与此同时，在墨西哥，30个鸡蛋仅售3.40美元。

en: Those bringing eggs into the U.S. risk fines of up to $10,000.
cn: 那些将鸡蛋带入美国的人可能面临高达1万美元的罚款。

en: But officials say they usually seize and destroy the eggs.
cn: 但官员们表示，他们通常会没收并销毁这些鸡蛋。

en: They also impose a $300 penalty.
cn: 还会处以300美元的罚款。

en: The Department of Agriculture banned eggs from Mexico in 2012.
cn: 美国农业部于2012年禁止从墨西哥进口鸡蛋。

en: This was due to the risk of bird flu.
cn: 原因是存在禽流感风险。

en: Officials said most people arriving at international borders with eggs are truthful about their purchases.
cn: 官员们表示，大多数携带鸡蛋抵达国际边境的人都会如实说明自己所购买的物品。

en: They simply don't know bringing eggs is not allowed.
cn: 他们只是不知道携带鸡蛋是不被允许的。

en: "Generally, the items are declared during the first inspection.
cn: 美国海关和边境保护局的一位发言人说："一般来说，这些物品会在第一次检查时申报。

en: Then the person can abandon the eggs without consequence," a Customs and Border Protection spokesperson said.
cn: 然后携带人员可以放弃这些鸡蛋而不会有任何后果。"

en: Even so, there have been a very small number of cases recently when authorities discovered eggs during further inspections.
cn: 即便如此，最近还是有极少数案例中，当局在进一步检查时发现了鸡蛋。

en: Net Ease House, a restaurant in America, has been hit with criticism after announcing on their website that children under the age of ten are no longer welcome.
cn: 美国一家名为"网易之家"的餐厅在其网站上宣布不再接待10岁以下儿童后，遭到了批评。

en: Among the reasons given for the decision, the restaurant cited noise levels, lack of space for highchairs, cleaning up crazy messes, and the liability of kids running around the restaurant.
cn: 该餐厅给出的决策理由包括噪音问题、高脚椅空间不足、清理脏乱的环境以及儿童在餐厅内跑动带来的责任风险。

en: They decided that it was time to take control.
cn: 他们认为时候进行管控了。

en: The decision wasn't made lightly, but some recent events pushed them to implement this new policy.
cn: 这一决定并非草率做出，但近期发生的一些事件促使他们实施这项新政策。

en: Responding to the post, one person commented that it is messed up beyond another level.
cn: 在对该帖子的回复中，有人评论称这一做法太过分了。

en: Children are children.
cn: 孩子终究是孩子。

en: Moms are tired and don't have time to cook.
cn: 妈妈们已经很累了，没时间做饭。

en: Not welcoming children under ten is a complete slap in the face to families.
cn: 不接待10岁以下儿童完全是对家庭的一记耳光。

en: He felt so disappointed in the establishment.
cn: 他对这家餐厅感到非常失望。

en: There are others, however, who showed support for the restaurant's decision.
cn: 然而，也有一些人支持餐厅的这一决定。

en: They said it has the right to implement any rules it wants.
cn: 他们表示，餐厅有权实施任何它想制定的规定。

en: Security officers were searching a suburb in Australia where an adult snake was believed to be wandering after the discovery of a huge, freshly shed snakeskin.
cn: 澳大利亚的一处郊区，有人发现了一张巨大且刚蜕下的蛇皮，据信有一条成年蛇在那里游荡，安保人员正在该地区进行搜寻。

en: The skin was found at a construction site, and the government wrote to residents to warn them.
cn: 这张蛇皮是在一个建筑工地被发现的，政府已致函居民发出警告。

en: They were told to observe and, if possible, photograph the animal.
cn: 居民们接到通知，要留意这条蛇，如有可能就拍下它的照片。

en: If it was moving, watch where it went.
cn: 如果蛇在移动，要观察它的去向。

en: It was recommended not to make contact with the animal.
cn: 同时，政府建议居民不要与这条蛇有接触。

en: The type of snake was determined to be one of the world's largest snake species.
cn: 这条蛇经确认属于世界上体型最大的蛇类之一。

en: It is not poisonous but can still attack and kill its victims.
cn: 它虽然没有毒性，但仍能攻击并杀死猎物。

en: This type of snake is classified as a threat to humans, especially small children as well as pets.
cn: 这种蛇被归类为对人类有威胁的物种，尤其是对小孩和宠物而言。

en: They may carry viruses that are fatal to native snakes, which do not have resistance.
cn: 它们可能携带对本土蛇类致命的病毒，而本土蛇类对此没有抵抗力。

en: "If officers found the snake, they would employ a licensed snake catcher to catch it and transport it to a specialist animal doctor," the government said.
