cn: 政府表示："如果工作人员发现了这条蛇，会聘请有执照的捕蛇人将其捕获，并送往专业的动物医生那里。"

en: "If caught, the snake could be examined to determine where it came from, how long it had been in the area, what it had been eating, whether it was carrying any diseases of concern, and whether it had produced babies."
cn: "一旦捕获，就可以对这条蛇进行检查，以确定它的来源、在该地区待了多久、以什么为食、是否携带任何令人担忧的疾病，以及是否已经产下幼蛇。"

en: Poor Hannah.
cn: 可怜的汉娜。

en: Why?
cn: 为什么这么说？

en: What happened?
cn: 发生什么事了？

en: Didn't you hear?
cn: 你没听说吗？

en: She won a TV competition and became a millionaire overnight.
cn: 她赢了一个电视比赛，一夜之间成了百万富翁。

en: No way!
cn: 不可能吧！

en: That's incredible!
cn: 太不可思议了！

en: Are you kidding?
cn: 你在开玩笑吗？

en: No, I'm serious.
cn: 不，我是认真的。

en: I swear it!
cn: 我发誓！

en: She went on a TV show where they quiz on general knowledge and she won first prize.
cn: 她参加了一个电视节目，节目里会考察常识，她赢得了一等奖。

en: Wow!
cn: 哇！

en: That's so lucky of her.
cn: 她太幸运了。

en: How much did she win?
cn: 她赢了多少？

en: I'm not sure of the exact figure, but it's a few million Euros, maybe five million Euros after tax.
cn: 我不确定具体数字，但有几百万欧元，税后可能有五百万欧元。

en: I can't believe it.
cn: 我简直不敢相信。

en: You are really not joking, are you?
cn: 你真的不是在开玩笑，对吗？

en: Honestly, look at my face.
cn: 说真的，你看我的表情。

en: Our friend Hannah won a ton of money.
cn: 我们的朋友汉娜赢了一大笔钱。

en: Unbelievable.
cn: 太难以置信了。

en: Then why were you saying "poor Hannah"?
cn: 那你为什么说"可怜的汉娜"呢？

en: Well, it turns out that she's spent it all already.
cn: 嗯，结果是她已经把钱全花光了。

en: Five million Euros—how is that even possible?
cn: 五百万欧元——这怎么可能呢？

en: She bought a house for herself and her husband, a house for her parents, and then a house for each of her four brothers and sisters.
cn: 她给自己和丈夫买了一套房子，给她父母买了一套房子，然后给她的四个兄弟姐妹每人都买了一套房子。

en: And then she bought her husband a ridiculously expensive sports car.
cn: 之后她还给丈夫买了一辆贵得离谱的跑车。

en: Wow!
cn: 哇！

en: Are they all happy?
cn: 他们都开心吗？

en: Because that's what matters, isn't it?
cn: 因为这才是重要的，不是吗？

en: I know for a fact Hannah isn't.
cn: 我确切知道汉娜不开心。

en: You see, she was planning to quit the job she hates and retire early.
cn: 你知道，她本来打算辞掉那份她讨厌的工作，早点退休。

en: But now that she ran out of money, she can't.
cn: 但现在她钱花光了，就没法退休了。

en: Basically, she miscalculated how fast she was burning through the money, and she's now full of regret.
cn: 基本上，她算错了自己花钱的速度，现在满心悔恨。

en: Why don't they sell that flashy new car?
cn: 他们为什么不把那辆花哨的新车卖掉呢？

en: She wants to, but her husband refuses to get rid of it.
cn: 她想卖，但她丈夫拒绝扔掉它。

en: He says the car is the best thing that has ever happened to him, and if she sells it, he will divorce her.
cn: 他说这辆车是他这辈子遇到的最好的事情，如果她把车卖了，他就和她离婚。

en: If you have time right now, I think we need to sit down and discuss what exactly we are going to do for Jake's education next year.
cn: 如果你现在有时间，我觉得我们得坐下来讨论一下明年杰克的教育问题，我们到底要怎么做。

en: I've been thinking it over, and I'd like to send him to Westwood Elementary.
cn: 我一直在考虑这件事，我想送他去韦斯特伍德小学。

en: You mean that boarding school?
cn: 你说的是那所寄宿学校吗？

en: I thought we agreed that we would not be sending him away at such a young age.
cn: 我以为我们已经达成一致，不会在他这么小的时候就把他送走。

en: I admit that their academic record is very strong, with many outstanding awards for achievements in Science and Math.
cn: 我承认他们的学术成绩非常出色，在科学和数学领域获得了许多杰出奖项。

en: But he is just not mature enough to live on his own at this point.
cn: 但目前他还不够成熟，无法独立生活。

en: What about enrolling him in Lakeview School?
cn: 让他去湖景学校怎么样？

en: They do have a great outdoor campus where he could finally learn all those outdoor sports you have been wanting him to try.
cn: 湖景学校确实有很棒的户外校园，在那里他终于可以学习所有你一直想让他尝试的户外运动了。

en: With so much greenery and fresh air, I think his current breathing problems would probably disappear.
cn: 那里有那么多绿色植物和新鲜空气，我觉得他现在的呼吸问题可能会消失。

en: They did just open though, so I don't think I feel comfortable having our son in the first class of a brand-new school.
cn: 不过这所学校才刚开学，让我们的儿子成为一所全新学校的第一届学生，我觉得不太放心。

en: Yeah, the classrooms would probably smell like paint, making the air in the school all stuffy.
cn: 是啊，教室可能还散发着油漆味，会让学校里的空气很闷。

en: What about our local school then?
cn: 那我们当地的学校呢？

en: They have a wonderful arts program that would really challenge Jake in terms of creativity and imagination.
cn: 他们有很棒的艺术课程，能真正激发杰克的创造力和想象力。

en: Being practically next door, one of us could take him to school every day before going to work.
cn: 学校就在隔壁，我们中的一个人每天上班前都可以送他去学校。

en: I don't know.
cn: 我不知道。

en: They have a reputation of being overly strict with the students.
cn: 听说他们对学生过于严格。

en: Not to mention the overwhelming amount of homework they assign, which would lead to a lot of pressure for Jake and me.
cn: 更不用说他们布置的海量作业了，这会给杰克和我带来很大的压力。

en: What if we send him to the place near your mother's house?
cn: 我们把他送到你妈妈家附近的那所学校怎么样？

en: Analytical decision-making is a decision-making approach where a manager makes important business decisions only with solid data.
cn: 分析型决策是一种决策方法，管理者仅依据可靠数据来制定重要的商业决策。

en: This style contrasts with more instinctive leadership styles where managers make many decisions using instinct or opinion.
cn: 这种风格与更依赖直觉的领导风格形成对比，在后者中，管理者会凭借直觉或个人观点做出许多决策。

en: While analytical decision-makers benefit from a deliberate, thoughtful approach, this style also has some shortcomings.
cn: 虽然分析型决策者能从深思熟虑、周全细致的方法中获益，但这种风格也存在一些缺点。

en: A key flaw with analytical decision-making is that it takes time.
cn: 分析型决策的一个关键缺陷是耗时。

en: While this approach is beneficial when you have the time and the decision is important, it is problematic when time is crucial.
cn: 当你有充足时间且决策至关重要时，这种方法会很有益处，但在时间紧迫的情况下，它就成了问题。

en: Analytical decision-makers struggle with deadlines and a sense of urgency with decisions.
cn: 分析型决策者难以应对截止日期和决策的紧迫感。

en: In situations where you need more timely action, decisions based on some information and instinct may work better.
cn: 在需要更及时行动的情况下，基于部分信息和直觉做出的决策可能效果更好。

en: The desire to be right is a major driver of analytical decision-making.
cn: 追求正确是分析型决策的一个主要驱动力。

en: Leaders who use this style don't want to make mistakes.
cn: 采用这种风格的领导者不希望犯错。

en: This commitment to one right way of thinking or doing things hinders the manager's flexibility.
cn: 这种对单一正确思维方式或行事方式的执着，会阻碍管理者的灵活性。

en: Inflexibility causes you to ignore or avoid listening to the thoughts and ideas of others.
cn: 缺乏灵活性会导致你忽视或不愿听取他人的想法和观点。

en: You only want to utilize hard data or facts.
cn: 只愿意利用确凿的数据或事实。

en: Despite its restrictions, analytical decision-making does have several key strengths.
cn: 尽管存在局限性，分析型决策确实有几个关键优势。

en: By relying on facts and data, you minimize your potential for a wrong decision.
cn: 通过依赖事实和数据，你可以将做出错误决策的可能性降到最低。

en: You also get away from the habit of making guesses or following instincts.
cn: 还能摆脱猜测或凭直觉行事的习惯。

en: Database technology enables business leaders to look to hard evidence in analyzing target markets and promotional strategies rather than making assumptions or guesses on what works.
cn: 数据库技术使企业领导者能够在分析目标市场和促销策略时依据确凿证据，而非对有效方法进行假设或猜测。

en: What is the secret to living past 100?
cn: 活到100岁以上的秘诀是什么？

en: Playing the piano is among the things the world's oldest person believes has contributed to her long life.
cn: 世界上最长寿的人认为，弹钢琴是有助于她长寿的因素之一。

en: Branyas Morera is now 115 years and 320 days old.
cn: 布兰亚斯·莫雷拉现在115岁零320天。

en: That means she's been alive longer than any other living individual.
cn: 这意味着她比其他任何在世的人都活得久。

en: Branyas was born in the United States on April 4, 1907, but her family moved to Spain, where they were originally from when she was a young child.
cn: 布兰亚斯1907年4月4日出生于美国，但在她年幼时，家人搬到了他们的原籍国西班牙。

en: She has lived there ever since.
cn: 从那以后，她就一直住在那里。

en: The 115-year-old is active on social media, regularly sharing aspects of her life.
cn: 这位115岁的老人活跃在社交媒体上，定期分享自己生活的方方面面。

en: She also shares some of her secrets to living so long.
cn: 她还分享了一些自己长寿的秘诀。

en: These include playing the piano from a young age.
cn: 其中包括从小弹钢琴。

en: Unfortunately, she had to give up the practice seven years ago at 108.
cn: 不幸的是，七年前，108岁的她不得不放弃了这项爱好。

en: Her other secrets for living a long life?
cn: 她其他的长寿秘诀呢？

en: She led an active lifestyle until her later years but has never followed a specific diet.
cn: 她直到晚年都保持着积极的生活方式，但从未遵循过特定的饮食。

en: "Many people ask me what diet I follow to live so many years," Branyas wrote.
cn: "很多人问我，为了活这么多年，我遵循什么样的饮食，"布兰亚斯写道。

en: "I have always eaten little, but everything, and I have never followed any plan."
cn: "我一直吃得很少，但什么都吃，而且从未遵循过任何计划。"

en: But she does eat yogurt every day, which she said has "an infinite number of positive properties" for the body.
cn: 不过，她确实每天都吃酸奶，她说酸奶对身体有"无数的益处"。

en: She has also said that the secret to a long life is "knowing how to choose" what to forget.
cn: 她还说，长寿的秘诀是"知道如何选择"该忘记什么。

en: "Life would be impossible if we remembered everything," she said.
cn: "如果我们什么都记得，生活就不可能继续了。"她说。

en: It's the first day of school, and your teacher tells you to find a seat in the classroom.
cn: 今天是开学第一天，老师让你在教室里找个座位坐下。

en: Where do you sit?
cn: 你会坐在哪里呢？

en: Does it matter?
cn: 这有什么关系吗？

en: Yes!
cn: 有关系！

en: It does matter where you sit in your classroom, so choose and choose carefully!
cn: 在教室里坐哪里确实很重要，所以要谨慎选择！

en: Studies report that where you sit in the classroom can impact your ability to learn and the way your teacher perceives you.
cn: 研究表明，你在教室里的座位会影响你的学习能力以及老师对你的看法。

en: Guess what else?
cn: 你猜还有什么会受影响？

en: Your grade!
cn: 你的成绩！

en: Then, what is the best seat in the classroom?
cn: 那么，教室里最好的座位是哪里呢？

en: In one study, students who sat in the front and center of the classroom received a higher grade average and scored higher on tests than those sitting towards the back of the classroom.
cn: 在一项研究中，坐在教室前排中间的学生平均分更高，考试得分也比坐在教室后排的学生高。

en: Get this!
cn: 告诉你哦！

en: Students sitting in the middle of the classroom also outscored students sitting behind them.
cn: 坐在教室中间的学生得分也比坐在他们后面的学生高。

en: This study gathered that students had a clearer vision of the blackboard, and were able to focus more attention on the instructor.
cn: 这项研究发现，这些学生能更清楚地看到黑板，也能更专注于老师讲课。

en: By sitting front and center, students were able to hear better too.
cn: 坐在前排中间，学生们也能听得更清楚。

en: The instructors said that they also formed a better connection with the students who sat in front.
cn: 老师们表示，他们与坐在前排的学生也能建立更好的联系。

en: Perhaps the connection is made because of eye contact and visibility and more interaction.
cn: 或许这种联系的建立是因为有眼神交流、能清楚看到对方以及更多的互动。

en: But when you sit in the front row, you may be called on more by your teacher, mainly due to the fact that you are easier to see.
cn: 但如果你坐在第一排，可能会更频繁地被老师点名，主要是因为老师更容易看到你。

en: So, for students who are not prepared and for those who are extremely shy, the attention could cause some unwanted stress.
cn: 所以，对于那些没做好准备的学生以及非常害羞的学生来说，这种关注可能会带来一些不必要的压力。
